article: Life Among the Paiutes is an 1882 autobiographical narrative by Sarah Winnemucca Hopkins. In the work, Winnemucca creates suspense by emphasizing her physical response to an event, writing _____
stem: Which quotation from Life Among the Paiutes most effectively illustrates the claim?

options.content: “Oh, how my heart jumped when I heard a noise close by. It was a horse running towards us. We had to lie down close to the ground. It came close to us and stopped. Oh, how my heart beat! I thought whoever it was would hear my heart beat.”
“Oh, how happy everybody was! One could hear laughter everywhere, and songs were sung by happy women and children.”

“Late in that fall, there came news that my grandfather was on his way home. Then my father took a great many of his men and went to meet his father, and there came back a runner, saying, that all our people must come together.”

“That same fall, after my grandfather came home, he told my father to take charge of his people and hold the tribe, as he was going back to California with as many of his people as he could get to go with him.”

## 题目类型说明

这是细节理解题，核心任务是找到最能体现“通过强调身体反应来制造悬念”的原文引用。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Life Among the Paiutes is an 1882 autobiographical narrative by Sarah Winnemucca Hopkins.

👉 介绍作品及作者。

**第2句：**
> In the work, Winnemucca creates suspense by emphasizing her physical response to an event, writing _____

👉 说明作品中制造悬念的手法是通过强调身体反应。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                         |
|:---------|:----------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍作品及作者               |
| 第二句   | 说明通过身体反应制造悬念的写作手法 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅（正确）
> “Oh, how my heart jumped when I heard a noise close by. It was a horse running towards us. We had to lie down close to the ground. It came close to us and stopped. Oh, how my heart beat! I thought whoever it was would hear my heart beat.”

该选项详细描写了作者心跳加速、害怕的身体反应，直接体现了题干中“强调身体反应制造悬念”的描述，符合题意。

**B 选项** ❌（错误）【方向相反】
> “Oh, how happy everybody was! One could hear laughter everywhere, and songs were sung by happy women and children.”

描写的是欢乐场景，没有体现身体反应，也没有制造悬念，与题干要求方向相反。

**C 选项** ❌（错误）【无中生有】
> “Late in that fall, there came news that my grandfather was on his way home. Then my father took a great many of his men and went to meet his father, and there came back a runner, saying, that all our people must come together.”

描述事件进展，没有体现身体反应或制造悬念，超出题干范围。

**D 选项** ❌（错误）【无中生有】
> “That same fall, after my grandfather came home, he told my father to take charge of his people and hold the tribe, as he was going back to California with as many of his people as he could get to go with him.”

叙述具体事件，没有涉及身体反应或悬念，内容与题干要求不符。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关注题干中的关键词“emphasizing her physical response”（强调身体反应）和“creates suspense”（制造悬念），锁定选项中描述身体反应细节的句子，如“heart jumped”、“heart beat”，排除只描述情绪、事件进展的选项，从而准确选出体现悬念的A选项。

article: A student is writing an essay on the subject of cultured meat, which is grown in a laboratory and is intended to help reduce the number of livestock harvested for food. The student wishes to make the case that people have mixed feelings about cultured meat that may be a barrier to its worldwide adoption.
stem: Which quotation from a publication by a researcher would most effectively support the student's claim?

options.content: "Many consumers who were surveyed believed that cultured meat would be good for the environment if widely available, but few of those same consumers were willing to try eating cultured meat themselves."
"Consumers tend to believe that using less packaging when selling meat products in stores would have a significant effect on the environment."
"Advocates of lab-grown meat claim that it's safer than conventional meat because the means of its production can be tightly controlled."
"The flavor of meat from livestock differs across species (from pig to chicken to cow), and is also influenced by farming conditions and the breeds and genders of animals."

## 题目类型说明

本题为信息匹配题，核心任务是从选项中找到最能支持“人们对培养肉持有矛盾情感，可能阻碍其全球推广”这一论点的引用。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> A student is writing an essay on the subject of cultured meat, which is grown in a laboratory and is intended to help reduce the number of livestock harvested for food.

👉 介绍培养肉的定义和目的。

**第2句：**
> The student wishes to make the case that people have mixed feelings about cultured meat that may be a barrier to its worldwide adoption.

👉 提出论点：人们对培养肉有矛盾态度，这可能阻碍其普及。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 介绍培养肉及其目标（减少屠宰牲畜） |
| 第二句 | 明确论文论点：人们对培养肉有矛盾感情，可能阻碍推广 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅
> "Many consumers who were surveyed believed that cultured meat would be good for the environment if widely available, but few of those same consumers were willing to try eating cultured meat themselves."

该选项直接体现了“人们对培养肉持有矛盾情感”：一方面认为环境友好，另一方面却不愿意尝试，完美支持题干论点。

**B 选项** ❌ 【无中生有】
> "Consumers tend to believe that using less packaging when selling meat products in stores would have a significant effect on the environment."

该选项讨论包装对环境影响，与培养肉的矛盾态度无关，无法支持论点。

**C 选项** ❌ 【方向相反】
> "Advocates of lab-grown meat claim that it's safer than conventional meat because the means of its production can be tightly controlled."

这是培养肉支持者的观点，强调安全性，未体现消费者的矛盾感情，方向不符。

**D 选项** ❌ 【无中生有】
> "The flavor of meat from livestock differs across species (from pig to chicken to cow), and is also influenced by farming conditions and the breeds and genders of animals."

讨论肉类风味差异，与培养肉的接受度或消费者感情无关。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关注“矛盾情感”这一关键词，选项中含有转折词“but”提示对比，直接揭示消费者一方面认可培养肉环保优势，另一方面却不愿尝试，形成“矛盾态度”，从而锁定A选项，排除其他无关或方向相反的选项。

article: Many believe that lullabies, characterized by their slow tempos, contain some acoustic features that are universally calming to infants. In a study, Constance M. Bainbridge and colleagues played both a lullaby sung in the Luk Saami language and a non-lullaby sung in the Tundra Nenets language to a group of infants. The researchers also measured the infants' heart rates, as a reduced heart rate is considered a measure of relaxation. They claim that the lullaby did indeed relax the infants.
stem: Which finding, if true, would most directly support Bainbridge and colleagues’ claim?

options.content: The heart rates of infants in the study were more irregular during the lullabies than during non-lullabies.
Infants' heart rates were substantially lower during the lullaby than during the non-lullaby.
Parents of infants in the study chose the lullaby over the non-lullaby when asked which song they would use to calm their child.
Both the song in Luk Saami and the song in Tundra Nenets were sung by a female singer.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

本题为细节理解题，核心任务是找到能直接支持研究者关于“摇篮曲能使婴儿放松”这一结论的证据。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Many believe that lullabies, characterized by their slow tempos, contain some acoustic features that are universally calming to infants.

👉 介绍普遍观点：摇篮曲因其节奏缓慢，具有普遍使婴儿安静的声学特征。

**第2句：**
> In a study, Constance M. Bainbridge and colleagues played both a lullaby sung in the Luk Saami language and a non-lullaby sung in the Tundra Nenets language to a group of infants.

👉 介绍研究设计：研究者用两种语言的摇篮曲和非摇篮曲分别播放给婴儿听。

**第3句：**
> The researchers also measured the infants' heart rates, as a reduced heart rate is considered a measure of relaxation.

👉 说明研究方法：通过测量心率来判断婴儿是否放松，心率降低即表示放松。

**第4句：**
> They claim that the lullaby did indeed relax the infants.

👉 提出结论：研究者认为摇篮曲确实使婴儿放松。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 摇篮曲具有普遍令人放松的声学特征的观点介绍 |
| 第二句 | 研究者用两种语言的摇篮曲和非摇篮曲进行实验 |
| 第三句 | 通过婴儿心率变化测量放松程度的方法说明 |
| 第四句 | 研究者得出摇篮曲使婴儿放松的结论 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> The heart rates of infants in the study were more irregular during the lullabies than during non-lullabies.

心率不规则并不等同于放松，文中强调的是“心率降低”作为放松指标，心率不规则反而可能说明不稳定或紧张。【方向相反】

**B 选项** ✅
> Infants' heart rates were substantially lower during the lullaby than during the non-lullaby.

心率降低被文中明确指出是“放松”的标志，该选项直接支持摇篮曲使婴儿放松的结论。

**C 选项** ❌
> Parents of infants in the study chose the lullaby over the non-lullaby when asked which song they would use to calm their child.

父母的偏好属于主观判断，不能直接证明婴儿是否真的放松。【无中生有】

**D 选项** ❌
> Both the song in Luk Saami and the song in Tundra Nenets were sung by a female singer.

歌手性别与婴儿放松无直接关系，不能支持结论。【无中生有】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于抓住文中“心率降低是放松的衡量标准”这一因果关系，题干要求找到最直接支持“摇篮曲使婴儿放松”的证据，选项中唯一与“心率降低”相关且正向对应的是B选项，其他选项要么与放松无关，要么方向相反，利用关键词“heart rates”、“lower”、“relaxation”快速锁定正确答案。

article: Water flowing around an obstruction creates vortices (patterns of swirls) of varying size; by detecting the vortices, fish can determine the size and position of the obstruction. Testing by Yuzo R. Yanagisuru, Otar Akanyeti, and James C. Liao using models of three head shapes—narrow (low ratio of width to length), intermediate, and wide (high ratio of width to length)—showed that for large vortices, fish with intermediate heads would be better able than narrow-headed fish to distinguish between vortices and general turbulence in the water. A second research team has therefore hypothesized that in low-visibility conditions, intermediate-headed fish will be more likely than narrow-headed fish to detect obstructions that create large vortices.
stem: Which finding, if true, would most directly support the second research team's hypothesis?

options.content: A study using obstructions that created large vortices in low-visibility conditions found that some specimens of the intermediate-headed Lobocheilos rhabdoura bumped into the obstructions more often than other specimens of the same fish did.

A study using obstructions that created large vortices in low-visibility conditions found that the lookdown (Selene vomer), which has a relatively narrow head, bumped into more than half of the obstructions.

A study using obstructions that created large vortices in low-visibility conditions found that the narrow-headed lookdown (Selene vomer) bumped into obstructions more often than the intermediate-headed Lobocheilos rhabdoura did.

A study using obstructions that created large vortices in low-visibility conditions found that the intermediate-headed Lobocheilos rhabdoura bumped into the obstructions just as often as the narrow-headed lookdown (Selene vomer) did.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

这是因果推断题，核心任务是找出哪项发现最直接支持“中等头型鱼在低能见度下更能探测出产生大涡旋的障碍物”的假设。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Water flowing around an obstruction creates vortices (patterns of swirls) of varying size; by detecting the vortices, fish can determine the size and position of the obstruction.

👉 说明水流绕障碍物产生涡旋，鱼通过探测涡旋判断障碍物大小和位置（提出背景信息和因果关系）。

**第2句：**
> Testing by Yuzo R. Yanagisuru, Otar Akanyeti, and James C. Liao using models of three head shapes—narrow (low ratio of width to length), intermediate, and wide (high ratio of width to length)—showed that for large vortices, fish with intermediate heads would be better able than narrow-headed fish to distinguish between vortices and general turbulence in the water.

👉 介绍实验证明：中等头型鱼比窄头鱼更能区分大涡旋和普通水流（提出研究结果支持中等头型的优势）。

**第3句：**
> A second research team has therefore hypothesized that in low-visibility conditions, intermediate-headed fish will be more likely than narrow-headed fish to detect obstructions that create large vortices.

👉 第二研究团队基于前述发现提出假设：在低能见度环境中，中等头型鱼比窄头鱼更容易探测出产生大涡旋的障碍物（提出假设）。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                                         |
|:---------|:-------------------------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 水流绕障碍物产生不同大小的涡旋，鱼通过涡旋判断障碍物大小和位置。 |
| 第二句   | 实验显示中等头型鱼较窄头鱼更能区分大涡旋与水流湍流。             |
| 第三句   | 第二研究团队假设：低能见度下中等头型鱼比窄头鱼更可能探测出大涡旋障碍物。 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌【以偏概全】
> A study using obstructions that created large vortices in low-visibility conditions found that some specimens of the intermediate-headed *Lobocheilos rhabdoura* bumped into the obstructions more often than other specimens of the same fish did.

错误原因：只说了部分中等头型鱼撞击障碍物次数较多，未与窄头鱼比较，且“有些鱼撞击较多”不能支持中等头型鱼更好探测障碍物的假设，属于以偏概全。

**B 选项** ❌【无中生有】
> A study using obstructions that created large vortices in low-visibility conditions found that the lookdown (*Selene vomer*), which has a relatively narrow head, bumped into more than half of the obstructions.

错误原因：只描述窄头鱼撞击障碍物较多，但没有对比中等头型鱼的表现，无法直接支持假设，且假设是比较两种鱼的探测能力，缺少对比信息，属于无中生有。

**C 选项** ✅
> A study using obstructions that created large vortices in low-visibility conditions found that the narrow-headed lookdown (*Selene vomer*) bumped into obstructions more often than the intermediate-headed *Lobocheilos rhabdoura* did.

正确原因：明确比较了两种鱼在低能见度、大涡旋条件下的撞击率，窄头鱼撞击更多，说明中等头型鱼更能探测障碍物，直接支持第二研究团队的假设。

**D 选项** ❌【方向相反】
> A study using obstructions that created large vortices in low-visibility conditions found that the intermediate-headed *Lobocheilos rhabdoura* bumped into the obstructions just as often as the narrow-headed lookdown (*Selene vomer*) did.

错误原因：说明两种鱼撞击率相同，否定了中等头型鱼更能探测障碍物的假设，方向与假设相反。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 题干问“最直接支持假设”的发现，关键词“low-visibility conditions”“large vortices”“intermediate-headed fish vs narrow-headed fish”是锁定答案的关键。正确选项必须包含两种头型鱼的直接比较，并且体现中等头型鱼撞击障碍物更少（探测能力更强）。无对比或仅单方面描述均不能支持假设，且描述相同撞击率则与假设方向相反。通过对比撞击频率的因果关系判断答案。

article: The Age of Innocence is a 1920 novel by Edith Wharton set in New York City in the 1870s. In the novel, Newland Archer attends an opera; in the audience is May Welland, with whom he is romantically involved. Newland visualizes the details of a future with May: ______
stem: Which quotation from The Age of Innocence best illustrates the claim?

options.content: "To come to the Opera in a [carriage for hire] was almost as honourable a way of arriving as in one's own carriage."
"Newland Archer, leaning against the wall at the back of the club box [where his seat was], turned his eyes from the stage and scanned the opposite side of the house."
"Already [Newland's] imagination, leaping ahead of the engagement ring, the betrothal kiss and the [wedding] march from Lohengrin, pictured [May] at his side."
"[May] dropped her eyes to the immense bouquet of lilies-of-the-valley on her knee, and Newland Archer saw her white-gloved finger-tips touch the flowers softly."

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

这是细节理解题，核心任务是从选项中找出最能体现文章中“Newland Archer对与May Welland未来生活细节的想象”这一描述的引文。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> *The Age of Innocence* is a 1920 novel by Edith Wharton set in New York City in the 1870s.

👉 介绍小说基本信息（背景介绍）。

**第2句：**
> In the novel, Newland Archer attends an opera; in the audience is May Welland, with whom he is romantically involved.

👉 介绍人物及情节背景，点明Newland和May的关系。

**第3句：**
> Newland visualizes the details of a future with May: ______

👉 提出观点：Newland对和May未来的生活细节进行想象。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                         |
|:---------|:----------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍小说及背景               |
| 第二句   | 介绍人物及两人关系           |
| 第三句   | 表明Newland对未来生活的想象 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> "To come to the Opera in a [carriage for hire] was almost as honourable a way of arriving as in one's own carriage."

此句描述的是乘坐马车的礼仪和社会习俗，未涉及Newland对未来生活的想象，属于【无中生有】。

**B 选项** ❌
> "Newland Archer, leaning against the wall at the back of the club box [where his seat was], turned his eyes from the stage and scanned the opposite side of the house."

此句描写Newland在剧院中的动作，属于场景描写，没有体现未来生活的想象，属于【无中生有】。

**C 选项** ✅
> "Already [Newland's] imagination, leaping ahead of the engagement ring, the betrothal kiss and the [wedding] march from Lohengrin, pictured [May] at his side."

这句话明确表述Newland的想象，直接呼应题干中“Newland visualizes the details of a future with May”，是对题干观点的最佳体现。

**D 选项** ❌
> "[May] dropped her eyes to the immense bouquet of lilies-of-the-valley on her knee, and Newland Archer saw her white-gloved finger-tips touch the flowers softly."

此句描写的是当下细节动作，未体现对未来生活的想象，属于【无中生有】。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 题干关键词“visualizes the details of a future”提示答案应体现“想象未来”，关注选项中包含“imagination”、“future”、“wedding”等暗示未来的词汇，直接锁定C选项；其他选项多为背景或动作描写，未涉及未来想象，故可排除。

article: The Reckoning and Resilience (2022) exhibition at Duke University's Nasher Museum of Art was the first to focus entirely on North Carolina artists since the exhibition Across County Lines four years earlier. The curators of the 2022 exhibition included painters like Beverly McIver, photographers like Kennedi Carter, and printmakers like Ayla Gizlice. But whereas the work by Carter would have fit the theme for Across County Lines, works by McIver and Gizlice would not have.
stem: Which finding about the Across County Lines exhibition, if true, would most directly support the underlined claim?

options.content: It consisted entirely of works by photographers.
It included a greater number of artists than Reckoning and Resilience.
It consisted mostly of works by printmakers.
It was curated specifically to emphasize works that are not owned by the Nasher Museum.

## 题目类型说明

这是细节支持题，核心任务是找到能直接支持文章中划线句子观点的选项。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
>The *Reckoning and Resilience* (2022) exhibition at Duke University's Nasher Museum of Art was the first to focus entirely on North Carolina artists since the exhibition *Across County Lines* four years earlier.
👉 介绍两个展览及其时间顺序，突出《Across County Lines》在4年前的地位。

**第2句：**
>The curators of the 2022 exhibition included painters like Beverly McIver, photographers like Kennedi Carter, and printmakers like Ayla Gizlice.

**第3句（划线部分）：**
>But whereas the work by Carter would have fit the theme for *Across County Lines*, works by McIver and Gizlice would not have.
👉 对比指出卡特的作品符合《Across County Lines》的主题，但麦克弗和吉兹利斯的作品不符合。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容与逻辑功能 |
|:---------|:---------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍两个展览及其时间关系，突出《Across County Lines》是前一个展览。 |
| 第二句   | 列举2022年展览涉及的艺术家类型。 |
| 第三句   | 对比划分哪些艺术家作品符合《Across County Lines》的主题，哪些不符合。 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅
> It consisted entirely of works by photographers.

**B 选项** ❌

与划线句矛盾，文中指出只有摄影师Carter的作品符合主题，若该展以版画家为主，则不支持划线句，属于【方向相反】。

## 核心解题技巧

article: Cardiff, Wales, has installed engineered structures—mainly breakwalls—along 87% of its shoreline to protect infrastructure from storm surges and other hazards, a practice known as shoreline hardening. Investigating the impact of such structures on waterbird communities at various sites in the Chesapeake Bay on the US East Coast, Diann Prosser et al. hypothesized that shoreline hardening more negatively affects waterbirds than does land development for uses such as housing or agriculture. To evaluate the responses of local waterbird species, including the osprey, to landscape alterations, the researchers utilized the Index of Waterbird Community Integrity (IWCI), on which a low score corresponds to low community integrity.
stem: Which finding, if true, would most directly support the researchers' hypothesis?

options.content: Waterbird communities at Back River, a site with a relatively high percentage of developed land and a relatively low percentage of hardened shoreline, had higher average IWCI scores than did waterbird communities at Margothy, a site with a lower percentage of developed land but a higher percentage of hardened shoreline.

Waterbird communities at Langford, a site with a relatively high percentage of developed land and a relatively low percentage of hardened shoreline, had lower average IWCI scores than did waterbird communities at Mill, a site with a lower percentage of developed land but a higher percentage of hardened shoreline.

Waterbird communities at Stony and Curtis, two sites with relatively high percentages of developed land and hardened shoreline, had similar IWCI scores, whereas waterbird communities at Ware and Honga, two sites with relatively low percentages of developed land and hardened shoreline, had widely differing IWCI scores.

Waterbird communities at Old Road, a site with a relatively high percentage of developed land and hardened shoreline, had lower average IWCI scores than did waterbird communities at Onancock, a site with a relatively low percentage of developed land and hardened shoreline.

## 题目类型说明

这是因果推断题，核心任务是找出最直接支持研究者假设（“shoreline hardening比土地开发对水鸟群落影响更负面”）的证据。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Cardiff, Wales, has installed engineered structures—mainly breakwalls—along 87% of its shoreline to protect infrastructure from storm surges and other hazards, a practice known as shoreline hardening.

👉 介绍背景，定义“shoreline hardening”及其目的。

**第2句：**
> Investigating the impact of such structures on waterbird communities at various sites in the Chesapeake Bay on the US East Coast, Diann Prosser et al. hypothesized that shoreline hardening more negatively affects waterbirds than does land development for uses such as housing or agriculture.

👉 提出研究主题和核心假设：shoreline hardening对水鸟影响比土地开发更负面。

**第3句：**
> To evaluate the responses of local waterbird species, including the osprey, to landscape alterations, the researchers utilized the Index of Waterbird Community Integrity (IWCI), on which a low score corresponds to low community integrity.

👉 说明研究方法，使用IWCI指标衡量水鸟群落完整性，低分代表低完整性（负面影响）。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                     |
|:---------|:----------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍shoreline hardening的定义和目的       |
| 第二句   | 提出研究者假设：shoreline hardening比土地开发影响更负面 |
| 第三句   | 介绍研究方法及指标IWCI，低分代表负面影响  |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅（正确）
> Waterbird communities at Back River, a site with a relatively high percentage of developed land and a relatively low percentage of hardened shoreline, had higher average IWCI scores than did waterbird communities at Margothy, a site with a lower percentage of developed land but a higher percentage of hardened shoreline.

此选项直接对比两地，一地土地开发高但shoreline hardening低，另一地土地开发低但shoreline hardening高，结果是shoreline hardening高的地方水鸟群落完整性（IWCI）更低，完全支持“shoreline hardening影响更负面”的假设，且引用了IWCI低分对应低完整性（文章第3句）。

**B 选项** ❌（错误）【方向相反】
> Waterbird communities at Langford, a site with a relatively high percentage of developed land and a relatively low percentage of hardened shoreline, had lower average IWCI scores than did waterbird communities at Mill, a site with a lower percentage of developed land but a higher percentage of hardened shoreline.

此选项显示土地开发高且shoreline hardening低的地点水鸟完整性更差，和假设“shoreline hardening负面影响更大”方向相反。

**C 选项** ❌（错误）【无中生有】
> Waterbird communities at Stony and Curtis, two sites with relatively high percentages of developed land and hardened shoreline, had similar IWCI scores, whereas waterbird communities at Ware and Honga, two sites with relatively low percentages of developed land and hardened shoreline, had widely differing IWCI scores.

此选项信息混乱，未明确指出shoreline hardening与土地开发的相对影响，也没有直接比较二者对IWCI的影响大小，缺乏支持假设的直接证据。

**D 选项** ❌（错误）【以偏概全】
> Waterbird communities at Old Road, a site with a relatively high percentage of developed land and hardened shoreline, had lower average IWCI scores than did waterbird communities at Onancock, a site with a relatively low percentage of developed land and hardened shoreline.

此选项只说明高土地开发+shoreline hardening的地方水鸟完整性低，但没有区分二者的单独影响，无法判断是shoreline hardening还是土地开发造成的影响，不能直接支持假设。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关注题干关键词“most directly support”和“hypothesis”，锁定“shoreline hardening比土地开发负面影响更大”的对比关系。利用文章中“低IWCI分数对应低群落完整性”这一因果标志，优先选择明确对比“土地开发高但shoreline hardening低”与“土地开发低但shoreline hardening高”两类场景的选项，排除未直接对比或方向相反的选项。

article: Cane is a 1923 novel by Jean Toomer. In one portion of the novel, Toomer uses figurative language to connect the narrator's urban environment of Washington, DC, and the rural South of the narrator's past, writing _____
stem: Which quotation from Cane most effectively illustrate the claim?

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> "The [train] engines of this valley have a whistle, the echoes of which sound like iterated gasps and sobs. I always think of them as crude music"

## 核心解题技巧

> The Underdogs is a 1915 novel by Mariano Azuela, originally written in Spanish.

article: Memoirs of Eleanor Eldridge is an 1838 historical account by Eleanor Eldridge and Frances Harriet Whipple Green. In the book, the authors assert that people don't need to be famous to be worthy of memoirs, writing, _____
stem: Which quotation from Memoirs of Eleanor Eldridge most effectively illustrates the claim?

options.content: "Then let no one turn with too much [fussiness] from the simple story of the humble Eleanor, though it may contain few, or none, of the thrilling charms of poetry and passion."

"There is often a kind of [deceptive] light, playing around such [famous] names, calculated to dazzle and mislead, by their false luster, until the eye can no longer receive the pure light of Truth, or the mind appreciate real excellence, or intrinsic worth."
"It should not be considered essential to the interest and value of biography, that its subject be of exalted rank, or illustrious name."

"How careful ought we to be to speak nothing but the truth, even in regard to the most trifling circumstances; and not only so, but to be well assured that what we suppose to be true, is truth, before we receive it as such."

text_analysis:

## 题目类型说明

这是细节定位题，核心任务是从选项中找到最能体现文章主张（“people don't need to be famous to be worthy of memoirs”）的直接论述或引用。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Memoirs of Eleanor Eldridge is an 1838 historical account by Eleanor Eldridge and Frances Harriet Whipple Green.

👉 介绍作品及作者背景。

**第2句：**
> In the book, the authors assert that people don't need to be famous to be worthy of memoirs, writing, _____

👉 明确书中主张，即记述对象无需名声显赫也有价值。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                     |
|:---------|:---------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍《Memoirs of Eleanor Eldridge》及作者 |
| 第二句   | 书中主张：人物不必出名也值得写传记           |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> "Then let no one turn with too much [fussiness] from the simple story of the humble Eleanor, though it may contain few, or none, of the thrilling charms of poetry and passion."

该选项表达的是不要因故事简单就忽视它，侧重于谦逊人物故事的接受态度，但没有直接说明“无名人物也值得写传记”。【以偏概全】

**B 选项** ❌
> "There is often a kind of [deceptive] light, playing around such [famous] names, calculated to dazzle and mislead, by their false luster, until the eye can no longer receive the pure light of Truth, or the mind appreciate real excellence, or intrinsic worth."

该选项批评名人名声的虚假光环，强调名声的误导性，但未直接陈述无名人物也值得传记，属于侧面论证，非最有效说明。【以偏概全】

**C 选项** ✅
> "It should not be considered essential to the interest and value of biography, that its subject be of exalted rank, or illustrious name."

此选项直接表述了“传记的价值不依赖于被传人物的显赫地位或名声”，完全对应题干所述主张，最直接有效。

**D 选项** ❌
> "How careful ought we to be to speak nothing but the truth, even in regard to the most trifling circumstances; and not only so, but to be well assured that what we suppose to be true, is truth, before we receive it as such."

该选项强调对事实真实性的谨慎态度，与“无名人物也值得写传记”的主张无关，属于【无中生有】。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题核心在于准确锁定主张“无名人物同样值得写传记”，注意选项中是否直接包含该观点的关键词（如“not essential”、“exalted rank”、“illustrious name”），排除侧面论述和无关内容，选出最直接对应的表述。选项A和B虽然相关，但未直接说明核心主张；D选项内容偏题。关键词“essential”、“exalted rank”、“illustrious name”是答案定位的关键。

article: The utilization of deceptive antipredator displays is well documented in the spotted sandpiper (Actitis macularius) and other species of the avian order Charadriiformes. An extensive literature review conducted by Léna de Framond et al. revealed that this trait has evolved across a surprisingly large phylogenetic distribution of 13 Aves orders, including Columbiformes and Cuculiformes. Subsequent investigation of potential selection mechanisms prompted the researchers to conclude that independent of avian order, the prevalence of the trait is mediated by environmental variations associated with the absolute latitude of brooding sites.
stem: Which finding, if true, would most strongly support the researchers' conclusion?

options.content: Across the orders in the study, deceptive antipredator displays are observed in approximately 34% of species with brooding ranges of 0°–30° absolute latitude and approximately 60% of species with brooding ranges of 50°–80° absolute latitude.

Across the orders in the study, approximately 54% of the bird species brood in ranges from 50° to 80° absolute latitude, but most of the birds that are known to use deceptive antipredator displays brood between 0° and 30° absolute latitude.

Deceptive antipredator displays are documented in Charadriiformes species across the entire range of absolute latitudes of brooding sites within that order, but in species from other orders, deceptive antipredator displays are documented only when brooding sites are at absolute latitudes 10°–20° higher than what is typical for those species.

The use of deceptive antipredator displays is widespread among Charadriiformes species independent of the absolute latitude of their breeding sites, but its prevalence in other avian orders is limited to species with brooding sites located in absolute latitudes of 0°–30°.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

本题为逻辑支持题，核心任务是判断哪个选项最有力支持文章中关于“该特征的普遍性受孵育地点绝对纬度环境变化影响”这一结论。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> The utilization of deceptive antipredator displays is well documented in the spotted sandpiper (Actitis macularius) and other species of the avian order Charadriiformes.

👉 介绍背景事实，说明欺骗性反捕食者行为在某一鸟类目（Charadriiformes）中被充分记录。

**第2句：**
> An extensive literature review conducted by Léna de Framond et al. revealed that this trait has evolved across a surprisingly large phylogenetic distribution of 13 Aves orders, including Columbiformes and Cuculiformes.

👉 说明该特征不仅限于一个鸟类目，而是在13个不同鸟类目中进化出现，强调其广泛的系统发育分布。

**第3句：**
> Subsequent investigation of potential selection mechanisms prompted the researchers to conclude that independent of avian order, the prevalence of the trait is mediated by environmental variations associated with the absolute latitude of brooding sites.

👉 提出结论：不论鸟类目，该特征的普遍性均受孵育地点绝对纬度环境差异的调控。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                               |
|:---------|:----------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍欺骗性反捕食者行为在Charadriiformes中被充分记录 |
| 第二句   | 该行为存在于13个鸟类目中，分布广泛           |
| 第三句   | 结论：该行为的普遍性受孵育地点绝对纬度相关环境变化影响 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅（正确）
> Across the orders in the study, deceptive antipredator displays are observed in approximately 34% of species with brooding ranges of 0°–30° absolute latitude and approximately 60% of species with brooding ranges of 50°–80° absolute latitude.

该选项提供了明确数据，显示在高绝对纬度（50°–80°）范围内该特征出现频率更高，直接支持“普遍性受绝对纬度环境变化影响”的结论。符合文章结论的因果关系，且与“independent of avian order”相符。

**B 选项** ❌（错误）【方向相反】
> Across the orders in the study, approximately 54% of the bird species brood in ranges from 50° to 80° absolute latitude, but most of the birds that are known to use deceptive antipredator displays brood between 0° and 30° absolute latitude.

该选项说大部分使用该特征的鸟类孵育于低纬度（0°–30°），与文章结论中“绝对纬度影响普遍性”的趋势相反，且与A选项相矛盾。

**C 选项** ❌（错误）【过度推断】
> Deceptive antipredator displays are documented in Charadriiformes species across the entire range of absolute latitudes of brooding sites within that order, but in species from other orders, deceptive antipredator displays are documented only when brooding sites are at absolute latitudes 10°–20° higher than what is typical for those species.

该选项引入了“10°–20°高于该物种典型纬度”的具体限制，过度推断了纬度范围的具体数值限制，文章中并未给出这种细节，且影响普遍性结论的核心是“绝对纬度环境变化”，非“比典型值高多少”。

**D 选项** ❌（错误）【方向相反】
> The use of deceptive antipredator displays is widespread among Charadriiformes species independent of the absolute latitude of their breeding sites, but its prevalence in other avian orders is limited to species with brooding sites located in absolute latitudes of 0°–30°.

该选项指出Charadriiformes中该行为不受绝对纬度影响，与文章中“该行为普遍存在于Charadriiformes，但普遍性受纬度影响”的结论矛盾。

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Over time, marine mollusks called nautilids continually add segments to their shells, and the chemical composition of each segment is influenced by the available materials in the surrounding water when the segment forms.

👉 介绍背景和关键科学原理：鹦鹉螺通过壳段增长，且壳段的化学成分反映形成时周围水的环境。

**第2句：**
> Paleontologist Amane Tajika and colleagues analyzed the septa (the walls between shell chambers) of one male (samples labeled 'M') and one female (samples labeled 'F') nautilid, finding that sample M02 had the same concentration of oxygen-18 as did water approximately 135 meters deep and that the oxygen-18 concentration in sample F17 matched that of water at approximately 375 meters deep.

👉 描述研究发现：两只鹦鹉螺不同性别样本的壳段氧-18浓度分别对应不同水深的水。

**第3句：**
> Tajika et al. concluded that sample M02 formed at a higher point in the water column than did F17.

👉 总结研究结论：M02壳段形成水深浅于F17。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 介绍鹦鹉螺壳段的形成及其化学成分受水环境影响的原理 |
| 第二句 | 介绍具体研究，测定不同性别样本壳段氧-18浓度对应不同水深 |
| 第三句 | 研究人员根据氧-18数据推断壳段形成水深的结论 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌【方向相反】
> In nautilids, sex predicts septa growth rate more strongly than does oxygen-18 concentration in the surrounding water

此选项强调性别影响壳段生长速度超过氧-18浓度，但研究结论依赖氧-18反映水深，非生长率，且题干无提及生长率影响，故与结论支持无关。

**B 选项** ✅（正确）
> Among nautilids, there is no effect of sex on the uptake of oxygen-18 from water or its deposition in septa.

该选项说明性别不会影响氧-18的吸收和沉积，排除了性别作为混淆变量，直接支持研究人员用氧-18浓度推断水深的结论。

**C 选项** ❌【无中生有】
> Regardless of sex, nautilids spend most of their lives at depths of 50 meters or greater, where oxygen-18 concentrations typically differ from those higher in the water column.

该选项提及鹦鹉螺大部分时间在50米以下，但未直接说明氧-18浓度与样本水深对应的关系，且未说明与结论的直接联系。

**D 选项** ❌【过度推断】
> Male nautilids tend to show higher concentrations of oxygen-18 than do female autilids inhabiting the same point in the water column

此选项若为真，则表明性别会影响氧-18浓度，即相同水深不同性别壳段氧-18不一致，反而削弱了用氧-18浓度推断水深的可靠性，与研究结论矛盾。

👉 介绍魔幻现实主义的起源和特征，说明其融合了非现实元素与现实叙述。

**第2句：**

👉 说明魔幻现实主义风格影响了世界各地作家，特别指出Tokarczuk的小说在现实主义与波兰民俗的结合上类似经典魔幻现实主义作品（即划线部分观点）。

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> "Like many works in the Latin American magical realist tradition, *Primeval and Other Times* is indebted to antirealistic elements in the folklore of Poland."

错误在于说*Primeval and Other Times*“像许多拉美魔幻现实主义作品”，但文中强调的是其“类似经典魔幻现实主义小说”，而非等同或从属于拉美传统，且未提及“像许多作品”这一广泛比较。【过度推断】

**B 选项** ❌
> "While *Primeval and Other Times* alternates between realistic and antirealistic modes of representation, details suggesting the influence of Polish folklore nevertheless occur throughout the novel."

此选项描述小说交替使用现实与非现实模式，且有波兰民俗影响，虽然相关，但“alternates”强调交替，文中用“juxtaposition（并置）”更侧重同时存在，且未如划线句般强调类似魔幻现实主义。【以偏概全】

**C 选项** ❌
> "Although Polish folklore clearly informs the style and occasionally antirealistic plot of *Primeval and Other Times*, the novel also shows the inarguable influence of the magical realist tradition of Latin America."

此选项强调波兰民俗和拉美魔幻现实主义的双重影响，然而划线部分只说“类似经典魔幻现实主义小说”，未涉及对拉美传统影响的强调，且“inarguable influence”是过度解读。【过度推断】

**D 选项** ✅

此选项直接体现了划线部分“juxtaposition of literary realism with folklore”，即现实逻辑被波兰民俗的形象和情境反复且有效地打断，最直接支持划线论断。

👉 提出假设：D. polymorpha的TiO2纳米颗粒生物累积可以作为替代指标，避免对常用的脊椎鱼类（如鲤鱼）进行昂贵且侵入性的检测。

**A 选项** ❌

**C 选项** ❌
> Compared with C. carpio, D. polymorpha can tolerate significantly higher TiO2-NP concentrations without displaying any negative effects.
错误原因：耐受性高与是否能作为检测代理无直接关系，文中假设关注的是累积指标的可替代性，耐受性是额外信息【无关信息】。

**D 选项** ✅
> In comparable environments, D. polymorpha and C. carpio display comparable rates of TiO2-NP uptake.
正确原因：该发现直接支持假设中斑马贻贝可作为鲤鱼的替代检测对象，因为两者在类似环境中纳米颗粒摄取率相当，说明斑马贻贝的累积数据可以代表鲤鱼，符合“valuable proxy role”要求。

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在理解“proxy role（代理角色）”的含义，需找到支持两种生物TiO2纳米颗粒累积情况相似的证据。选项中表述两者累积率相当的D项最为直接贴合假设，排除其他侧重耐受性、检测难易或个体差异的选项。锁定关键词“comparable rates of uptake”帮助确定答案。

article: The phrase omo-rompo bilak is a past-oriented expression used by members of the Yupno, an indigenous group in Papua New Guinea, that translates to "a couple of years ago." Rafael Nunez and colleagues recorded Yupno speakers explaining several of these temporal-related words and phrases and coded each speaker's manual gestures. Previous research has found evidence of Spanish speakers referring to the front/back axis to describe events in time, and many researchers believe that this tendency to make temporal distinctions along imagined linear axes is universal. However, Nunez and colleagues claim that this tendency is not in fact ubiquitous.
stem: Which finding, if true, would most directly support Nunez and colleagues' claim?

When outdoors and referring to the future, Yupno speakers facing uphill gesture in front of themselves, whereas those facing downhill gesture behind themselves.

## 题目类型说明

本题为逻辑推理题，核心任务是找出最能支持文章中Nunez及其同事“时间的线性空间映射并非普遍存在”这一主张的发现。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> The phrase omo-rompo bilak is a past-oriented expression used by members of the Yupno, an indigenous group in Papua New Guinea, that translates to "a couple of years ago."

👉 介绍Yupno语中的一个表达过去时间的短语，作为研究背景。

**第2句：**
> Rafael Nunez and colleagues recorded Yupno speakers explaining several of these temporal-related words and phrases and coded each speaker's manual gestures.

👉 描述研究者如何采集并分析Yupno语者与时间相关词汇及其手势。

**第3句：**
> Previous research has found evidence of Spanish speakers referring to the front/back axis to describe events in time, and many researchers believe that this tendency to make temporal distinctions along imagined linear axes is universal.

👉 介绍已有研究发现西班牙语者用空间的前后轴来表达时间，且许多学者认为这种空间-时间映射是普遍存在的。

**第4句：**
> However, Nunez and colleagues claim that this tendency is not in fact ubiquitous.

👉 转折，提出Nunez及其同事认为上述线性时间映射并非普遍现象。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                                         |
|:---------|:-------------------------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍Yupno语中表示过去时间的短语，作为研究对象背景             |
| 第二句   | 说明研究者记录并分析了Yupno语者关于时间词汇及相应手势的情况   |
| 第三句   | 介绍已有研究发现西班牙语者用空间前后轴表达时间，并认为普遍存在 |
| 第四句   | 转折，提出Nunez等人认为这种时间空间映射不是普遍存在           |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌【无中生有】
> Yupno speakers typically use their left hand to make temporal gestures regardless of whether the gestures are past oriented or future oriented.

该选项仅描述了使用哪只手做手势，与是否存在线性时间空间映射无关，无法支持Nunez关于非普遍性的主张。

**B 选项** ✅
> When outdoors and referring to the future, Yupno speakers facing uphill gesture in front of themselves, whereas those facing downhill gesture behind themselves.

该选项显示Yupno语者的时间手势依赖于面向的方向（上坡或下坡），表明他们对时间的空间映射不是统一的线性前后轴，直接支持“Nunez等人认为线性时间映射非普遍”的观点。

**C 选项** ❌【无中生有】
> Yupno speakers were observed making temporal gestures both indoors and outdoors, though with greater frequency when indoors.

该选项仅说明时间手势出现的环境和频率，未涉及时间与空间映射的方式，不能支持主张。

**D 选项** ❌【方向相反】
> Some Yupno grammatical structures used when talking about also used in Spanish.

该选项暗示Yupno和西班牙语在语法上有相似之处，反而可能支持时间表达的普遍性，与Nunez提出的非普遍性观点相反。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于识别文章最后一句的转折信号词“However”，暗示前文提到的普遍性观点被挑战，选项中需要支持“非普遍性”结论的内容。选项B通过描述面向不同方向时手势空间位置的变化，体现时间空间映射的多样性，从而直接支持这一点；其他选项要么与时间空间映射无关，要么与非普遍性结论相悖，可据此排除。

article: Jocelyn Plassais and other researchers probed the evolutionary history of size variation in canids (wolves, foxes, dogs, and their close relatives). The researchers found that small domestic dogs (e.g., toy poodles) as well as small wild canids (e.g., foxes) tend to have a particular variant, known as the C allele, of the gene IGF1, a growth-related gene found in all mammals. Large canids (e.g., grey wolves, German shepherds), however, tend to have a different variant, known as the T allele, of IGF1. The researchers concluded that the T allele is the more recent of the two alleles to emerge.
stem: Which finding, if true, would most directly support the researchers' conclusion?

options.content: The T allele is more common among wild canids native to cold regions, whereas the C allele is more common among wild canids native to warm regions.
The C allele but not the T allele is found in both bears and ferrets, which share a relatively recent common ancestor with canids.
Many domestic dogs and wild canids are heterozygous with regard to IGF1, meaning that they carry both the C and T alleles.
Domestic dogs are descended from populations of wild canids in which the C allele was more prevalent than the T allele.

## 题目类型说明

这是推理支持题，核心任务是找出哪个发现能最直接支持研究者关于T等位基因比C等位基因更新的结论。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Jocelyn Plassais and other researchers probed the evolutionary history of size variation in canids (wolves, foxes, dogs, and their close relatives).

👉 介绍研究对象和研究目的（提出研究背景）。

**第2句：**
> The researchers found that small domestic dogs (e.g., toy poodles) as well as small wild canids (e.g., foxes) tend to have a particular variant, known as the C allele, of the gene IGF1, a growth-related gene found in all mammals.

👉 说明小型犬和小型野生犬科动物倾向携带C等位基因（提出观察结果）。

**第3句：**
> Large canids (e.g., grey wolves, German shepherds), however, tend to have a different variant, known as the T allele, of IGF1.

👉 对比说明大型犬科动物倾向携带T等位基因（提出对比事实，转折关系）。

**第4句：**
> The researchers concluded that the T allele is the more recent of the two alleles to emerge.

👉 研究者得出结论：T等位基因较新（提出结论）。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 介绍研究对象和目的 |
| 第二句 | 观察小型犬科携带C等位基因 |
| 第三句 | 对比大型犬科携带T等位基因 |
| 第四句 | 研究结论：T等位基因较新 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> The T allele is more common among wild canids native to cold regions, whereas the C allele is more common among wild canids native to warm regions.

此选项描述了等位基因的地理分布，但未涉及哪一等位基因出现较早或较晚，无法直接支持“ T等位基因较新”的结论。
错误类型：【无中生有】

**B 选项** ✅
> The C allele but not the T allele is found in both bears and ferrets, which share a relatively recent common ancestor with canids.

如果C等位基因存在于与犬科有较近共同祖先的其他动物中，而T等位基因不存在，说明C等位基因起源较早，T等位基因是在犬科分支之后出现的，直接支持T等位基因较新的结论。

**C 选项** ❌
> Many domestic dogs and wild canids are heterozygous with regard to IGF1, meaning that they carry both the C and T alleles.

此选项说明存在杂合状态，但未说明哪一等位基因先出现，无法支持等位基因出现时间的推断。
错误类型：【无中生有】

**D 选项** ❌
> Domestic dogs are descended from populations of wild canids in which the C allele was more prevalent than the T allele.

此选项说明C等位基因在祖先中更常见，但无法说明T等位基因是否后来出现，仅反映频率差异，不能直接支持T等位基因较新的结论。
错误类型：【过度推断】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题核心在于理解“较新”的时间概念，寻找能体现等位基因起源时间的证据。选项中，只有B通过比较犬科与其近亲中是否存在某等位基因，间接说明等位基因出现顺序，因而最直接支持结论。其他选项多涉及频率或地理分布，属于无关信息或过度推断，无法锁定答案。注意关键词“more recent”与“common ancestor”提示时间先后关系。

article: Periods of subfreezing temperatures in Alaska have been growing shorter in response to climate warming, potentially enabling increased carbon dioxide (CO2) absorption through greater productivity of common pepperweed (Lepidium densiflorum) plants and other vegetation, but also potentially enabling increased CO2 output through greater heterotrophic respiration (CO2 generated by the activity of soil microorganisms). Hydrologist Yonghong Yi and her colleagues developed a model incorporating numerous inputs—years of soil composition and snow cover data among them—to evaluate the effects of warming on the CO2 balance in Alaska, concluding that net CO2 is likely to increase if warming hastens spring snow melt.
stem: Which finding, if true, would most directly support the researchers' conclusion?

Early snow melt amplifies the effect of soil composition on the growth of plant species such as L. densiflorum and on the rate of heterotrophic respiration.
Early snow melt reduces the amount of soil moisture available for the growth of plant species such as L. densiflorum, and it raises the rate of heterotrophic respiration.
Early snow melt slows the growth of plant species such as L. densiflorum by reducing soil insulation, and it suppresses heterotrophic respiration.

## 题目类型说明

本题为推理支持题，核心任务是找出能最直接支持研究者关于“早期融雪导致净CO₂增加”结论的发现。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Periods of subfreezing temperatures in Alaska have been growing shorter in response to climate warming, potentially enabling increased carbon dioxide (CO₂) absorption through greater productivity of common pepperweed (Lepidium densiflorum) plants and other vegetation, but also potentially enabling increased CO₂ output through greater heterotrophic respiration (CO₂ generated by the activity of soil microorganisms).

👉 介绍背景和双向可能影响：气温变暖缩短冰冻期，可能增加植物吸收CO₂，也可能增加土壤微生物呼吸释放CO₂。

**第2句：**
> Hydrologist Yonghong Yi and her colleagues developed a model incorporating numerous inputs—years of soil composition and snow cover data among them—to evaluate the effects of warming on the CO₂ balance in Alaska, concluding that net CO₂ is likely to increase if warming hastens spring snow melt.

👉 介绍研究方法和结论：通过模型分析，得出如果气温变暖加快春季融雪，净CO₂排放可能增加。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                                         |
|:---------|:-------------------------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 气温变暖缩短冰冻期，可能增加植物CO₂吸收也可能增加微生物呼吸释放CO₂ |
| 第二句   | 研究者建模分析，结论是早融雪会导致净CO₂增加                       |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> Early snow melt extends the period in which plant species such as L. densiflorum can absorb CO₂ but has no effect on the rate of heterotrophic respiration.

错误原因：文章强调净CO₂增加是因为植物吸收和微生物呼吸两个因素共同作用，A项说融雪只影响植物吸收，不影响微生物呼吸，无法解释净CO₂增加，属于【以偏概全】。

**B 选项** ❌
> Early snow melt amplifies the effect of soil composition on the growth of plant species such as L. densiflorum and on the rate of heterotrophic respiration.

错误原因：虽然提到影响植物和微生物呼吸，但并未明确说明净CO₂增加方向，且“放大土壤组成影响”不直接支持结论，属于【无中生有】。

**C 选项** ✅
> Early snow melt reduces the amount of soil moisture available for the growth of plant species such as L. densiflorum, and it raises the rate of heterotrophic respiration.

正确原因：文章结论是早融雪导致净CO₂增加，C项说明融雪减少植物生长（减少CO₂吸收）且提高微生物呼吸（增加CO₂排放），直接支持净CO₂增加的结论。

**D 选项** ❌
> Early snow melt slows the growth of plant species such as L. densiflorum by reducing soil insulation, and it suppresses heterotrophic respiration.

错误原因：D项说融雪抑制微生物呼吸，减少CO₂排放，与净CO₂增加结论相反，属于【方向相反】。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 文章核心在于净CO₂增加由植物吸收减少和微生物呼吸增加共同导致，题干要求支持“净CO₂增加”，因此要找同时说明植物吸收减少且微生物呼吸增加的选项；关键词“net CO₂ increase”、“early snow melt”锁定答案，排除只提单一影响或与结论相反的选项。

article: Describing adverbs "as damaging to a writer," novelist Graham Greene is one of several authors and literary critics who have recommended minimizing the use of adverbs, especially those ending in -ly (e.g., "obediently"), in works of fiction. To investigate the prevalence of -ly adverbs in novels, author and statistician Ben Blatt used natural language processing—machine learning technology that reads and interprets text—to calculate the rates at which these words occur in the novels of Ernest Hemingway, who was awarded the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1954. Blatt concluded that in Hemingway's oeuvre, there is a negative correlation between -ly adverb proliferation and perceived literary merit.
stem: Which finding, if true, would most directly support Blatt's conclusion?

options.content: Whereas Hemingway's acclaimed novel The Sun Also Rises has one of the lowest -ly adverb rates among Hemingway's works, F. Scott Fitzgerald's classic novel The Great Gatsby has the lowest -ly adverb rate among Fitzgerald's novels.

Whereas Hemingway used on average 80 -ly adverbs per 10,000 words in the 10 novels of Hemingway's that Blatt investigated, Toni Morrison, winner of the 1993 Nobel Prize in Literature, used on average 76 -ly adverbs per 10,000 words in her novels.

In his celebrated novel A Farewell to Arms, Hemingway used 67 -ly adverbs per 10,000 words, whereas 67% of celebrated authors' novels that have fewer than 50 -ly adverbs per 10,000 words have been classified as great by critics.

In The Sun Also Rises, which is widely recognized as a literary masterpiece, Hemingway used 63 -ly adverbs per 10,000 words, whereas in his less-acclaimed novel True at First Light, Hemingway used 102 -ly adverbs per 10,000 words.

这是一题逻辑推理题，核心任务是判断哪项发现最直接支持第二组研究者关于“最有信息量的传感器更敏感”的假设。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> To detect information about water flow, fish have sensors running from the snout tip down the sides of the head.

👉 介绍鱼类检测水流的传感器位置和功能。

**第2句：**
> Yuzo R. Yanagisuru, Otar Akanyeti, and James C. Liao conducted tests to find where the difference in pressure is greatest between two adjacent sensors because, according to the researchers, as these pressure differences increase, so does the amount of information available to the fish.

👉 说明第一组研究者测试压力差最大的位置，且压力差越大，信息量越大。

**第3句：**
> Using the ratio of head width to length, they found that the greatest pressure difference is closer to the snout for narrower heads (lower ratio of width to length) and farther from the snout for wider heads (higher ratio of width to length).

👉 发现压力差最大的位置因头部宽长比不同而异。

**第4句：**
> Based on this finding, a second team of researchers has hypothesized that the sensors where information is greatest are likely more sensitive than the rest.

👉 第二组研究者基于上述发现，假设信息量最大的传感器比其他更敏感。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第1句 | 鱼类传感器的位置和功能介绍 |
| 第2句 | 第一组研究者测试压力差与信息量的关系 |
| 第3句 | 发现压力差最大位置与头部宽长比的关系 |
| 第4句 | 第二组研究者假设最有信息量的传感器更敏感 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅（正确）
> The longnose gar (Lepisosteus osseus) has a much narrower head than the devil catfish (Bagarius bagarius), and the most sensitive sensors of the longnose gar are closer to the snout than are those of the devil catfish.

这个选项说明了头部较窄的长嘴鳄鱼的最敏感传感器位置更靠近吻部，符合文章第三句中“压力差最大位置随头宽长比变化”的结论，同时表明了信息量最大处的传感器更敏感，直接支持第二组研究者的假设。

**B 选项** ❌（错误）
> The longnose gar (Lepisosteus osseus) has a much narrower head than the devil catfish (Bagarius bagarius), and the most sensitive sensors for both are very close to their snouts.

该选项说两种鱼的最敏感传感器都靠近吻部，违背了文章第三句中“压力差最大位置随头宽长比变化”的发现，且没有体现敏感度与信息量最大位置的对应关系。【方向相反】

**C 选项** ❌（错误）
> The longnose gar (Lepisosteus osseus) has a much narrower head than the devil catfish (Bagarius bagarius), and while the sensors nearest the snout for the longnose gar are more sensitive than the others, for the devil catfish all sensors are equally sensitive.

该选项虽然说长嘴鳄鱼吻部传感器更敏感，但指出鲶鱼所有传感器敏感度相同，无法体现信息量最大处更敏感的假设对所有鱼种的普适性，削弱假设的普遍支持。【以偏概全】

**D 选项** ❌（错误）
> The longnose gar (Lepisosteus osseus) has a much narrower head than the devil catfish (Bagarius bagarius), and the most sensitive sensors for the devil catfish are closer to the snout than are those for the longnose gar.

该选项传感器敏感位置与文章发现相反，文章指出头宽较宽的鱼压力差最大位置远离吻部，而这里说宽头鱼敏感传感器更靠近吻部，违背文章结论。【方向相反】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关注文章第三句中“压力差最大位置与头宽长比的关系”及第四句中“最有信息量处传感器更敏感”的假设，题干问“最直接支持假设的发现”，选项中需体现两点：1）敏感传感器位置符合压力差最大位置；2）敏感度与信息量最大处对应。选项A符合这两点，其他选项均与文章结论矛盾或不完全支持假设。锁定关键词“closer to the snout for narrower heads”和“more sensitive”是解题关键。

## 题目类型说明

本题为逻辑支持题，核心任务是找出能最直接支持研究者观点的发现，验证其对传统观点的挑战。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> In an international collaboration, Elaine Ostrander, Alan K. Outram, and other researchers probed the evolutionary history of size variation in modern dogs.
👉 介绍研究背景和研究对象。

**第2句：**
> Scientific consensus held that early dogs had large body mass and that a genetic driver of smaller size in some breeds (e.g., bulldogs) developed only within the last 20,000 years as a result of selective breeding for characteristics favored by humans.
👉 说明传统科学共识，即小型犬的基因变化出现在最近2万年，由人工选择导致。

**第3句：**
> Ostrander et al. assert that this explanation is flawed, having discovered that a mutation responsible for variants of IGF1, a gene found in many mammals that regulates production of insulin-like growth factor 1, is ubiquitous in domestic dog breeds.
👉 提出研究者观点：传统解释有误，因为IGF1基因变异普遍存在于家犬中，暗示其起源时间可能更早。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                                         |
|:---------|:-------------------------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍研究团队及研究内容（狗体型进化史）                       |
| 第二句   | 介绍传统科学共识：小型犬的基因变异出现在过去2万年内，因人为选择 |
| 第三句   | 研究者观点：传统解释有误，IGF1基因变异普遍存在于家犬，暗示变异起源更早 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> IGF1 has been isolated in genetic material from fossils more than 20,000 years old of the red wolf (Canis rufus) and certain other species related to dogs.
错误原因：仅表明IGF1基因存在于相关物种中，但未说明与体型变异相关的突变何时出现，无法直接支持研究者关于“变异起源早于2万年”的观点。【以偏概全】

**B 选项** ❌
> An additional mutation related to IGF1 affects the development of characteristics other than body size in smaller dog breeds like bulldogs.
错误原因：提到的是影响其他特征的突变，与体型大小的变异无关，不能支持研究者针对体型变异起源时间的断言。【无中生有】

**C 选项** ✅
> The mutation related to IGF1 influences body size and is found in 53,000-year-old genetic material from fossils of Siberian wolves (Canis lupus campestris), an ancestor of dogs.
正确原因：明确指出与体型相关的IGF1突变存在于5.3万年前的狼类祖先中，直接支持了研究者关于体型变异起源远早于2万年前的主张。

**D 选项** ❌
> One variant of IGF1 is found only in smaller dog breeds like bulldogs and appears to have emerged no more than 20,000 years ago.
错误原因：内容完全符合传统观点，支持传统解释而非研究者的反驳，方向相反。【方向相反】

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题核心在于识别研究者观点与传统观点的冲突点——体型变异的起源时间。关键词有“mutation related to IGF1”，“body size”，“ubiquitous”，“20,000 years”。选项中只有C明确指出该突变出现在远早于2万年前的祖先中，直接支持观点。排除时注意选项是否涉及体型变异、突变时间以及是否与研究者观点相符。

## 题目类型说明

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> A team of public transportation experts in Detroit is creating a new streetcar stop for the Woodward Avenue Streetcar system that will service a neighborhood in which a stop does not currently exist.

👉 介绍背景和任务：专家团队正在为一个没有街车站的社区设立新的街车站。

**第2句：**
> To decide where to place the stop, the team is using a survey from ten years ago that asked how far neighborhood residents would be willing to walk to a streetcar stop.

👉 说明决策依据：团队使用了十年前的调查数据来决定站点位置。

**第3句：**
> The team also looked at studies showing that people's willingness to walk to public transit is influenced by factors like weather and the presence of paved sidewalks and available crosswalks.

👉 解释影响因素：人们愿意步行到公交站的距离受天气、铺装人行道和斑马线等因素影响。

**第4句：**
> A researcher has argued that the survey does not accurately reflect the feelings of today's residents of this neighborhood.

👉 转折并提出观点：有研究者认为十年前的调查不能准确反映当前居民的意愿。

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅
> The number of sidewalks and crosswalks in the neighborhood that the streetcar stop will service has increased substantially in the last ten years.

该选项表明影响居民步行意愿的基础设施发生了实质性变化，直接支持了研究者认为“旧调查数据不准确”的观点，因为居民的步行环境已经改变。

**B 选项** ❌【无中生有】
> Residents of Detroit are much less likely to use public transit on rainy days than on clear days.

虽然天气影响步行意愿，但该选项仅说明天气影响，并未涉及十年前调查数据和当前居民意愿的变化，不能直接支持研究者观点。

**C 选项** ❌【无中生有】
> There has been a sharp increase in the last ten years in cyclists who use the roads in the neighborhood that the streetcar stop will service.

骑行人数增加与居民步行意愿调查的准确性无关，无法直接支持研究者观点。

**D 选项** ❌【方向相反】
> Current users of the Woodward Avenue Streetcar are satisfied with the number of stops along the line.

该选项反映的是当前用户对站点数量的满意度，与调查数据的时间差异及其准确性无关，不能支持研究者观点。

## 题目类型说明

这是一道细节理解题，核心任务是找出哪个研究结果最直接支持团队关于“区分真假笑声能力具有跨文化普遍性”的结论。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Psychologists Gregory Bryant, Dorsa Amir, and colleagues investigated cross-cultural perceptions of spontaneous (real) laughter and volitional (fake or forced) laughter.

👉 介绍研究主题：跨文化对真假笑声的感知调查。

**第2句：**
> Study participants from 21 societies, including those in Austria and Samoa, listened to randomized recordings of 18 spontaneous laughs taken from natural conversations between pairs of women and 18 volitional laughs produced separately by 18 different women in response to an instruction to laugh.

👉 说明研究方法：来自21个社会的参与者听取真假笑声的录音。

**第3句：**
> Analysis of the participants' evaluations of the laughs prompted the team to conclude that the ability to distinguish between spontaneous and volitional laughter appears to be universal across cultures.

👉 研究结论：区分真假笑声的能力在不同文化中普遍存在。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                      |
|:---------|:--------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍研究主题和对象         |
| 第二句   | 描述研究方法和样本         |
| 第三句   | 得出跨文化普遍性的结论     |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> An assessment of the effect of demographic variables on judgments of laughter type in Austria, Samoa, and the other societies in the study revealed that participants' evaluations were correlated with the economic conditions of the societies in which participants live.

此选项谈及经济条件对判断的影响，偏离了“普遍性”核心，且暗示判断受社会环境影响，不能直接支持“跨文化普遍性”结论。
错误类型：【以偏概全】

**B 选项** ✅
> The overall rate of correct judgments by participants was 64%, substantially better than chance, and spontaneous and volitional laughs were recognized at similar rates in Austria, Samoa, and the other societies in the study.

此选项指出参与者判断准确率明显高于随机，且各社会间识别率相近，直接支持“跨文化普遍性”的结论，与文章最后一句完全呼应。

**C 选项** ❌
> Acoustic features of spontaneous laughter, such as pitch and intensity, have measurable variations both within and across societies.

此选项描述笑声声学特征的变化，与判断能力的普遍性无关，未能支持结论。
错误类型：【无中生有】

**D 选项** ❌
> A variety of people from Austria and Samoa evaluated the recordings in the study, and no significant differences in listeners' judgments of laughter types were found.

虽然表明两地听众判断无显著差异，但未涵盖其他社会，支持力度不够，不能完全支持“跨文化普遍性”的结论。
错误类型：【过度推断】

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于识别“跨文化普遍性”这一结论的核心证据，即“不同文化背景的参与者都能准确区分真假笑”，注意选项中表述准确率和不同文化间比较的内容是核心线索，排除偏向单一文化或无关变量的选项。关键词“similar rates”、“substantially better than chance”直接指向正确答案。

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Psychologists Gregory Bryant, Dorsa Amir, and colleagues investigated cross-cultural perceptions of spontaneous (real) laughter and volitional (fake or forced) laughter.

👉 介绍研究对象和主题：跨文化对真实笑与假笑的感知研究。

**第2句：**
> Study participants from 21 societies, including those in Austria and Turkey, listened to randomized recordings of 18 spontaneous laughs taken from natural conversations between pairs of women and 18 volitional laughs produced separately by 18 different women in response to an experimenter's instruction to laugh.

👉 说明研究方法：21个社会的参与者听取18个真实笑和18个假笑录音。

**第3句：**
> Analysis of the participants' evaluations of the laughs prompted the team to conclude that the ability to distinguish between spontaneous and volitional laughter appears to be universal across cultures.

👉 研究结论：不同文化背景的人普遍能区分真实笑和假笑。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                             |
|:---------|:--------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍研究对象：跨文化对真实笑和假笑的感知 |
| 第二句   | 描述研究方法：21社会参与者听18真笑和18假笑录音 |
| 第三句   | 研究结论：普遍存在区分真笑假笑的能力   |

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅
> "When an individual chooses to produce volitional laughter in a natural social context, the laughter often shares certain acoustic qualities, such as pitch and fluctuation of intensity, with spontaneous laughter."

此选项指出假笑在自然社交场合中会与真笑共享声学特征，说明假笑和真笑的声音特征重叠，削弱了团队认为“跨文化普遍能区分真笑与假笑”的结论，因为如果声音特征相似，区分难度会增大。此为直接削弱证据。

**B 选项** ❌【无中生有】
> "Although the team considered the average size of communities in each society in the study, that demographic factor was found to have no effect on listeners' identifications of laughter as spontaneous or volitional."

此选项只是补充社区规模对结果无影响，与是否能区分真笑假笑无关，不能削弱结论。

**C 选项** ❌【无中生有】
> "Judgments of spontaneous laughter are often associated with acoustic features such as greater intensity variability and higher pitch."

该选项仅描述真笑的声学特征，与假笑的可区分性无关，没有削弱效果。

**D 选项** ❌【无中生有】
> "Recent studies in communications have shown that certain acoustic features of spontaneous laughter, such as pitch and intensity, are consistent both within and across societies."

该选项强调真笑的声学特征在不同文化间一致，反而支持团队结论。

## 题目类型说明

这是一道细节理解题，核心任务是根据文章内容找出能直接支持研究者最终建议的研究发现。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Vegetation has two primary mechanisms by which it reduces air pollution: deposition (absorption of pollutants) and the, more effective, dispersion (dilution of pollutants by ventilation).

👉 介绍植被减少空气污染的两种主要机制，并指出扩散（通风稀释）更有效。

**第2句：**
> Accordingly, establishment of green space to reduce major air pollutants such as coarse particulate matter in urban areas receives considerable attention.

👉 说明在城市中建立绿地以减少主要空气污染物（粗颗粒物）受到广泛关注，作为前述机制的应用背景。

**第3句：**
> Research by Zander S. Venter et al. comprised data from air-quality monitoring stations in Belgium, the US state of West Virginia, and thousands of other global locations over a ten-year span, coupled with aerial imagery of those locations from the same period.

👉 介绍研究对象和方法——多地点、多时间跨度的空气质量数据及航拍影像。

**第4句：**
> The researchers ultimately recommended that reducing anthropogenic emissions remain the primary focus of urban air quality improvement efforts.

👉 给出研究结论：建议减少人为排放应作为城市空气质量改善的主要方向。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 植被减少空气污染的两种机制，强调扩散更有效 |
| 第二句 | 绿地建设在城市减少空气污染中的重要性和关注度 |
| 第三句 | 研究数据来源和范围的介绍 |
| 第四句 | 研究者最终建议优先减少人为排放 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> The association between levels of coarse particulate matter and green space is strongly negative for locations containing or in close proximity to major cities but becomes insignificant for more rural locations.

错误原因：此选项只说明绿地在城市附近与粗颗粒物的负相关，但未涉及为何减少人为排放应为优先，未直接支持研究结论。【过度推断】

**B 选项** ✅
> The association between green space and coarse particulate matter levels is moderately negative overall but becomes slightly negative and sometimes positive when consideration is limited to busy streets with tree cover heavy enough to hinder ventilation.

正确原因：此选项指出绿地对空气污染的影响因通风受阻而减弱甚至反转，直接表明绿地作用有限，因而支持研究者建议应优先减少人为排放。

**C 选项** ❌
> Ambient levels of coarse particulate matter are comparable across locations with comparable local infrastructure (e.g., typical building shape) but vary considerably depending on the predominant type of vegetation present.

错误原因：此选项强调植被类型对颗粒物的影响，未涉及减少人为排放的必要性，与研究结论无直接关联。【无中生有】

**D 选项** ❌
> There is a predictable relationship between a location's typical climate conditions and the efficacy of green spaces in that location, but anomalous local weather events have an outsized effect on deposition and dispersion of coarse particulate matter.

错误原因：此选项讨论气候和异常天气对绿地效果的影响，未直接说明绿地作用不足以优先减少人为排放。【以偏概全】

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关注题干“most directly account for the recommendation”中的“直接支持”信号，结合文章末句研究建议聚焦减少人为排放，锁定选项中体现绿地作用受限或不足的内容（如B选项中“树木覆盖阻碍通风导致绿地效果减弱”），排除未涉及研究结论的选项，确保选项与研究建议形成因果对应。

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第3句：**
> While bioaccumulation of manufactured nanoparticles may be inherently worrisome, it has been hypothesized that Ag-NP bioaccumulation in invertebrates like E. fetida could serve a valuable proxy role,

👉 提出假设：红蚯蚓等无脊椎动物中Ag-NP的积累可作为代理指标。

**第4句：**
> obviating the need for manufacturers to conduct costly and intrusive sampling of vertebrate species—such as zebrafish (Danio rerio), commonly used in regulatory compliance testing—for nanoparticle bioaccumulation, as environmental protection laws currently require.

👉 解释假设的价值：用无脊椎动物替代脊椎动物检测，可以减少成本和麻烦。

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> Compared with D. rerio, E. fetida can tolerate significantly higher Ag-NP concentrations without displaying any negative effects.

该选项谈的是耐受性差异，未涉及两种动物中Ag-NP积累的相关性或可替代性，无法直接支持代理假设。【无中生有】

**B 选项** ❌
> Ag-NP concentrations in E. fetida correlate strongly with Ag-NP levels in the environment, whereas Ag-NP concentrations in D. rerio are fairly stable regardless of environment.

该选项只说明红蚯蚓体内Ag-NP与环境浓度相关，但没有说明红蚯蚓与斑马鱼之间的积累关系，无法证明红蚯蚓能替代斑马鱼。【以偏概全】

**C 选项** ✅
> When E. fetida and D. rerio are exposed to similar levels of Ag-NPs, individuals of the two species tend to accumulate similar amounts of Ag-NPs, adjusted for body size.

该选项直接说明两种动物在同等暴露下积累量相似，支持红蚯蚓积累可作为斑马鱼积累的代理，最直接支持文章假设。

**D 选项** ❌
> It is easier to detect low and harmless concentrations of Ag-NPs in E. fetida than it is to detect high and harmful concentrations of Ag-NPs in D. rerio.

该选项谈检测难易，与两种动物积累量是否相似及可替代性无关，不能直接支持假设。【无中生有】

## 核心解题技巧

## 文章逻辑拆解

> This style has exerted a decisive influence on authors around the world, including Olga Tokarczuk, whose 1996 novel *Primeval and Other Times* resembles classic magical realist novels in its juxtaposition of literary realism with folklore—namely, that of Poland.

👉 说明魔幻现实主义风格影响了全球作家，特别指出托卡尔丘克的作品以现实主义与波兰民俗的结合类似经典魔幻现实主义小说。

| 第二句   | 强调该风格的全球影响，特别是托卡尔丘克作品通过现实主义与波兰民俗的结合体现魔幻现实主义。 |

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅（正确）

选项明确指出该小说的现实主义情节被波兰民俗的形象和情境反复且有成效地打断，直接对应文中“现实主义与波兰民俗并置”的描述，且强调两者的结合是“productive”，符合原文“resembles classic magical realist novels”的意思。

**B 选项** ❌（错误）

**C 选项** ❌（错误）

**D 选项** ❌（错误）

Recently, however, evolutionary ecologist Khudadad Khudadad examined the remnants of a Devonian forest in what is now Cairo, New York, and concluded that evidence from the Cairo site is inconsistent with the partition hypothesis.
stem: Which finding about the Cairo site, if true, would most directly support Khudadad's conclusion?

options.content: The site appears to have been a tropical deltaic forest early in the Devonian period but transitioned to an arid floodplain forest after the end of the Devonian period.

## 题目类型说明

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Based on findings from fossil sites, paleobotanists had developed the so-called partition hypothesis, which holds that there were two distinctly different kinds of biomes during the Devonian period (circa 360 to 420 million years ago).

👉 介绍“partition hypothesis”的内容和背景，即在泥盆纪存在两种截然不同的生物群落。

**第2句：**
> One was a tropical deltaic forest biome home to plants such as the fernlike Eospermatopteris, and the other was an arid floodplain forest biome home to plants such as the coniferlike Archaeopteris.

👉 具体说明这两种生物群落的特点及代表植物。

**第3句：**
> Recently, however, evolutionary ecologist Khudadad Khudadad examined the remnants of a Devonian forest in what is now Cairo, New York, and concluded that evidence from the Cairo site is inconsistent with the partition hypothesis.

👉 转折，提出Khudadad的研究结果与“partition hypothesis”相矛盾。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                     |
|:---------|:----------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍“partition hypothesis”：泥盆纪有两种不同的生物群落。   |
| 第二句   | 详细描述两种生物群落及其代表植物。                   |
| 第三句   | Khudadad发现开罗遗址的证据与该假说不符。              |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> The site appears to have been a tropical deltaic forest early in the Devonian period but transitioned to an arid floodplain forest after the end of the Devonian period.

错误原因：该选项描述的是时期上的变化，且变化发生在泥盆纪之后，未直接反驳“partition hypothesis”中两种生物群落在泥盆纪并存的观点。【无中生有】

**B 选项** ✅
> The site appears to have been an arid floodplain forest during the Devonian period and contains fossil evidence of contemporaneous Eospermatopteris and Archaeopteris.

正确原因：该选项表明两种代表性植物同时存在于同一地点和时间，直接反驳了“partition hypothesis”中两种生物群落独立存在的观点，支持Khudadad的结论。

**C 选项** ❌
> Fossil evidence from the site suggests that several forest plant species other than Eospermatopteris and Archaeopteris lived there during the Devonian period.

错误原因：该选项只是说明有其他植物存在，并未触及两种生物群落是否分区的问题，未能直接支持Khudadad的结论。【无中生有】

**D 选项** ❌
> Although the site appears to have been a tropical deltaic forest during the Devonian period, fossil evidence suggests that Eospermatopteris was present at that time.

错误原因：该选项仅重复了“partition hypothesis”中关于热带三角洲森林及其代表植物的内容，未涉及两种生物群落同时存在的问题，无法支持Khudadad的结论。【无中生有】

👉 交代主要人物和情境设定（人物关系介绍）

**第3句：**
> Chekhov portrays the relationship between Vanya and Professor Serebrakoff as being much more strained than it once was, as is evident when _______

👉 文章核心观点：Vanya和教授的关系比以前紧张，后文将给出证据支持这一观点

| 第二句   | 介绍主要人物及他们的关系和居住环境 |
| 第三句   | 提出观点：Vanya与教授关系紧张，后续举例证明 |

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> Professor Serebrakoff asks Vanya to leave the room, saying, "For the sake of our former friendship do not protest against going, We will talk some other time."

此句显示教授试图维护“former friendship”，语气中带有请求和妥协，更多体现的是教授的忍让而非双方紧张关系的直接体现。【方向相反】

**B 选项** ✅
> Vanya says to Professor Serebrakoff, "For twenty-five years I have managed [the country estate], and have sent you the returns from it like the most honest of servants, and you have never given me one single word of thanks for my work, not one — neither in my youth nor now."

此句直接表达了Vanya对教授长期忽视和不感谢的愤怒和失望，充分体现了双方关系的紧张和疏远，紧扣题干“关系更紧张”的核心。

**C 选项** ❌
> Vanya says of Professor Serebrakoff, "He is everlastingly whining about his hard lot, though, as a matter of fact, he is extraordinarily lucky."

此句主要体现Vanya对教授的评价和不满，但侧重于教授的抱怨，不是直接反映两人关系紧张的具体互动或冲突。【以偏概全】

**D 选项** ❌

此句表现教授对他人态度的抱怨，虽有不满，但并未直接表现他与Vanya之间关系紧张的具体证据。【无中生有】

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于锁定“关系紧张”的直接体现。选项中需要包含双方明确的冲突或情绪表达。关注选项中的情绪词（如“never given thanks”、“most honest of servants”）和直接对话内容，排除那些表达妥协、抱怨但无直接冲突的选项，最终选出最能体现双方关系恶化的句子。

article: Autofiction is an emerging literary form that incorporates autobiographical writing into fiction. Practitioners of autofiction emphasize the autobiographical aspects of their work by patterning their protagonists' lives after their own, typically naming their protagonists after themselves. Autofiction usually borrows formal elements from autobiographical writing too, including its first-person point of view and its use of a narrative voice so forthright that it borders on confessional. Ocean Vuong's 2019 novel On Earth We're Briefly Gorgeous is a representative work of autofiction, one that erases the distinction that fiction typically observes between authors and the characters they create.
stem: Which statement, if true, would most strongly support the text's description of On Earth We're Briefly Gorgeous?

options.content: The novel portrays the upbringing of the protagonist, a young writer, in a working-class Vietnamese American family that is virtually identical to Vuong's family, and the protagonist narrates the novel in a tone that many reviewers describe as surprisingly frank.

Although the narrative of On Earth We're Briefly Gorgeous proceeds in a largely chronological fashion, as narratives do in most works of fiction, the form of Vuong's narrative is unique: the novel consists of a single long letter that the protagonist, a soft-spoken young man, has written to his mother.

On Earth We're Briefly Gorgeous makes use of imagery in much the same way that contemporary poetry does, exploiting certain images-butterflies for example-for their emotional or conceptual associations; in this way, Vuong blurs the distinction between poetry and fiction.

The novel's protagonist bears an obvious resemblance to Vuong himself and in interviews Vuong speaks of the protagonist as a sort of alternation the protagonist refers to himself as 'Little Dog' throughout the novel never divulges his actual name.

## 题目类型说明

这是细节理解题，核心任务是找到最能支持文章对《On Earth We're Briefly Gorgeous》描述的陈述。

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Autofiction is an emerging literary form that incorporates autobiographical writing into fiction.

👉 定义“autofiction”，说明它是一种将自传体写作融入小说的新兴文学形式。

**第2句：**
> Practitioners of autofiction emphasize the autobiographical aspects of their work by patterning their protagonists' lives after their own, typically naming their protagonists after themselves.

👉 解释autofiction的特点：作者通常让主角的生活模式与自身相似，甚至使用自己的名字。

**第3句：**
> Autofiction usually borrows formal elements from autobiographical writing too, including its first-person point of view and its use of a narrative voice so forthright that it borders on confessional.

👉 说明autofiction的写作形式特点，如第一人称视角和接近忏悔体的坦率叙述。

**第4句：**
> Ocean Vuong's 2019 novel *On Earth We're Briefly Gorgeous* is a representative work of autofiction, one that erases the distinction that fiction typically observes between authors and the characters they create.

👉 举例说明Vuong的小说是autofiction的典型代表，强调该书模糊了作者与角色之间的界限。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                                         |
|:---------|:-------------------------------------------------------------|
| 第1句    | 定义autofiction，说明其是将自传与小说结合的新文学形式       |
| 第2句    | 说明autofiction作家如何通过让主角生活与自己相似体现自传性   |
| 第3句    | 介绍autofiction的叙述形式，第一人称和坦率叙述               |
| 第4句    | 以Vuong的小说为例，说明其模糊作者与角色界限，是典型autofiction|

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅（正确）
> The novel portrays the upbringing of the protagonist, a young writer, in a working-class Vietnamese American family that is virtually identical to Vuong's family, and the protagonist narrates the novel in a tone that many reviewers describe as surprisingly frank.

此选项直接对应第2句和第3句，强调主角生活几乎与作者相同，且叙述语气坦率，符合autofiction的特征，强力支持文章对该小说的描述。

**B 选项** ❌（错误）
> Although the narrative of *On Earth We're Briefly Gorgeous* proceeds in a largely chronological fashion, as narratives do in most works of fiction, the form of Vuong's narrative is unique: the novel consists of a single long letter that the protagonist, a soft-spoken young man, has written to his mother.

该选项侧重叙事结构的独特性，但文章未提及叙事结构或书信体，且重点在作者与角色的关系，故无力支持文章观点。
【无中生有】

**C 选项** ❌（错误）
> *On Earth We're Briefly Gorgeous* makes use of imagery in much the same way that contemporary poetry does, exploiting certain images-butterflies for example-for their emotional or conceptual associations; in this way, Vuong blurs the distinction between poetry and fiction.

文章未提及诗歌或意象的使用，也未涉及诗与小说的界限，故该信息与文中内容无关。
【无中生有】

**D 选项** ❌（错误）
> The novel's protagonist bears an obvious resemblance to Vuong himself and in interviews Vuong speaks of the protagonist as a sort of alternation the protagonist refers to himself as 'Little Dog' throughout the novel never divulges his actual name.

选项中虽然提到主角与作者相似，但强调主角未用真实姓名，与文章中“typically naming their protagonists after themselves”相反，且“never divulges his actual name”与作者命名主角的描述冲突。
【方向相反】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在抓住文章对autofiction的定义和特征，尤其是“主角生活模式与作者相同”和“坦率的第一人称叙述”两大核心点。选项中只有A选项明确体现这两个要素，因此最符合文意。其他选项要么涉及未提及的细节（结构、诗歌意象），要么与“主角命名”矛盾，利用这些信号词（virtually identical、frank tone）锁定正确答案，排除干扰。

article: Born in Chile in 1917, artist and ethnomusicologist Violeta Parra was a pioneer in the nueva canción chilena (Chilean New Song) movement that emerged in the late 1950s and then spread throughout Latin America, Portugal, and Spain as nueva canción. Parra traveled all over Chile compiling extensive records of authentic folk music as well as recipes, proverbs, and other facets of cultural history. These records formed the foundation for the early movement's revival of traditional Chilean folk forms in new songs that represented modern realities of the working class and strongly advocated for social change. As the movement spread beyond Chile, the breadth of musical traditions incorporated into its foundation also expanded.
stem: Which detail about songs associated with nueva canción, if true, would best illustrate the underlined claim?

options.content: Many feature political commentary addressing contemporary issues that stemmed from shared experiences of European colonization in Latin American countries.
Many were written with parts meant to be played on the quena, a traditional flute used across Andean countries, including Chile.
Many were produced by Argentinian artists in the late 1950s, with others by artists in additional Latin American countries first emerging soon after.
Many demonstrate the stylistic influence of corrido, a genre of narrative songs from Mexico that had come to be characterized by political themes in the early 1800s.

## 题目类型说明

这是细节理解题，核心任务是找出能最好地支持文中划线句（关于nueva canción音乐传统广泛融合的论断）的具体细节。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Born in Chile in 1917, artist and ethnomusicologist Violeta Parra was a pioneer in the *nueva canción chilena* (Chilean New Song) movement that emerged in the late 1950s and then spread throughout Latin America, Portugal, and Spain as *nueva canción*.

👉 介绍Violeta Parra及其在nueva canción运动中的先驱身份，以及该运动的起源和传播范围。

**第2句：**
> Parra traveled all over Chile compiling extensive records of authentic folk music as well as recipes, proverbs, and other facets of cultural history.

👉 说明Parra通过收集民间音乐及文化资料，为nueva canción提供内容基础。

**第3句：**
> These records formed the foundation for the early movement's revival of traditional Chilean folk forms in new songs that represented modern realities of the working class and strongly advocated for social change.

👉 阐述这些文化记录如何成为运动中传统民歌复兴和社会变革表达的基础。

**第4句（划线句）：**
> As the movement spread beyond Chile, the breadth of musical traditions incorporated into its foundation also expanded.

👉 论述运动传播到其他地区后，音乐传统的融合范围扩大，提出题干所问的论点。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 介绍Violeta Parra和nueva canción运动的起源及传播范围。 |
| 第二句 | 描述Parra收集传统民间文化资料的行动。 |
| 第三句 | 说明这些资料如何成为复兴传统民歌并反映现代工人阶级现实的基础。 |
| 第四句 | 论断运动传播后音乐传统融合范围扩大（划线句）。 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> Many feature political commentary addressing contemporary issues that stemmed from shared experiences of European colonization in Latin American countries.

错误，因为选项强调的是政治评论和共同历史背景，而非“音乐传统的广泛融合”，不直接支持划线句中的“musical traditions incorporated”扩展。
错误类型：【以偏概全】

**B 选项** ❌
> Many were written with parts meant to be played on the *quena*, a traditional flute used across Andean countries, including Chile.

错误，虽然提到使用安第斯地区的传统乐器，但只涉及一个传统乐器，没有体现“音乐传统广泛融合”的扩展，支持力度不足。
错误类型：【以偏概全】

**C 选项** ❌
> Many were produced by Argentinian artists in the late 1950s, with others by artists in additional Latin American countries first emerging soon after.

错误，此选项侧重于地理传播和艺术家国籍，描述运动传播，但未提及音乐传统融合的“广度”扩大，与划线句核心不符。
错误类型：【无中生有】（未体现“musical traditions”融合的细节）

**D 选项** ✅
> Many demonstrate the stylistic influence of *corrido*, a genre of narrative songs from Mexico that had come to be characterized by political themes in the early 1800s.

正确，明确指出nueva canción吸收了墨西哥叙事歌曲*corrido*的风格影响，体现了“音乐传统的广泛融合”，直接支持划线句。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 题干要求选择能最好证明“音乐传统融合范围扩大”的细节，需关注划线句关键词“breadth”、“musical traditions”。选项中只有D具体提到其他地区的传统音乐类型（*corrido*）对nueva canción的影响，体现了“融合”的概念。其他选项虽涉及政治内容、乐器或传播范围，但未直接说明“音乐传统”融合，故被排除。锁定关键词及其含义是解题关键。

article: Economists have demonstrated that herding—in which individuals converge on the same action by imitating the economic decisions of one or more peers—occurs among investors. Investigating whether herding also occurs among nations in matters of economic policy, Maru Etta-Nkwelle examined changes in the foreign currency reserves of emerging economies in various world regions in the years following the widespread financial crisis of 1997. Etta-Nkwelle posited that herding would manifest in regional peer countries converging on the same foreign currency accumulation rate regardless of each country's observable circumstances. She found that Asian countries showed evidence of herding but African countries did not.
stem: Based on the text, which finding, if true, would best account for the discrepancy Etta Nkwelle observed?

options.content: The majority of the currency held in reserves by the African countries was foreign currency, whereas the majority of the currency held in reserves by the Asian countries was domestic currency.
The African countries tended to accumulate a variety of foreign currencies for their reserves, whereas the Asian countries tended to favor a single foreign currency for their reserves.

Most of the African countries belonged to international economic unions that set individual foreign-currency accumulation policies for each member, whereas the Asian countries were largely free to set their own policies.

The 1997 financial crisis resulted in immediate declines in many of the African countries' foreign currency reserves, whereas the crisis had few short-term effects on the foreign currency reserves of most of the Asian countries.
