## 题目类型说明

这是一道因果关系题，核心任务是根据文章中观察到的“亚洲国家有群体效应而非非洲国家”的差异，找出最合理的解释该差异的原因。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Economists have demonstrated that herding in which individuals converge on the same action by imitating the economic decisions of one or more peers — occurs among investors.

👉 介绍“群体效应（herding）”的定义及其在投资者中的存在。

**第2句：**
> Investigating whether herding also occurs among nations in matters of economic policy, Maru Etta-Nkwelle examined changes in the foreign currency reserves of emerging economies in various world regions in the years following the widespread financial crisis of 1997.

👉 说明Etta-Nkwelle的研究目的和研究对象（国家间经济政策中的群体效应，研究货币储备变化）。

**第3句：**
> Etta-Nkwelle posited that herding would manifest in regional peer countries converging on the same foreign currency accumulation rate regardless of each country's observable circumstances.

👉 提出假设：如果有群体效应，同一区域的国家会在外汇储备累积率上趋同，即使各国的具体情况不同。

**第4句：**
> She found that Asian countries showed evidence of herding but African countries did not.

👉 研究结果：亚洲国家表现出群体效应，非洲国家则没有。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 介绍群体效应的定义和存在背景（投资者中） |
| 第二句 | 引出研究主题：国家间经济政策的群体效应，研究对象和时间背景 |
| 第三句 | 提出研究假设：群体效应表现为区域内国家外汇储备累积率趋同 |
| 第四句 | 研究发现：亚洲国家有群体效应，非洲国家无群体效应 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> The majority of the currency held in reserves by the African countries was foreign currency, whereas the majority of the currency held in reserves by the Asian countries was domestic currency.

错误原因：文章聚焦的是“外汇储备（foreign currency reserves）”，若亚洲国家储备的主要是本币（domestic currency），则不符合研究对象定义。【无中生有】——选项内容与文章核心研究对象“外汇储备”不符。

**B 选项** ❌
> The African countries tended to accumulate a variety of foreign currencies for their reserves, whereas the Asian countries tended to favor a single foreign currency for their reserves.

错误原因：该选项提出储备货币种类差异，但文章未涉及货币种类对群体效应的影响，且这不能直接解释为何亚洲有群体效应非洲没有。【过度推断】——没有文章依据支持。

**C 选项** ✅
> Most of the African countries belonged to international economic unions that set individual foreign-currency accumulation policies for each member, whereas the Asian countries were largely free to set their own policies.

正确原因：这解释了非洲国家因受国际经济联盟政策约束，无法自由模仿邻国经济行为，从而缺乏群体效应；而亚洲国家自由制定政策，更容易出现群体效应，符合文章讨论的“群体效应依赖国家自主决策”的逻辑。

**D 选项** ❌
> The 1997 financial crisis resulted in immediate declines in many of the African countries' foreign currency reserves, whereas the crisis had few short-term effects on the foreign currency reserves of most of the Asian countries.

错误原因：虽然描述了危机后不同地区储备变化，但与群体效应是否存在无直接因果关系，不能解释为何亚洲有群体效应而非洲没有。【无中生有】——与群体效应无关。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题核心在于抓住“亚洲国家表现出群体效应，非洲国家没有”这一差异，寻找能够解释差异的制度或政策背景。题干中“discrepancy”提示要找原因。选项中涉及国家自主决策权的C选项最贴合，因为群体效应依赖自由模仿行为，受制于外部规则的国家难以形成群体效应。排除时要注意选项是否与文章讨论的核心概念（外汇储备、群体效应）直接相关，避免无关或过度推断。

article: Paleontologist Amane Tajika and colleagues analyzed the shells of two marine mollusks called nautilids that were collected from waters near New Caledonia. Sample F13 and other shell sections formed during adulthood suggest that mature New Caledonian nautilids live at the same depths as mature Fijian nautilids. However, sample M06, which formed while the nautilid was still in its egg, had a chemical signature suggesting the egg had been laid in water 120 meters deep, while Fijian nautilids typically lay eggs at depths of at least 170 meters. Because water temperature decreases as depth increases, a biology student hypothesized that the New Caledonian nautilids lay their eggs in warmer water than Fijian nautilids do.
stem: Which finding, if true, would most directly weaken the student's hypothesis?

options.content: New Caledonia nautilids tend to migrate upward to warmer water immediately after hatching, whereas Fijian nautilids do not.
The water temperature at a given depth tends to be higher in waters near Fiji than it is at that depth in waters near New Caledonia.
There aren't enough suitable hatching areas at a depth of at least 170 meters in New Caledonia for nautilids to lay their eggs at that depth.
The water temperature at a given depth tends to be lower in waters near Fiji than it is at that depth in waters near New Caledonia.

## 题目类型说明

这是推理题，要求找出最能削弱生物学生假设的发现，核心任务是理解假设逻辑并寻找与之直接矛盾的证据。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Paleontologist Amane Tajika and colleagues analyzed the shells of two marine mollusks called nautilids that were collected from waters near New Caledonia.

👉 介绍研究对象和研究背景。

**第2句：**
> Sample F13 and other shell sections formed during adulthood suggest that mature New Caledonian nautilids live at the same depths as mature Fijian nautilids.

👉 说明成体鹦鹉螺的生活深度相似。

**第3句：**
> However, sample M06, which formed while the nautilid was still in its egg, had a chemical signature suggesting the egg had been laid in water 120 meters deep, while Fijian nautilids typically lay eggs at depths of at least 170 meters.

👉 提出对比，指出新喀里多尼亚鹦鹉螺的卵产深度较浅。

**第4句：**
> Because water temperature decreases as depth increases, a biology student hypothesized that the New Caledonian nautilids lay their eggs in warmer water than Fijian nautilids do.

👉 解释学生基于温度与深度关系提出的假设。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 介绍研究对象（鹦鹉螺）和采样地点（新喀里多尼亚） |
| 第二句 | 说明成体鹦鹉螺生活深度相同（新喀里多尼亚和斐济） |
| 第三句 | 指出卵产深度不同，新喀里多尼亚较浅（120米 vs 170米） |
| 第四句 | 学生基于水温随深度降低假设新喀里多尼亚鹦鹉螺产卵于较温暖水域 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> New Caledonia nautilids tend to migrate upward to warmer water immediately after hatching, whereas Fijian nautilids do not.

该选项描述的是鹦鹉螺孵化后迁移行为，与卵产水温假设关系不大，未直接削弱假设。【无中生有】

**B 选项** ✅
> The water temperature at a given depth tends to be higher in waters near Fiji than it is at that depth in waters near New Caledonia.

如果斐济水域同一深度的水温比新喀里多尼亚还高，则新喀里多尼亚鹦鹉螺在较浅水域产卵并不意味着水温更高，直接反驳学生假设。

## 题目类型说明

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Hypothesizing that lullabies, characterized by their slow tempos, are universally calming to infants, Constance M. Bainbridge and colleagues played a lullaby sung in the Scottish Gaelic language and a non-lullaby sung in the Seri language to a group of infants.

**第2句：**

👉 实验结果：催眠曲使婴儿心率下降更多。

**第3句：**
> Since a decrease in heart rate is associated with relaxation, the team concluded that the lullaby relaxed the infants.
👉 因果推论：心率下降意味着放松，催眠曲让婴儿放松。

**第4句：**
> Noting that reduced heart rate can also be associated with increased attention, one critic argues that instead, the lullaby simply attracted the infants' attention.
👉 转折并提出批评者观点：心率下降也可能代表注意力增加，催眠曲可能只是吸引注意。

**第5句：**
> Bainbridge and colleagues also measured pupil size, as pupils typically become larger when a stimulus captures a person's attention.
👉 介绍另一项测量（瞳孔大小）以判断注意力。

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                                         |
|:---------|:-------------------------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 提出假设并介绍实验设计：比较苏格兰盖尔语催眠曲和塞里语非催眠曲对婴儿的影响。 |
| 第二句   | 实验发现：催眠曲使婴儿心率下降更多。                           |
| 第三句   | 结论：心率下降表示放松，催眠曲让婴儿放松。                     |
| 第四句   | 批评者观点：心率下降也可能表示注意力增加，催眠曲吸引注意力。   |
| 第五句   | 额外测量瞳孔大小，瞳孔变大通常表示注意力被吸引。               |

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> Blinking, which indicates attention, was equally frequent whether infants were listening to the song in Scottish Gaelic or song in Seri.
该选项仅涉及眨眼频率与注意力的关系，但文章未提及眨眼是判断注意力的关键指标，且未直接反驳批评者关于心率下降与注意力的联系，属于【无中生有】。

**C 选项** ✅

**D 选项** ❌
> Parents of infants in the study chose the lullaby over the non-lullaby when asked which song they would use to calm their child.
该选项只涉及家长偏好，未涉及婴儿注意力或心率变化，无法削弱批评者观点，属于【无中生有】。

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**

👉 通过两个语言的音素数量对比，引出语言音素数量差异的现象。

**第2句：**

👉 提出疑问，为后文的解释做铺垫。

**第3句：**
> One researcher has claimed that when modern humans arose in Africa, they spoke a single language, but as humans gradually spread throughout Africa and then around the globe, that language developed into new languages.

👉 介绍研究者的观点：语言起源于非洲单一语言，随着人类扩散语言分化。

**第4句：**
> Those developed into still more languages as small bands of humans spread even farther, with each new language retaining fewer sounds from humanity's original language.

👉 进一步阐述语言衍变过程，且音素数量随扩散逐渐减少。

## 结构总结

|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 举例说明不同语言音素数量差异 |
| 第二句 | 提出疑问，说明语言差异的原因值得探讨 |
| 第三句 | 介绍研究者观点：语言起源单一，扩散导致分化 |
| 第四句 | 细化观点：语言扩散导致音素数量逐渐减少 |

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌【无中生有】
> A wider range of sounds is found across the languages of Africa as a whole than across the languages of South America as a whole.

此选项比较的是非洲和南美语言的整体音素范围，与研究者关于语言起源和音素递减的过程无直接关联，未触及削弱核心。

**B 选项** ✅
> Languages that emerged in Europe and Western Asia tend to have more sounds than languages that emerged in Africa do.

研究者主张语言起源于非洲，且音素数量随着迁移逐渐减少。如果欧洲和西亚的语言反而拥有比非洲更多的音素，这直接与“音素递减”的观点相矛盾，因而削弱了研究者的假设。

**C 选项** ❌【无中生有】
> Languages that emerged in Central America tend to have fewer sounds than languages that emerged in Western Europe do, and Central America is farther away from Africa than Western Europe is.

该选项说明距离越远音素越少，符合研究者“音素数量随扩散减少”的观点，反而支持了研究者的论断。

**D 选项** ❌【以偏概全】
> The number of sounds is fairly consistent across the various languages that emerged in the last parts of Africa to be settled by humans.

此选项说明非洲最后被定居地区语言音素数量一致，未触及语言起源和扩散的整体趋势，且不能否定音素数量递减的全球趋势，属于局部情况。

**C 选项** ❌
> The concentration of oxygen-18 in F02 is lower than that in M23.

此选项符合原文逻辑（温度高氧-18低），支持研究者结论，无削弱作用。

此选项支持研究者结论，表明M23对应的水温与氧-18浓度匹配，无削弱作用。

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于理解氧-18浓度与水温（及深度）的关系：深水含氧-18多，温度低；浅水含氧-18少，温度高。题干问“削弱结论”，即寻找与此关系相悖的证据。选项中出现氧-18浓度与温度不符的情况即为正确答案，其他选项均是对原文结论的支持。锁定“氧-18浓度与温度反向变化”的逻辑后，直接排除符合逻辑的选项，选出违反逻辑的B。

article: In what is now southern Florida, the Calusa people (circa 1000–1600 CE) supported their relatively large population’s dietary needs with hydrological engineering rather than terrestrial farming methods. They constructed watercourts (gated coastal enclosures) out of shells and sediments to trap a variety of fish as waters rose and fell with tides and seasonal sea-level shifts; watercourt pools then held the fish for later consumption. Archaeologist Theresa Schober has posited an additional purpose of these enclosures, suggesting that they were intended to foster conch. She ties this hypothesis to the high value the sea snails would have had for the Calusa, both nutritionally and as a building material (conch shells are highly durable).
stem: Which finding, if true, would most directly weaken Schober’s hypothesis?

options.content: Samples of animal remains collected at Calusa sites reflect a greater diversity of marine species, particularly among sea snails, within the perimeter of watercourts than in locations known to have been devoted to the preparation and consumption of food.

Historical population-size estimates suggest that the sea snails and fish most common in the Calusa diet were plentiful in open coastal waters when the watercourts were constructed but decreased in abundance in the years immediately after construction.

Radar surveys of Calusa sites reveal watercourt dimensions suitable for sustaining fish of many local species but not conducive for maintaining the shallow environments with ample seagrasses that allow sea snails to thrive.

Sediment layers excavated from Calusa watercourt sites contain heterogeneous mixtures of scales from multiple species of fish and fragments of shells from various types of sea snails, but conch shells do not constitute the majority of the mixture in most of those layers.

## 题目类型说明

这是一个逻辑推理题，核心任务是通过分析Schober关于水围栏促进海螺生长的假设，找出最能削弱该假设的证据。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> In what is now southern Florida, the Calusa people (circa 1000–1600 CE) supported their relatively large population’s dietary needs with hydrological engineering rather than terrestrial farming methods.

👉 介绍Calusa人依赖水利工程满足饮食需求，而非陆地耕作。

**第2句：**
> They constructed watercourts (gated coastal enclosures) out of shells and sediments to trap a variety of fish as waters rose and fell with tides and seasonal sea-level shifts; watercourt pools then held the fish for later consumption.

👉 解释水围栏的结构和功能：利用潮汐捕捉鱼类并储存。

**第3句：**
> Archaeologist Theresa Schober has posited an additional purpose of these enclosures, suggesting that they were intended to foster conch.

👉 提出Schober的假设：水围栏还用于促进海螺（conch）生长。

**第4句：**
> She ties this hypothesis to the high value the sea snails would have had for the Calusa, both nutritionally and as a building material (conch shells are highly durable).

👉 说明Schober假设的理由：海螺对Calusa人营养和建筑材料都很重要。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                           |
|:---------|:------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍Calusa用水利工程满足饮食需求 |
| 第二句   | 说明水围栏的构造与捕鱼功能       |
| 第三句   | 提出Schober关于促进海螺生长的假设 |
| 第四句   | 说明海螺价值支持该假设           |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌【无中生有】
> Samples of animal remains collected at Calusa sites reflect a greater diversity of marine species, particularly among sea snails, within the perimeter of watercourts than in locations known to have been devoted to the preparation and consumption of food.

该选项说明水围栏内的海洋生物种类较多，尤其是海螺，这与Schober的假设相符，反而支持假设，不是削弱证据。

**B 选项** ❌【以偏概全】
> Historical population-size estimates suggest that the sea snails and fish most common in the Calusa diet were plentiful in open coastal waters when the watercourts were constructed but decreased in abundance in the years immediately after construction.

该选项指出水围栏建成时海螺和鱼类在开放海域充足，但建成后数量减少。虽暗示水围栏未能促进海螺数量增长，但并未直接说明水围栏环境不适合海螺生长，削弱力度有限。

**C 选项** ✅
> Radar surveys of Calusa sites reveal watercourt dimensions suitable for sustaining fish of many local species but not conducive for maintaining the shallow environments with ample seagrasses that allow sea snails to thrive.

该选项直接指出水围栏的尺寸和环境条件不适合海螺生长所需的浅水海草环境，直接反驳了Schober关于水围栏促进海螺生长的假设，是最直接的削弱证据。

**D 选项** ❌【过度推断】
> Sediment layers excavated from Calusa watercourt sites contain heterogeneous mixtures of scales from multiple species of fish and fragments of shells from various types of sea snails, but conch shells do not constitute the majority of the mixture in most of those layers.

该选项指出多数沉积物中海螺壳比例不高，但并未说明水围栏不适合海螺生长，仅表明海螺可能不是主要物种，削弱力度不及C选项直接。

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于理解Schober假设的核心是水围栏促进海螺生长，因此寻找直接指出水围栏环境不适合海螺生长的证据最为有效。选项C中的“not conducive for maintaining the shallow environments with ample seagrasses that allow sea snails to thrive”明确否定了这一点，是削弱假设的核心依据。其他选项或支持或间接，无法直接反驳假设。注意锁定“促进海螺生长”这一因果关系，排除仅描述数量或种类的选项。

article: Some fuel additives contain cerium oxide nanoparticles (CeO2-NPs), which can leach into waterways and soils via wastewater. In a 2015 study, Maël Garaud and colleagues found that CeO2-NPs can accumulate in the bodies of zebra mussels (Dreissena polymorpha). While bioaccumulation of manufactured nanoparticles may be inherently worrisome, it has been hypothesized that CeO2-NP bioaccumulation in invertebrate like D. polymorpha could serve a valuable proxy role, obviating the need for manufacturers to conduct costly and intrusive sampling of vertebrate species—such as rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss), commonly used in regulatory compliance testing—for nanoparticle bioaccumulation, as environmental protection laws currently require.
stem: Which finding, if true, would most directly weaken the hypothesis presented in the text?

options.content: When D. polymorpha and O. mykiss are exposed to similar levels of CeO2-NPs, concentrations of CeO2-NPs in animals of both species show little variation from individual to individual.
The rate of CeO2-NP uptake in D. polymorpha differs from the rate of CeO2-NP uptake in O. mykiss in a way that is not yet well understood by researchers.
D. polymorpha has been shown to accumulate several other types of manufactured nanoparticles in addition to CeO2-NPs, whereas O. mykiss has been shown to accumulate only CeO2-NPs.
Compared with O. mykiss, D. polymorpha can accumulate detectable CeO2-NP concentrations with significantly fewer negative effects.

## 题目类型说明

这是一题“削弱假设题”，核心任务是找出最直接削弱文章中关于用D. polymorpha作为生物指标（proxy）替代O. mykiss进行CeO₂-NP生物累积测试这一假设的证据。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Some fuel additives contain cerium oxide nanoparticles (CeO₂-NPs), which can leach into waterways and soils via wastewater.

👉 说明背景事实：CeO₂纳米颗粒存在于燃料添加剂中并能进入环境。

**第2句：**
> In a 2015 study, Maël Garaud and colleagues found that CeO₂-NPs can accumulate in the bodies of zebra mussels (Dreissena polymorpha).

👉 提出研究发现：D. polymorpha体内可积累CeO₂纳米颗粒。

**第3句：**
> While bioaccumulation of manufactured nanoparticles may be inherently worrisome, it has been hypothesized that CeO₂-NP bioaccumulation in invertebrate like D. polymorpha could serve a valuable proxy role, observing the need for manufacturers to conduct costly and intrusive sampling of vertebrate species—such as rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss), commonly used in regulatory compliance testing—for manipulative bioaccumulation, as environmental protection laws currently require.

👉 提出假设：D. polymorpha对CeO₂-NPs的生物累积可作为O. mykiss等脊椎动物的替代指标，以降低采样成本和侵入性。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容及逻辑功能 |
|:---------|:--------------|
| 第1句    | 介绍CeO₂-NPs存在及其进入环境的途径（背景说明） |
| 第2句    | 说明D. polymorpha能积累CeO₂-NPs（事实依据） |
| 第3句    | 提出假设：用D. polymorpha替代O. mykiss作为生物累积指标（假设提出） |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> When D. polymorpha and O. mykiss are exposed to similar levels of CeO₂-NPs, concentrations of CeO₂-NPs in animals of both species show little variation from individual to individual.

选项说明两物种在同等暴露水平下个体间积累量差异小，这支持了用D. polymorpha替代O. mykiss的假设，没有削弱假设。
错误类型：【方向相反】

**B 选项** ✅
> The rate of CeO₂-NP uptake in D. polymorpha differs from the rate of CeO₂-NP uptake in O. mykiss in a way that is not yet well understood by researchers.

选项表明两物种对CeO₂-NPs的吸收速率不同且机制不明，直接质疑D. polymorpha是否能准确反映O. mykiss的情况，削弱了该替代指标的合理性。符合题意。

**C 选项** ❌
> D. polymorpha has been shown to accumulate several other types of manufactured nanoparticles in addition to CeO₂-NPs, whereas O. mykiss has been shown to accumulate only CeO₂-NPs.

选项说明D. polymorpha积累的纳米颗粒种类更多，这并未直接否定其作为CeO₂-NPs指标的作用，反而体现其敏感性，未直接削弱假设。
错误类型：【无中生有】

**D 选项** ❌
> Compared with O. mykiss, D. polymorpha can accumulate detectable CeO₂-NP concentrations with significantly fewer negative effects.

选项说明D. polymorpha对CeO₂-NPs的耐受性更强，这并不影响其作为积累指标的有效性，只是说明了负面影响不同，不削弱假设。
错误类型：【无中生有】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题核心在于锁定“削弱假设”这一任务，重点关注假设中“用D. polymorpha替代O. mykiss作为CeO₂-NPs生物累积指标”的前提条件。选项中涉及两物种吸收特性差异且研究尚不明确的（B选项）最能直接质疑该假设。关键词“differs”“not yet well understood”提示存在不确定性，从而否定了替代的合理性。其余选项要么支持假设，要么与假设核心无关，因而排除。

article: Variously, researchers have closely examined obsidian artifacts to understand ancient social and economic structures, as in Raymond V. Sidrys’s 1976 study, or to glean aspects of cultural identity, as in Dennis Ogburn and colleagues’ 2009 study. Studies of the Malia archaeological site on the Mediterranean island of Crete have shown that significant changes to building styles—changes consistent with an influx of people from another culture elsewhere in the Mediterranean—occurred from the Middle Bronze Age to the Late Bronze Age. In a 2022 study, however, Tristan Carter and Vassilis Kilikoglou found that obsidian-object production methods at Malia stayed remarkably consistent during this architectural transition, which they interpret as indicative of local cultural continuity in the Middle and Late Bronze Ages.
stem: Which finding, if true, would most directly weaken Carter and Kilikoglou’s argument?

options.content: The obsidian used to produce objects at Malia was transported to Crete from the same source elsewhere in the Mediterranean throughout the Middle and Late Bronze Ages.
The methods used to produce obsidian objects at Malia during the Middle and Late Bronze Ages were also used by some other Mediterranean cultures in the period.
The obsidian-object production method that was most common among other Mediterranean cultures during the Middle and Late Bronze Ages was more efficient than the method used at Malia.
Changes to buildings like those that occurred at Malia have not been linked to changes in obsidian-object production methods in other Mediterranean cultures during the Middle and Late Bronze Ages.

## 题目类型说明

这是逻辑削弱题，核心任务是找出最能削弱Carter和Kilikoglou关于“玛利亚遗址黑曜石制作方法稳定反映文化连续性”的论点的发现。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Variously, researchers have closely examined obsidian artifacts to understand ancient social and economic structures, as in Raymond V. Sidrys’s 1976 study, or to glean aspects of cultural identity, as in Dennis Ogburn and colleagues’ 2009 study.

👉 介绍研究黑曜石文物的不同目的，说明研究背景。

**第2句：**
> Studies of the Malia archaeological site on the Mediterranean island of Crete have shown that significant changes to building styles—changes consistent with an influx of people from another culture elsewhere in the Mediterranean—occurred from the Middle Bronze Age to the Late Bronze Age.

👉 提出玛利亚遗址建筑风格发生重大变化，暗示外来文化影响。

**第3句：**
> In a 2022 study, however, Tristan Carter and Vassilis Kilikoglou found that obsidian-object production methods at Malia stayed remarkably consistent during this architectural transition, which they interpret as indicative of local cultural continuity in the Middle and Late Bronze Ages.

👉 转折，指出尽管建筑变化，黑曜石制作方法保持稳定，推断文化连续性。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                                         |
|:---------|:-------------------------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍黑曜石文物研究的不同方向和目的                           |
| 第二句   | 玛利亚遗址建筑风格发生显著变化，暗示有外来文化影响           |
| 第三句   | Carter和Kilikoglou发现黑曜石制作方法稳定，解释为文化连续性证据 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> The obsidian used to produce objects at Malia was transported to Crete from the same source elsewhere in the Mediterranean throughout the Middle and Late Bronze Ages.

此选项说明黑曜石来源一致，与制作方法稳定性无关，未涉及文化连续性或变化，不能削弱论点。
错误类型：【无中生有】

**B 选项** ✅
> The methods used to produce obsidian objects at Malia during the Middle and Late Bronze Ages were also used by some other Mediterranean cultures in the period.

如果其他文化也使用相同制作方法，则制作方法稳定不能唯一代表玛利亚的文化连续性，直接削弱论点。

**C 选项** ❌
> The obsidian-object production method that was most common among other Mediterranean cultures during the Middle and Late Bronze Ages was more efficient than the method used at Malia.

此选项仅说明效率差异，与文化连续性无关，不能削弱论点。
错误类型：【无中生有】

**D 选项** ❌
> Changes to buildings like those that occurred at Malia have not been linked to changes in obsidian-object production methods in other Mediterranean cultures during the Middle and Late Bronze Ages.

此选项支持建筑变化与制作方法变化无关，反而间接支持Carter和Kilikoglou的论点，非削弱而是增强。
错误类型：【方向相反】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于理解Carter和Kilikoglou用“制作方法稳定”来推断“文化连续性”的逻辑。选项B通过指出其他文化也用相同方法，削弱了制作方法作为文化独特标志的效力，从而直接削弱论点。注意题干中的“most directly weaken”提示排除与文化连续性无关或支持论点的选项。抓住“制作方法”和“文化连续性”之间的因果关系是破题关键。

> Neuroscientist Kiyohito Ligaya and colleagues developed a computational model to predict how much a person will enjoy a particular work of art on a scale from 1 (not at all) to 4 (very much) and then recruited participants to use the same scale to rate several sets of paintings in various styles.

👉 介绍研究背景和评分标准，说明模型与参与者评分的对应关系。

**第2句：**
> The team calculated the correlation between the ratings predicted by the model and those reported by the participants, with higher correlations indicating that predicted ratings were closer to reported ratings.

👉 解释研究方法，说明相关系数代表模型预测与实际评分的相符程度。

**第3句：**
> Assuming that participant P4 gave equal ratings to the impressionist and cubist paintings, the graph reveals that the model predicted _____

👉 题干设定前提，要求根据图表推断模型预测的评分趋势。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                     |
|:---------|:----------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍模型和参与者评分的量表与对象           |
| 第二句   | 说明计算相关系数以衡量模型预测与实际评分的匹配度 |
| 第三句   | 设定P4对两种画派评分相等，要求用图表预测模型评分 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌【方向相反】
> P4's ratings for impressionist and cubist paintings would equal one another

错误在于题干已设定P4对两种画派评分相等，模型预测却未必相同。图表显示模型对两种画派预测评分存在差异，故此选项与图表数据相反。

**B 选项** ✅（正确）
> P4's ratings for impressionist and cubist paintings would differ from one another

正确，因为图表显示模型预测P4对印象派和立体派画作的评分相关系数不同，说明模型预测两者评分不相同，尽管P4实际评分相等。

**C 选项** ❌【过度推断】
> P4 would derive more aesthetic pleasure from cubist paintings than from impressionist paintings.

错误在于题干只说明评分差异，未说明谁的评分更高，不能推断P4更喜欢哪种画派。

**D 选项** ❌【过度推断】
> P4 would derive less aesthetic pleasure from cubist paintings than from impressionist paintings.

同C选项，题干未明确模型预测中哪一画派评分更高，不能断定P4更喜欢印象派。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 重点关注题干设定的前提“P4 gave equal ratings”，结合图表中模型预测评分的差异（相关系数不同）判断模型预测是否一致。识别选项中是否直接与题干前提矛盾（如A），或是否进行了无根据的喜好高低推断（如C、D），通过排除法锁定正确答案B。

## 题目类型说明

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> *Drosophila* (fruit flies) have generation times of 10–12 days, so seasonal changes in exposure to ultraviolet light and other environmental conditions can drive seasonal fluctuations in chromosome rearrangements in species such as *D.persimilis* and *D.subobscura*.

👉 说明果蝇生命周期短，季节性环境变化会影响其染色体重排，提出背景和因果关系。

**第2句：**
> *Drosophila* body size (for which wing centroid size serves as a proxy measure) correlates with life span.

👉 阐明果蝇体型（通过翅膀中心大小测量）与寿命相关，建立核心变量间联系。

**第3句：**
> Banu Şebnem Önder and Cansu Fidan Aksoy measured the wing sizes of members of a *D.melanogaster* population in Yeşilöz, Turkey, that were collected monthly between May and October over three years.

👉 介绍研究方法：对特定时间段内果蝇翅膀大小的实测。

**第4句：**
> Their research suggests that *Drosophila* collected in relatively cooler months should tend to have a shorter life span, as is illustrated by the finding that _______.

👉 提出结论：较凉月份采集的果蝇寿命较短，并要求用数据支持这一结论。

## 结构总结

|:---------|:-----------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 说明果蝇生命周期短，季节环境影响染色体重排  |
| 第二句   | 说明体型（翅膀中心大小）与寿命相关          |
| 第三句   | 介绍研究对象及测量方法                      |
| 第四句   | 提出结论并要求用数据完成论证                |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅
> the average female wing centroid size was smaller in May than in July.

正确。文章中指出较凉月份果蝇体型较小（翅膀中心大小作为体型代理），而5月气温较7月低，选项体现了5月（较凉）翅膀较小，符合“较凉月份体型较小寿命较短”的论断。

**B 选项** ❌ 【无中生有】
> the average male wing centroid size was 1.98 mm in September but was 2.31 mm in July.

错误。虽然数值看似支持体型变化，但题干要求完成“较凉月份体型较小”，而9月气温一般不比5月低，且该选项未明确比较凉暖月份，未直接支撑文章论断。

**C 选项** ❌ 【以偏概全】
> the average male wing centroid size was consistently smaller than the average female wing centroid size in all four months in the table.

错误。该选项描述性陈述体型性别差异，与文章核心论点“较凉月份体型较小”无关，且未体现季节性变化。

**D 选项** ❌ 【无中生有】
> the average monthly low temperature was lower in May than in September.

错误。该选项涉及温度比较，但文章结论依赖翅膀大小作为体型及寿命代理，且温度数据未必准确，且题目要求用数据支持翅膀大小与寿命的关系，而非单纯温度对比。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题核心在于识别文章提出的因果关系（较凉月份→较小体型→较短寿命），利用翅膀中心大小这一关键代理指标判断季节性体型变化；选项中需体现“较凉月份体型较小”，否则即为无关或无中生有；注意题干和文章中温度与体型的逻辑顺序，避免直接用温度数据替代体型指标。

## 题目类型说明

本题为**逻辑补全题**，核心任务是根据文章内容和表格数据，选择最能合理衔接并补充文章论述的选项。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Eduardo Martinez and colleagues found that tilling––the practice of turning soil with hoes, plows, or other machines before planting crops––was associated with an increased yield of winter wheat.

👉 介绍Martinez等人的研究发现，耕作与冬小麦产量增加有关（提出观点）。

**第2句：**
> But some studies of other crops have found the opposite effect, raising the question of whether the increase in yield found by Martinez and colleagues is specific to their study crop.

👉 提出转折，指出其他作物的研究有相反结果，提出疑问：产量增加是否仅适用于冬小麦（转折+提出疑问）。

**第3句：**
> However, this doesn't seem to be the case: ______

👉 否定上句疑问，暗示后续内容会用数据说明增加产量并非仅限冬小麦（转折+补充说明）。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 介绍Martinez等人研究，耕作增加冬小麦产量。 |
| 第二句 | 指出其他作物研究结果相反，提出增加产量是否仅限冬小麦的疑问。 |
| 第三句 | 否定疑问，说明产量增加不是冬小麦独有现象，等待用数据补充说明。 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> Igor Bogunovic and colleagues reported an even larger positive effect of tilling on the yield of maize.

错误原因：原文疑问是是否增加产量现象仅限冬小麦，A选项提到“更大正效应”但未说明是否普遍适用于其他作物；且“更大正效应”偏向过度强调，没有直接说明其他作物也有正向关联，属于【过度推断】。

**B 选项** ❌
> a study using winter wheat yielded 4,829 kilograms per hectare with tilling and only 2,894 kilograms per hectare without tilling.

错误原因：B选项仅重复了冬小麦的数据，没有回应第二句中“是否仅限冬小麦”的疑问，属于【无中生有】（没有补充新信息）。

**C 选项** ✅
> Fuseini Issaka and colleagues found a similar association in a study using rice.

正确原因：C选项明确指出另一作物（水稻）也发现了类似耕作与产量正相关的结果，直接回应了“增加产量现象并非冬小麦特有”的论点，符合上下文逻辑。

**D 选项** ❌
> crop yields with tilling have ranged from 1,676 kilograms per hectare for spring barley to 6,400 kilograms per hectare for rice.

错误原因：D选项列举产量范围，但未明确说明耕作与产量的关联性，缺少论证耕作对产量影响的正面关系，属于【偷换概念】（以产量绝对值代替产量变化的因果关系）。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题核心在于识别转折词“However, this doesn't seem to be the case”，明确文章想否定“产量增加仅限冬小麦”的疑问，选项需说明其他作物也有类似正相关。锁定含有“similar association（类似关联）”的C选项，排除无关或信息重复的选项。注意选项是否直接回应疑问，避免被表面数字或无关描述干扰。

## 题目类型说明

本题为细节理解题，核心任务是根据文章和表格数据，准确判断哪条选项最符合城市规划者关于“urban agriculture改善态度和展望”的结论。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Esther Sanye-Mengual, Kathrin Specht, and their team surveyed three groups of people in Bologna, Italy—leaders of urban agriculture projects, stakeholders in urban agriculture (e.g., food researchers and urban farming associations), and the general public—to compare their views about the extent to which urban agriculture contributes to 25 social or ecological services that the team identified.

👉 说明研究对象和研究目的：调查三组人对城市农业贡献的25项社会或生态服务的看法。

**第2句：**
> The researchers used these ratings to rank the services for each group, with a conclusion that both stakeholders and general public regard the improvement of attitudes and outlooks as important benefit of urban agriculture.

👉 说明研究方法和结论：根据评价对服务排序，得出利益相关者和公众都认为“改善态度和展望”是城市农业的重要益处。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 介绍调查对象和研究目的——比较三组对城市农业25项服务贡献的看法 |
| 第二句 | 介绍研究方法和结论——根据评分排序，利益相关者和公众都认为改善态度和展望是重要益处 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> The improvement of physical health was ranked lower for the general public than it was for project leaders.

选项陈述的是“公众对身体健康改善的排名低于项目领导”，文章并未提及具体排名数据，且题干关注的是“改善态度和展望”，此选项与核心结论无关，且无数据支持。【无中生有】

**B 选项** ❌
> The provision of raw materials was ranked higher for the general public than was the improvement of attitudes and outlooks.

根据文章结论，“改善态度和展望”被公众和利益相关者视为重要益处，排名应该较高，B选项说“原材料提供”排名高于“改善态度和展望”与结论矛盾。【方向相反】

**C 选项** ❌
> The improvement of attitudes and outlooks was ranked higher for stakeholders than it was for the general public.

文章说“利益相关者和公众都认为改善态度和展望重要”，但未说明利益相关者排名高于公众。且题干问的是支持城市规划者结论的数据，结论强调公众和利益相关者一致，而非谁高谁低。【过度推断】

**D 选项** ✅
> The improvement of attitudes and outlooks was ranked higher for the general public than were the other four services.

该选项准确反映了文章结论，表明“改善态度和展望”在公众中排名最高，支持城市规划者的结论，符合原文数据的含义。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题核心在于锁定关键词“improvement of attitudes and outlooks”和“rank”，结合文章结论“both stakeholders and general public regard... as important”，选项中对比排名高低的数据是关键，排除与结论相悖或无数据支持的选项，确认“公众中该服务排名最高”最符合结论。注意题干中的“support the conclusion”提示答案应直接呼应结论核心点。

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> the cougar habitat in Washington can support more than 1.90 individuals per 100 square kilometers.

**B 选项** ✅

**C 选项** ❌
> there are more cougars overall in both Oregon and Washington than there are in New Mexico.

错误，题干关注的是密度差异，不是总数；且“更多总数”未必对应“密度更大”，属于【偷换概念】。

**D 选项** ❌
> cougar habitat makes up a greater proportion of the overall land area in Montana than is the case in New Mexico.

错误，题干关注种群密度差异，栖息地比例未必直接导致最大密度差异，且表中无相关数据支持，属于【过度推断】。

## 题目类型说明

本题为**数据支持题**，核心任务是根据表格中的数据判断哪些数据支持研究者关于“mating environment hypothesis不被支持”的结论。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> The mating environment hypothesis predicts that populations of flowering plants compensate for reduced mating opportunities due to dichogamy (a plant’s expression of male and female functions at separate times to prevent self-pollination) by adjusting the bias of floral sex allocation during the flowering period, increasing the probability of successful cross-plant pollination.

👉 说明研究假设，即植物会通过调整花的性别分配比例来补偿因异时授粉导致的交配机会减少。

**第2句：**
> Researchers tested the hypothesis by examining a population of broadleaf arrowhead, a plant for which bloom onset generally takes longer for male flowers than for female flowers, during the flowering season.

👉 介绍研究对象和实验设计，说明研究者通过观察特定植物的花期及性别分配进行假设验证。

**第3句：**
> They concluded that the mating environment hypothesis is not well supported by their observational data.

👉 研究结论，指出观察数据不支持该假设。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 介绍mating environment hypothesis及其预测内容。 |
| 第二句 | 说明研究方法：观察箭叶植物性别花期差异。 |
| 第三句 | 得出结论：观察数据不支持该假设。 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌【以偏概全】
> Whereas the total number of open flowers per growth unit peaked on day 15, the proportion of male flowers experienced a peak earlier in the flowering season, on day 10.

此选项描述的是花数和雄花比例的峰值时间差异，虽然是事实但并未直接说明假设被支持或不被支持，缺乏与“补偿交配机会”相关的成功率数据，属于片面描述。

**B 选项** ❌【无中生有】
> Despite the sharp reduction in the total number of open flowers per growth unit from day 15 to 20, there was no decline in the estimated reproductive success rate of male flowers in that interval.

选项中提到“雄花繁殖成功率无下降”，如果属实可能支持假设，但题干未明确表格有该数据，且选项未反映性别分配变化对成功率的影响，推断过度。

**C 选项** ❌【方向相反】
> Sex allocations were largely evenly distributed on days 10 and 15 but were female biased on days 5 and 20.

该选项描述性别分配的时间变化，但与原文中“雄花开花时间晚于雌花”及假设预期的“通过调整性别分配补偿交配机会”不符，且未说明成功率，方向错误。

**D 选项** ✅
> Although sex allocations became overwhelmingly female biased by day 20, male flowers’ estimated reproductive success rate did not vary from day 5 to 20.

该选项指出尽管性别分配偏向雌花，但雄花的繁殖成功率没有变化，直接支持研究结论“观察数据不支持该假设”（即性别分配调整并未带来成功率的补偿）。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 解题时要关注题干关键词“support researchers’ conclusion”，结合文章结论“假设不被支持”，锁定选项中体现“性别分配调整未改善繁殖成功率”的描述。重点关注表格中“性别分配”和“繁殖成功率”两组数据的变化关系，排除仅描述花数或性别分配峰值时间的选项，避免无依据的推断。

## 文章逻辑拆解

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅
> the third extract in the sequence contains dimethyl sulfides and the fourth contains alkanes.

**C 选项** ❌

## 题目类型说明

## 文章逻辑拆解

> Some animals evade predation with the help of contrasting markings that signal toxicity.

**第4句：**

| 第三句 | 描述实验的具体设置和白蚁披风分布 |
| 第四句 | 指出观察指标并得出结论：对比色披风起威慑作用 |

## 逐项分析选项

> Half of the spiders that first looked at a termite wearing a black-and-white striped cape attacked a termite wearing a solid white cape, and the other half of those spiders were just as likely to attack a termite wearing a black-and-white striped cape as they were to attack a termite wearing a solid black cape.

正确原因：强调无论蜘蛛最初关注哪种披风，攻击主要集中在无对比色的披风上，直接支持“对比色披风是威慑”的结论。

## 题目类型说明

本题为逻辑推断题，核心任务是结合文章内容和图表信息，推断实验结果对两种学者观点的支持情况。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Political scientists have asserted that by providing succinct and clear information about candidates and issues, campaign advertisements should reduce the differences in political knowledge observed between groups of voters.

👉 介绍政治学家观点：竞选广告应减少不同选民群体间的政治知识差距。

**第2句：**
> Cognitive scientists have noted, however, that existing domain knowledge facilitates the acquisition of new information in that domain.

👉 转折，介绍认知科学家的观点：已有领域知识有助于获取新信息。

**第3句：**
> Valentino et al. shed light on this issue by presenting control ads or ads for George W. Bush or Al Gore (candidates in the 2000 US presidential election) to participants with low or high existing political knowledge, then quizzing participants on their understanding of both candidates’ positions.

👉 描述实验设计：通过不同政治知识水平参与者观看不同广告，测试其对候选人立场的理解。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                                         |
|:---------|:-------------------------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 政治学家认为竞选广告应减少不同选民群体间的政治知识差距       |
| 第二句   | 认知科学家指出已有领域知识促进新信息获取                     |
| 第三句   | Valentino等人设计实验测试不同知识水平参与者看广告后的理解差异 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> They appear to have worsened the problem that political scientists claim that campaign ads should alleviate, possibly because the phenomenon identified by cognitive scientists appears not to have occurred.

错误原因：文章和实验说明认知科学家提出的“已有知识促进新信息获取”现象确实发生了，且广告未改善政治知识差距，而非认知科学家现象未发生。【方向相反】

**B 选项** ❌
> They appear to have benefited high-knowledge participants more than they benefited low-knowledge participants, which lends more support to the view advanced by political scientists than to the view advanced by cognitive scientists.

错误原因：广告对高知识者更有益实际上支持的是认知科学家的观点（已有知识促进新信息获取），而非政治学家观点（广告应缩小知识差距）。【方向相反】

**C 选项** ✅
> They appear to have had an effect contrary to the effect that political scientists expect campaign ads to have, possibly due to the phenomenon that cognitive scientists have identified.

正确原因：广告未能缩小知识差距（与政治学家预期相反），这可能是因为认知科学家指出的已有知识促进新信息获取的现象导致的，完全符合文章和实验设计的逻辑。

**D 选项** ❌
> They appear to have had the result that political scientists predict that campaign ads will have, but only for high-knowledge participants, which is what cognitive scientists would expect.

错误原因：文章未表明广告对高知识者产生了政治学家预期的效果（即缩小知识差距），而是效果与政治学家预期相反。【无中生有】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于识别两派学者观点的对比（政治学家期待广告缩小知识差距，认知科学家强调已有知识促进新信息获取），以及理解实验结果对这两种观点的支持情况。题干中的“Taken together”提示结合文本和图表综合判断，转折词“however”明确认知科学家观点与政治学家观点相反，锁定答案方向为广告效果与政治学家预期相反，且符合认知科学家的解释，从而排除掉与政治学家观点一致或认知科学家观点不符的选项。

## 题目类型说明

这是信息整合题，核心任务是结合文章定义和表格数据，判断哪条选项最有效支持学生关于四国农业生产成本的推断。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> A tariff is a tax on imported goods intended to protect domestic producers of similar goods from international competition.
👉 定义关税及其保护国内生产者的功能。

**第2句：**
> Eliminating tariffs can lead to an influx of cheaper imported goods, lowering prices; in a place where domestic production is relatively expensive, this influx can suppress domestic production, as the country's consumers favor more cheaply produced imported goods over domestically produced ones.
👉 解释取消关税后，较便宜的进口商品涌入导致价格下降，且在国内生产成本较高的国家，国内生产会减少。

**第3句：**
> A student consults a table showing projected changes in production and average market prices of agricultural commodities in four countries in a tariff-elimination scenario.
👉 说明学生通过表格数据分析四国在取消关税后的农业生产和价格变化。

**第4句：**
> Based on the data, the student claims that compared with India and Russia, agricultural production in Argentina and the United States is likely relatively inexpensive.
👉 学生根据数据做出推断：阿根廷和美国农业生产成本相较印度和俄罗斯更低。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 关税定义及保护国内产业的目的。 |
| 第二句 | 取消关税导致进口商品价格下降及对国内生产的抑制，尤其是成本较高国家。 |
| 第三句 | 学生查看表格中四国取消关税后农业生产和价格的预测变化。 |
| 第四句 | 学生推断阿根廷和美国农业生产相对印度和俄罗斯更便宜。 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅（正确）
> Although agricultural production in India and Russia would likely decrease if tariffs were eliminated, it would likely increase in both Argentina and the United States.
选项指出印度和俄罗斯生产下降，阿根廷和美国生产增加，与文章中“在国内生产相对昂贵的国家取消关税会抑制生产”的逻辑一致，支持学生推断阿根廷和美国农业生产成本较低，因其生产未被抑制反而增加。

**B 选项** ❌（错误）
> Although eliminating tariffs would likely cause agricultural market prices to decrease in most locations, it would likely cause agricultural market prices to increase in both Argentina and the United States.
文章中关税取消导致价格下降是普遍趋势，选项提出阿根廷和美国价格上升与文章内容相反，违背“进口商品涌入导致价格下降”的因果关系。
错误类型：【方向相反】

**C 选项** ❌（错误）
> Argentina and the United States are the only countries shown that are projected to see both an increase in agricultural production and a reduction in agricultural prices in the absence of tariffs.
选项强调阿根廷和美国同时生产和价格双增减，表面看似支持，但文章中“价格降低促使生产增加”的因果关系已隐含，不是学生推断的直接依据，且是否唯一未必由数据完全支持，存在过度推断。
错误类型：【过度推断】

**D 选项** ❌（错误）
> In the absence of tariffs, total agricultural production in Argentina and the United States would likely exceed that in India and Russia.
选项强调总生产量绝对值大小，但学生推断是关于“相对生产成本”的比较，生产量大小与成本高低不必然相关，选项偏离核心论点。
错误类型：【偷换概念】

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于理解文章关于“取消关税导致低成本国家生产增加，高成本国家生产减少”的因果逻辑，结合表格数据验证生产变化趋势。题干中学生推断生产成本相对高低，故需选项明确指出生产变化的方向差异（印度、俄罗斯减产，阿根廷、美国增产）。注意区分生产量和生产成本，避免偷换概念；价格变化趋势需符合文中因果关系，排除方向相反选项。

## 题目类型说明

本题为逻辑补全题，核心任务是利用表格数据结合文章内容，选择最准确且逻辑严密的句子完成文章结论。

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> The percent of cities and towns in a given period that persist from a prior period (backward continuity) and the percent that persist into a later period (forward continuity) are known to correlate positively with economic and political stability in a region.

👉 解释定义及因果关系：定义“backward continuity”和“forward continuity”，并说明它们与经济政治稳定正相关。

**第2句：**
> Researchers studying demographic trends in the Indigenous societies of ancient Mexico determined both continuity measures for the Yautepec Valley, which lay within the macroregional hegemony of the city-state of Teotihuacan from roughly 100 BCE until roughly 450 CE, after which point Teotihuacan declined.

👉 说明研究对象及时间背景：介绍研究地区（Yautepec Valley）及其历史背景（Teotihuacan的霸权及其衰落时间）。

**第3句：**
> The team concluded that _____.

👉 设问，要求结合数据选择对研究结论的合理补充。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容及逻辑功能                                     |
|:---------|:-------------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 定义backward和forward continuity，并说明其与稳定性的正相关（因果解释） |
| 第二句   | 介绍研究对象Yautepec Valley及Teotihuacan霸权及其衰落（背景信息）    |
| 第三句   | 结论缺失，需用数据补充完整（设问）                         |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> Teotihuacan's hegemony imposed stability on the Yautepec Valley, mitigating the decrease in the compound average annual growth rate of the valley's population as well as the decrease in the number of cities and towns there in the Early Classic and Middle Classic.

错误原因：文中仅说明霸权期间连续性较高与稳定相关，但未表明霸权“缓解”了人口增长率和城镇数目的下降，且题干暗示霸权结束后才有明显变化，A项属于【过度推断】。

**B 选项** ❌
> the marginal decrease in the compound average annual growth rate of the Yautepec Valley's population in the Early Classic was likely associated with the widespread abandonment of cities and towns established in the Terminal Formative.

错误原因：题干并未提及具体时间段的人口增长率减少与城镇废弃的因果联系，且“likely associated”属于推测，缺乏直接数据支持，故为【过度推断】。

**C 选项** ❌
> values for both backward and forward continuity in the Yautepec Valley were consistently higher during the centuries of Teotihuacan's hegemony than they were in the period following the collapse of the hegemony.

错误原因：虽然逻辑上正确，但题干没有说明“持续更高”，而且“consistently”过于绝对，数据未必支持始终更高，属于【过度推断】。

**D 选项** ✅
> although the forward continuity data suggest that the decline of Teotihuacan occasioned economic and political instability in the Yautepec Valley, these developments were nonetheless associated with a net increase in the valley's population.

正确原因：该选项准确体现了题干中连续性（forward continuity）与稳定性正相关的说明，并指出霸权衰落后导致不稳定，同时结合人口数据说明不稳定时期人口依然净增长，符合题意且未超出数据范围。

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在理解“backward continuity”和“forward continuity”与稳定性的正相关关系，结合时间节点（霸权时期及其衰落后）判断数据变化趋势。选项中包含绝对词或推测词（如“mitigating”，“likely”，“consistently”）需谨慎排除，准确表达数据指示的因果关系与趋势是选对答案的关键。

文章和题干暗示浅色虹膜的狗被视为更脆弱（非更成熟），与本选项“越成熟越可能有浅色虹膜”相反。

**B 选项** ✅（正确）
> participants favored the dogs in images 2 and 11, which they rated as less mature than the dogs in images 20 and 16.

本选项符合表格数据且与文章观点一致：参与者偏好图2和11中较不成熟的狗，支持虹膜颜色影响脆弱性和喜好判断。

**C 选项** ❌【无中生有】
> participants rated the dog in image 2 as less mature than the dog in image 11 and rated the dog in image 16 as less mature than the dog in image 20.

题干及文章未提及图2与图11、图16与图20之间的成熟度比较，选项内容缺乏依据。

**D 选项** ❌【以偏概全】
> dogs that participants rated as friendlier were also dogs that participants indicated a stronger willingness to interact with or keep.

文章强调脆弱性和虹膜色彩的关联，而非“友好度”直接决定互动意愿，此选项未紧扣虹膜颜色和脆弱性主线。

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于捕捉“虹膜颜色→脆弱性→互动意愿”的因果链，注意选项是否紧扣“脆弱性”和“成熟度”这两个关键词，利用表格中图像对应的成熟度和偏好数据排除与文章结论相反或无关的选项。转折词“as illustrated by”提示选项必须用数据支持文章结论，避免“无中生有”和“方向相反”的选项。

## 题目类型说明

这是图表信息解读题，核心任务是根据图表数据判断哪条信息削弱了学生关于FTA促进农业出口增长的结论。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> To measure whether countries in free trade agreements (FTAs) --- agreements among nations to reduce tariffs, duties, and other trade barriers --- experience changes in total agricultural exports, economist Kayode Ajewole and colleagues calculated average export growth rates for several countries over the five years before and the five years after entering an FTA with the United States.

👉 说明研究目的和方法：测量加入FTA前后农业出口增长率的变化。

**第2句：**
> The graph shows the results for three countries in the study.

👉 说明图表内容：展示三个国家的出口增长数据。

**第3句：**
> Consulting the graph, a student claims that joining an FTA increases the rate of growth of a country's total agricultural exports.

👉 陈述学生的结论：加入FTA促进农业出口增长率提升。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 介绍研究目的和计算出口增长率的方法。 |
| 第二句 | 说明图表展示了三个国家的数据。 |
| 第三句 | 学生基于图表得出加入FTA提高出口增长率的结论。 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌【以偏概全】
> All the countries shown had positive growth in agricultural exports over the five years after joining their respective FTAs, but their rates of export growth varied.

错误原因：该选项描述的是FTA后出口都增长，但增长率有差异，未体现FTA前后的对比，不能削弱学生观点，反而部分支持其结论。

**B 选项** ✅
> Although agricultural exports from Nicaragua grew over the five years after Nicaragua joined CAFTA-DR, their growth rate was even higher in the five years before CAFTA-DR.

正确原因：该选项指出尼加拉瓜在加入FTA前的出口增长率高于加入后，直接反驳了学生“加入FTA提升出口增长率”的观点。

**C 选项** ❌【支持结论】
> Although agricultural exports from Mexico decreased over the five years before NAFTA, a reversal in this trend was observed over the five years after Mexico joined NAFTA.

错误原因：该选项说明墨西哥加入NAFTA后出口增长率上升，支持学生结论，不构成削弱。

**D 选项** ❌【支持结论】
> Over the five years after El Salvador joined CAFTA-DR, agricultural exports from El Salvador grew at a rate of about 21.8 percent, which is higher than the rate over the five years before El Salvador joined the agreement.

错误原因：该选项说明萨尔瓦多加入FTA后出口增长率增加，支持学生结论，不构成削弱。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于比较“加入FTA前后出口增长率的变化”，关注转折词“although”以及比较表达“higher than”定位FTA前后数据对比，只有指出增长率加入后不升反降的选项才能削弱学生观点，排除仅描述FTA后增长或模糊比较的选项。

## 题目类型说明

本题属于逻辑补全题，核心任务是根据文章内容和图表数据，选择最合理且符合实验结论的选项完成句子。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> *Hemerocallis sp.* plants typically carry a negative electrical charge, while bees and other pollinators tend to accumulate a positive charge.
👉 介绍背景事实，提出植物和传粉者电荷的基本差异。

**第2句：**
> Given that negatively and positively charged objects attract, a research team hypothesized that the difference in charges could attract *Hemerocallis sp.* stamens to the plants' pollinators.
👉 基于电荷吸引原理，提出研究假设。

**第3句：**
> Based on the team's experiments, the hypothesis was well supported for positive charges above a certain threshold.
👉 说明实验结果支持假设，但存在一个“正电荷阈值”限制。

**第4句：**
> The team found that European peacock butterflies exceeded that threshold, which suggests that _______
👉 引出结论，暗示超过阈值的传粉者可以吸引雄蕊，需用图表数据补全句意。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                               |
|:---------|:--------------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 阐述植物带负电，传粉者带正电的电荷特征。           |
| 第二句   | 提出研究假设：电荷差异吸引植物雄蕊与传粉者接触。   |
| 第三句   | 实验验证假设，发现存在正电荷阈值。                 |
| 第四句   | 指出欧洲孔雀蝶超过阈值，暗示其能吸引雄蕊，需补全。 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> bumblebees and European peacock caterpillars, with greater maximum charges than European peacock butterflies have, cannot attract the stamens.
错误原因：根据题干，欧洲孔雀蝶超过阈值能吸引雄蕊，且选项说“毛毛虫和大黄蜂电荷更大却不能吸引”与实验结论矛盾。【方向相反】

**B 选项** ❌
> the threshold positive charge for a pollinator to attract the stamens must be greater than 200 pC.
错误原因：题干中只说“超过某阈值”，未明确阈值高于200 pC，且图表数据若无此明确支持则为过度推断。【过度推断】

**C 选项** ✅
> bumblebees can also attract the stamens.
正确原因：根据题干和图表，毛毛蜂电荷超过阈值，符合“正电荷超过阈值能吸引雄蕊”的结论，符合逻辑。

**D 选项** ❌
> European peacock caterpillars tend to repel the stamens.
错误原因：题干未提及毛毛虫带负电或排斥雄蕊，且毛毛虫电荷大小与吸引关系未说明，缺乏支持。【无中生有】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于识别“超过阈值的正电荷能吸引雄蕊”这一核心条件，结合图表中各传粉者电荷大小判定哪些超过阈值。选项中涉及“超过阈值”和“能否吸引”是判断核心，排除与实验结果相反或无依据的选项。转折词“which suggests that”提示后文结论需紧扣阈值判断。

## 题目类型说明

这是逻辑推断题，核心任务是根据文章描述和图表数据，推断哪种关于基因功能的结论最符合实验结果。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> In a study of the evolution of *DptA* and *DptB*—*Diptericin* genes encoding antimicrobial peptides that combat pathogens and foster beneficial microbes in fruit flies (*Drosophila*)—researchers assessed *Drosophila melanogaster* resistance to pathogenic infections by *Providencia rettgeri* and *Acetobacter sicerae*, bacteria common in the flies' environments.

👉 介绍研究对象（*DptA*和*DptB*基因）及实验设计，说明研究内容和研究对象。

**第2句：**
> Subjects included flies identified by mutations silencing *DptA*, *DptB*, or both *DptA* and *DptB* (termed types A, B, and AB, respectively).

👉 说明实验组分类标准，即根据基因沉默分组。

**第3句：**
> In conjunction with the observation that resistance to *P. rettgeri* correlates with *DptA* activity but is not significantly affected by *DptB* activity, data in the graph of survival rates post-*A. sicerae* infection suggest that_____

👉 结合已知关于*P. rettgeri*的基因保护作用，引出关于图表中* A. sicerae*感染后存活率的数据及其暗示的结论。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                                         |
|:---------|:-------------------------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍*DptA*和*DptB*基因及研究内容，研究对象为果蝇和两种细菌。 |
| 第二句   | 说明实验分组依据：不同基因沉默组合的果蝇。                   |
| 第三句   | 结合*P. rettgeri*感染的基因作用，提出* A. sicerae*感染数据暗示的结论。 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> defense against *A. sicecare* is strongest when both *DptA* and *DptB* are present.

错误原因：文章中指出*P. rettgeri*的抵抗力与*DptA*相关，且图表显示*DptB*对*A. sicerae*有作用，但没有证据表明两者同时存在时防御最强。此选项对两基因协同效应的描述超出文中支持。
错误类型：【过度推断】

**B 选项** ❌
> *DptB* protects against only one bacteria species, whereas *DptA* protects against multiple species.

错误原因：文中只提到*DptA*与*P. rettgeri*的抵抗相关，*DptB*可能对*A. sicerae*有保护作用，但没有数据说明*DptB*只保护一种细菌，且未说明*DptA*保护多种细菌。
错误类型：【过度推断】

**C 选项** ✅
> *DptB* may have developed as a specific defense against *A. sicecare*.

正确原因：根据文章和图表，*DptB*对*P. rettgeri*影响不大，但与*A. sicerae*的存活率有关，暗示*DptB*可能特化为针对*A. sicerae*的防御，这与数据相符。

**D 选项** ❌
> *DptA* confers defense against *A. sicecare* regardless of the presence of *DptB*.

错误原因：文章指出*DptA*与*P. rettgeri*抵抗相关，但对*A. sicerae*的防御作用并不明显，图表也未显示*DptA*单独影响*A. sicerae*的存活率。
错误类型：【方向相反】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于抓住文章中关于两种细菌与两个基因不同防御效果的对比，尤其注意“correlates with”和“not significantly affected”这类表述，结合图表数据验证哪种基因对应哪种细菌的防御，排除对基因功能无明确支持的选项，最终锁定描述基因特异性防御的选项。

## 题目类型说明

本题为逻辑补全题，核心任务是根据图表数据和题干条件，判断模型对P6参与者对两种画作评分预测的关系，从而选出最合适的选项。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Neuroscientist Kiyohito Iigaya and colleagues developed a computational model to predict how much a person will enjoy a particular work of art on a scale from 1 (not at all) to 4 (very much).

👉 说明研究背景：介绍科学家及其开发的模型功能。

**第2句：**
> They then recruited participants to use the same scale to rate several sets of paintings in various styles and calculated the correlation between the ratings predicted by the model and those reported by the participants.

👉 说明研究方法：参与者使用相同量表评分，研究者计算模型预测值与实际评分的相关性。

**第3句：**
> Assuming participant P6 gave equal ratings to the abstract and cubist paintings, the data in the graph indicate the model predicted that _______

👉 提出假设并引出问题：假设P6对抽象画和立体主义画评分相等，依据图表数据模型如何预测P6的评分？

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                 |
|:---------|:------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍科学家及其用于预测艺术作品喜好程度的模型 |
| 第二句   | 说明参与者评分方法及模型与实际评分的相关性计算 |
| 第三句   | 假设P6评分相等，问模型预测结果如何          |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅（正确）
> P6's ratings for abstract and cubist paintings would differ from one another.

正确。题干假设P6对两种画作评分相等，但根据题干中“calculated the correlation between the ratings predicted by the model and those reported by the participants”以及图表显示的模型预测数据，模型对P6的预测评分在抽象画和立体主义画上不相同，说明模型预测评分与P6实际评分存在差异，符合选项A。【图表数据支撑】

**B 选项** ❌（错误）【方向相反】
> P6 would derive less aesthetic pleasure from abstract paintings than from cubist paintings.

错误。题干未说明P6对抽象画的喜好低于立体主义画，且假设中P6评分相等，模型预测并不明确支持抽象画低于立体主义画的结论，方向相反。

**C 选项** ❌（错误）【无中生有】
> P6's ratings for abstract and cubist paintings would equal one another.

错误。题干假设P6评分相等，但模型预测并未显示两者相等，反而显示差异，选项错误地假设模型预测与P6评分相等，属于无中生有。

**D 选项** ❌（错误）【过度推断】
> P6 would derive more aesthetic pleasure from abstract paintings than from cubist paintings.

错误。与B选项类似，题干和模型预测未显示P6对抽象画的喜好更高，且没有足够证据支持此推断，属于过度推断。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于区分“P6实际评分相等”与“模型预测评分是否相等”的关系，题干已明确假设P6评分相等，需根据图表数据判断模型预测是否一致。注意题干中“correlation between predicted and reported ratings”提示模型预测与实际评分可能不一致，抓住这一转折词“assuming”和“indicate”锁定模型预测与假设不符，从而排除选项C，选择体现差异的A。其他选项因未准确反映模型预测差异而被排除。

## 题目类型说明

这是逻辑推断题，核心任务是根据文章和表格信息，找出一个对新年决心制定者习惯的合理结论。

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> A Pew Research Center survey conducted in January 2024 found that three out of ten US adults make at least one New Year’s resolution (a promise for the year ahead), while half of those who make a resolution make more than one.

👉 介绍调查结果，说明美国成年人中制定新年决心的总体比例及多项决心的比例。

**第2句：**
> The survey asked participants what kinds of resolutions they made and separated them into several categories.

👉 说明调查如何分类决心类型。

**第3句：**
> The table presents percentages of people who make particular kinds of New Year’s resolutions among those who choose to make them, indexed by age bracket.

👉 说明表格内容，展示不同年龄组中不同类型决心的比例。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 调查显示30%美国成年人制定至少一个新年决心，且其中一半制定多项决心。 |
| 第二句 | 调查将新年决心分为几类。 |
| 第三句 | 表格展示按年龄分组的各种决心类型的比例。 |

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> The majority of US adults who make resolutions related to health and exercise also make resolutions in multiple additional categories.

错误原因：原文只提到“半数制定多项决心”，但没有具体说明健康和锻炼类别决心制定者中多数还制定其他类别决心。【无中生有】

**B 选项** ✅

**C 选项** ❌
> Among all US adults, people become less likely to make New Year’s resolutions as they age, regardless of the type of resolution.

错误原因：题干和文章未说明整体随年龄增长决心制定概率的变化，且表格显示不同类型决心比例随年龄变化不一致。【过度推断】

**D 选项** ❌
> Resolution makers between the ages of 18 and 29 are more likely to make resolutions about health and exercise than resolution makers between the ages of 30 and 49 are.

错误原因：表格数据通常显示30-49岁组在健康和锻炼类决心比例高于18-29岁组，选项与数据相反。【方向相反】

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关键在于紧扣表格中的年龄分组与决心类型比例数据，利用比较词（more likely, less likely）直接对应表格数值；避免对文章未提及的整体趋势做过度推断；注意选项中提及的具体类别与年龄段是否符合数据，排除与表格矛盾的选项。

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> a smaller percentage of those that also filed Form 4720 did so because they engaged in self-dealing than the percentage of those that filed Form 4720 because they did not meet the minimum charitable distribution requirement.

此选项断言“因自我交易而提交4720的比例小于因未达最低分配要求而提交4720的比例”，但根据图表数据，未达最低分配要求的罚款数量和比例明显更高，故该断言应为真；但题干问“most effectively uses data”，而A选项只是比例比较，未涉及罚款金额，且表述复杂，数据支持力度较弱。此选项表达相对笼统，且没有突出罚款金额差异，属于【过度推断】。

**B 选项** ❌
> those that also filed Form 4720 paid a larger penalty for failing to meet a minimum charitable distribution requirement than those organizations that filed Form 990 but also filed Form 4720 for the same reason.

此选项将提交Form 4720的私人基金会与提交Form 990的公募慈善混为一谈，且文章开头明确区分两者提交不同表格，且罚款仅针对私人基金会，故此选项存在概念混淆，属于【偷换概念】。

**C 选项** ❌
> those that were also required to filed Form 4720 because they had excess holdings in a business enterprise paid, on average, a larger penalty than those organizations that filed Form 4720 because they made taxable expenditures.

根据图表，因持有过多企业权益（excess holdings）和因应税支出缴纳的罚款金额对比，罚款金额并无明显差异或后者更大，故该断言与数据不符，属于【方向相反】。

**D 选项** ✅
> those that also filed Form 4720 collectively paid larger penalties for failing to meet the minimum charitable distribution requirement than for other reasons.

选项明确指出“因未达最低分配要求而提交Form 4720的机构集体缴纳的罚款金额超过其他原因”，这与图表数据完全吻合，罚款金额最高且占比最大，且与文章中对禁止行为的列举相符，最有效地利用了图表数据完成句子。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题核心在于识别文章中对“Form 4720提交原因”的限定条件和对应罚款，关注关键词“minimum charitable distribution requirement”（最低慈善分配要求）和“penalty”（罚款），并用图表数据验证罚款金额的大小，排除选项中混淆对象（如公募与私人基金会）或与数据相悖的断言，从而锁定正确答案D。

## 题目类型说明

本题为逻辑补全题，核心任务是根据文章内容和表格数据，选择最准确且符合文中逻辑的句子来完整文章结论。

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Domestic sheep's wild ancestor, the mouflon, has a coarse outer coat and an inner coat of wool fiber that is finer in diameter and therefore much softer.

👉 介绍野生祖先羊的外层和内层毛发特征，提出对比基准。

**第2句：**
> In some domestic breeds, such as the Spanish Merino, the outer fiber is only marginally coarser than the inner, and the wool is soft overall.

👉 说明家养品种Merino羊的外层与内层纤维差异变小，整体毛发更柔软。

**第3句：**
> Thus, Merino wool is ideal for delicate garments worn against the skin.

👉 归纳Merino羊毛柔软的实际用途，得出结论。

**第4句：**
> Meanwhile, the Navajo-Churro has been selected to retain the marked distinction between outer and inner fiber that the Merino has lost.

👉 对比Navajo-Churro羊，强调其保持了外内层纤维的明显区别。

**第5句：**
> Being coarser than Merino wool overall, Navajo-Churro wool yields a more durable yarn, which Diné (Navajo) weavers use in their celebrated rugs.

👉 说明Navajo-Churro羊毛较粗，适合制作耐用地毯。

**第6句：**
> Yet a comparison of the fiber characteristics of all three sheep reveals that _____

👉 引出对三种羊毛纤维特征比较的结论，需补全。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                                         |
|:---------|:-------------------------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 描述野生祖先mouflon的粗糙外层和细软内层毛发特征               |
| 第二句   | 介绍Merino羊毛外层与内层差异减小，整体柔软                      |
| 第三句   | 说明Merino羊毛适合贴肤精细衣物                                |
| 第四句   | 介绍Navajo-Churro保持外内层纤维明显差别                       |
| 第五句   | 说明Navajo-Churro毛更粗，产出更耐用纱线，制成地毯              |
| 第六句   | 引出三种羊毛纤维特征比较的结论，需用表格数据补全               |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> the domestication of the mouflon and the subsequent selection process that produced the Merino and the Navajo-Churro resulted in greater softness of outer and inner fiber alike.

错误原因：文章指出Navajo-Churro保持了较粗的外层纤维，整体比Merino更粗糙，不符合“outer and inner fiber alike都更柔软”的说法。【方向相反】

---

**B 选项** ❌
> domestication resulted in a counterintuitive increase in the inner fiber's minimum diameter, making the inner fiber of the Merino and the Navajo-Churro less suitable for delicate garments than the mouflon's inner fiber is.

错误原因：文章强调Merino的内层纤维较细软，适合精细服装，未说明内层纤维“变粗”且“更不适合精细服装”，不符。【无中生有】

---

**C 选项** ❌
> the Navajo-Churro more closely resembles its ancestor, the mouflon, in the uniform softness of its inner fiber, while the Merino more closely resembles the mouflon in the variable diameter of its outer fiber.

错误原因：文中指出Navajo-Churro保留外层和内层明显区别，且整体更粗糙，未说明其内层纤维“均匀柔软”，且Merino是外层与内层差异减小，与mouflon的“外层纤维直径变化”不同。【偷换概念】

---

**D 选项** ✅
> the selection process that enabled the Navajo-Churro to retain its somewhat coarse outer fiber also resulted in inner fiber that, at its softest, is softer than either the mouflon's or the Merino's inner fiber.

正确原因：选项指出Navajo-Churro虽保持较粗的外层纤维，但其内层纤维中最柔软的部分甚至比mouflon和Merino更柔软，符合题干对三者纤维特征比较的补充，且与前文“marked distinction”和“more durable yarn”相辅相成。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于捕捉文章对三种羊毛外层和内层纤维粗细和柔软度的对比，尤其关注“marked distinction”“more durable yarn”“soft overall”等关键词，排除与文中描述相反或无根据的选项。题干“comparison… reveals that”提示答案必须是综合表格数据且精确对比三者纤维特征的陈述，故细致辨别各选项与文意的吻合度是关键。

## 题目类型说明

本题为逻辑补全题，核心任务是结合文章信息和图表数据，选择最符合文意和数据支持的结论。

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> In a study of the evolution of *DptA* and *DptB*—*Diptericin* genes encoding antimicrobial peptides that combat pathogens and foster beneficial microbes in fruit flies (*Drosophila*)—researchers assessed *Drosophila melanogaster* resistance to pathogenic infections by *Providencia rettgeri* and *Acetobacter sicearae*, bacteria common in the flies’ environments.

👉 介绍研究背景，说明研究对象是编码抗菌肽的两个基因*DptA*和*DptB*，研究内容是果蝇对两种细菌感染的抵抗力。

**第2句：**
> Subjects included flies identified by mutations silencing *DptA*, *DptB*, or both *DptA* and *DptB* (termed types A, B, and AB, respectively).

👉 说明实验设计，分组依据是基因沉默状态，分为三种类型果蝇。

**第3句：**
> In conjunction with the observation that resistance to *P. rettgeri* correlates with *DptA* activity but is not significantly affected by *DptB* activity, data in the graph of survival rates post–*A. sicearae* infection suggest that______

👉 给出关于*P. rettgeri*抵抗力与*DptA*和*DptB*的关系，并引出对* A. sicearae*感染后存活率的图表数据，要求根据图表推断结论。

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                                         |
|:---------|:-------------------------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍研究背景和研究对象（*DptA*、*DptB*基因及两种细菌）       |
| 第二句   | 说明实验分组（基因沉默状态的果蝇类型）                       |
| 第三句   | 说明*P. rettgeri*抵抗与*DptA*相关，*DptB*无显著影响，提示根据图表推断* A. sicearae*感染后存活率的含义 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> *DptA* confers defense against *A. sicearae* regardless of the presence of *DptB*.

错误。文章说明*DptA*对*P. rettgeri*抵抗有效，但对* A. sicearae*的抵抗没有说明*DptA*单独作用，且图表显示*DptB*对* A. sicearae*影响显著，故该选项忽略了*DptB*的作用。【偷换概念】

**B 选项** ✅
> *DptB* may have developed as a specific defense against *A. sicearae*.

正确。题干指出*DptA*与*P. rettgeri*抵抗相关，图表数据表明*DptB*对* A. sicearae*存活率有显著影响，符合*DptB*特异性防御* A. sicearae*的结论。

**C 选项** ❌
> *DptB* protects against only one bacteria species, whereas *DptA* protects against multiple species.

错误。文中仅说明*DptA*与*P. rettgeri*相关，*DptB*对* A. sicearae*有作用，但没有证据支持*DptA*保护多个细菌种类，过度推断。【过度推断】

**D 选项** ❌
> defense against *A. sicearae* is strongest when both *DptA* and *DptB* are present.

错误。题干及图表未明确表明同时存在两者时抵抗力最强，且*DptA*对* A. sicearae*影响不显著，故该选项无数据支持。【无中生有】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于识别题干中关于不同基因对不同细菌抗性的描述，利用“*DptA*与*P. rettgeri*相关，*DptB*对* A. sicearae*有作用”的对比关系，结合图表数据判断哪种基因对应哪种细菌的防御作用，从而排除忽视*DptB*作用或无数据支持的选项。转折词“in conjunction with”提示要综合前后信息。

**B 选项** ✅
> There are some studies, such as the study by Mosab Halwani and colleagues, that have found crop yields to be lower with tilling than without it.

正确原因：该选项引用其他研究发现耕作产量更低，直接用数据反驳了学生认为耕作普遍增产的观点，体现了题干要求的“削弱”作用。

**C 选项** ❌
> The study by Lötjönen and Isolahti actually found that tilling was associated with a decrease in crop yield rather than an increase.

错误原因：题干中明确学生是引用该研究结果，且题干无提示研究结论是产量降低，属于【无中生有】。

**D 选项** ❌
> Vinicius Brown and colleagues reported a crop yield of 3,070 kilograms per hectare when no tilling was used but a yield of only 2,270 kilograms per hectare when tilling was used.

错误原因：虽然数据表明无耕作产量更高，但题干未提及该数据是否代表一般情况，且该选项仅描述个别数据，不能代表普遍结论，属于【以偏概全】。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于识别“削弱学生普遍结论”的证据，需关注选项是否直接用数据或研究结果反驳“耕作普遍增产”；选项中出现“其他研究发现产量降低”是典型削弱信号词，能直接否定学生观点，排除未直接反驳或仅局限于个别数据的选项。

## 题目类型说明

这是事实细节题，核心任务是根据表格数据找出与学生观点相矛盾的例子，从而削弱学生关于“开画周末票房能预测奥斯卡提名”的论断。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Many films in a language other than English grow to be financially successful over the course of their time in movie theaters in the United States, but some become immediate successes in their opening weekends.

👉 说明非英语电影票房表现的两种不同模式：逐渐成功和开画周末即成功。

**第2句：**
> Such success is driven by many factors like advertising, genre popularity, and the fame of the actors and directors.

👉 解释影响电影票房成功的多种因素。

**第3句：**
> A student claims that opening weekend earnings can reliably predict whether a film will be nominated for an Oscar: films that draw large audiences at the beginning of their release are the most likely contenders to earn these coveted award nominations.

👉 提出学生观点：开画周末票房高的电影更可能获得奥斯卡提名。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                      |
|:---------|:-----------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍非英语电影票房成功的两种不同时间趋势。|
| 第二句   | 说明影响电影票房成功的因素。               |
| 第三句   | 提出学生关于开画周末票房预测奥斯卡提名的观点。|

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅
> Sanju was not recognized by the Oscars but had much higher opening weekend earnings than Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon, which was recognized by the Oscars.

该选项提供了开画周末票房高但未获奥斯卡提名的电影Sanju，与票房较低但获提名的Crouching Tiger对比，直接反驳了学生“开画周末票房能预测奥斯卡提名”的观点。符合题意。

**B 选项** ❌【无中生有】
> Iron Monkey had higher lifetime earnings than Cinema Paradiso did, even though Cinema Paradiso was recognized by the Oscars.

该选项涉及的是终生票房和奥斯卡提名的关系，而非开画周末票房，偏离了题干中“开画周末票房能预测提名”的核心论点，无法削弱学生观点。

**C 选项** ❌【无中生有】
> Although both Crouching Tiger Hidden Dragon and Cinema Paradiso were recognized by the Oscars, Crouching Tiger Hidden Dragon had higher lifetime earnings.

该选项描述两部均获奥斯卡提名电影的终生票房差异，与开画周末票房无关，不能反驳学生观点。

**D 选项** ❌【无中生有】
> Although both Iron Monkey and Sanju were directed by well-known figures, neither film was recognized by the Oscars.

该选项强调导演名气与奥斯卡提名无关，但没有提及开画周末票房表现，不能削弱学生关于开画周末票房预测提名的论断。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于锁定学生观点中“开画周末票房”与“奥斯卡提名”的因果关系，选项必须涉及“开画周末票房”数据并反驳其与提名的正相关。注意区分“开画周末票房”与“终生票房”两个不同指标，避免被无关数据干扰。正确答案中出现了“开画周末票房高但未获提名”的反例，直接削弱原观点。错误选项则多涉及终生票房或导演名气，偏离题干核心。

article: While observing birds for a biology class, a group of students noticed a pied oystercatcher (Haematopus longirostris), a bird of the order Charadriiformes (shorebirds), slowly move away, make loud noises, and feign an injured wing as the group approached the bird's ground nest. Researching this behavior, the students learned that this phenomenon is commonly referred to as "broken-wing display" and is meant to lure predators away from the nesting site and toward a seemingly vulnerable adult bird. Upon learning of other birds that also exhibit the behavior they had observed, the students hypothesized that the phenomenon is exclusive to shorebirds.
stem: Which choice best describes data from the table that weaken the students' claim?

options.content: The common sandpiper, in the order Charadriiformes, is known to perform broken-wing display, and the West Peruvian dove, in the order Columbiformes, is not.
Neither the West Peruvian dove nor the purple sandpiper is known to perform broken-wing display.
Unlike the common sandpiper, the purple sandpiper is not known to perform broken-wing display, even though both are in the order Charadriiformes.
Both the sooty grouse and the sandhill crane are known to perform broken-wing display.

## 题目类型说明

这是考察数据与观点匹配关系的逻辑推理题，核心任务是找出表格数据中哪条信息能够削弱学生关于“broken-wing display只存在于shorebirds”的假设。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> While observing birds for a biology class, a group of students noticed a pied oystercatcher (Haematopus longirostris), a bird of the order Charadriiformes (shorebirds), slowly move away, make loud noises, and feign an injured wing as the group approached the bird's ground nest.

👉 叙述学生观察到的行为及该鸟的分类，提出观察事实。

**第2句：**
> Researching this behavior, the students learned that this phenomenon is commonly referred to as "broken-wing display" and is meant to lure predators away from the nesting site and toward a seemingly vulnerable adult bird.

👉 解释“broken-wing display”的定义和目的。

**第3句：**
> Upon learning of other birds that also exhibit the behavior they had observed, the students hypothesized that the phenomenon is exclusive to shorebirds.

👉 学生基于所学及观察，提出“broken-wing display只出现在shorebirds”这一假设。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                  |
|:---------|:-------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 描述学生观察到的pied oystercatcher的“broken-wing display”行为及其分类。   |
| 第二句   | 解释“broken-wing display”的定义及功能。             |
| 第三句   | 学生基于观察提出该行为仅见于shorebirds的假设。            |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌【以偏概全】
> The common sandpiper, in the order Charadriiformes, is known to perform broken-wing display, and the West Peruvian dove, in the order Columbiformes, is not.

该选项说明一种shorebird执行该行为，另一非shorebird不执行，支持而非削弱学生观点。

**B 选项** ❌【无中生有】
> Neither the West Peruvian dove nor the purple sandpiper is known to perform broken-wing display.

该选项指出两个鸟类都不表现该行为，未提供任何破坏学生假设的证据。

**C 选项** ❌【方向相反】
> Unlike the common sandpiper, the purple sandpiper is not known to perform broken-wing display, even though both are in the order Charadriiformes.

该选项显示同属shorebirds中也有不表现该行为的，说明不是所有shorebirds都有此行为，但并未否定该行为只存在于shorebirds，反而间接支持学生的“专属性”。

**D 选项** ✅
> Both the sooty grouse and the sandhill crane are known to perform broken-wing display.

该选项指出非shorebirds（sooty grouse和sandhill crane）也有该行为，直接削弱了学生“该行为仅存在于shorebirds”的假设。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题核心在于识别学生提出的“broken-wing display专属于shorebirds”的绝对假设，题干要求找出能削弱该假设的数据。选项中关键是判断鸟类分类与行为是否匹配。D项中非shorebirds表现该行为，直接反驳假设；而A/B/C都未提供反例或支持该假设。解题时注意关注分类词（shorebirds、Charadriiformes）和行为表现的对应关系，利用逻辑排除法快速定位削弱选项。

## 题目类型说明

这是事实细节题，核心任务是根据表格数据找出最能削弱学生主张（美国应效仿澳大利亚停止生产某些硬币）的信息。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Issuing a one-dollar coin yields positive seigniorage––profit generated when the face value of a coin exceeds the unit cost of producing it––for Singapore's government, which can be used to fund such services as education.

👉 说明正面案例：发行一美元硬币带来正的铸币税收益，可以资助公共服务。

**第2句：**
> Issuing coins can also result in negative seigniorage, however, and this phenomenon led Australia to stop producing certain coins.

👉 转折，指出发行硬币也可能产生负铸币税收益，澳大利亚因此停止生产某些硬币。

**第3句：**
> A student argues that it is in the financial interest of the United States to follow the example of Australia with regard to each of the four coins shown in the table.

👉 提出学生观点：美国应效仿澳大利亚，停止生产表中四种硬币。

## 结构总结

|:---------|:-------------|
| 第一句 | 说明发行硬币可带来正铸币税收益（正面例子） |
| 第二句 | 转折，说明发行硬币也可能导致负铸币税收益，澳大利亚因此停止部分硬币发行 |
| 第三句 | 学生观点：美国应效仿澳大利亚停止发行表中四种硬币 |

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌【以偏概全】
> Seigniorage per dollar issued was slightly greater for quarter-dollar coins than for ten cent coins, but seigniorage in millions of dollars was much greater for quarter dollar coins than for ten-cent coins.

该选项只是比较了25美分和10美分硬币的铸币税收益大小，未涉及是否应停止发行，也未直接削弱学生观点，属于对数据的部分描述，不能削弱学生论点。

**B 选项** ✅（正确）
> Although issuing one cent and five cent coins resulted in negative seigniorage in millions of dollars, issuing ten-cent and quarter-dollar coins resulted in positive seigniorage in millions of dollars.

该选项指出，虽然1分和5分硬币导致负铸币税收益，但10分和25分硬币带来正铸币税收益，说明学生主张“对四种硬币一概停止发行”不合理，直接削弱学生论点。

**C 选项** ❌【无中生有】
> Issuing one-cent and five-cent coins created negative seigniorage in millions of dollars, but for each of those coins, the gross cost of issuing the coin was lower than the gross cost of issuing ten-cent or quarter-dollar coins was.

该选项提到的“发行成本低于10分和25分硬币”未在原文或表格中体现，属于无中生有，不能作为削弱依据。

**D 选项** ❌【无中生有】
> Although issuing five cent coins created the greatest negative seigniorage in millions of dollars, issuing one cent coins created the greatest negative seigniorage per dollar issued.

该选项涉及“每发行一美元的负铸币税收益”与“总负铸币税收益”的比较，表格中未必有明确数据支持，属于无中生有，不能用来削弱学生论点。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于理解“正负铸币税收益”对是否停止发行硬币的影响，题干问“哪项数据削弱学生主张”，应锁定表达“部分硬币正收益，部分负收益”的选项，排除只描述单一数据或无表格支持的选项。转折词“although”在B选项中提示对立情况，直接削弱“一刀切”观点。

article: Spanning the 1920s to the 1980s, Mexican architect Luis Barragán's prolific career evolved through distinct phases. After traveling to the United States and Europe in the early 1930s and immersing himself in an international architectural discourse, Barragán began incorporating principles derived from functionalism and modernism in his work, as seen in the apartment building in Calles Lerma and Guadiana, whose unadorned geometric forms contrast with the historically inspired architecture found in the Cristo House, one of Barragán's early projects in Guadalajara.
stem: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?

options.content: Barragán's design of the Cristo House is considered more experimental than his design for the apartment building in Calles Lerma and Guadiana.
A notable shift in Barragán's design aesthetic reflects the influence of his time abroad.

## 题目类型说明

主旨大意题，核心任务是准确把握文章整体内容，提炼作者想要表达的主要观点。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Spanning the 1920s to the 1980s, Mexican architect Luis Barragán's prolific career evolved through distinct phases.

👉 介绍Barragán职业生涯的时间跨度和阶段性演变，提出背景和主题。

**第2句：**
> After traveling to the United States and Europe in the early 1930s and immersing himself in an international architectural discourse, Barragán began incorporating principles derived from functionalism and modernism in his work,

👉 说明Barragán受到国外经历和国际建筑思想的影响，开始采用功能主义和现代主义原则。

**第3句：**
> as seen in the apartment building in Calles Lerma and Guadiana, whose unadorned geometric forms contrast with the historically inspired architecture found in the Cristo House, one of Barragán's early projects in Guadalajara.

👉 通过具体例子对比两种设计风格，强调公寓楼体现功能主义现代主义，而Cristo House体现历史风格。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 介绍Barragán职业生涯时间和阶段演变 |
| 第二句 | Barragán早期出国经历及受国际建筑影响，开始吸收功能主义和现代主义原则 |
| 第三句 | 以两个建筑作品对比，展示设计风格的转变 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌【以偏概全】
> Barragán's design of the Cristo House is considered more experimental than his design for the apartment building in Calles Lerma and Guadiana.
原文并未提及哪一个设计更“实验性”，只说两者风格不同且对比，没有评价“更实验”。因此此选项信息无依据且过度解读。

**B 选项** ✅
> A notable shift in Barragán's design aesthetic reflects the influence of his time abroad.
文章明确指出Barragán在出国经历后，设计风格由历史主义向功能主义现代主义转变，符合“设计美学的显著转变”和“受国外影响”的表述。

**C 选项** ❌【方向相反】
> Barragán's designs of the apartment building in Calles Lerma and Guadiana and the Cristo House are considered paragons of a functionalist and modernist aesthetic.
文中说Cristo House体现历史风格，与功能主义现代主义相反，故此选项错误，混淆了两者风格。

**D 选项** ❌【方向相反】
> Barragán's early work shows an initial dedication to a modernist aesthetic that he later abandoned.
文中说明Barragán早期项目Cristo House是历史风格，后期开始采用现代主义，方向正好相反。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 抓住关键词“shift”、“influence”、“after traveling”等表明因果和时间顺序的信号词，锁定文章重点是设计风格的转变及其原因；排除选项时注意风格对比的细节，避免选项对比方向错误或无依据的主观评价。

article: Arthropods—skeleton shrimp, peacock butterflies, and many other invertebrate animals—have a nervous system made up of a brain, nerve cord, and other nerves. Researchers have gained insights about this system in ancient arthropods from traces found in various fossils. For example, in a study of two fossils of the extinct arthropod species Mollisonia symmetrica, Javier Ortega-Hernández, James Weaver, and team observed clear signs of a nerve cord. They also saw possible indications of a synganglion, a brain-like mass of nerves. Researchers hope to identify more features of the nervous systems of prehistoric arthropods as additional fossils are found.
stem: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?

options.content: Researchers need to focus on finding more fossils of ancient arthropods.
Newly discovered fossils suggest that ancient peacock butterflies and ancient skeleton shrimp had spines.
Fossil evidence can contribute to the understanding of the nervous system in ancient arthropods.
There are several similarities between the brains of peacock butterflies and the brains of skeleton shrimp.

## 题目类型说明

主旨大意题，核心任务是准确把握全文中心思想，选择最能概括全文主要内容的选项。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Arthropods—skeleton shrimp, peacock butterflies, and many other invertebrate animals—have a nervous system made up of a brain, nerve cord, and other nerves.
👉 介绍节肢动物及其神经系统的基本组成，提出话题背景。

**第2句：**
> Researchers have gained insights about this system in ancient arthropods from traces found in various fossils.
👉 说明通过化石痕迹，研究人员对古代节肢动物的神经系统有所了解，点明研究手段和主题。

**第3句：**
> For example, in a study of two fossils of the extinct arthropod species *Mollisonia symmetrica*, Javier Ortega-Hernández, James Weaver, and team observed clear signs of a nerve cord.
👉 举例说明具体研究发现，强化前文观点。

**第4句：**
> They also saw possible indications of a synganglion, a brain-like mass of nerves.
👉 进一步描述研究发现，补充细节。

**第5句：**
> Researchers hope to identify more features of the nervous systems of prehistoric arthropods as additional fossils are found.
👉 展望未来研究方向，表达研究期望。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                    |
|:---------|:---------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍节肢动物及其神经系统组成               |
| 第二句   | 说明研究人员通过化石获得古代节肢动物神经系统信息 |
| 第三句   | 举例具体研究发现神经索的迹象                |
| 第四句   | 进一步发现可能的脑样神经团                   |
| 第五句   | 未来研究方向，希望发现更多化石以识别神经系统特征 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> Researchers need to focus on finding more fossils of ancient arthropods.
错误，文章最后一句提到研究者希望发现更多化石，但全文重点是化石证据对理解神经系统的贡献，而非单纯强调“需要集中寻找更多化石”。此选项片面，属于【以偏概全】。

**B 选项** ❌
> Newly discovered fossils suggest that ancient peacock butterflies and ancient skeleton shrimp had spines.
错误，文中未提及“有脊椎（spines）”相关内容，且节肢动物是无脊椎动物，选项内容错误且无中生有，属于【无中生有】。

**C 选项** ✅
> Fossil evidence can contribute to the understanding of the nervous system in ancient arthropods.
正确，准确概括全文主旨，文章多次强调通过化石痕迹获得古代节肢动物神经系统信息，符合全文中心。

**D 选项** ❌
> There are several similarities between the brains of peacock butterflies and the brains of skeleton shrimp.
错误，文中提及两者是节肢动物，但没有比较它们脑部的相似性，属于【无中生有】。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题通过捕捉全文反复出现的关键词“fossils（化石）”“nervous system（神经系统）”和“researchers（研究者）”，结合文章结构中举例与展望，锁定文章主旨是“化石证据帮助理解古代节肢动物神经系统”，从而排除与神经系统无关或内容错误的选项，选出最贴合全文中心的C选项。

article: Horizontal gene transfer involves the exchange of genetic material between organisms not in a parent-offspring relationship. It is common among prokaryotes (single-celled organisms such as the bacteria Brevibacillus borstelensis and Massilia timonae). The process can have the effect of increasing bacterial resistance to antibiotics; as such, an understanding of how to prevent horizontal gene transfer might result in the mitigation of dangerous pathogens (organisms that cause disease).
stem: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?

options.content: A common perception of horizontal gene transfer is inaccurate.
Horizontal gene transfer is more common than was initially thought.
The results of new research into horizontal gene transfer cast doubt on earlier findings.
The study of horizontal gene transfer may yield findings with useful applications.

---

## 题目类型说明

主旨大意题，核心任务是准确概括文章的中心思想。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Horizontal gene transfer involves the exchange of genetic material between organisms not in a parent-offspring relationship.

👉 定义“水平基因转移”的概念。

**第2句：**
> It is common among prokaryotes (single-celled organisms such as the bacteria Brevibacillus borstelensis and Massilia timonae).

👉 说明水平基因转移在原核生物中普遍存在。

**第3句：**
> The process can have the effect of increasing bacterial resistance to antibiotics;

👉 阐述水平基因转移的一个重要后果——增强细菌抗药性。

**第4句：**
> as such, an understanding of how to prevent horizontal gene transfer might result in the mitigation of dangerous pathogens (organisms that cause disease).

👉 推论：理解如何阻止水平基因转移可能有助于控制致病菌，暗示其研究价值和应用前景。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                                         |
|:---------|:-------------------------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 定义水平基因转移                                                |
| 第二句   | 说明其在原核生物中的普遍性                                      |
| 第三句   | 描述其导致细菌抗药性增强的后果                                  |
| 第四句   | 强调研究该过程对控制致病菌的潜在重要意义，体现应用价值          |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> A common perception of horizontal gene transfer is inaccurate.

文章未提及任何关于“常见认知错误”的信息，缺乏对应依据。
错误类型：【无中生有】

**B 选项** ❌
> Horizontal gene transfer is more common than was initially thought.

文章只说“水平基因转移在原核生物中常见”，未提及“比以前认为更常见”，缺乏时间或认知变化的比较。
错误类型：【无中生有】

**C 选项** ❌
> The results of new research into horizontal gene transfer cast doubt on earlier findings.

文章未提及任何研究结果或对早期发现的质疑。
错误类型：【无中生有】

**D 选项** ✅
> The study of horizontal gene transfer may yield findings with useful applications.

文章最后一句明确指出“理解如何阻止水平基因转移可能有助于减少危险病原体”，即研究该过程具有实际应用价值，符合文章主旨。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题通过关注文章结尾的因果推论（“as such”引导的句子）锁定文章主旨；其他选项均无文本支持，属于“无中生有”，因此抓住关键因果转折词和结论句是解题关键。

article: Guojun He and colleagues studied a food-delivery phone app that is popular in China. stem: According to the text, which choice best describes a conclusion He and colleagues drew from their study?

options.content: Small changes to how a food-delivery app works can greatly lower plastic waste.

## 题目类型说明

本题为细节理解题，核心任务是根据文章内容准确找出作者的结论。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Guojun He and colleagues studied a food-delivery phone app that is popular in China.

👉 介绍研究对象和研究者。

**第2句：**
> The researchers found that having "no cutlery" automatically selected influences whether customers request disposable plastic utensils with their food orders.

👉 说明研究发现，即默认“无餐具”选项影响顾客选择。

**第3句：**
> Based on their results, the researchers concluded that this and other small changes to the app could reduce plastic waste in China by as much as 3.26 million metric tons per year.

👉 提出结论：小改动可以大幅减少塑料废弃物。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 介绍研究背景和对象 |
| 第二句 | 描述研究发现：默认“无餐具”选项影响顾客行为 |
| 第三句 | 给出结论：小改动可显著减少塑料废弃物 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅
> Small changes to how a food-delivery app works can greatly lower plastic waste.

符合第三句结论，“this and other small changes to the app could reduce plastic waste by as much as 3.26 million metric tons per year”，准确反映研究结论。

**B 选项** ❌ 【无中生有】
> Customers who understand how food-delivery apps work make more environmentally friendly choices.

文章未提及顾客理解或认知对选择的影响，属于无中生有。

**C 选项** ❌ 【方向相反】
> Production of plastic waste in China is likely to increase in the near future.

文章结论是通过小改动减少塑料废弃物，未提及废弃物增加，方向相反。

**D 选项** ❌ 【无中生有】
> Food-delivery apps that prevent customers from requesting cutlery are becoming more popular.

文章仅提到默认“无餐具”选项影响选择，未提及此类app流行趋势，属于无中生有。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关注题干“conclusion”和文中关键词“concluded”、“small changes”、“reduce plastic waste”，锁定第三句结论句。排除选项时注意区分文章明确提及的信息和无中生有或方向相反的内容。关键词“reduce”（减少）帮助排除废弃物增加的选项。

The following text is from Yung Wing's 1909 memoir My Life in China and America.

We landed in New York on the 12th of April, 1847, after a passage of ninety-eight days of unprecedented fair weather. The New York of 1847 was altogether a different city from the New York of 1909. It was a city of only 250,000 or 300,000 inhabitants; now it is a metropolis rivaling London in population, wealth and commerce. The whole of Manhattan Island is turned into a city of skyscrapers, churches and palatial residences.
stem: Based on the passage, how does Yung perceive New York to have changed between 1847 and 1909?

options.content: The layout of the city's streets has become more organized.
The city has become more developed and populated.
The architecture of the city has become simpler in style.
The city's population has become much more diverse than London's.
