---

## 题目类型说明

这是细节理解题，核心任务是根据文中具体描述，判断作者如何看待1847年至1909年间纽约市的变化。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> We landed in New York on the 12th of April, 1847, after a passage of ninety-eight days of unprecedented fair weather.

👉 叙述时间背景和作者抵达纽约的经历，交代事件发生时间。

**第2句：**
> The New York of 1847 was altogether a different city from the New York of 1909.

👉 提出对比观点，说明1847年的纽约和1909年的纽约完全不同。

**第3句：**
> It was a city of only 250,000 or 300,000 inhabitants; now it is a metropolis rivaling London in population, wealth and commerce.

👉 具体说明变化，强调人口和经济规模的巨大增长。

**第4句：**
> The whole of Manhattan Island is turned into a city of skyscrapers, churches and palatial residences.

👉 进一步描述城市发展，强调建筑密集且规模宏大。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                               |
|:---------|:--------------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 交代时间背景和抵达纽约的经历                       |
| 第二句   | 提出1847年纽约与1909年纽约完全不同的对比观点       |
| 第三句   | 强调人口和经济的巨大增长                           |
| 第四句   | 描述曼哈顿岛建筑变化，城市变得更加发达和宏伟       |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> The layout of the city's streets has become more organized.

**B 选项** ✅
> The city has become more developed and populated.

符合文中“now it is a metropolis rivaling London in population, wealth and commerce”和“Manhattan Island is turned into a city of skyscrapers”描述，准确反映作者观点。

**C 选项** ❌
> The architecture of the city has become simpler in style.

文中提到的是“skyscrapers, churches and palatial residences”，显示建筑风格复杂豪华，故此选项与原文相反，属于【方向相反】。

**D 选项** ❌
> The city's population has become much more diverse than London's.

文中未提及人口多样性问题，且只比较了人口数量和财富，属于【无中生有】。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 题干关键词“changed between 1847 and 1909”要求关注时间对比，文中转折词“altogether a different city”、“now it is a metropolis rivaling London”指出城市在规模和发展上的显著变化，直接锁定人口和发展相关选项B；排除无关或相反描述选项时，注意文中未提及街道布局和多样性，且建筑描述指向复杂而非简单。

article:
The following text is adapted from Daniel Defoe’s 1704 nonfiction book The Storm.

The sermon is a sound of words spoken to the ear, and prepared only for present meditation, and extends no farther than the strength of memory can convey it; a book printed is a record; remaining in every man’s possession, always ready to renew its acquaintance with his memory, and always ready to be produced as an authority or voucher to any reports he makes out of it, and conveys its contents for ages to come, to the eternity of mortal time, when the author is forgotten in his grave.
stem: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?

options.content: Words committed to print have a greater permanence than messages that are merely spoken aloud.
People are less likely to forget a message when they hear it spoken aloud than they are when they read it in print.
Unless a spoken message is delivered by an expert, it can be safely ignored.
Most authors have little hope of being remembered well past their lifetimes.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

主旨大意题，核心任务是准确概括文章主要观点。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> The sermon is a sound of words spoken to the ear, and prepared only for present meditation, and extends no farther than the strength of memory can convey it;

👉 对比“sermon”（口头讲道）是即时且仅限于记忆的声音，说明口头信息的暂时性。

**第2句：**
> a book printed is a record; remaining in every man’s possession, always ready to renew its acquaintance with his memory, and always ready to be produced as an authority or voucher to any reports he makes out of it,

👉 说明印刷书籍是记录，随时可以被回顾和引用，具有持久性和权威性。

**第3句：**
> and conveys its contents for ages to come, to the eternity of mortal time, when the author is forgotten in his grave.

👉 进一步强调印刷品的内容可以传递很长时间，超越作者的生存期限。

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容与逻辑功能 |
|:---------|:---------------|
| 第1句    | 对比口头讲道的暂时性，提出观点：口头信息依赖记忆，易遗忘。 |
| 第2句    | 说明印刷书籍的持久性和权威性，作为对比的正面例证。 |
| 第3句    | 强调印刷内容传递时间之长，超越作者生存期，进一步支持对比观点。 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅
> Words committed to print have a greater permanence than messages that are merely spoken aloud.

符合文章主旨，文章明确对比了口头信息的短暂和印刷文字的持久性，A选项准确概括了这一核心观点。

**B 选项** ❌ 【方向相反】
> People are less likely to forget a message when they hear it spoken aloud than they are when they read it in print.

文章强调口头信息依赖记忆，容易遗忘，印刷信息才有持久性，B选项与原文观点相反。

**C 选项** ❌ 【无中生有】
> Unless a spoken message is delivered by an expert, it can be safely ignored.

文章未提及讲话者的专业性，也没有说口头信息可以忽略，属于无中生有。

**D 选项** ❌ 【以偏概全】
> Most authors have little hope of being remembered well past their lifetimes.

文章末尾提到作者会被遗忘，但主要论点是印刷内容传承，作者被忘记是附带说明，不是主旨，D选项只抓住了部分细节，忽略了全文重点。

## 核心解题技巧

article: Optimal foraging theory (OFT) holds that animals' foraging behaviors reflect cost-benefit trade-offs that vary by species and with dynamic ecological circumstances. One such circumstance is lunar intensity, which Alexander Lang and colleagues found to be negatively associated with foraging by white throated round eared bats but Patricia C. Wright found to be positively associated with foraging by three striped night monkeys. This discrepancy is explicable in terms of OFT: the monkeys' greater reliance on vision means that higher lunar intensity benefits them more than it benefits the bats.
stem: According to the text, the difference between Lang and colleagues' findings and Wright's findings can be attributed to which difference between white-throated round-eared bats and three-striped night monkeys?

options.content: The bats are less reliant on vision than the monkeys are.
The bats decrease their foraging activity as lunar intensity increases, whereas the monkeys increase their foraging activity.
The bats are more vulnerable to predators than the monkeys are.
The bats encounter different levels of lunar intensity than the monkeys do.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

这是细节理解题，核心任务是根据文章内容找到导致两组研究结果差异的关键原因。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Optimal foraging theory (OFT) holds that animals' foraging behaviors reflect cost-benefit trade-offs that vary by species and with dynamic ecological circumstances.

👉 介绍最优取食理论（OFT）及其核心观点，提出背景理论。

**第2句：**
> One such circumstance is lunar intensity, which Alexander Lang and colleagues found to be negatively associated with foraging by white throated round eared bats but Patricia C. Wright found to be positively associated with foraging by three striped night monkeys.

👉 说明月光强度作为一种生态环境因素对两种动物觅食行为的不同影响，指出两项研究结果的差异。

**第3句：**
> This discrepancy is explicable in terms of OFT: the monkeys' greater reliance on vision means that higher lunar intensity benefits them more than it benefits the bats.

👉 解释两项研究结果差异的原因，即猴子比蝙蝠更依赖视觉，因此月光强度高对猴子更有利。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                               |
|:---------|:----------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍OFT及其对觅食行为的解释框架       |
| 第二句   | 提出月光强度对两种动物觅食影响的研究差异 |
| 第三句   | 解释差异原因：猴子更依赖视觉，月光强度对其更有利 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅（正确）
> The bats are less reliant on vision than the monkeys are.

正确。文章明确指出“the monkeys' greater reliance on vision means that higher lunar intensity benefits them more than it benefits the bats”，直接说明蝙蝠比猴子对视觉的依赖程度低。

**B 选项** ❌（错误）【以偏概全】
> The bats decrease their foraging activity as lunar intensity increases, whereas the monkeys increase their foraging activity.

选项描述了两种动物觅食活动的方向性差异，虽然与文中事实相符，但题目问的是“差异的原因”，而非结果，故该选项偏离了题干要求。

**C 选项** ❌（错误）【无中生有】
> The bats are more vulnerable to predators than the monkeys are.

文章未提及任何关于两者捕食风险或易受捕食程度的内容，该选项无依据。

**D 选项** ❌（错误）【无中生有】
> The bats encounter different levels of lunar intensity than the monkeys do.

文中仅说月光强度影响不同动物的觅食行为，没有提及两者经历不同的月光强度环境，属于无中生有。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于捕捉句中因果逻辑信号词“means that”，以及对比词“more than”，明确指出两种动物对视觉的依赖差异是两项研究结果差异的根本原因，从而锁定A选项；排除选项时需注意题干问的是“原因”，而非“现象”或“结果”，避免以偏概全或无中生有的选项干扰。

article: Falcons and horses can see in three dimensions(3D), which helps them perceive distance and depth. Octopuses and squid are thought to lack 3D vision. Many researchers once thought the same about cuttlefish, but Trevor Wardill and his team wanted to test whether this assumption was true. The team studied how cuttlefish wearing 3D glasses reacted to 3D images of shrimp (a favorite prey) projected on a tank wall. Cuttlefish changed their striking position to match the 3D images, suggesting that their vision is more like that of falcons and horses than that of octopuses or squid.

## 题目类型说明

这是一道主旨大意题，核心任务是准确把握文章的中心思想，选出最能总结全文主旨的选项。

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Falcons and horses can see in three dimensions(3D), which helps them perceive distance and depth.

👉 介绍猎鹰和马具有三维视觉的事实，提出背景信息。

**第2句：**
> Octopuses and squid thought to lack 3D version.

👉 说明章鱼和鱿鱼被认为没有三维视觉，形成对比。

**第3句：**
> Many researchers once thought the same about cuttlefish, but Trevor Wardill and his team wanted to test whether this assumption was true.

👉 介绍对墨鱼三维视觉的疑问，并引出研究团队进行验证。

**第4句：**
> The team studied how cuttlefish wearing 3D glasses reacted to 3D images of shrimp (a favorite prey) projected on a tank wall.

👉 具体描述研究方法。

**第5句：**
> Cuttlefish changed their striking position to match the 3D images, suggesting that their vision is more like that of falcons and horses than that of octopuses or squid.

👉 通过实验结果得出结论，表明墨鱼可能具有三维视觉。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                    |
|:---------|:---------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 猎鹰和马拥有三维视觉，帮助感知距离和深度。 |
| 第二句   | 章鱼和鱿鱼被认为不具备三维视觉。           |
| 第三句   | 研究团队怀疑墨鱼是否有三维视觉，准备验证。   |
| 第四句   | 描述实验设计：给墨鱼戴3D眼镜，观察反应。    |
| 第五句   | 实验结果显示墨鱼的视觉更像猎鹰和马，可能有3D视觉。 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> cuttlefish eyes are much more complex than those of falcons or horses.

错误原因：文章未提及墨鱼眼睛比猎鹰或马更复杂，只是说视觉更相似，存在事实范围外的夸大。【无中生有】

**B 选项** ❌
> Wardill's team designed 3D glasses for cuttlefish.

错误原因：文章提到墨鱼“wearing 3D glasses”，但并未说研究团队设计了眼镜，设计与使用不同，过度推断。【过度推断】

**C 选项** ❌
> Before completing their study, Wardill's team thought that cuttlefish have 3D vision, but horses may not.

错误原因：文章表明研究团队怀疑墨鱼是否有3D视觉，而不是他们先认定有；且猎鹰和马被明确认为有3D视觉，选项方向错误。【方向相反】

**D 选项** ✅
> The finding of Wardill's team's study suggest like falcons and horses, cuttlefishes may also have 3D vision.

正确原因：完全符合文章最后一句实验结论，即墨鱼视觉更像猎鹰和马，可能具备三维视觉。

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关注文章结尾的因果推论和总结句，“suggesting that their vision is more like that of falcons and horses”，是主旨所在；排除选项时注意是否与文章事实直接对应，避免无中生有和过度推断；转折词“but”提示对比和研究目的，锁定研究结论为核心答案。

article: The Far Side of the World, first published in 1984, is a novel in Patrick O'Brian's Aubrey/Maturin series, which includes twenty books plus an unfinished fragment of a twenty-first. Like the rest of the books in the series, The Far Side of the World has a rather abrupt ending, but the following book, the Reverse of the Medal, picks up neatly where the Far Side of the World leaves off. Thus, the sudden ending is only an issue if one considers the books as independent texts — the Aubrey/Maturin series is best thought of as a single incredibly long work, similar to other multivolume stories, such as John Galsworthy's me Forsyte Saga.

## 题目类型说明

本题为主旨大意题，核心任务是准确把握文章的中心思想，找到最能概括全文主旨的选项。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> *The Far Side of the World*, first published in 1984, is a novel in Patrick O'Brian's Aubrey/Maturin series, which includes twenty books plus an unfinished fragment of a twenty-first.

👉 介绍背景和基本信息，说明《The Far Side of the World》是奥布里/马图林系列中的一部小说。

**第2句：**
> Like the rest of the books in the series, The Far Side of the World has a rather abrupt ending, but the following book, the Reverse of the Medal, picks up neatly where the Far Side of the World leaves off.

👉 说明该书结尾突然，但下一部作品紧接其后，突出两书之间的连贯性。

**第3句：**
> Thus, the sudden ending is only an issue if one considers the books as independent texts — the Aubrey/Maturin series is best thought of as a single incredibly long work, similar to other multivolume stories, such as John Galsworthy's me Forsyte Saga.

👉 得出结论：只有把每本书当作独立作品时，突然结尾才成问题；实际上，该系列应被视为一个整体长篇作品，类似《福赛特家族》。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                                         |
|:---------|:-------------------------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍《The Far Side of the World》及其所在的奥布里/马图林系列。 |
| 第二句   | 说明该书结尾突然，但下一本书紧接其后，表现出书间连贯性。       |
| 第三句   | 总结观点：该系列应被看作一个整体长篇，而非独立作品，类似《福赛特家族》。 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌【无中生有】
> It is unfair that the Aubrey/Maturin series does not have the critical reputation of the Forsyte Saga, which has a similar structure.

文中并未提及任何关于奥布里/马图林系列评价或声誉的内容，故该选项内容无中生有。

**B 选项** ❌【过度推断】
> The Far Side of the World and the Reverse of the Medal are two of the most complex of Patrick O'Brian's novels of the Aubrey/Maturin series with unconventional structures.

文中只说《The Far Side of the World》结尾突然，且下一本书紧接其后，没有提及“最复杂”或“非传统结构”，该选项属于过度推断。

**C 选项** ✅
> The structure of each of the novels of the Aubrey/Maturin series suggests that the series should be considered a single continuous story.

选项准确反映了最后一句的核心观点：“the Aubrey/Maturin series is best thought of as a single incredibly long work”，符合文意。

**D 选项** ❌【无中生有】
> Many readers find the Aubrey/Maturin novels to be remarkably entertaining despite flaws in the novels’ structures.

文中没有提及读者感受或娱乐性，属于无中生有。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本文通过“thus”引导的总结句明确表达了中心思想，关注转折词“but”对比两书的连贯性，以及“only...if”结构指出“突然结尾”问题的前提，锁定文章主旨是强调该系列作为一个整体的连续故事来理解，进而排除与评价、复杂性、读者感受无关的选项。

主旨大意题，核心任务是准确把握文章中心思想，提炼作者对历史书写方式的评价。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> The knowledge, communicated by the historian and biographer, is analogous to that which we acquire of a country by the map,—minute, perhaps, and accurate, and available for all necessary purposes, but cold and naked, and wholly destitute of the mimic charm produced by landscape painting.

👉 说明历史学家传达的知识像地图一样，虽然详细准确，但缺乏生动和魅力。

**第2句：**
> These defects are partly remediable, and even without an absolute violation of literal truth, although by methods rightfully interdicted to professors of biographical exactness.

👉 表示这些缺点可以部分弥补，且不一定完全违背事实，但通常被严谨的传记学者所禁止使用。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                                         |
|:---------|:-------------------------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 历史学家的知识像地图，详细准确但缺乏生动魅力。               |
| 第二句   | 这种缺陷可以部分弥补，不必违背事实，但方法不被严谨学者认可。 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> Works of pure fiction can reveal more about the world than works that are strictly factual.
错误原因：文中未提及纯虚构作品揭示世界更多，只强调历史作品缺乏生动魅力，未涉及虚构作品的优越性。【无中生有】

**B 选项** ❌
> Paintings may be more beautiful than maps, but maps are more useful than paintings.
错误原因：文中用地图和风景画比喻历史知识和生动描绘，重点在于生动性和准确性的对比，而非实用性。【偷换概念】

**C 选项** ✅
> Historians' fidelity to the truth often results in work that is less engaging than it could be.
正确原因：符合文中“历史知识准确但冷漠，缺乏魅力”及“缺陷虽可部分弥补但被严谨学者禁用”的表达。

**D 选项** ❌
> Historians do not agree among themselves about the best methods of recording history.
错误原因：文中无提及历史学家之间存在方法争议，重点是对严谨方法的限制。【无中生有】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关注比喻关系（历史知识=地图，生动描绘=风景画），抓住“minute, accurate”与“cold and naked”形成的对比，以及“defects are partly remediable but interdicted”中的限制词，明确作者批评了历史叙述的严谨性导致作品缺乏吸引力，从而锁定C选项，排除与虚构优劣、实用性或学者分歧无关的选项。

Sometimes it was he and the second mate who were not ill; but it was generally he and one other man. If not he and another man, then it was he by himself.

## 题目类型说明

这是主旨大意题，核心任务是准确把握文段的整体中心思想，筛选最能概括文章内容的选项。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> [Harris] told us anecdotes of how he had gone across the [English] Channel when it was so rough that the passengers had to be tied into their [beds], and he and the captain were the only two living souls on board who were not ill.

👉 描述Harris讲述自己乘船经历，并强调在恶劣天气中他和船长是仅有的没生病的人。

**第2句：**
> Sometimes it was he and the second mate who were not ill; but it was generally he and one other man.

👉 进一步说明Harris讲述时细节有变化，但核心是他总是没生病。

**第3句：**
> If not he and another man, then it was he by himself.

👉 强调无论怎样变化，Harris始终是没病的那个人。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                   |
|:---------|:--------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | Harris讲述一次英吉利海峡的船程经历，恶劣天气下他和船长没生病。 |
| 第二句   | 细节变化，有时是他和二副没病，通常是他和另一人没病。        |
| 第三句   | 即使不是和别人一起，Harris自己也没病。                    |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> Harris is worried that the captain will start to feel sick during this boat trip.

文中没有任何关于Harris担心船长会生病的内容，文章聚焦Harris自己是否生病。【无中生有】

**B 选项** ❌
> Harris has a hard time remembering his first trip across the English Channel when his friends ask about it.

文中没有提及Harris难以回忆细节，只是他讲述时细节变化，重点在他自己没病。【过度推断】

**C 选项** ✅
> When Harris speaks of an earlier trip, he often changes the details but always brags about his own wellness.

准确反映了文中Harris讲述时细节变化（不同人没病），但他自己始终没病的事实，体现“总是吹嘘自己健康”。

**D 选项** ❌
> Harris spent most of his time with a particular passenger during a previous boat trip.

文中强调的是谁没生病，而非Harris与某乘客共度时间的长短。【无中生有】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题抓住了文中反复出现的因果关系和对比结构（“sometimes… but generally…”和“If not… then…”），这些转折和递进词表明细节在变，但核心事实不变，即Harris总是没病。选项C准确捕捉了这一逻辑，其他选项则无视文中细节变化和核心信息，属于无中生有或过度推断。理解文章的重复强调和细节变化是锁定正确答案的关键。

Multiple sculptures dating to the period have been alleged to be the reported bust, but none have been authenticated as Desiderio's depiction of Strozzi. Given the historical importance of both Strozzi and Desiderio's sculpture of her, positively identifying the bust would be a notable accomplishment for art historians.

Although successfully finding and authenticating Desiderio's portrait bust of Strozzi remains a challenge, the historical importance of the work justifies the continued pursuit of this goal.
Although numerous fifteenth-century Florentine portrait busts have been recovered over time, evidence has led art historians to conclude that Desiderio's bust of Strozzi is likely no longer extant.
Although historians strongly suspect that a particular sculpture is Desiderio's portrait bust of Strozzi, they do not currently have a method for conclusively verifying the artist or subject.

## 题目类型说明

主旨大意题，核心任务是总结文章的主要内容和作者的中心观点。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> According to historical documents, Marietta Strozzi—a young woman who was prominent in fifteenth century Florentine culture—inspired several artworks, including a portrait bust sculpted by Desiderio da Settignano.

👉 介绍背景和人物，说明Strozzi的重要性及其激发了艺术创作。

**第2句：**
> Multiple sculptures dating to the period have been alleged to be the reported bust, but none have been authenticated as Desiderio's depiction of Strozzi.

👉 陈述现状，存在多个疑似雕像但无一被确认为Desiderio所作。

**第3句：**
> Given the historical importance of both Strozzi and Desiderio's sculpture of her, positively identifying the bust would be a notable accomplishment for art historians.

👉 强调鉴定该雕像的重要性和价值，表达对未来鉴定成功的期待。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                                         |
|:---------|:-------------------------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍Marietta Strozzi及其在15世纪佛罗伦萨文化中的重要地位，及其激发的艺术作品。 |
| 第二句   | 说明虽有多个疑似作品，但没有一件被确认为Desiderio对Strozzi的描绘。           |
| 第三句   | 强调鉴定该雕像的历史意义及其对艺术史学家的重要价值。                     |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> Although there is documentation that Desiderio was commissioned to sculpt the portrait bust of Strozzi, numerous instances of false identification have made art historians skeptical that the sculpture will be uncovered.

错误原因：文中并未提及“有委托文献”或“多次错误鉴定导致怀疑雕像是否会被发现”，选项信息超出原文内容，且“怀疑是否会被发现”态度过于消极。
错误类型：【无中生有】

**B 选项** ✅
> Although successfully finding and authenticating Desiderio's portrait bust of Strozzi remains a challenge, the historical importance of the work justifies the continued pursuit of this goal.

正确原因：准确对应文中“尚未鉴定成功”（挑战）和“鉴定成功将是重大成就”（历史重要性和持续追求）。表达了难度与价值并存的态度。

**C 选项** ❌
> Although numerous fifteenth-century Florentine portrait busts have been recovered over time, evidence has led art historians to conclude that Desiderio's bust of Strozzi is likely no longer extant.

错误原因：文中无“已经发现多件作品”和“认为雕像可能已不存在”的信息，结论超出文意。
错误类型：【无中生有】

**D 选项** ❌
> Although historians strongly suspect that a particular sculpture is Desiderio's portrait bust of Strozzi, they do not currently have a method for conclusively verifying the artist or subject.

错误原因：文中未提及“强烈怀疑某特定雕像为真”，反而是“无一被认证”，且未提及“无法鉴定方法”，信息部分错误。
错误类型：【无中生有】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 主旨题要抓住文章整体语气和核心内容，关注转折词（如but、given）提示前后内容关系；“challenge”（挑战）、“importance”（重要性）等关键词显示难度和价值并存，排除带有过度否定或无依据信息的选项，锁定兼顾难度与意义的答案。

article: Historians point to the rule of the Piast dynasty as crucial to the formation of the Polish state. However, some differentiate between members of the dynasty like Władysław I Herman, who ruled as duke from 1079 to 1102 CE, and less well-documented figures like Lestek, who is said to have ruled in the 9th and 10th centuries but whose historical actuality is disputed. Lestek appears in the Gesta principum Polonorum, a chronicle of medieval Polish history written between 1112 and 1118. However, the chronicle's documentation of Lestek relies on oral tradition, unlike its records of later rulers.
stem: According to the text, what is a difference between how historians view Lestek and how they view Władysław I Herman?

options.content: Historians believe that the Gesta principum Polonorum provides more evidence for Lestek's existence than it does for Władysław I Herman's existence.
Historians agree that Władysław I Herman existed, but disagree about whether Lestek existed.
Historians agree that Lestek ruled Poland much later than Władysław I Herman.
Historians find the orally transmitted stories affirming the existence of Władysław I Herman to be more convincing than similar stories about Lestek.

## 题目类型说明

这是细节理解题，核心任务是准确区分历史学家对两位人物存在与统治时间的不同态度。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Historians point to the rule of the Piast dynasty as crucial to the formation of the Polish state.

👉 介绍主题，说明Piast王朝统治对波兰国家形成的重要性。

**第2句：**
> However, some differentiate between members of the dynasty like Władysław I Herman, who ruled as duke from 1079 to 1102 CE, and less well-documented figures like Lestek, who is said to have ruled in the 9th and 10th centuries but whose historical actuality is disputed.

👉 转折，指出学者对两类成员看法不同：对Władysław I Herman资料较多，对Lestek的历史真实性存疑。

**第3句：**
> Lestek appears in the Gesta principum Polonorum, a chronicle of medieval Polish history written between 1112 and 1118.

👉 举例说明Lestek的记载来源，即该中世纪编年史。

**第4句：**
> However, the chronicle's documentation of Lestek relies on oral tradition, unlike its records of later rulers.

👉 对比说明，Lestek的记录基于口述传统，而其他后期统治者的记录则有更确凿的文献依据。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                                   |
|:---------|:-------------------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍Piast王朝对波兰形成的重要性                         |
| 第二句   | 转折，区分对Władysław I Herman和Lestek的不同历史看法    |
| 第三句   | 说明Lestek出现在中世纪编年史《Gesta principum Polonorum》中 |
| 第四句   | 对比Lestek的记录依赖口头传统，后期统治者记录更可靠      |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> Historians believe that the Gesta principum Polonorum provides more evidence for Lestek's existence than it does for Władysław I Herman's existence.

错误，文中明确说明《Gesta principum Polonorum》对Lestek的记载依赖口头传统，而对后期统治者（如Władysław I Herman）的记录更为确凿，故证据对Lestek不够充分。
错误类型：【方向相反】

**B 选项** ✅
> Historians agree that Władysław I Herman existed, but disagree about whether Lestek existed.

正确，文章第2句指出对Władysław I Herman的存在较为肯定，而Lestek的历史真实性有争议，符合原文描述。

**C 选项** ❌
> Historians agree that Lestek ruled Poland much later than Władysław I Herman.

错误，文中说明Lestek据称统治时间在9至10世纪，而Władysław I Herman统治时间为1079至1102年，Lestek时间更早，非“晚于”Władysław I Herman。
错误类型：【方向相反】

**D 选项** ❌
> Historians find the orally transmitted stories affirming the existence of Władysław I Herman to be more convincing than similar stories about Lestek.

错误，文中表明口述传统是Lestek的记载依据，而对Władysław I Herman的记录则非口述传统，而是更可靠的文献记录，且未提口述传统对Władysław I Herman的存在认知。
错误类型：【无中生有】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题核心在于抓住转折词"However"和对比结构，明确区分两位人物的历史证据差异——Lestek的存在存在争议且依赖口头传统，而Władysław I Herman的存在更为确定且有文献记载；通过原文中“whose historical actuality is disputed”和“unlike its records of later rulers”定位正确选项，排除选项中的时间顺序错误和证据来源错误。

article: Shaohong Feng and colleagues relied on historical DNA (hDNA)—genomic data incidentally preserved in specimens housed in natural history collections—to investigate genetic diversity declines in the crested ibis (Nipponia nippon). Although this approach offers unique benefits, such as the ability to sample genomic material from extinct species, it remains relatively underutilized because archival specimens are sometimes stored in ways that compromise DNA quality, a situation not easily remediable under current methodological paradigms and with extant DNA extraction and analysis technologies.

options.content: They are primarily used as sources of genomic data by scientists studying organisms that have undergone major evolutionary change.
Because of their often-deteriorated condition, they tend to yield genomic data that are time-consuming to extract and interpret.
While they may contain valuable genomic data, not all of them can yield usable hDNA.
While they were used in a study that made an important scientific discovery, they are generally of marginal value as sources of genomic data.

## 题目类型说明

本题为细节理解题，核心任务是准确把握文章对自然历史馆藏标本中DNA的描述，判断哪些说法与文中信息最为吻合。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Shaohong Feng and colleagues relied on historical DNA (hDNA)—genomic data incidentally preserved in specimens housed in natural history collections—to investigate genetic diversity declines in the crested ibis (Nipponia nippon).

👉 说明研究对象和研究方法，介绍hDNA及其应用。

**第2句：**
> Although this approach offers unique benefits, such as the ability to sample genomic material from extinct species, it remains relatively underutilized because archival specimens are sometimes stored in ways that compromise DNA quality, a situation not easily remediable under current methodological paradigms and with extant DNA extraction and analysis technologies.

👉 表示hDNA方法的优势及其局限，指出标本保存方式影响DNA质量，限制了此方法的广泛使用。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                                         |
|:---------|:-------------------------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍Shaohong Feng等人利用自然历史馆藏标本中的hDNA研究朱鹮的遗传多样性下降。 |
| 第二句   | 阐述hDNA方法的优点（如研究灭绝物种）及其受限原因（标本保存影响DNA质量，技术难以解决）。 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌【无中生有】
> They are primarily used as sources of genomic data by scientists studying organisms that have undergone major evolutionary change.

文中未提及这些标本主要用于研究经历重大进化变化的生物，且强调的是研究遗传多样性下降，而非“重大进化变化”，该说法无文中依据。

**B 选项** ❌【过度推断】
> Because of their often-deteriorated condition, they tend to yield genomic data that are time-consuming to extract and interpret.

文章提到标本存储方式影响DNA质量，限制hDNA的使用，但未具体说明提取和解析数据是否“耗时”，此为过度推断。

**C 选项** ✅
> While they may contain valuable genomic data, not all of them can yield usable hDNA.

与文中“archival specimens are sometimes stored in ways that compromise DNA quality”完全吻合，说明虽有价值但并非所有标本都能产出可用hDNA。

**D 选项** ❌【方向相反】
> While they were used in a study that made an important scientific discovery, they are generally of marginal value as sources of genomic data.

文中强调了hDNA的独特优势和价值，未暗示标本价值“边缘化”，该选项与原文信息相反。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关注转折词“although”引导的让步结构，明确hDNA的优势与限制并存；重点定位“archival specimens are sometimes stored in ways that compromise DNA quality”这一因果关系，排除无根据的推断和与文意相反的选项，从而锁定正确答案。

article: Some researchers have characterized the flora and fauna of the South Pacific island of Grande Terre as members of clades that inhabited nearby islands before Grande Terre completely emerged 37 million years ago. Gonzalo Giribet et al. found that the crown age (the age of the most recent common ancestor of all living and extinct species in the clade) of the clade of daddy longlegs spiders on Grande Terre is approximately 57.0 million years, while Antoine N. Nicolas and Gregory M. Plunkett found that the crown age of the clade of Apiales plants on Grande Terre is approximately 25.4 million years.
stem: Which statement about the view put forward by "some researchers" is best supported by information in the text?

options.content: The view has some empirical support but is weakened by the findings of Giribet et al.
The view depends on inaccurate assumptions about the crown ages of the clades of daddy longlegs spiders and Apiales plants on Grande Terre.
The view could be true of Grande Terre's daddy longlegs spiders but is not true of the island's Apiales plants.
The view suggests that Grande Terre may have emerged as early as 57.0 million years ago.
