---

## 题目类型说明

本题为细节理解题，核心任务是判断“some researchers”提出的观点与后文给出的具体数据之间的关系，验证观点的正确性和适用范围。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Some researchers have characterized the flora and fauna of the South Pacific island of Grande Terre as members of clades that inhabited nearby islands before Grande Terre completely emerged 37 million years ago.

👉 提出观点：一些研究者认为Grande Terre上的动植物属于早于该岛完全形成（37百万年前）就存在于邻近岛屿的类群。

**第2句：**
> Gonzalo Giribet et al. found that the crown age (the age of the most recent common ancestor of all living and extinct species in the clade) of the clade of daddy longlegs spiders on Grande Terre is approximately 57.0 million years,

👉 提供证据1：Daddy longlegs蜘蛛类群的祖先年龄约为57百万年，比37百万年前早。

**第3句：**
> while Antoine N. Nicolas and Gregory M. Plunkett found that the crown age of the clade of Apiales plants on Grande Terre is approximately 25.4 million years.

👉 提供证据2：Apiales植物类群的祖先年龄约为25.4百万年，比37百万年前晚。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 引述部分研究者观点，认为Grande Terre的动植物类群早于37百万年前就在邻近岛屿存在 |
| 第二句 | 证据1，Daddy longlegs蜘蛛的祖先年龄约57百万年，支持观点中“早于37百万年”的说法 |
| 第三句 | 证据2，Apiales植物的祖先年龄约25.4百万年，晚于37百万年，反驳观点中对所有类群的普适性 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> The view has some empirical support but is weakened by the findings of Giribet et al.

错误原因：Giribet等人的发现（57百万年）支持了观点，反而是Apiales植物的发现与观点矛盾。此选项错误地将Giribet的发现视为削弱观点的证据。
错误类型：【方向相反】

**B 选项** ❌
> The view depends on inaccurate assumptions about the crown ages of the clades of daddy longlegs spiders and Apiales plants on Grande Terre.

错误原因：文中未表明“some researchers”的观点基于错误的年龄假设；相反Giribet等人的年龄数据支持部分观点，只有Apiales植物的数据不支持。
错误类型：【过度推断】

**C 选项** ✅
> The view could be true of Grande Terre's daddy longlegs spiders but is not true of the island's Apiales plants.

正确原因：Daddy longlegs蜘蛛的祖先年龄（57百万年）确实早于Grande Terre的出现（37百万年），支持观点；而Apiales植物的祖先年龄（25.4百万年）晚于岛屿出现时间，反驳观点的普遍性。符合文章信息。

**D 选项** ❌
> The view suggests that Grande Terre may have emerged as early as 57.0 million years ago.

错误原因：“some researchers”的观点是指动植物类群早于岛屿出现，而非推断岛屿出现时间；文中无证据支持岛屿出现时间可能早于37百万年。
错误类型：【无中生有】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于区分研究者观点与具体年龄数据的关系，注意“before Grande Terre completely emerged 37 million years ago”是时间点，Giribet等人提供的57百万年数据支持观点，而25.4百万年则反驳观点的普适性。选项中要警惕将支持证据误读为反证（A选项），以及将观点逻辑倒置（D选项）。锁定关键词“crown age”和“before 37 million years ago”是解题关键。

article:
The following text is from Ralph Waldo Emerson’s 1841 essay “The Method of Nature.”

The scholars are the priests of that thought which establishes the foundations of the earth. No matter what is their special work or profession, they stand for the spiritual interest of the world, and it is a common calamity if they neglect their post in a country where the material interest is so predominant as it is in America.
stem: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?

options.content: In a country whose citizens are largely preoccupied with tangible gains, it is crucial that some people work to foster and preserve ideas.
Military experience encourages Americans to contemplate aspects of human life that they would not choose to otherwise.
The habit of intellectuals of privileging ideas over material things invariably leads to tragedy.
Scholars have played an important role in society for a much longer time than have those people who are mainly concerned with financial gain.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

主旨大意题，核心任务是准确把握文章中心思想，选出最能概括全文主旨的选项。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> The scholars are the priests of that thought which establishes the foundations of the earth.

👉 比喻性地提出观点：学者是建立世界基础思想的“祭司”，强调他们的精神引导作用。

**第2句：**
> No matter what is their special work or profession, they stand for the spiritual interest of the world,

👉 进一步阐述观点：无论学者具体职业如何，他们代表着世界的精神利益。

**第3句：**
> and it is a common calamity if they neglect their post in a country where the material interest is so predominant as it is in America.

👉 因果推论：在像美国这样物质利益占主导的国家，如果学者忽视职责，是一种普遍的不幸。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                           |
|:---------|:----------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 学者被比作“祭司”，代表奠定世界基础的思想。   |
| 第二句   | 学者代表世界的精神利益，无论其具体职业为何。   |
| 第三句   | 在物质利益主导的美国，学者忽视职责是普遍灾难。 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅（正确）
> In a country whose citizens are largely preoccupied with tangible gains, it is crucial that some people work to foster and preserve ideas.

选项准确对应“material interest is so predominant as it is in America”和“scholars stand for the spiritual interest”两层意思，体现了物质利益占主导但学者精神引领不可或缺的主旨。

**B 选项** ❌（错误）
> Military experience encourages Americans to contemplate aspects of human life that they would not choose to otherwise.

文章未提及“军事经验”或相关内容，完全无中生有，与原文无关。
【无中生有】

**C 选项** ❌（错误）
> The habit of intellectuals of privileging ideas over material things invariably leads to tragedy.

原文中只说忽视学者职责是“common calamity”，并无说学者偏重思想“必然”导致悲剧，且语气更中性，C选项过度推断。
【过度推断】

**D 选项** ❌（错误）
> Scholars have played an important role in society for a much longer time than have those people who are mainly concerned with financial gain.

文章无比较学者与关注经济利益者的历史时间长短，D选项无依据，属于无中生有。
【无中生有】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题核心是抓住文章对比“material interest”和“spiritual interest”的对立，通过“predominant”与“common calamity”等关键词锁定主题为“物质利益主导下学者精神职责的重要性”，排除无关内容（如军事经验）和过度推断（必然导致悲剧），从而选出最贴合主旨的A选项。

---

article:
The following text is from Anthony Trollope's 1855 novel The Warden. Tom Towers is a writer for the newspaper The Jupiter.

It is true that in far-off provinces men did not talk daily of Tom Towers but they read The Jupiter, and acknowledged that without The Jupiter life was not worth having. This kind of hidden but still conscious glory suited the nature of the man. He loved to sit silent in a corner of his club and listen to the loud chattering of politicians, and to think how they all were in his power; how he could smite the loudest of them, were it worth his while to raise his pen for such a purpose.
stem: What does the text most strongly suggest about Tom Towers?

options.content: He flatters himself that his readers take a greater interest in him than in politicians.
He has received much praise but tends to overestimate influential people's respect for him.
He seeks mainly the admiration of readers in places that are far away.
He takes private satisfaction in his capacity to influence public opinion.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

这是细节理解题，核心任务是根据文章具体描述，准确把握人物的心理状态和行为动机。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> It is true that in far-off provinces men did not talk daily of Tom Towers but they read The Jupiter, and acknowledged that without The Jupiter life was not worth having.

👉 说明Tom Towers虽然不被广泛讨论，但他的报纸被远方读者认可，显示他的影响力。

**第2句：**
> This kind of hidden but still conscious glory suited the nature of the man.

👉 表明Tom Towers喜欢这种“隐藏的但自知的荣耀”，揭示其性格特点。

**第3句：**
> He loved to sit silent in a corner of his club and listen to the loud chattering of politicians, and to think how they all were in his power; how he could smite the loudest of them, were it worth his while to raise his pen for such a purpose.

👉 描述Tom Towers私下感到自己能够掌控政客，并暗示他有影响力但不轻易动用。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                                         |
|:---------|:------------------------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 远方的人们虽不常谈论Tom Towers，但读他的报纸并认可其价值。   |
| 第二句   | Tom Towers喜欢这种“隐性但自知”的荣耀，符合他的性格。         |
| 第三句   | 他私下觉得自己掌控政客，有能力影响他们，但不轻易使用这种力量。|

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌【过度推断】
> He flatters himself that his readers take a greater interest in him than in politicians.

文中仅说远方人们不常谈论他，但读他的报纸，没有说他自我感觉读者对他兴趣超过政客，这属于过度推断。

**B 选项** ❌【无中生有】
> He has received much praise but tends to overestimate influential people's respect for him.

文中没有提到他获得“很多赞扬”，也没有说他高估了政客对他的尊重，故此选项无依据。

**C 选项** ❌【方向相反】
> He seeks mainly the admiration of readers in places that are far away.

文中指出远方人们不常谈论他，且他喜欢“隐性荣耀”，并非主动寻求远方读者的赞赏，方向相反。

**D 选项** ✅
> He takes private satisfaction in his capacity to influence public opinion.

原文第三句明确写他“爱坐在俱乐部角落，听政客喋喋不休，想着他们都在他掌控之中”，说明他私下对影响力感到满足。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 重点关注文中描述人物内心感受的句子（如“loved to sit silent... and to think how they all were in his power”），利用人物私下的心理活动来判断其真实态度，排除选项中与原文心理描写不符的内容，避免无中生有和过度推断。关键词“hidden but still conscious glory”暗示隐秘的满足感，锁定D选项。

article: In what is now Minnesota, the Shakopee Mdewakanton Sioux Community operates the Hoċokata Ṫi, a cultural center. Relying on traditional knowledge to guide the design of exhibits, this institution presents Dakota history and culture to the tribe's citizens. The Turtle Mountain Band of Chippewa, a tribe in North Dakota, employs a similar strategy in its own cultural center. Both centers contrast with museums that aren't Indigenous-led; when displaying Indigenous artifacts, such museums tend to anticipate mainly non-Indigenous audiences and rely on Euro-centric strategies for designing exhibits.
stem: The text best supports which conclusion about the cultural center operated by the Turtle Mountain Band of Chippewa?

options.content: Its exhibits are likely intended to reconcile Indigenous perspectives with Euro-centric perspectives.
Its exhibits likely rely on the traditional knowledge of multiple tribes.
Its ability to present history and culture to tribal citizens is limited by its physical size.
Its exhibits are likely designed for the benefit of audiences consisting mainly of tribal citizens.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

本题为细节理解题，核心任务是根据文章对Turtle Mountain Band of Chippewa文化中心的描述，推断该文化中心展览的目标受众。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> In what is now Minnesota, the Shakopee Mdewakanton Sioux Community operates the Hoċokata Ṫi, a cultural center.

👉 介绍具体文化中心的存在和位置。

**第2句：**
> Relying on traditional knowledge to guide the design of exhibits, this institution presents Dakota history and culture to the tribe's citizens.

👉 说明该文化中心以传统知识为依据，面向部落成员展示历史文化。

**第3句：**
> The Turtle Mountain Band of Chippewa, a tribe in North Dakota, employs a similar strategy in its own cultural center.

👉 说明Turtle Mountain Band of Chippewa部落的文化中心采取了类似的策略。

**第4句：**
> Both centers contrast with museums that aren't Indigenous-led; when displaying Indigenous artifacts, such museums tend to anticipate mainly non-Indigenous audiences and rely on Euro-centric strategies for designing exhibits.

👉 对比土著主导的文化中心与非土著主导的博物馆，指出后者主要面向非土著观众并采用欧洲中心主义的设计。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 介绍Shakopee Mdewakanton Sioux Community文化中心及其地理位置。 |
| 第二句 | 该文化中心依托传统知识，向部落成员展示达科他历史与文化。 |
| 第三句 | Turtle Mountain Band of Chippewa部落的文化中心采用类似策略。 |
| 第四句 | 对比土著主导文化中心与非土著主导博物馆的展览设计和目标观众。 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> Its exhibits are likely intended to reconcile Indigenous perspectives with Euro-centric perspectives.

原文未提及该文化中心试图调和土著与欧洲中心观点，只说明文化中心依传统知识设计展览，面向部落成员。此选项为【无中生有】。

**B 选项** ❌
> Its exhibits likely rely on the traditional knowledge of multiple tribes.

原文仅指出采用“类似策略”，并未说明展览基于多个部落的传统知识，原文聚焦单一部落。此选项为【过度推断】。

**C 选项** ❌
> Its ability to present history and culture to tribal citizens is limited by its physical size.

文中无任何关于文化中心物理规模及其限制的描述。此选项为【无中生有】。

**D 选项** ✅
> Its exhibits are likely designed for the benefit of audiences consisting mainly of tribal citizens.

原文指出Shakopee Mdewakanton Sioux Community文化中心“presents Dakota history and culture to the tribe's citizens”，Turtle Mountain Band of Chippewa文化中心采用“similar strategy”，故展览主要面向部落成员，支持此结论。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关键在于抓住“presents ... to the tribe's citizens”和“employs a similar strategy”这两处细节，确认文化中心的展览主要服务对象是部落成员，从而排除涉及其他受众或多部落知识的选项。转折对比句中明确非土著主导的博物馆主要面向非土著观众，进一步强化文化中心面向本族群体的特点。

article: Vancouver has high pedestrian traffic, but other cities cannot increase their pedestrian traffic simply by replicating a single feature of Vancouver—e.g., its high number of pedestrian amenities—that is associated with walkability. As urbanist Mariela Alfonzo argues, many factors influence people's decision-making about whether to walk: some studies have shown the importance of demographic characteristics, others have shown the importance of average commuting distance, and so on, and it is clear that none of these factors in isolation fully explains pedestrian habits in a given city.
stem: Based on the text, the author would most likely agree with which statement about Vancouver's "high number of pedestrian amenities"?

options.content: It may increase walkability in Vancouver but is known to reduce walkability in other cities.
It is better understood as an effect of the high level of pedestrian traffic in Vancouver than as a cause of that pedestrian traffic.
It affects walking decisions in Vancouver less than demographic characteristics and average commuting distance do.
It should be understood as just one of several factors that influence pedestrian activity in Vancouver.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

这是细节理解题，核心任务是根据文章内容判断作者对温哥华“高数量行人设施”作用的态度。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Vancouver has high pedestrian traffic, but other cities cannot increase their pedestrian traffic simply by replicating a single feature of Vancouver—e.g., its *high number of pedestrian amenities*—that is associated with walkability.

👉 提出观点：温哥华行人流量高，但其他城市仅复制温哥华的单一特征（如行人设施丰富）无法增加行人流量。

**第2句：**
> As urbanist Mariela Alfonzo argues, many factors influence people's decision-making about whether to walk: some studies have shown the importance of demographic characteristics, others have shown the importance of average commuting distance, and so on, and it is clear that none of these factors in isolation fully explains pedestrian habits in a given city.

👉 进一步解释原因：多种因素共同影响人们是否步行，单一因素不足以解释某城市的行人习惯。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 温哥华行人流量高，但其他城市不能仅靠复制温哥华某单一特征（如行人设施多）来提高行人流量。 |
| 第二句 | 引用专家观点说明影响步行决策的多因素（人口特征、通勤距离等），没有单一因素能完全解释行人习惯。 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> It may increase walkability in Vancouver but is known to reduce walkability in other cities.

错误，文中没有提及该特征会“减少”其他城市的步行率，只说复制单一特征“不能增加”，并无“减少”之意。【无中生有】

**B 选项** ❌
> It is better understood as an effect of the high level of pedestrian traffic in Vancouver than as a cause of that pedestrian traffic.

错误，文中并未讨论该特征是结果还是原因，只说复制单一因素无法解释行人流量，未涉及因果方向。【无中生有】

**C 选项** ❌
> It affects walking decisions in Vancouver less than demographic characteristics and average commuting distance do.

错误，文中提到多因素都影响步行决策，但未比较“行人设施”与“人口特征、通勤距离”的影响大小。【无中生有】

**D 选项** ✅
> It should be understood as just one of several factors that influence pedestrian activity in Vancouver.

正确，文中明确指出影响行人习惯的因素多样，单一因素不足以解释，表明“高数量行人设施”只是多个因素之一。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关注文中转折词“but”、“and so on”，以及“none of these factors in isolation fully explains”，提示影响因素多元且单一因素不足，锁定正确选项为强调“多个因素共同作用”的D选项，同时排除其他选项的过度推断和无中生有。

article: The Federalist Papers are a collection of 85 essays written by Alexander Hamilton, John Jay and James Madison. Their publication (under a single pen name) was divided among the Independent Journal and other New York newspapers in 1787-88. The essays argue that New Yorkers should vote to ratify the proposed United States Constitution. Though the authorship of most of the individual essays is certain, that of a few is in question: for instance, while No. 12, "The Utility of the Union in Respect to Revenue," was surely penned by Hamilton, No. 62, "The Senate," may have been written by either Hamilton or Madison.
stem: Based on the text, what do the essays "The Utility of the Union in Respect to Revenue" and "The Senate" have in common?

options.content: They were both written by one of the three authors of the Federalist Papers, but which of the authors wrote either is not entirely clear.
They were both published sometime during 1787 or 1788.
They were both published in the Independent Journal.
They were both collaborative efforts between Alexander Hamilton and James Madison.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

本题为细节理解题，核心任务是根据文章内容准确找出两篇文章的共同点。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> The Federalist Papers are a collection of 85 essays written by Alexander Hamilton, John Jay and James Madison.
👉 介绍联邦党人文集及其作者。

**第2句：**
> Their publication (under a single pen name) was divided among the Independent Journal and other New York newspapers in 1787-88.
👉 说明这些文章在1787-88年间分刊于纽约多家报纸，包括Independent Journal。

**第3句：**
> The essays argue that New Yorkers should vote to ratify the proposed United States Constitution.
👉 阐明文章主旨：支持宪法批准。

**第4句：**
> Though the authorship of most of the individual essays is certain, that of a few is in question: for instance, while No. 12, "The Utility of the Union in Respect to Revenue," was surely penned by Hamilton, No. 62, "The Senate," may have been written by either Hamilton or Madison.
👉 说明大部分文章作者确定，但少数如第12篇确定是Hamilton写，第62篇作者不确定是Hamilton或Madison。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 介绍联邦党人文集的作者和篇数 |
| 第二句 | 说明文章发表于1787-88年，分布于Independent Journal及其他报纸 |
| 第三句 | 文章内容主旨是支持批准宪法 |
| 第四句 | 说明大部分文章作者确定，第12篇由Hamilton写，第62篇作者存疑 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> They were both written by one of the three authors of the Federalist Papers, but which of the authors wrote either is not entirely clear.
文章明确指出第12篇肯定是Hamilton所写，而第62篇作者不确定是Hamilton还是Madison，因此“哪篇文章作者不确定”这个描述只适用于第62篇，不适用于两篇文章共同点。【以偏概全】

**B 选项** ✅
> They were both published sometime during 1787 or 1788.
文章明确表示联邦党人文集文章均发表于1787-88年，包括第12篇和第62篇，因此这两篇文章的共同点是均发表于此时间段，符合原文。

**C 选项** ❌
> They were both published in the Independent Journal.
文章只说联邦党人文集文章分布在Independent Journal和其他报纸，没有明确指出这两篇都刊载于Independent Journal，信息不足。【无中生有】

**D 选项** ❌
> They were both collaborative efforts between Alexander Hamilton and James Madison.
文章指出第12篇确定是Hamilton独自撰写，第62篇作者不确定，但没有提到合作写作，故此选项错误。【无中生有】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关注题干中“have in common”的表述，锁定两篇文章共有信息。文章中作者信息对两篇文章并非完全相同（第12篇确定，第62篇不确定），排除选项A和D。文章明确指出所有文章发表于1787-88年，故选项B正确。注意区分文章中明确和不明确的信息，避免无中生有或以偏概全。关键词“published in 1787-88”是答案的关键。

article: Motivated to sell as many paintings as possible, Alfred Hair, an influential figure among the landscape artists known as the Florida Highwaymen, pioneered "fast painting," which in part involved working across multiple canvases at once. That many of Hair's acolytes, including Isaac Knight, imitated the technique accounts in part for the impressionistic qualities that are now synonymous with the group's shared aesthetic. But not all Highwaymen fully embraced this approach; for instance, though Willie Reagan was also prolific, his paintings were executed with greater attention to detail.
stem: What does the text most strongly suggest about paintings by Knight?

options.content: Because of the manner in which they were created, they likely have visual qualities that are regarded as more typical of Florida Highwaymen paintings than the qualities in works by Reagan are.
Although it is evident that Knight adopted some of Hair's preferred techniques, Knight's works are less derivative of works by Hair than is typically acknowledged.
The lack of precision with which they were executed suggests that they are inferior to works by either Hair or Reagan.
Knight's reliance on the technique of fast painting likely accounts for his works being more aesthetically interesting than works by Reagan are.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

本题为细节理解题，核心任务是根据文章对人物和技法的描述，推断Knight的画作具有何种视觉特征。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Motivated to sell as many paintings as possible, Alfred Hair, an influential figure among the landscape artists known as the Florida Highwaymen, pioneered "fast painting," which in part involved working across multiple canvases at once.

👉 介绍Alfred Hair及其发明的“快速绘画”技法。

**第2句：**
> That many of Hair's acolytes, including Isaac Knight, imitated the technique accounts in part for the impressionistic qualities that are now synonymous with the group's shared aesthetic.

👉 说明Hair的追随者（包括Knight）模仿其技法，导致该团体绘画具有印象派风格。

**第3句：**
> But not all Highwaymen fully embraced this approach; for instance, though Willie Reagan was also prolific, his paintings were executed with greater attention to detail.

👉 转折，指出并非所有画家都采用快速绘画法，举例说明Reagan画作更注重细节。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                                         |
|:---------|:-------------------------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍Alfred Hair及其“快速绘画”技法                           |
| 第二句   | Hair的追随者（包括Knight）模仿该技法，形成印象派风格         |
| 第三句   | 转折，Reagan虽多产但注重细节，未完全采纳快速绘画法             |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅
> Because of the manner in which they were created, they likely have visual qualities that are regarded as more typical of Florida Highwaymen paintings than the qualities in works by Reagan are.

选项准确反映第二句中“including Isaac Knight, imitated the technique accounts…for the impressionistic qualities”以及第三句中Reagan注重细节与快速绘画形成对比，说明Knight画作视觉特征更典型。

**B 选项** ❌【无中生有】
> Although it is evident that Knight adopted some of Hair's preferred techniques, Knight's works are less derivative of works by Hair than is typically acknowledged.

文中无任何信息暗示Knight的作品“less derivative”（较少模仿），与原文“imitated the technique”矛盾，属于无中生有。

**C 选项** ❌【过度推断】
> The lack of precision with which they were executed suggests that they are inferior to works by either Hair or Reagan.

文中未评价作品优劣，仅描述风格及技法，选项涉及价值判断，属于过度推断。

**D 选项** ❌【过度推断】
> Knight's reliance on the technique of fast painting likely accounts for his works being more aesthetically interesting than works by Reagan are.

文中未提“aesthetically interesting”（更美观或更有趣）类主观评价，属于过度推断。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关注转折词“But”和因果关系短语“accounts for”，锁定Knight和Reagan的对比，结合“impressionistic qualities”与“greater attention to detail”描绘的画风差异，从而确定Knight画作更典型，排除带有价值判断和无中生有的选项。

article: Joel Brown and colleagues showed that high moonlight intensity inhibits the activity of the Arizona pocket mouse (Perognathus amplus), a finding explicable in terms of benefits and costs: greater lunar intensity may not enable the mice to increase foraging success enough to offset the higher chance of detection by predatory owls or hawks. Though many other nocturnal mammals respond to lunar intensity variations similarly to Arizona pocket mice, Azara's night monkeys (Aotus azarae) display the opposite pattern, as their heavy reliance on visual foraging results in a different balance of reward and risk.
stem: Based on the text, why do Azara's night monkeys respond to high lunar intensity differently than Arizona pocket mice do?

options.content: In such conditions, the chance of detection by predators declines for Azara's night monkeys but rises for Arizona pocket mice.
Although the risks of activity in such conditions are greater for Azara's night monkeys than they are for Arizona pocket mice, the rewards are also greater for Azara's night monkeys.
In such conditions, the costs of activity are lower relative to the benefits of activity for Azara's night monkeys than they are for Arizona pocket mice.

Due to their heavy reliance on visual foraging, Azara's night monkeys experience a reduction in their foraging success in such conditions, whereas Arizona pocket mice experience no change in their foraging success.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

这是一道因果关系理解题，核心任务是根据文章内容理解两种动物对月光强度反应不同的原因。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Joel Brown and colleagues showed that high moonlight intensity inhibits the activity of the Arizona pocket mouse (Perognathus amplus), a finding explicable in terms of benefits and costs: greater lunar intensity may not enable the mice to increase foraging success enough to offset the higher chance of detection by predatory owls or hawks.

👉 说明研究发现，并用“利益和成本”框架解释：月光强使得老鼠活动减少，因为增加的觅食成功不足以弥补被捕食者发现概率的增加。

**第2句：**
> Though many other nocturnal mammals respond to lunar intensity variations similarly to Arizona pocket mice, Azara's night monkeys (Aotus azarae) display the opposite pattern, as their heavy reliance on visual foraging results in a different balance of reward and risk.

👉 对比说明大多数夜行动物（包括Arizona pocket mouse）对月光强度的反应与Azara夜猴不同，原因是它们视觉觅食依赖强，导致风险和收益的平衡不同。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 介绍Arizona pocket mouse对月光强度反应，活动减少，因觅食收益不足以抵消被捕食风险。 |
| 第二句 | 说明其他夜行动物反应相似，但Azara夜猴因视觉觅食依赖大，反应相反，风险收益平衡不同。 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> In such conditions, the chance of detection by predators declines for Azara's night monkeys but rises for Arizona pocket mice.

错误原因：文中只提到Arizona pocket mice被捕食风险增加，并未说Azara夜猴被捕食风险降低。【无中生有】

**B 选项** ❌
> Although the risks of activity in such conditions are greater for Azara's night monkeys than they are for Arizona pocket mice, the rewards are also greater for Azara's night monkeys.

错误原因：文中未提及Azara夜猴风险更大，只说风险收益的平衡不同。【过度推断】

**C 选项** ✅
> In such conditions, the costs of activity are lower relative to the benefits of activity for Azara's night monkeys than they are for Arizona pocket mice.

正确原因：文章明确指出Azara夜猴“their heavy reliance on visual foraging results in a different balance of reward and risk”，即相对于Arizona pocket mice，Azara夜猴活动的成本与收益比例不同，符合选项描述。

**D 选项** ❌
> Due to their heavy reliance on visual foraging, Azara's night monkeys experience a reduction in their foraging success in such conditions, whereas Arizona pocket mice experience no change in their foraging success.

错误原因：文中并未说Azara夜猴觅食成功下降，反而暗示因视觉依赖，收益更大；且Arizona pocket mice的觅食成功也不是“不变”。【方向相反】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于理解“risk and reward balance”（风险与收益的平衡）如何影响动物对月光强度的不同反应。题干询问原因时，需锁定文章对“Azara's night monkeys”与“Arizona pocket mouse”的对比描述，尤其是“heavy reliance on visual foraging”和“different balance of reward and risk”两处关键词，排除选项中未提及或错误描述风险变化的选项，选出体现“成本与收益相对关系不同”的选项。

---

article:
The following text is from Anthony Trollope's 1855 novel The Warden. The narrator is describing a rectory, the residence of a clergyperson.

There was an air of heaviness about the rooms which might have been avoided without any sacrifice of propriety; colours might have been better chosen and lights more perfectly diffused; but perhaps in doing so the thorough clerical aspect of the whole might have been somewhat marred; at any rate, it was not without ample consideration that those thick, dark, costly carpets were put down; those embossed, but sombre [wallpapers] hung up; those heavy curtains draped so as to half exclude the light of the sun.
stem: What does the text most strongly suggest about the rooms in the rectory?

options.content: They are meant to feel comfortable but are in reality uninviting.
They have been furnished with the intention of maintaining a sense of appropriateness.
They are decorated in a style that strikes the narrator as too extravagant.
They have many decorations the narrator finds good looking, but they are not particularly practical.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

这是主旨理解题，核心任务是判断文章对牧师住宅房间布置的态度和意图。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> There was an air of heaviness about the rooms which might have been avoided without any sacrifice of propriety;

👉 说明房间显得沉闷，但这种沉闷感其实是可以避免的且不会有失体面。

**第2句：**
> colours might have been better chosen and lights more perfectly diffused;

👉 具体指出房间色彩和灯光布置可以做得更好。

**第3句：**
> but perhaps in doing so the thorough clerical aspect of the whole might have been somewhat marred;

👉 转折，说明如果改变色彩和灯光，房间的“彻底牧师气质”可能会被破坏。

**第4句：**
> at any rate, it was not without ample consideration that those thick, dark, costly carpets were put down;

👉 强调深思熟虑后才铺设了厚重、深色且昂贵的地毯。

**第5句：**
> those embossed, but sombre [wallpapers] hung up;

👉 描述墙纸是浮雕但阴暗的。

**第6句：**
> those heavy curtains draped so as to half exclude the light of the sun.

👉 描述厚重窗帘部分遮挡阳光。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                                         |
|:---------|:-------------------------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 房间有沉闷感，这种沉闷感本可避免且不影响体面。               |
| 第二句   | 色彩和灯光本可更好。                                         |
| 第三句   | 但改变色彩和灯光会破坏房间的牧师气质。                       |
| 第四句   | 地毯的选择经过充分考虑，是厚重、深色且昂贵的。               |
| 第五句   | 墙纸是压花但阴暗的。                                         |
| 第六句   | 厚重窗帘半遮阳光。                                           |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> They are meant to feel comfortable but are in reality uninviting.

文章并未提及房间是为了“舒适”而布置，也没有直接说房间“不招人喜欢”，而是强调了沉闷感是有意维持的“牧师气质”，属于【无中生有】。

**B 选项** ✅
> They have been furnished with the intention of maintaining a sense of appropriateness.

原文多次提到布置是“ample consideration”（充分考虑）后的结果，且为了不破坏“thorough clerical aspect”（彻底的牧师气质），即为了保持“体面”和合适的形象，完全符合原文。

**C 选项** ❌
> They are decorated in a style that strikes the narrator as too extravagant.

虽然地毯“costly”（昂贵），但整体强调的是沉闷和阴暗，并无“过于奢华”的批评，属于【过度推断】。

**D 选项** ❌
> They have many decorations the narrator finds good looking, but they are not particularly practical.

文章没有表达“好看但不实用”的意思，更多在谈气氛和气质，不涉及实用性评价，属于【无中生有】。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于抓住转折词“but”连接的因果关系，明确作者强调沉闷布置是“为了不破坏牧师气质”，以及“ample consideration”显示布置是经过深思熟虑的；据此排除A、C、D选项中对舒适、奢华或实用的无根据推断，锁定B选项的“维护体面”意图。

---

article:
The following text is Emily Dickinson's circa 1873 poem "There is no Frigate like a Book". "A Frigate like a Book". A Frigate is a light fast ship; courses are swift horses.

There is no Frigate like a Book
To take us Lands away
Nor any Coursers like a Page
Of prancing Poetry––
This Traverse may the poorest take
Without oppress of Toll––
How frugal is the Chariot
That bears the Human soul.
stem: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?

options.content: Reading gives people a reprieve from the financial focus of modern life.
Poetry can forge connections between people from different cultures.
People can learn more about distant places by reading books than by traveling to those places.
Literature can metaphorically transport people to new places regardless of their means.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

这是主旨大意题，核心任务是准确把握文章的中心思想，并从选项中选出最能概括全文主旨的答案。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> There is no Frigate like a Book

👉 提出观点：书籍如同快船般能带人远行。

**第2句：**
> To take us Lands away

👉 进一步解释：书能带我们去遥远的土地。

**第3句：**
> Nor any Coursers like a Page

👉 对比说明：没有任何骏马像书页一样迅速。

**第4句：**
> Of prancing Poetry––

👉 举例说明：尤其是充满活力的诗歌。

**第5句：**
> This Traverse may the poorest take

👉 说明原因：即使是最穷的人也能通过书旅行。

**第6句：**
> Without oppress of Toll––

👉 补充原因：且无需缴纳任何费用。

**第7句：**
> How frugal is the Chariot

👉 赞美方式：这种“战车”（比喻书）是多么节省。

**第8句：**
> That bears the Human soul.

👉 总结升华：这“战车”承载着人的灵魂，强调文学的精神力量。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                             |
|:---------|:--------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 书如快船，能带人远行             |
| 第二句   | 书带我们去遥远的土地             |
| 第三句   | 书页像骏马一样迅速               |
| 第四句   | 诗歌作为例子                     |
| 第五句   | 穷人也能通过书“旅行”             |
| 第六句   | 旅行无需缴费                     |
| 第七句   | “战车”节省资源                   |
| 第八句   | “战车”承载灵魂，文学精神力量     |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> Reading gives people a reprieve from the financial focus of modern life.

错误原因：文章强调的是书籍能带来精神上的“旅行”和自由，虽然提到“poorest”且“without oppress of Toll”，但并非聚焦于摆脱“financial focus”或现代生活的财务压力。【过度推断】

**B 选项** ❌
> Poetry can forge connections between people from different cultures.

错误原因：文中提到诗歌“prancing Poetry”作为书页的例子，但全文没有提及文化间连接或跨文化交流。【无中生有】

**C 选项** ❌
> People can learn more about distant places by reading books than by traveling to those places.

错误原因：文章比喻书为快船带人远行，但并未比较阅读和实际旅行的优劣或学习多少。【无中生有】

**D 选项** ✅
> Literature can metaphorically transport people to new places regardless of their means.

正确原因：诗中多次用“Frigate”“Coursers”“Chariot”等比喻，强调书籍能带人远行且“the poorest”也能享受，无需付费，完美体现了“metaphorical transport”与“不论经济条件”这一主旨。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于抓住诗中的比喻意象（Frigate、Coursers、Chariot）和强调“poorest”与“without oppress of Toll”两点，识别出文学作品象征“精神旅行”的核心含义，排除那些对文化连接或现实旅行的无关推断，从而锁定最符合全文精神的选项D。

article:
The following text is from Virginia Woolf's 1919 novel Night and Day. The narrator describes a gathering of artists and intellectuals.

One person after another rose, and, as with an ill-balanced axe, attempted to hew out his conception of art a little more clearly, and sat down with the feeling that, for some reason which he could not grasp, his strokes had gone awry. As they sat down they turned almost invariably to the person sitting next them, and rectified and continued what they had just said in public.
stem: The text makes which point about the people at the gathering?

options.content: Each is contemptuous of the other attendees but strives to impress them.
Each fails at presenting a wholly coherent vision of art but does not understand why.
Each becomes entangled in a debate about art, and no one knows how to resolve the debate.
Each delights in speaking publicly about abstract subjects but detests speaking privately about them.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

这是细节理解题，核心任务是准确把握文章对人物行为和心理的描述，理解作者对人物表现的评价。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> One person after another rose, and, as with an ill-balanced axe, attempted to hew out his conception of art a little more clearly, and sat down with the feeling that, for some reason which he could not grasp, his strokes had gone awry.

👉 描述每个人依次发言，试图表达自己的艺术观念，但都感觉表达得不够准确，且不理解为何未能成功。

**第2句：**
> As they sat down they turned almost invariably to the person sitting next them, and rectified and continued what they had just said in public.

👉 描述发言者坐下后，几乎都会向邻座的人纠正并继续刚才公开表达的观点，暗示他们在公开发言时表达不清，需要私下补充。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                     |
|:---------|:----------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 人们依次发言，试图阐述艺术观念，但感觉表达失败且不明原因。 |
| 第二句   | 发言者坐下后向邻座补充和纠正刚才的公开陈述。           |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> Each is contemptuous of the other attendees but strives to impress them.
文章没有提及“轻蔑”或“鄙视”他人的态度，描述的是表达不清和纠正，属于【无中生有】。

**B 选项** ✅
> Each fails at presenting a wholly coherent vision of art but does not understand why.
准确反映了“attempted to hew out... with the feeling... his strokes had gone awry”和“for some reason which he could not grasp”的描述，符合原文。

**C 选项** ❌
> Each becomes entangled in a debate about art, and no one knows how to resolve the debate.
原文无“辩论”或“争论”内容，仅描述发言和纠正，属于【过度推断】。

**D 选项** ❌
> Each delights in speaking publicly about abstract subjects but detests speaking privately about them.
原文未提及“喜欢”或“厌恶”公开或私下发言，且私下是纠正和继续发言，非“厌恶”，属于【无中生有】。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 重点关注句中表达失败且“不明原因”（“for some reason which he could not grasp”）的心理描写，以及发言后“纠正和继续”表达的行为，排除无根据的情感判断和过度推断，锁定描述“表达不成功且不理解原因”的选项。关键词“ill-balanced axe”、“strokes gone awry”和“rectified and continued”是理解文章主旨的关键。

article: The Federalist Papers are a collection of essays written by Alexander Hamilton, John Jay and James Madison and published pseudonymously in the Daily Advertiser and other New York newspapers in 1787-88. Though the authorship of most of the essays is certain, that of some is obscure: for instance, while No.15, "The Insufficiency of the Present Confederation to Preserve the Union," was surely penned by Hamilton, No.52 "The House of Representatives" may have been written by either Hamilton or Madison. The difficulty of determining No.52's author arises not from a lack of evidence but from too much contradictory evidence.
stem: Based on the text, which choice best explains why it is challenging to confidently assign authorship of the essay "The House of Representatives"?

options.content: Evidence shows that two versions of "The House of Representatives," one authored by Hamilton and another authored by Madison, appeared in different New York newspapers.
The evidence that would indisputably prove that either Hamilton or Madison was the sole author of "The House of Representatives" has been lost.
Support can be found for a strong case that either Hamilton or Madison was the sole author of “The House of Representatives.”
It is most likely that "The House of Representatives" was the product of a collaborative effort between Hamilton and Madison.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

这是一道细节理解题，核心任务是根据文章内容准确理解并解释为何无法确定《众议院》的作者。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> The Federalist Papers are a collection of essays written by Alexander Hamilton, John Jay and James Madison and published pseudonymously in the Daily Advertiser and other New York newspapers in 1787-88.
👉 介绍《联邦党人文集》的作者及出版背景。

**第2句：**
> Though the authorship of most of the essays is certain, that of some is obscure: for instance, while No.15, "The Insufficiency of the Present Confederation to Preserve the Union," was surely penned by Hamilton, No.52 "The House of Representatives" may have been written by either Hamilton or Madison.
👉 说明大多数文章作者明确，但部分文章如第52号作者不确定。

**第3句：**
> The difficulty of determining No.52's author arises not from a lack of evidence but from too much contradictory evidence.
👉 解释第52号作者难以确定的原因是证据过多且相互矛盾，而非证据缺失。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 介绍《联邦党人文集》的作者和出版情况。 |
| 第二句 | 指出大部分文章作者明确，例外为第52号可能是汉密尔顿或麦迪逊。 |
| 第三句 | 说明第52号作者难定的原因是证据过多且矛盾，而非缺失。 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> Evidence shows that two versions of "The House of Representatives," one authored by Hamilton and another authored by Madison, appeared in different New York newspapers.
错误。原文并未提及存在两版文章分别由不同作者撰写，且两版文章同时出现的情况。此选项内容属于【无中生有】。

**B 选项** ❌
> The evidence that would indisputably prove that either Hamilton or Madison was the sole author of "The House of Representatives" has been lost.
错误。原文明确指出难以确定作者的原因不是证据缺失，而是证据过多且互相矛盾，因此此选项属于【方向相反】。

**C 选项** ✅
> Support can be found for a strong case that either Hamilton or Madison was the sole author of “The House of Representatives.”
正确。原文说“not from a lack of evidence but from too much contradictory evidence”，即有大量证据支持两种可能，符合选项表达。

**D 选项** ❌
> It is most likely that "The House of Representatives" was the product of a collaborative effort between Hamilton and Madison.
错误。原文只提到作者可能是汉密尔顿或麦迪逊之一，并未提及合作写作，属于【过度推断】。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于把握句中转折词“not...but...”的逻辑关系，准确理解作者强调“作者难以确定不是因为证据缺失，而是因为证据过多且相互矛盾”，从而排除强调证据缺失的选项B和无中生有的选项A，正确选项C准确反映了这一点。选项D则因无文本依据而被排除。理解转折和因果关系是解题的关键。

---

article: The Hawaiian archipelago is home to the kiwikiu (Pseudonestor xanthophrys), one of several bird species that can only be found on the islands. Due to Hawaii's uniquely varied geographic and ecological conditions, the kiwikiu became highly specialized as it adapted to survive in a specific island habitat. However, like many highly specialized species, the kiwikiu is particularly vulnerable to environmental stressors, such as disease, invasive species, and habitat destruction, that disrupt the delicately balanced ecosystems in which the birds live.
stem: Based on the text, why is the kiwikiu a highly specialized species?

options.content: It lives exclusively in the most geographically isolated locations on the Hawaiian archipelago.
It adapted over time to live in a specific habitat found on the Hawaiian archipelago.
It adapted over time to share a habitat with other highly specialized bird species on the Hawaiian archipelago.
It lives in a habitat that is exposed to numerous environmental stressors.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

这是细节理解题，核心任务是根据文章内容准确理解“kiwikiu为何高度专业化”的原因。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> The Hawaiian archipelago is home to the kiwikiu (Pseudonestor xanthophrys), one of several bird species that can only be found on the islands.

👉 介绍背景，说明kiwikiu是夏威夷群岛特有的鸟类。

**第2句：**
> Due to Hawaii's uniquely varied geographic and ecological conditions, the kiwikiu became highly specialized as it adapted to survive in a specific island habitat.

👉 解释原因，说明kiwikiu高度专业化是因为适应了特定的岛屿栖息地。

**第3句：**
> However, like many highly specialized species, the kiwikiu is particularly vulnerable to environmental stressors, such as disease, invasive species, and habitat destruction, that disrupt the delicately balanced ecosystems in which the birds live.

👉 转折，指出高度专业化导致脆弱性，列举环境压力因素。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容逻辑功能                              |
|:---------|:---------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍kiwikiu及其独特的地理分布            |
| 第二句   | 解释kiwikiu高度专业化的原因              |
| 第三句   | 转折，说明专业化带来的脆弱性及环境威胁    |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> It lives exclusively in the most geographically isolated locations on the Hawaiian archipelago.

错误，文章只说kiwikiu是夏威夷特有种，没有提到“最地理隔离的地点”，属于【无中生有】。

**B 选项** ✅
> It adapted over time to live in a specific habitat found on the Hawaiian archipelago.

正确，直接对应第2句“kiwikiu became highly specialized as it adapted to survive in a specific island habitat”。

**C 选项** ❌
> It adapted over time to share a habitat with other highly specialized bird species on the Hawaiian archipelago.

错误，文章未提及kiwikiu与其他高度专业化鸟类共享栖息地，属于【无中生有】。

**D 选项** ❌
> It lives in a habitat that is exposed to numerous environmental stressors.

错误，虽然第3句提到环境压力，但这是专业化带来的脆弱性，不是专业化的原因，属于【方向相反】。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关注因果关系词“Due to”明确指出kiwikiu高度专业化的原因是“适应特定栖息地”，排除与“环境压力”或“地理隔离”无直接因果关系的选项，锁定强调“适应特定栖息地”的B选项。

article: Philosophers note that many people have an intuitive sense that while we ought not to lie, there may be circumstances in which lying is permissible. If this intuition is correct and we lack an inviolable duty to speak truthfully, what grounds opposition to lying in the first place? Japa Pallikkathayil has advanced one answer by appealing to a duty to respect others' agential interests: the possession of false beliefs constrains agency, and thus we ought not to impede the formation of true beliefs unless doing so prevents a greater constraint on someone's agency or an otherwise impermissible end.
stem: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?

options.content: Pallikkathayil's argument suggests that if we have a duty to respect other people's agential interests and if possession of false beliefs constrains agency, then we have an inviolable duty to speak truthfully.

Pallikkathayil's argument shows that if our intuition that circumstances may make lying permissible is correct, then it is unclear whether there are any grounds for an opposition to lying in the first place.

One potential means of justifying opposition to lying is Pallikkathayil's argument that we have an obligation to respect other people's agency that entails a commitment to truthfulness except in certain circumstances.

Many people have an intuitive sense that lying is permissible in some circumstances but lack a principled way to identify those circumstances, and Pallikkathayil's argument may provide a means of resolving that problem.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

主旨大意题，核心任务是准确把握文章的中心论点和作者的主要观点。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Philosophers note that many people have an intuitive sense that while we ought not to lie, there may be circumstances in which lying is permissible.

👉 介绍背景观点：许多人直觉上认为虽然不应撒谎，但某些情况下撒谎是可以接受的。

**第2句：**
> If this intuition is correct and we lack an inviolable duty to speak truthfully, what grounds opposition to lying in the first place?

👉 提出问题：如果不存在绝对的说真话义务，那么反对撒谎的理由是什么？

**第3句：**
> Japa Pallikkathayil has advanced one answer by appealing to a duty to respect others' agential interests:

👉 引出解决方案：Pallikkathayil提出基于尊重他人“能动性利益”的义务作为答案。

**第4句：**
> the possession of false beliefs constrains agency, and thus we ought not to impede the formation of true beliefs unless doing so prevents a greater constraint on someone's agency or an otherwise impermissible end.

👉 解释Pallikkathayil观点细节：错误信念限制能动性，因此不应阻碍真信念的形成，除非这样做能防止更大的能动性受限或不当结果。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                               |
|:---------|:--------------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍普遍直觉：撒谎通常不可，但某些情况下可接受       |
| 第二句   | 提出问题：若无绝对说真话义务，反对撒谎的依据何在？   |
| 第三句   | 引出Pallikkathayil的答案：尊重他人能动性义务          |
| 第四句   | 详细说明该义务：避免错误信念限制能动性，除非更大代价 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> Pallikkathayil's argument suggests that if we have a duty to respect other people's agential interests and if possession of false beliefs constrains agency, then we have an inviolable duty to speak truthfully.

错误原因：原文明确指出“we lack an inviolable duty to speak truthfully”（第二句），因此“有不可侵犯的说真话义务”是错误的推断。
错误类型：【方向相反】

**B 选项** ❌
> Pallikkathayil's argument shows that if our intuition that circumstances may make lying permissible is correct, then it is unclear whether there are any grounds for an opposition to lying in the first place.

错误原因：文中Pallikkathayil正是提出了“反对撒谎的依据”（尊重能动性义务），而非“不明确是否有反对理由”。
错误类型：【方向相反】

**C 选项** ✅
> One potential means of justifying opposition to lying is Pallikkathayil's argument that we have an obligation to respect other people's agency that entails a commitment to truthfulness except in certain circumstances.

正确原因：准确概括了文章主旨，即Pallikkathayil通过尊重他人能动性义务来为反对撒谎提供理由，但允许在特定情境下例外。

**D 选项** ❌
> Many people have an intuitive sense that lying is permissible in some circumstances but lack a principled way to identify those circumstances, and Pallikkathayil's argument may provide a means of resolving that problem.

错误原因：文章未提及人们缺乏“识别何时撒谎可接受的原则性方法”，也未表明Pallikkathayil解决了这一问题，属于扩展推断。
错误类型：【过度推断】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题重点是抓住文章提出的问题（是否有反对撒谎的理由）和Pallikkathayil的解决方案（尊重能动性义务），注意原文否定了“绝对说真话义务”，因此选项中涉及“绝对义务”或“反对理由不存在”的选项应排除；同时关注转折词“unless”，明确Pallikkathayil允许例外，锁定C选项。

article:
The following text is from George Eliot's 1857 short story “The Sad Fortunes of the Rev. Amos Barton." The Countess Czerlaski is a newcomer to the town of Milby.

 It is true, the countess was a little vain, a little ambitious, a little selfish, a little shallow and frivolous, a little given to white lies, --- But who considers such slight blemishes, such moral pimples as these, disqualifications for entering into the most respectable society! Indeed, the severest ladies in Milby would have been perfectly aware that these characteristics would have created no wide distinction between the Countess Czerlaski and themselves: and since it was clear there was a wide distinction --- why it must lie in the possession of some vices from which they were undeniably free.
stem: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?

options.content: The residents of Milby had initially viewed the Countess Czerlaski with suspicion, but they have gradually come to see her as mostly harmless.
Although the Countess Czerlaski actively cultivates a sense of mystery about her, her background is less interesting than what many residents of Milby have been led to believe.
Although the residents of Milby are generally thought to be hospitable, the Countess Czerlaski has committed many social blunders that have caused her to be widely disliked.
Some residents of Milby are determined to disapprove of the Countess Czerlaski, even though the reasons for their dislike are largely groundless.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

主旨大意题，核心任务是准确把握文章中心思想，判断哪一选项最恰当地总结了作者对人物及其社会关系的整体看法。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> It is true, the countess was a little vain, a little ambitious, a little selfish, a little shallow and frivolous, a little given to white lies, ---

👉 描述伯爵夫人的性格缺点，提出她有多种小瑕疵。

**第2句：**
> But who considers such slight blemishes, such moral pimples as these, disqualifications for entering into the most respectable society!

👉 转折，表明这些小缺点并不足以让她被排除在上流社会之外。

**第3句：**
> Indeed, the severest ladies in Milby would have been perfectly aware that these characteristics would have created no wide distinction between the Countess Czerlaski and themselves:

👉 进一步强调，即使是最严格的米尔比女士们也不会因为这些小缺点认为伯爵夫人有明显差别。

**第4句：**
> and since it was clear there was a wide distinction --- why it must lie in the possession of some vices from which they were undeniably free.

👉 因为确实存在明显差别，这差别必然源于伯爵夫人有些她们没有的恶习。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 列举伯爵夫人的一些小缺点 |
| 第二句 | 转折，这些小缺点不足以使她被排斥 |
| 第三句 | 米尔比最严厉的女士们也认同这些小缺点无异于自身缺点 |
| 第四句 | 真正造成差别的是她有别的恶习，这些恶习让她被排斥 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> The residents of Milby had initially viewed the Countess Czerlaski with suspicion, but they have gradually come to see her as mostly harmless.

选项暗示居民起初怀疑伯爵夫人，后来觉得她无害，文中无“起初怀疑”或“逐渐接受”的信息，属于【无中生有】。

**B 选项** ❌
> Although the Countess Czerlaski actively cultivates a sense of mystery about her, her background is less interesting than what many residents of Milby have been led to believe.

文中未提及伯爵夫人刻意制造神秘感，也无关于背景是否有趣的内容，完全无关，属于【无中生有】。

**C 选项** ❌
> Although the residents of Milby are generally thought to be hospitable, the Countess Czerlaski has committed many social blunders that have caused her to be widely disliked.

文中无提及伯爵夫人犯下“许多社交失误”，也无暗示米尔比居民“普遍好客”，此选项与文意不符，属于【无中生有】。

**D 选项** ✅
> Some residents of Milby are determined to disapprove of the Countess Czerlaski, even though the reasons for their dislike are largely groundless.

选项准确反映文意：虽然伯爵夫人有轻微缺点，但米尔比部分女士仍固执地不喜欢她，这种不喜欢基于非实质理由。符合文中“她们认为真正区别是她有她们没有的恶习”的暗示。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于捕捉转折词“But”和“since”，理解作者先承认伯爵夫人的小缺点，但强调这些不足以导致排斥，真正的排斥源于“some vices”，暗示不喜欢的理由缺乏充分依据，从而排除过度或无关选项，选出体现“无理反感”的D选项。

---

article: Biologist Abbigail Merrill and colleagues conducted a study of how butterfly color and weather conditions relate to butterfly behavior, which wouldn't have been possible without data gathered by students and other amateur science enthusiasts in the community. Considering over three years' worth of data, the researchers found that orange butterflies were observed in the evening more often than any other butterflies, and that butterflies tended to prefer orange and red flowers on cloudy days and multicolor flowers on partly cloudy days.
stem: According to the text, which factors seemed to be linked to the behavior of butterflies in Abbigail Merrill and colleagues' study?

options.content: Butterfly color but not weather conditions
Weather conditions but not butterfly color
Neither butterfly color nor weather conditions
Both butterfly color and weather conditions

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

本题为细节理解题，核心任务是准确抓住所给文章中关于“蝴蝶行为受哪些因素影响”的具体信息。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Biologist Abbigail Merrill and colleagues conducted a study of how butterfly color and weather conditions relate to butterfly behavior, which wouldn't have been possible without data gathered by students and other amateur science enthusiasts in the community.

👉 介绍研究主题和研究数据来源。

**第2句：**
> Considering over three years' worth of data, the researchers found that orange butterflies were observed in the evening more often than any other butterflies, and that butterflies tended to prefer orange and red flowers on cloudy days and multicolor flowers on partly cloudy days.

👉 报告研究发现：蝴蝶颜色和天气条件均与蝴蝶行为相关。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                             |
|:---------|:--------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍研究内容和数据来源           |
| 第二句   | 研究发现：蝴蝶颜色和天气影响行为 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> Butterfly color but not weather conditions

错误，文章明确指出天气条件（cloudy days, partly cloudy days）与蝴蝶行为相关，排除天气条件错误。【以偏概全】

**B 选项** ❌
> Weather conditions but not butterfly color

错误，文章中orange butterflies在晚上出现频率最高，表明蝴蝶颜色也影响行为。【以偏概全】

**C 选项** ❌
> Neither butterfly color nor weather conditions

错误，文章明确指出两者都与蝴蝶行为有关，排除两者都无关的选项。【无中生有】

**D 选项** ✅
> Both butterfly color and weather conditions

正确，符合文章“butterfly color and weather conditions relate to butterfly behavior”的直接表述。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题重点关注文章中描述的关系词汇，如“relate to”、“found that”等，明确指出“butterfly color”和“weather conditions”均影响蝴蝶行为，借助转折词“and”连接两个因素，锁定答案为同时包含两者的选项，排除只包含单一因素或否定两者的选项。

article: From petroleum refining to fuel for residential heating, hydrogen has many applications. Currently, producing hydrogen is carbon intensive, but Alexandra M. Oliveira is one of many scholars investigating the feasibility of large-scale production of hydrogen through electrolysis, a process that emits no carbon when renewable energy is used. Oliveira suggests that although some obstacles may prevent electrolytic hydrogen from dominating energy systems, there is utility in its ability to decarbonize the petroleum and heating industries, where reducing carbon emissions is especially challenging.
stem: Which statement about the use of hydrogen in the petroleum and heating industries is most strongly supported by the text?

options.content: The adoption of electrolytic hydrogen by these industries has been impeded by concerns about how carbon intensive its production is.
Development of applications for electrolytic hydrogen is less advanced in these industries than it is in most other carbon-intensive industries.
At least some of electrolytic hydrogen’s potential to lessen these industries’ carbon emissions is as yet unrealized.
The fact that large-scale electrolytic hydrogen production is not yet available has limited these industries’ interest in pursuing hydrogen-based applications.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

这是细节理解题，核心任务是根据文章内容判断关于氢气在石油和供暖行业应用的正确陈述。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> From petroleum refining to fuel for residential heating, hydrogen has many applications.

👉 介绍氢气在多个领域的应用范围。

**第2句：**
> Currently, producing hydrogen is carbon intensive, but Alexandra M. Oliveira is one of many scholars investigating the feasibility of large-scale production of hydrogen through electrolysis, a process that emits no carbon when renewable energy is used.

👉 说明目前制氢碳排放高，但电解水制氢作为无碳排放的潜在技术正在被研究。

**第3句：**
> Oliveira suggests that although some obstacles may prevent electrolytic hydrogen from dominating energy systems, there is utility in its ability to decarbonize the petroleum and heating industries, where reducing carbon emissions is especially challenging.

👉 表明电解氢虽然面临障碍，但在难以减碳的石油和供暖行业具有减碳价值。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                             |
|:---------|:------------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍氢气在石油精炼和住宅供暖等多个领域的应用。   |
| 第二句   | 说明当前制氢碳排放高，但电解制氢作为无碳选项正在研究。 |
| 第三句   | 强调电解氢虽有障碍，但在难减碳的石油和供暖行业有减碳用途。 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> The adoption of electrolytic hydrogen by these industries has been impeded by concerns about how carbon intensive its production is.

错误原因：文章说“producing hydrogen is carbon intensive”是当前情况，但电解制氢是在用可再生能源时无碳排放，且并未说明这些行业因碳排放顾虑阻碍采用电解氢。【过度推断】

**B 选项** ❌
> Development of applications for electrolytic hydrogen is less advanced in these industries than it is in most other carbon-intensive industries.

错误原因：文中未提及电解氢在石油和供暖行业的发展程度与其他行业的比较，属于无根据的推断。【无中生有】

**C 选项** ✅
> At least some of electrolytic hydrogen’s potential to lessen these industries’ carbon emissions is as yet unrealized.

正确原因：文中说“some obstacles may prevent electrolytic hydrogen from dominating energy systems”暗示潜力尚未完全实现，且强调其在难减碳行业的减碳效用，支持该选项。

**D 选项** ❌
> The fact that large-scale electrolytic hydrogen production is not yet available has limited these industries’ interest in pursuing hydrogen-based applications.

错误原因：文中未提及这些行业兴趣受限，且只是说学者们在研究可行性，没有提到行业兴趣或意愿受限。【无中生有】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关注关键词“obstacles may prevent... dominating”、“utility in its ability to decarbonize”提示电解氢潜力尚未完全发挥；排除选项时注意文章未提及行业态度或发展程度的内容，避免无根据推断。关键词“currently carbon intensive”指现状，但“when renewable energy is used”提示电解氢能无碳排放，避免错误理解。

article:
The following text is from Ralph Waldo Emerson's 1841 essay "The Method of Nature."

The scholars are the priests of that thought which establishes the foundations of the earth. No matter what is their special work or profession, they stand for the spiritual interest of the world, and it is a common calamity if they neglect their post in a country where the material interest is so predominant as it is in America.
stem: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?

options.content: The habit of intellectuals of privileging ideas over material things invariably leads to tragedy.
Scholars have played an important role in society for a much longer time than have those people who are mainly concerned with financial gain.
In a country whose citizens are largely preoccupied with tangible gains, it is crucial that some people work to foster and preserve ideas.
Those Americans who have some military experience will be the ones most likely to have a thorough understanding of the world.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

这是主旨大意题，核心任务是准确把握文章的中心思想，即作者通过论述学者的重要性，强调在物质利益占主导的社会中精神文化的维护必要性。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> The scholars are the priests of that thought which establishes the foundations of the earth.

👉 说明学者的身份和作用，将学者比作“思想的祭司”，强调其思想对世界基础的奠定作用。

**第2句：**
> No matter what is their special work or profession, they stand for the spiritual interest of the world,

## 题目类型说明

本题为“推理理解题”，核心任务是根据文章内容推断概率模型与因果决定论之间的关系，判断哪项最符合文本的暗示。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Probabilistic models generate predictions based on outcomes of analogous past events, but even as these models project likely outcomes, they implicitly acknowledge that lower-frequency events may occur instead.

👉 说明概率模型基于过去类似事件预测结果，同时承认低频事件也可能发生（提出观点 + 解释原因）。

**第2句：**
> Because they accommodate multiple potential outcomes, such models may seem incompatible with causal determinism — the view that particular outcomes are inevitable given certain preconditions.

👉 解释概率模型因为容纳多种可能结果，看似与因果决定论（认为结果必然）不兼容（因果推论 + 转折）。

**第3句：**
> But complete foreknowledge of relevant conditions is generally unavailable, suggesting that a state of uncertainty ultimately prevails in which outcomes can be predicted but not definitively foretold.

👉 指出由于无法完全预知条件，现实中存在不确定性，结果可预测但不可确定（解释原因 + 因果推论）。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容逻辑功能 |
|:---------|:-------------|
| 第一句 | 说明概率模型基于过去事件预测且承认低频事件可能发生（提出观点 + 解释） |
| 第二句 | 说明概率模型因多种可能结果似乎与因果决定论冲突（因果推论 + 转折） |
| 第三句 | 说明因无法完全预知，现实存在不确定性，结果可预测非必然（解释原因 + 因果推论） |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅（正确）
> The predictive use of probabilistic models can be reconciled with acceptance of causal determinism because causal determinism does not necessarily entail the existence of absolute certainty.

选项正确，因为文章最后一句明确指出“complete foreknowledge ... is generally unavailable”，从而导致不确定性，即使因果决定论存在，绝对确定性并不必然成立，概率模型的预测和因果决定论可以调和。

**B 选项** ❌（错误）【方向相反】
> The predictive use of probabilistic models represents a rejection of causal determinism because such models associate a single event with multiple potential outcomes.

文章说“may seem incompatible”，但并未断言概率模型拒绝因果决定论，且最终指出两者可调和，故此选项断言拒绝因果决定论过于绝对，方向错误。

**C 选项** ❌（错误）【过度推断】
> Probabilistic models reflect the influence of causal determinism because their predictions of future outcomes are informed by concrete information about past events.

文中虽说基于过去事件，但并未表明概率模型“反映因果决定论的影响”，这属于过度推断。

**D 选项** ❌（错误）【无中生有】
> Probabilistic models can be understood as compatible with causal determinism only when their predictions of future events overwhelmingly favor one potential outcome.

文章未提“only when overwhelmingly favor one outcome”的条件，此为无中生有。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关注转折词“but”“may seem”以及因果连接词“because”“suggesting”，锁定文章主旨是概率模型表面上似乎与因果决定论冲突，但因“complete foreknowledge is unavailable”，不确定性存在，故二者可调和；排除绝对断言或添加无文中依据条件的选项。

## 题目类型说明

主旨大意题，核心任务是准确把握文章的中心思想，找出最全面且准确表达文章主旨的选项。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Why do some people with high incomes vote for politicians supporting higher taxes on those with high incomes like themselves?

👉 提出问题，导入主题：为何高收入者会支持对高收入者征税？

**第2句：**
> Economists Benjamin Enke et al. propose that values are a luxury good: that is, the higher one's income, the more weight one has the liberty to assign to one's values when voting.

👉 提出理论观点，解释原因：经济学家认为价值观是一种“奢侈品”，收入越高，越有自由根据价值观投票。

**第3句：**
> Thus, Enke et al. suggest that although the behavior of high-income earners who advocate for higher taxes may seem counterintuitive, such people likely do so because they feel enabled by their economic security to take a stance they think is morally correct.

👉 因果推论，总结观点：尽管看似矛盾，高收入者支持高税是因为经济安全使他们能根据道德价值观投票。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 提出问题：为何高收入者支持对高收入者加税？ |
| 第二句 | 解释原因：价值观作为“奢侈品”，高收入者更能基于价值观投票。 |
| 第三句 | 结论：高收入者因经济安全被赋能，基于道德价值观支持高税。 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> According to a team of economists, the higher a voter's income, the more likely that voter's values are to conflict with their material interests.

错误原因：文章未提及“价值观与物质利益冲突”的可能性，只说高收入者更能根据价值观投票，没有提到价值观和利益必然冲突。【无中生有】

**B 选项** ❌
> According to a group of economists, politicians who support higher taxes on those with high incomes must convince a sufficient number of people with such incomes to vote against their material interest if the politicians are to be elected.

错误原因：文章没有讨论政治家如何说服选民，也未涉及选举策略，仅聚焦于高收入者为何支持高税的心理机制。【无中生有】

**C 选项** ✅
> A group of economists asserts that people with relatively high incomes are consequently enabled to take certain considerations into account when voting.

正确原因：准确表达了文章核心观点，即高收入者因经济安全被赋能，能基于价值观等考虑投票，符合“values are a luxury good”的理论。

**D 选项** ❌
> A team of economists finds that people who vote for higher taxes on those with high incomes are likely to think their moral values coincide with their material interests.

错误原因：文章并未说高收入者认为道德价值与物质利益一致，反而暗示他们可能违背物质利益而基于道德选择投票。【方向相反】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于把握“values are a luxury good”这一核心理论，理解高收入者因经济安全“被赋能”而能基于价值观投票。题干问主旨，需关注全文中心思想而非细节。选项中带有“冲突”、“说服政治策略”等内容均为无中生有，排除时需紧盯文章对高收入者行为的解释和因果关系。转折词“Thus”提示总结因果关系，定位正确答案。

## 题目类型说明

主旨大意题，核心任务是准确把握文章的中心论点，找出最能概括全文主旨的选项。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> In their meta-analysis of research on advergames (video games developed to promote products or services), Zeph M.C. van Berlo et al. confirm that such games, though they can elicit player interest, may not facilitate subsequent recall of product and brand information.

👉 介绍研究发现：广告游戏能吸引兴趣，但不利于品牌信息的记忆。

**第2句：**
> This phenomenon can be explained by the finite nature of cognitive capacity as it is articulated in Annie Lang's limited capacity model of motivated mediated message processing.

👉 提出解释框架：有限认知资源模型解释上述现象。

**第3句：**
> In this case, players' cognitive resources are directed foremost toward the advergame's mechanics, leaving little or no capacity for encoding and storing the information the advertiser intends to be salient.

👉 具体说明原因：玩家认知资源主要用于游戏机制，导致难以记忆广告信息。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                                         |
|:---------|:-------------------------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍van Berlo等的元分析结果：广告游戏吸引兴趣但不促进记忆       |
| 第二句   | 说明用Lang的有限认知资源模型来解释这一现象                     |
| 第三句   | 具体解释认知资源分配导致广告信息难以被编码和储存                 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅（正确）
> The limited capacity model of motivated mediated message processing developed by Lang provides a means of explaining the finding by van Berlo et al. that players may not readily recollect the brand and product information embedded in advergames.

准确概括文章主旨，指出Lang模型解释了van Berlo等发现的广告游戏难以记忆品牌信息的现象，符合原文：“This phenomenon can be explained by... Lang's limited capacity model”。

**B 选项** ❌（错误）
> The meta-analysis by van Berlo et al. reveals that higher engagement in advergame mechanics is linked to lower effectiveness in persuading players to purchase particular brands and products.

原文只提及记忆（recall）困难，没有提及说服力或购买行为，属于【过度推断】。

**C 选项** ❌（错误）
> Although the limited capacity model of motivated mediated message processing developed by Lang suggests otherwise, advergames can succeed as marketing tools, provided that they achieve a balance between game mechanics and the promotion of a brand or product.

文章无任何暗示或论述广告游戏可以成功，也未提及“平衡机制”，与原文观点不符，属【无中生有】。

**D 选项** ❌（错误）
> Research by van Berlo et al. corroborates Lang's conclusion that because people predominantly focus on game mechanics when playing video games, it is difficult for advergames to communicate brand and product information in ways that are highly memorable.

“corroborates Lang's conclusion”表述过强，文章说Lang模型“explains”现象，而非van Berlo研究“证实”Lang结论，存在【偷换概念】。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题抓住核心概念“limited capacity model”和“van Berlo et al.的研究发现”之间的逻辑关系，关注关键词“explain”、“recall”等；排除错误选项时注意文章未涉及的购买行为、成功可能性等信息，避免【过度推断】和【无中生有】。选项中“provides a means of explaining”精确对应文章表述，是答案锁定点。

错误原因：文中并未提及声音操控象征音乐对听众“自我感”的影响，原文强调的是对“数字技术介入人类体验”的反思。【无中生有】

**B 选项** ❌

**D 选项** ✅

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于定位文末总结句“invites the listener to reflect”，这是对声音操控意义的直接阐释，说明其“评论当代社会状况”的功能。选项中只有D准确对应“commentary”和“contemporary social conditions”，其他选项均未在文中找到支持，因而排除。注意识别原文中的因果关系词（如“by”引导的结果），锁定答案。

## 核心解题技巧

article: Optimal foraging theory (OFT) holds that animals' foraging behaviors reflect cost-benefit trade-offs that vary by species and with dynamic ecological circumstances. One such circumstance is lunar intensity, which Joel Brown and colleagues found to be negatively associated with foraging by Arizona pocket mice but Patricia C. Wright found to be positively associated with foraging by three-striped night monkeys. This discrepancy is explicable in terms of OFT: the monkeys' greater reliance on vision means that higher lunar intensity benefits them more than it benefits the mice.
stem: Which choice best describes the finding made by Wright, as presented in the text?

options.content: During periods of high lunar intensity, three-striped night monkeys increase their reliance on vision.
As lunar intensity increases, Arizona pocket mice reduce their foraging activity.
As lunar intensity increases, three-striped night monkeys increase their foraging activity.
Increased lunar intensity is more beneficial for three-striped night monkeys than it is for Arizona pocket mice.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

本题为细节理解题，核心任务是准确理解文中关于Wright研究发现的具体描述。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Optimal foraging theory (OFT) holds that animals' foraging behaviors reflect cost-benefit trade-offs that vary by species and with dynamic ecological circumstances.

👉 介绍理论基础，提出观点：动物觅食行为受物种和生态环境变化的成本收益权衡影响。

**第2句：**
> One such circumstance is lunar intensity, which Joel Brown and colleagues found to be negatively associated with foraging by Arizona pocket mice but Patricia C. Wright found to be positively associated with foraging by three-striped night monkeys.

👉 具体举例，说明月光强度对两种动物觅食行为的不同影响。

**第3句：**
> This discrepancy is explicable in terms of OFT: the monkeys' greater reliance on vision means that higher lunar intensity benefits them more than it benefits the mice.

👉 解释原因，说明差异源于视觉依赖度不同导致月光强度带来的益处差异。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                                                                  |
|:---------|:-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍OFT理论，指出觅食行为受物种和生态环境成本收益权衡影响。                           |
| 第二句   | 举例说明月光强度对两种动物觅食行为的不同影响：对老鼠负相关，对猴子正相关。             |
| 第三句   | 解释差异原因：猴子对视觉依赖更大，月光强度提升对它们更有利。                         |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> During periods of high lunar intensity, three-striped night monkeys increase their reliance on vision.

错误，文中说的是猴子“greater reliance on vision”是解释原因，没说“increase their reliance”，是固定的依赖度而非变化。
错误类型：【无中生有】

**B 选项** ❌
> As lunar intensity increases, Arizona pocket mice reduce their foraging activity.

虽然此句正确反映了布朗研究结果，但题目问的是Wright的发现，不是布朗的。
错误类型：【题干针对性错误】

**C 选项** ✅
> As lunar intensity increases, three-striped night monkeys increase their foraging activity.

准确反映Wright发现：“positively associated with foraging by three-striped night monkeys”即月光强度增加时猴子觅食增加。

**D 选项** ❌
> Increased lunar intensity is more beneficial for three-striped night monkeys than it is for Arizona pocket mice.

文中确实提到“higher lunar intensity benefits them more”，但这不是Wright的直接“发现”，而是对两者差异的解释，题目问“best describes the finding made by Wright”，此选项是推论而非直接发现。
错误类型：【过度推断】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 细节题核心在于明确题干限定“Wright的发现”，锁定关键词“positively associated with foraging by three-striped night monkeys”，排除涉及其他研究者或推论的选项；注意区分“发现”与“解释”之间的逻辑关系，避免无中生有或过度推断。

But Drelichman and Voth’s unique contribution to the field is their reconstruction of the earliest extant set of annual fiscal records for any sovereign state, demonstrating in turn that Philip’s defaults were caused by short-term cash shortages, not long-term unsustainable debts.
stem: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?

Drelichman and Voth advanced the field of research on European early modern state finance by assembling a novel collection of evidence that gave them insight into Philip II’s debt defaults.
The research by Drelichman and Voth suggests that the logistics of ruling both Spain and much of Belgium led to short-term problems with cash that forced Philip II to default on his debts.
Drelichman and Voth’s research on Philip II’s debt defaults builds on earlier work by Hoffman and Norberg, adding nuance to the earlier work’s findings.

## 题目类型说明

主旨大意题，核心任务是总结文章的中心观点，准确概括文章的主要内容和作者的独特贡献。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Mauricio Drelichman and Hans-Joachim Voth’s research into the debt defaults of Philip II (who ruled an empire including Spain and much of Belgium from 1556 to 1598) relates to other work on European early modern state finance, including Hoffman and Norberg’s research on the relationship between state finance and political development.

👉 介绍研究主题及其与已有研究的关联，说明Drelichman和Voth的研究属于欧洲早期现代国家财政领域，并且与Hoffman和Norberg的研究相关。

**第2句：**
> But Drelichman and Voth’s unique contribution to the field is their reconstruction of the earliest extant set of annual fiscal records for any sovereign state, demonstrating in turn that Philip’s defaults were caused by short-term cash shortages, not long-term unsustainable debts.

👉 转折，强调Drelichman和Voth的独特贡献，即重建了最早的年度财政记录，并通过这一证据指出菲利普二世债务违约的真正原因。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                             |
|:---------|:--------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍Drelichman和Voth的研究主题及其与其他研究的关系 |
| 第二句   | 突出Drelichman和Voth的独特贡献和研究结论         |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌【无中生有】
> Analysis of the earliest available records of a sovereign state’s finances can be found not in the work of Hoffman and Norberg but in that of Drelichman and Voth.

错误在于原文并未说Hoffman和Norberg没有分析最早的财政记录，只是说Drelichman和Voth重建了最早的年度财政记录，且选项错误对比了两者的工作，文章只是提到两者研究相关，没有否定Hoffman和Norberg的工作。

**B 选项** ✅（正确）
> Drelichman and Voth advanced the field of research on European early modern state finance by assembling a novel collection of evidence that gave them insight into Philip II’s debt defaults.

正确。选项准确反映了第二句的核心内容：Drelichman和Voth通过重建最早的财政记录，推动了早期现代国家财政研究，并解释了菲利普二世债务违约的原因。

**C 选项** ❌【过度推断】
> The research by Drelichman and Voth suggests that the logistics of ruling both Spain and much of Belgium led to short-term problems with cash that forced Philip II to default on his debts.

错误在于文章并未提及“logistics of ruling”是导致现金短缺的原因，这是选项对原因的过度推断，原文仅指出短期现金短缺，而非统治过程中的后勤问题。

**D 选项** ❌【方向相反】
> Drelichman and Voth’s research on Philip II’s debt defaults builds on earlier work by Hoffman and Norberg, adding nuance to the earlier work’s findings.

错误在于文章未明确说明Drelichman和Voth是在“补充”或“细化”Hoffman和Norberg的发现，只说研究“related to”而非“builds on”，选项夸大了两者研究的关系。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于抓住转折词“But”，明确作者突出的是Drelichman和Voth的“unique contribution”，即他们通过重建最早的财政记录，带来了新的见解。题干问主旨，故需综合全文找出核心内容，排除选项中未被文中证实的内容（如选项C的过度推断和A、D的错误归因）。关注因果逻辑（债务违约原因）和独特贡献，是锁定正确答案的关键。

## 题目类型说明

这是一道细节理解题，核心任务是根据文中关于Mohol bushbabies对月光强度反应的描述，判断哪项陈述最符合文中信息。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Optimal foraging theory (OFT) holds that animals’ foraging behaviors reflect cost-benefit trade-offs that vary by species and with dynamic ecological circumstances.

👉 提出观点：介绍OFT理论，强调动物觅食行为是基于不同物种和生态环境的成本收益权衡。

**第2句：**
> One such circumstance is lunar intensity, which Mary V. Price and colleagues found to be negatively associated with foraging by white-throated woodrats but Simon Kenneth Bearder and colleagues found to be positively associated with foraging by Mohol bushbabies.

👉 举例说明：指出月光强度作为生态环境因素，对两种动物觅食行为影响不同，白喉鼠觅食随月光强度减少，Mohol bushbabies觅食随月光强度增加。

**第3句：**
> This discrepancy is explicable in terms of OFT: the bushbabies’ greater reliance on vision means that higher lunar intensity benefits them more than it benefits the woodrats.

👉 解释原因：差异可用OFT解释，Mohol bushbabies因更依赖视觉，月光强度增加带来的好处超过白喉鼠。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                                         |
|:---------|:-------------------------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍OFT理论，动物觅食行为基于物种和环境的成本收益权衡         |
| 第二句   | 举例月光强度对两种动物觅食行为的不同影响                     |
| 第三句   | 解释差异原因：Mohol bushbabies依赖视觉，月光强度增加对其更有利 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> If increased lunar intensity imposed the same costs on the bushbabies that it imposes on white-throated woodrats, there would be no association between lunar intensity and the bushbabies' foraging.

错误原因：文中没有说明两者成本相同的假设，也未提及成本相同时觅食行为无关联，属于【过度推断】。

**B 选项** ❌
> If the advantages that the bushbabies gain from increased lunar intensity explain the change in their foraging behavior, those advantages are likely shared by some other species that are not heavily reliant on vision.

错误原因：文中强调优势来自对视觉的依赖，其他不依赖视觉的物种不大可能共享此优势，属于【方向相反】。

**C 选项** ✅
> If increased lunar intensity creates any disadvantages for the bushbabies, those disadvantages are more than compensated for by the advantages that the bushbabies gain.

正确原因：文中提到“higher lunar intensity benefits them more”，意味着即使存在劣势，优势更大，完全支持该选项。

**D 选项** ❌
> If the bushbabies’ foraging behavior under increased lunar intensity actually reflects a cost-benefit trade-off, their behavior should be more similar to that of white-throated woodrats than it is.

错误原因：文中已解释两者因视觉依赖不同，权衡不同，行为不同是合理的，不应更相似，属于【方向相反】。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关键词“benefits them more”直接说明Mohol bushbabies从月光强度中获益多于白喉鼠，锁定优势大于劣势，排除成本假设相同（A）、优势共享（B）及行为应相似（D）等选项，确认C选项为正确答案。抓住“discrepancy is explicable”及“greater reliance on vision”是理解题意的关键。

The following text is from Ralph Waldo Emerson's 1841 essay "The Method of Nature."
The rapid wealth which hundreds of the community acquire in trade, or by the incessant expansions of our population and arts, enchants the eyes of all the rest; the luck of one is the hope of thousands, and the bribe acts like the neighborhood of a gold mine to impoverish the farm, the school, the church, the house, and the very body and feature of man.
stem: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?

options.content: Those who wish to accumulate wealth can do so more quickly by engaging in trade than in other activities such as teaching and farming.
Participating in a variety of activities is important for one's physical health.
When a few people in a society become rich, the rest of the society will benefit in turn, given enough time.
Observing the success of a few people can lead many to abandon important parts of their lives in the pursuit of similar success.
