---

## 题目类型说明

这是逻辑补全题，核心任务是根据上下文逻辑，选择最合理、最贴切的句子完成段落，准确反映作者观点。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Although Grant Tavinor concludes that computer games are art by virtue of their forming a subcategory of fiction, and Berys Gaut similarly places them within the realm of cinema,

👉 转折句，提出前人观点，但暗示后文会有不同看法。

**第2句：**
> neither approach adequately captures a central aspect of playing these games: when the player no longer attends to the narrative and is instead simply absorbed in the instrumentalities of gameplay.

👉 反驳前人观点，指出两种观点未能涵盖游戏的核心体验（玩家沉浸于游戏机制而非叙事）。

**第3句：**
> This is among the reasons philosopher C. Thi Nguyen contends that the work of computer-game designers is in what he calls the medium of player agency, which the designer prescribes through rules and goals, and which elicits positive aesthetic experiences in the player who agrees to adopt it.

👉 说明Nguyen的观点：游戏设计师通过“玩家能动性”这一媒介，设计规则和目标，带来美学体验。

**第4句：**
> Therefore, Nguyen’s position is that Tavinor’s and Gaut’s frameworks _____

👉 总结Nguyen对前述两种框架的评价，需补全句子，说明两框架的不足。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 提出Tavinor和Gaut关于游戏归类为艺术的观点（分别是虚构和电影） |
| 第二句 | 反驳这两种观点，指出它们忽视了玩家沉浸于游戏机制的体验 |
| 第三句 | 介绍Nguyen的观点，强调“玩家能动性”是游戏设计的核心媒介 |
| 第四句 | 需要补全，表达Nguyen对前两框架的评价和态度 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> are helpful starting points for studying computer games as art, even though these frameworks are overly simplistic.

错误原因：文中Nguyen强调的是两框架“未能充分捕捉核心方面”，而非“仅过于简单”，且“helpful starting points”语气太正面，原文语境偏向批评。
错误类型：【偷换概念】

**B 选项** ❌
> are useful for analyzing the narrative aspects of computer games, even if neither attempts to address player agency.

错误原因：文章未提及这两种框架“对叙事方面有用”，而且Nguyen批评的是“未涵盖玩家能动性”，未必意味着对叙事有用。
错误类型：【过度推断】

**C 选项** ❌
> overstate the influence of fiction and cinema on the narrative elements of computer games.

错误原因：Nguyen批评的是忽视玩家能动性，不是“过度强调虚构和电影对叙事的影响”，且文中未提“过度强调”表述。
错误类型：【无中生有】

**D 选项** ✅
> subsume computer games under other categories of media that do not address a feature of games that is integral to player enjoyment.

正确原因：符合文意，Nguyen认为两框架将游戏归类于虚构或电影，忽视了“玩家能动性”这一关键特征，且此特征对玩家的享受至关重要。
原文支持：“neither approach adequately captures a central aspect...”，“Nguyen contends... medium of player agency... elicits positive aesthetic experiences”。

## 核心解题技巧

**第1句：**

👉 解释实验设计，指出野外土壤湿度的变化可能影响植物化学成分，因而在可控环境中控制变量，单独施加不同微生物群落，测量芥菜中关键的风味物质。

**第4句（未给出，题目要求补全）**

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> demonstrate that differences in plants' flavor chemistry result from differences in the level of glucosinolates regardless of the soil moisture.

错误，文章并未说明“无视土壤湿度”的影响，反而提到土壤湿度是一个变量且可能影响植物化学；实验是在控制环境中单独操控微生物群落，未排除土壤湿度的影响，也未说明“无视”土壤湿度。
错误类型：【方向相反】

**B 选项** ❌
> re-create the conditions of studies conducted in the wild that found links between soil microbial communities and levels of butenyl in mustard plants.

错误，文章提到“控制环境”中引入不同微生物群落，是为了解释变量，而非简单复现野外条件；且野外条件中土壤湿度不一，本实验目的是分离影响因素，而非复刻。
错误类型：【过度推断】

**C 选项** ❌
> disentangle the influence of microbial communities on soil moisture from their influence on glucosinolate content in the plants.

错误，文中并未说微生物群落影响土壤湿度，反而是“土壤湿度影响植物化学”，实验是在控制环境中种植，土壤湿度被控制，目的是分离土壤湿度和微生物群落对植物化学的影响。
错误类型：【偷换概念】

**D 选项** ✅
> distinguish variations in glucosinolates due to differences in microbial communities from those that in a natural setting may be due to differences in soil moisture.

正确，符合实验设计目的——在控制环境下单独操纵微生物群落，以区分自然环境中因土壤湿度不同导致的植物化学差异和因微生物群落不同导致的差异。
原文依据：“Recognizing that soil moisture varies by location in the wild and could influence plants' chemistry, Walsh et al. introduced distinct microbial communities to individually potted mustard plants (Brassica juncea) growing in a controlled environment…”说明实验目的即为区分两种影响因素。

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> The National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA) requires US federal agencies to assess environmental effects of potential actions, such as building highways.

👉 介绍NEPA法案要求联邦机构评估潜在行动对环境的影响，提出背景。

**第2句：**
> While many NEPA reviews require public comment, categorical exclusions (CEs) allow quick reviews with no public comment for actions that will minimally affect the environment.

👉 说明CEs作为快速审查程序的功能，针对对环境影响极小的行动无需公众评论。

**第3句：**
> In 2020 the rule governing CEs was revised: before, CEs could be granted for actions that "do not individually or cumulatively have a significant effect on the human environment," but the revised rule allowed CEs if actions "normally do not have a significant effect on the human environment."

👉 说明2020年CE规则的修订，旧规则要求单独或累计不产生重大影响，修订后改为“通常不产生重大影响”。

**第4句：**
> Environmentalists found this revision to be potentially detrimental because ______

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 介绍NEPA法案要求评估环境影响。 |
| 第二句 | 说明CEs允许对影响极小的行动快速审查，无需公众评论。 |
| 第三句 | 介绍2020年CE规则修订，标准从“不产生重大影响”变为“通常不产生重大影响”。 |
| 第四句 | 引出环境保护人士对修订的负面看法，需补全原因。 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> the increasing need to build new highways and rehabilitate older highways in the US incentivizes agencies to grant CEs after 2020 for reasons that would not have been considered valid prior to 2020.

错误在于选项强调“增加建高速公路需求”导致机构更倾向于授予CE，但文章未提及需求变化，且焦点是规则宽松带来的环境风险，不是激励机制。【无中生有】

**B 选项** ❌
> the 2020 relaxation of the rule regarding CEs would permit more exclusions, resulting in more reviews of actions by federal agencies and a paradoxically slower review process.

错误在于规则宽松应导致更少审查而非更多审查，文中CE是快速审查，放宽规则应减少审查而非增加，结论与文意相反。【方向相反】

**C 选项** ❌
> the rule that governed CEs before 2020 allowed expedited reviews of actions that might have significant effects on the environment if those effects were believed to be rare, while the 2020 revision of the rule subjected such actions to slower reviews.

错误在于选项内容与文章信息相反，文章说明2020年规则是放宽（允许更多CE），不是加严导致更慢审查。【方向相反】

**D 选项** ✅
> the 2020 revision of the rule governing CEs would allow expedited reviews of actions that had a minimal environmental effect when considered on their own but a significant effect when considered together.

正确。文章第三句明确对比了“individually or cumulatively”与“normally”，修订后去掉了“cumulatively”，可能导致单独影响小但累计影响大的行为也被快速审查，环境保护者担心累计影响被忽视，符合“potentially detrimental”的逻辑。

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关注关键词“individually or cumulatively”和“normally”的区别，理解修订规则放宽了累计影响的限制，从而引出环境保护人士担忧累计影响被忽视的逻辑。排除选项时注意规则放宽与审查速度的关系，避免与文意相悖的推断。

## 题目类型说明

本题为逻辑补全题，核心任务是根据文章论述的逻辑，选择最合理、最符合作者观点的句子来完成文段。

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> In the world's democracies, proportionally few elected representatives are young adults.

👉 介绍现象：年轻人作为当选代表的比例较低。

**第2句：**
> While some philosophers argue that certain types of underrepresentation (of women, for example) are unfair in principle and should be remediated via quotas, there is broad agreement that youth underrepresentation is not inherently unfair since it is universal (all people are underrepresented when young), temporary (underrepresented young people become overrepresented older people), and reflective of a legitimate concern (lack of relevant experience).

👉 对比观点：指出女性等群体的代表性不足被认为不公平，而青年代表性不足则被普遍认为不不公平，理由是普遍性、暂时性和合理性。

**第3句：**
> Accordingly, when philosopher Juliana Uhuru Bidadanure advocates for youth quotas for elected representatives, she does so on the basis of their instrumental value for promoting youth interests, arguing that _____

👉 引出哲学家主张青年配额的原因是其工具价值，即促进青年利益，接下来需补充其具体论点。

|:---------|:------------------------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 说明年轻人在民主国家代表中比例偏低的现象                   |
| 第二句   | 对比不同群体代表性不足的公平性观点，说明青年代表性不足被认为不是本质上的不公平 |
| 第三句   | 引出哲学家支持青年配额的理由是促进青年利益，等待补充具体论点 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> young adults may lack certain kinds of experience but those experiences are not relevant to the question of whether youth underrepresentation is fair in principle.

错误原因：文章第二句明确指出“lack of relevant experience”是青年代表性不足被认为公平的一个合理原因，选项否认其相关性，违背文章观点。
错误类型：【方向相反】

**B 选项** ❌
> age-related quotas would alleviate the inherently unfair overrepresentation of older people that tends to occur in the world's democracies.

错误原因：文章明确说青年代表性不足“不是本质上的不公平”，且没有说老年人过度代表是“不公平”的问题，选项错误地将老年人过度代表定性为“不公平”。
错误类型：【无中生有】

**C 选项** ✅
> youth underrepresentation may be fair in principle but leads to worse outcomes for young adults than could be achieved with more proportionate youth representation.

正确原因：选项符合文章逻辑，承认青年代表不足“在原则上可能公平”，但强调其“工具价值”，即代表性不足会导致青年利益受损，支持哲学家主张配额的理由。与“instrumental value for promoting youth interests”相呼应。

**D 选项** ❌
> it does not matter that youth underrepresentation is universal, temporary, and reflective of a legitimate concern since it is inherently unfair.

错误原因：文章明确反驳青年代表性不足是“不公平”的观点，强调其普遍性、暂时性和合理性，选项主张“青年代表性不足本质上不公平”，与文章核心观点矛盾。
错误类型：【方向相反】

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于理解第二句对青年代表性不足公平性的论述（普遍、暂时、合理）以及哲学家主张配额的理由（“instrumental value”即促进青年利益）。选项需承认青年代表不足原则上不不公平，但强调其实用价值带来的正面影响，从而锁定C选项，排除否认合理性或强调不公平性的选项。

## 题目类型说明

逻辑补全题，核心任务是根据文章设计细节推断研究排除了哪些可能性，从而合理补全结尾内容。

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Interested in how the color of dogs’ irises affects human responses to dogs, Akitsugu Konno et al. showed images of 12 dogs’ faces to human participants and asked them to rate the dogs’ kindness and trustworthiness as well as the likelihood that they would interact with or keep the dogs.

👉 介绍研究目的和实验设计：研究者通过展示狗的脸部照片让人类评价狗的特征和互动意愿。

**第2句：**
> The researchers had previously adjusted the images so that each dog was presented in two versions, one with light irises and one with dark irises.

👉 说明实验控制变量的方法：每只狗有两种虹膜颜色版本的照片。

**第3句：**
> They distributed the images such that no participant saw both the light and dark versions of the same dog.

👉 说明实验设计避免对比效应的措施：每个参与者只看一种虹膜颜色版本。

**第4句：**
> Konno et al. found that participants responded more positively to the latter.

👉 报告实验结果：参与者对深色虹膜狗的反应更积极。

**第5句：**
> The study’s design allowed the researchers to exclude the possibility that the results ______

👉 提出结论转折，强调设计排除某种干扰因素，后文需补全排除的可能性。

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                  |
|:---------|:-------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍研究目的和实验方法               |
| 第二句   | 说明每只狗两种虹膜颜色版本的图片     |
| 第三句   | 说明每个参与者只看一种虹膜颜色版本   |
| 第四句   | 实验结果：深色虹膜狗反应更积极       |
| 第五句   | 设计排除某种可能性，需补全文本       |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌【无中生有】
> may have been different if participants had been able to see the dogs’ irises in person instead of only seeing images that included the dogs’ irises.

文章未涉及“现实中看到狗虹膜与图片中看到的区别”，设计也未排除现实与图片的差异，选项引入了文中未提及的新因素，属于无中生有。

**B 选项** ✅（正确）
> reflected a preference on the part of participants for facial features that happened to coincide with dark irises in the dogs depicted in the images.

文章提到每只狗的图片被调整成两种虹膜颜色版本，且参与者未看见同一狗的两种版本，说明设计排除了“偏好其他脸部特征而非虹膜颜色”的可能性，完全符合文意。

**C 选项** ❌【方向相反】
> were a function of participants emphasizing the colors of the dogs’ irises over the dogs’ kindness and trustworthiness when reacting to the images.

文中指出参与者评价了“kindness and trustworthiness”以及虹膜颜色影响，设计目的是考察虹膜颜色影响，不是排除虹膜颜色影响，选项方向错误。

**D 选项** ❌【过度推断】
> could be explained by participants having preexisting positive feelings about dogs with dark irises or preexisting negative feelings about dogs with light irises.

文中未提及参与者的先入为主情感，且设计通过图片分配避免了此类偏见，选项推断过度。

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题核心在于理解实验设计如何通过“每只狗两种虹膜版本”及“每个参与者只看一种版本”控制变量，从而排除脸部其他特征影响，锁定选项B。注意“排除可能性”常对应设计细节，选项中涉及未提及的新因素要警惕“无中生有”或“过度推断”。关键词包括“study’s design allowed… exclude”，提示答案需紧扣设计排除的干扰因素。

## 文章逻辑拆解

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**

👉 提出假设：中世纪城镇由于强层级社会结构的限制，社会网络和经济整合受限，可能导致密度-规模关系不同。

**第3句：**
> They found that the typically expected density-size relationship held for each of the 173 medieval settlements whose growth they analyzed, suggesting that _______

|:---------|:-----|

| 第二句 | 提出假设：中世纪城镇因强层级社会结构，密度-规模关系可能不同。 |
| 第三句 | 研究发现中世纪城镇仍表现出典型的密度-规模关系，暗示后续结论。 |

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> the social and economic dynamics that affect urban agglomeration were likely much different in medieval settlements than in modern cities, despite the similarity across time in population density patterns.

错误原因：文章结论是中世纪城镇和现代城市在人口密度与规模关系上表现一致，A选项说“社会经济动态很不同”，与文章“density-size relationship held”相矛盾，属于【方向相反】。

**B 选项** ❌

错误原因：文章未提及“限制人口密度增长速率”，只是说关系成立，B选项过度推断了“限制增长速率”，为【过度推断】。

**C 选项** ✅
> despite a change in the role of social structures over time, there is likely a notable consistency between medieval settlements and modern cities in underlying elements of the social and economic interactions among individuals that shape the development of core urban areas.

正确原因：符合文章逻辑，尽管社会结构作用不同，但密度-规模关系一致，说明社经互动的基本要素存在显著一致性。

**D 选项** ❌
> the constraining influence of hierarchical medieval institutions likely had a significant effect on individuals in some social groupings but little to no effect on members of other social groupings.

## 核心解题技巧

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> To combat predation by the big brown bat and other insectivorous bats, many moth species, including *Xylophanes tersa*, emit ultrasonic pulses that, in some cases, disrupt the echolocation bats rely on for foraging.

👉 说明背景和主题：介绍蛾类通过发出超声波脉冲来对抗以大棕蝠为代表的捕食者，这些超声波能干扰蝙蝠的回声定位。

**第2句：**
> Some scientists have hypothesized that this capability evolved because it imposes a lower metabolic cost than does the alternative mechanism of producing chemicals that render moths noxious to bats.

👉 提出假设：科学家推测这种超声波能力进化的原因是其代谢成本低于产生有毒化学物质的方式。

**第3句：**
> Pablo Sebastián Padrón et al. investigated the acoustic properties of moths' ultrasonic responses to audio of bat echolocation and then assessed the palatability of the ultrasound-producing moths.

👉 介绍研究：研究者分析了蛾类超声波反应的声学特性，并评估了这些蛾类的可食性。

**第4句：**
> They found that several moth genera that emit ultrasonic pulses capable of disrupting bat echolocation are unpalatable to bats, suggesting that ______

👉 结果及逻辑暗示：发现多种能发出干扰蝙蝠回声定位超声波的蛾类对蝙蝠来说不可口，由此暗示某种结论。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                     |
|:---------|:----------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 蛾类通过发超声波干扰蝙蝠回声定位以抵御捕食 |
| 第二句   | 科学家假设超声波能力进化因代谢成本低于产生有毒物质 |
| 第三句   | 研究者测试蛾类超声波反应及其对蝙蝠的可食性       |
| 第四句   | 发现多种发超声波的蛾类对蝙蝠不可口，暗示新的结论   |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅（正确）
> the hypothesis about the development of this ultrasonic defense likely does not account for all instances of the trait in moths.

本选项指出该假设（低代谢成本假设）可能无法解释所有蛾类超声波防御的情况，符合原文“多种发超声波的蛾类不可口”，表明存在其他防御机制，合理扩展了研究结果。与原文“several moth genera... are unpalatable”相符，暗示单一假设不足以涵盖所有情况。

**B 选项** ❌（错误）【过度推断】
> further investigations into moths' ability to protect themselves by disrupting bat echolocation will likely find that moth genera relying on this mechanism are also generally inedible to bats.

此选项推断未来研究将发现所有依赖超声波机制的蛾类通常不可食，属于过度推断。原文仅说“several moth genera”，未表明所有或大多数蛾类均如此，故此推断范围过大。

**C 选项** ❌（错误）【无中生有】
> most genera of moths that produce ultrasound capable of disrupting bat echolocation do so primarily for purposes other than evading capture by the big brown bat and other predators.

选项声称大多数发超声波的蛾类主要不是为了躲避捕食者，原文无此暗示，且文章整体主题是防御捕食者，故此选项无事实根据，属于无中生有。

**D 选项** ❌（错误）【偷换概念】
> although previous findings about *Xylophanes tersa* are consistent with the hypothesis about the low metabolic cost of producing noxious chemicals, the ability to disrupt bat echolocation and unpalatability are not mutually exclusive traits.

选项试图说两种防御机制不排斥，虽有一定合理性，但原文重点在“假设可能不适用所有蛾类”，而非强调两者共存，且“previous findings”与“this ultrasonic defense”混淆，偷换了假设对象，逻辑关系不严密。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于捕捉文章最后一句的暗示信号：“several moth genera... are unpalatable”，提示原假设无法解释所有案例，因而逻辑补全要选择表达“假设不涵盖所有情况”的选项。注意“several”（几个）与“most”（大多数）或“all”（所有）区别，排除范围过大选项。抓住因果推论和范围限定词是解题关键。

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> The Uto-Aztecan language family is divided into a northern branch, which includes the Shoshone language of present-day Idaho and Utah, and a southern one, whose best-known representative is Nahuatl, the language of the Aztec Empire in Mexico.

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> northern Uto-Aztecan tribes likely obtained the crop directly from a southern Uto-Aztecan tribe rather than from a non-Uto-Aztecan tribe.
错误在于文中强调两支系的玉米词汇不共享，说明北方部族未必直接从南方部族获得玉米词汇，且考古证据只说明玉米向北传播，不支持“直接从南方部族获得玉米”的细节。【过度推断】

**B 选项** ❌

文中未提及词汇差异与种植方法相关，仅指出两支系词汇不共享，且该选项讨论的是“每个分支内的词汇变异”，与题干“北南支系词汇不共享”信息不符。【无中生有】

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题核心在于抓住转折词“However”引出的玉米词汇不共享这一关键信息，结合考古证据“maize originated in Mexico and diffused northward”推断时间顺序；理解题干逻辑需要确认“语言分支形成”与“玉米传播”之间的先后关系，从而排除涉及时间或来源错误推断的选项，最终选出时间顺序合理的D选项。

article: In classical Greek and Roman mythology, female characters are typically cast as either villains lacking in psychological depth or passive victims who are marginal to these stories which usually focus on the exploits of male characters. Recently, a subgenre has emerged in which writers reimagine these stories from the perspectives of their female characters, giving them agency and complex motivations. Purists argue that such efforts represent a distinctively modern tendency to impose our own values on past civilizations, obscuring those civilizations' beliefs. Defenders of the subgenre counter that reimaginings of the myths for new cultural contexts are almost as old as the myths themselves, suggesting that ______
stem: Which choice most logically completes the text?

options.content: bringing female perspectives to the forefront is not indicative of a novel attitude regarding fidelity to Greek and Roman myths' ideologies.
purists are overlooking a long tradition of adapting Greek and Roman myths to focus on female characters.
the complex motivations given to female characters in modern retellings of Greek and Roman myths reflect a recent shift toward psychological depth in fictional representation.
modern writers foregrounding of female characters is chiefly motivated by a desire to counterbalance the primacy of male perspectives among earlier adaptations of Greek and Roman myths.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

本题为逻辑补全题，核心任务是根据上下文逻辑，选择最合理、最连贯地完成段落论述的选项。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> In classical Greek and Roman mythology, female characters are typically cast as either villains lacking in psychological depth or passive victims who are marginal to these stories which usually focus on the exploits of male characters.

👉 介绍古希腊罗马神话中女性角色的传统形象及故事关注点。

**第2句：**
> Recently, a subgenre has emerged in which writers reimagine these stories from the perspectives of their female characters, giving them agency and complex motivations.

👉 描述近来出现的新次类型，强调从女性视角重写故事，赋予女性角色主动性和复杂动机。

**第3句：**
> Purists argue that such efforts represent a distinctively modern tendency to impose our own values on past civilizations, obscuring those civilizations' beliefs.

👉 介绍传统主义者的观点，认为这是现代人将自身价值观强加于古代文化。

**第4句：**
> Defenders of the subgenre counter that reimaginings of the myths for new cultural contexts are almost as old as the myths themselves, suggesting that ______

👉 引出支持者的反驳，指出神话重写的历史悠久，暗示接下来应说明这种重写并非现代独有。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                                         |
|:---------|:-------------------------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍古希腊罗马神话中女性角色的传统刻画及故事关注点             |
| 第二句   | 描述新兴子类型，强调女性视角和角色复杂性                       |
| 第三句   | 传统主义者批评该现象是现代价值观的强加                         |
| 第四句   | 支持者反驳，指出神话重写历史悠久，暗示该现象非现代独有         |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅（正确）
> bringing female perspectives to the forefront is not indicative of a novel attitude regarding fidelity to Greek and Roman myths' ideologies.

此选项强调“将女性视角置于前台并非对古希腊罗马神话信奉的全新态度”，符合支持者观点“重写神话由来已久”，与原文“reimaginings… are almost as old as the myths themselves”直接呼应，逻辑严密。

**B 选项** ❌（错误）
> purists are overlooking a long tradition of adapting Greek and Roman myths to focus on female characters.

此选项暗示传统主义者忽视了长期存在的女性聚焦改编，文中无此指控，且重点在于重写神话的历史而非纯粹“女性聚焦”，属于【过度推断】。

**C 选项** ❌（错误）
> the complex motivations given to female characters in modern retellings of Greek and Roman myths reflect a recent shift toward psychological depth in fictional representation.

此选项强调“女性复杂动机是近期心理深度转变的体现”，与文中反驳传统主义者观点不符，且文中支持者指出重写历史悠久，故属于【方向相反】。

**D 选项** ❌（错误）
> modern writers foregrounding of female characters is chiefly motivated by a desire to counterbalance the primacy of male perspectives among earlier adaptations of Greek and Roman myths.

此选项强调现代写作者动机是“平衡男性视角”，文中并未提及动机，仅讨论重写历史，属于【无中生有】。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在捕捉转折信号词“counter”和“suggesting”，支持者提出“重写神话历史悠久”，故答案需呼应“这不是现代独有现象”；选项需紧扣“历史悠久”这一因果逻辑，排除强调现代动机或批评传统主义者的选项。锁定含义最贴合原文逻辑的A选项即可。

article: David Mitchell's 2006 novel Black Swan Green contains elements drawn from Mitchell's own life—there are many parallels between the experiences of the novel's protagonist, Jason Taylor, and those of Mitchell—and as a result Black Swan Green is regularly described as an autobiographical novel. This characterization can be useful, but it also presents drawbacks in terms of how the work is perceived, given the high value placed on creativity and imagination in artistic endeavors. Readers who take this characterization to mean that Mitchell merely fictionalized actual events may conclude that _____.
stem: Which choice most logically completes the text?

options.content: Black Swan Green is not as worthy of praise as it might have been if it had no basis in fact.
critics disagree about whether Black Swan Green shows greater originality than works without autobiographical elements.
the real-world counterparts of other characters in Black Swan Green are hard to identify.
Mitchell should not have claimed that Black Swan Green is based on real events.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

这是逻辑补全题，核心任务是根据文章前后逻辑，选择一个合理且符合文章论述方向的句子来完成段落。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> David Mitchell's 2006 novel *Black Swan Green* contains elements drawn from Mitchell's own life—there are many parallels between the experiences of the novel's protagonist, Jason Taylor, and those of Mitchell—

👉 说明小说与作者生活经历有许多相似之处，提出小说含有自传元素的观点。

**第2句：**
> and as a result *Black Swan Green* is regularly described as an autobiographical novel.

👉 说明由于上述相似性，小说常被称为自传体小说，承接第1句，进一步解释。

**第3句：**
> This characterization can be useful, but it also presents drawbacks in terms of how the work is perceived, given the high value placed on creativity and imagination in artistic endeavors.

👉 转折，指出虽然将小说归为自传体有用，但会有负面影响，特别是艺术作品中创造力与想象力被高度重视。

**第4句：**
> Readers who take this characterization to mean that Mitchell merely fictionalized actual events may conclude that _____.

👉 因果推论，指出若读者认为小说只是对真实事件的简单虚构，可能会得出某种结论，空白处需填补合理结论。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 介绍小说与作者生活经历的相似性，提出含自传元素的观点。 |
| 第二句 | 说明因此小说常被称为自传体小说。 |
| 第三句 | 转折，指出这种分类既有用也有缺点，特别是影响作品的艺术评价。 |
| 第四句 | 推论，若读者认为小说只是对真实事件的简单虚构，可能会得出某种负面结论。 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅
> *Black Swan Green* is not as worthy of praise as it might have been if it had no basis in fact.

此选项准确反映了第3句和第4句的逻辑，即由于“创造力和想象力”被高度重视，若读者认为小说只是简单虚构真实事件，可能认为小说“没有那么值得称赞”。这与“presents drawbacks in terms of how the work is perceived”高度契合，符合因果推论。

**B 选项** ❌【无中生有】
> critics disagree about whether *Black Swan Green* shows greater originality than works without autobiographical elements.

文章未提及评论家对原创性的争议，且题干讨论的是读者对自传体分类的看法及影响，B选项内容无依据。

**C 选项** ❌【无中生有】
> the real-world counterparts of other characters in *Black Swan Green* are hard to identify.

文章未涉及其他角色与现实人物的对应关系，且此内容与“作品被看作自传体的影响”无关，属于无中生有。

**D 选项** ❌【过度推断】
> Mitchell should not have claimed that *Black Swan Green* is based on real events.

文章未表达作者不应声明小说基于真实事件的观点，只是讨论读者可能产生的评价影响，D选项为过度推断。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于识别转折词“but”引出的负面影响，以及因果关系提示“may conclude that”后需填入合理的读者结论。文章强调艺术价值中“创造力和想象力”的重要性，排除无关或超范围选项，锁定反映读者可能贬低作品价值的选项A。

## 题目类型说明

这是逻辑补全题，核心任务是根据文章实验描述和结果，选择最合适、最合理的结论来完整文章论述。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Subsequent to simulating an attack to elicit defense responses in three caterpillar species, ecologists placed a treatment group of those individuals in an enclosure where they were exposed to slight, harmless ambient electric field shifts like those created by common predatory wasps in flight.

👉 介绍实验设计：模拟攻击后，将毛虫暴露于类似捕食者飞行产生的微弱电场变化中。

**第2句：**
> When exposed to the treatment, cinnabar moth caterpillars and scarce vapourer moth caterpillars remained coiled in a defensive position for an average of 71 seconds and 87 seconds, respectively, whereas European peacock butterfly caterpillars continued to flail defensively for 20 seconds.

👉 报告实验观察结果：不同毛虫种类对电场刺激的防御行为持续时间不同。

**第3句：**
> Meanwhile, in a control group, all individuals (from all three species) resumed neutral behavior in less than one-tenth of a second after the simulated attack.

👉 对照组表现：无电场刺激时，所有毛虫很快恢复中性行为。

**第4句：**
> These results suggest that _____

👉 结论引导句，要求根据上述实验结果推断合理结论。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                             |
|:---------|:--------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍实验设计和处理组的电场刺激   |
| 第二句   | 描述三种毛虫对电场刺激的防御持续时间 |
| 第三句   | 对照组无电场刺激时行为快速恢复   |
| 第四句   | 引导结论句，要求补全合理推断     |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅（正确）
> some species of caterpillars are able to detect potential threats via changes in ambient electric fields.

选项符合文章实验结果：不同毛虫种类在接触模拟的电场变化时表现出明显的防御行为，说明它们能通过电场变化感知潜在威胁，且对照组无此反应支持此结论。

**B 选项** ❌（错误）
> caterpillar species with the sensory acuity to detect small changes in ambient electric fields may also be able to cause shifts in those fields.

文中无任何信息提及毛虫能主动引起电场变化，属于【无中生有】。

**C 选项** ❌（错误）
> in some caterpillar species, the type and duration of defensive responses to electric field shifts varies based on the size of the shifts.

文中只说明不同种类防御持续时间不同，但未提及防御差异与电场“大小”有关，属于【过度推断】。

**D 选项** ❌（错误）
> European peacock butterfly caterpillars are more sensitive to changes in ambient electric fields than are cinnabar moth caterpillars or scarce vapourer caterpillars.

文中欧洲孔雀蝶毛虫防御时间最短（20秒），而其他两种更长，敏感度不应理解为防御持续时间短，属于【方向相反】。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于理清实验设计与结果的因果关系，注意对照组快速恢复行为排除非感知因素；选项中需紧扣“防御行为”与“电场变化”的关联，排除无中生有或未提及的信息，尤其关注因果词和对比词，如“when exposed”、“meanwhile”等，帮助锁定感知威胁的结论。

article: Like many other genera of wild bees, bumblebees have in recent decades experienced population collapse caused by, among other factors, habitat destruction and climate variation. Bumblebees are also one of the most researched bee genera, second only to honeybees. As a result, ecologists have gained much of their insight about wild-bee declines from bumblebees. In a 2021 paper, zoologist Guillaume Ghisbain notes that bumblebees are among the relatively few wild-bee genera that display social behaviors and dietary generalism (ability to obtain nectar and pollen from a diversity of plant species), two traits that are associated with increased resilience to some specific environmental changes. Ghisbain therefore contends that_____
stem: Which choice most logically completes the text?

options.content: because bumblebees and other bees with generalist diets are less negatively affected by environmental stress than bees with specialized diets are, they are less likely to experience major population changes in the future than bees with specialized diets are.

although bumblebees have been more extensively studied than most wild bees, researchers should not use bumblebees to draw conclusions about the decline of other wild bees, even ones with feeding patterns and levels of sociability that are similar to those of bumblebees.

although bumblebees and many other wild bees have experienced similar population declines in the past, compared with other wild bees, bumblebees are likely at greater risk of being harmed by climate variation than by habitat destruction.

because the responses of bumblebees and other wild bees to environmental threats are not always comparable, researchers need to exercise caution when extrapolating information about wild-bee population declines from bumblebees.

## 题目类型说明

这是逻辑补全题，核心任务是根据前文信息判断哪种结论最合理地衔接和总结全文内容。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Like many other genera of wild bees, bumblebees have in recent decades experienced population collapse caused by, among other factors, habitat destruction and climate variation.
👉 说明背景事实：大黄蜂和其他野生蜜蜂一样，近几十年数量锐减，原因包括栖息地破坏和气候变化。

**第2句：**
> Bumblebees are also one of the most researched bee genera, second only to honeybees.
👉 说明研究现状：大黄蜂是研究较多的蜜蜂属，仅次于蜜蜂。

**第3句：**
> As a result, ecologists have gained much of their insight about wild-bee declines from bumblebees.
👉 因果关系：因此生态学家很多关于野生蜜蜂数量减少的认识来自大黄蜂研究。

**第4句：**
> In a 2021 paper, zoologist Guillaume Ghisbain notes that bumblebees are among the relatively few wild-bee genera that display social behaviors and dietary generalism (ability to obtain nectar and pollen from a diversity of plant species), two traits that are associated with increased resilience to some specific environmental changes.
👉 介绍专家观点：大黄蜂具备社会性和饮食广泛性，这两者与对环境变化的韧性增强相关。

**第5句（未完句）：**
> Ghisbain therefore contends that_____
👉 引出结论，要求选择最合逻辑的结论。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                             |
|:---------|:--------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 大黄蜂和其他野生蜜蜂都经历了数量锐减，原因有栖息地破坏和气候变化。 |
| 第二句   | 大黄蜂是研究较多的野生蜜蜂属。       |
| 第三句   | 生态学家关于野生蜜蜂数量减少的认识主要来自大黄蜂研究。 |
| 第四句   | 大黄蜂具有社会性和饮食广泛性，这两种特质增强其对环境变化的韧性。 |
| 第五句   | 引出结论，需补全Ghisbain的观点。     |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌【方向相反】
> because bumblebees and other bees with generalist diets are less negatively affected by environmental stress than bees with specialized diets are, they are less likely to experience major population changes in the future than bees with specialized diets are.
错误原因：原文提到大黄蜂具备韧性，但并未断言它们未来“更不可能经历重大种群变化”，而且题干强调的是“研究者从大黄蜂得知野生蜜蜂减少的情况”，并无预测未来趋势的论述，属于过度推断和方向相反。

**B 选项** ❌【无中生有】
> although bumblebees have been more extensively studied than most wild bees, researchers should not use bumblebees to draw conclusions about the decline of other wild bees, even ones with feeding patterns and levels of sociability that are similar to those of bumblebees.
错误原因：原文无否定用大黄蜂研究推断其他蜜蜂的说法，反而说明生态学家“从大黄蜂得出许多见解”，故B选项无依据，属于无中生有。

**C 选项** ❌【无中生有】
> although bumblebees and many other wild bees have experienced similar population declines in the past, compared with other wild bees, bumblebees are likely at greater risk of being harmed by climate variation than by habitat destruction.
错误原因：文中未提及大黄蜂受气候变化影响大于栖息地破坏的风险，属于无中生有。

**D 选项** ✅
> because the responses of bumblebees and other wild bees to environmental threats are not always comparable, researchers need to exercise caution when extrapolating information about wild-bee population declines from bumblebees.
正确原因：原文提到大黄蜂具有特殊的社会性和饮食广泛性，这意味着它们对环境变化的反应可能与其他野生蜜蜂不同，故研究者推断其他蜜蜂时需谨慎，符合文意逻辑。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于理解Ghisbain指出的大黄蜂的特殊性（社会性和饮食广泛性）如何影响其对环境变化的反应，从而推断研究者在利用大黄蜂研究结果类推其他蜜蜂时应保持谨慎。题干中“therefore”提示推断结论，选项中需体现“不同反应”和“谨慎推断”两层含义，排除无关或无中生有选项，锁定D。

## 题目类型说明

完形填空题（逻辑补全题），核心任务是根据文章对沉积物特征的描述，推断出最符合沉积环境的合理结论。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Data collected by the Mars rover *Curiosity* at the Gale Crater's Murray Formation are suggestive of hydrological deposition of sediment in the distant past.

👉 介绍背景和研究对象，提出“水文沉积”的可能性。

**第2句：**
> To characterize the nature of the depositional environment, Frances Rivera-Hernández et al. analyzed the grain size of Murray Formation sediment, finding that although there are intervals of coarse grains, most of the sediment consists of fine grains that show signs of cracking due to episodic desiccation.

👉 说明研究方法（粒度分析）及主要发现：存在粗颗粒和大多数细颗粒，细颗粒显示周期性干涸迹象。

**第3句：**
> Rivera-Hernández et al. concluded that the coarse grains are sandstone, which tends to be deposited by flowing water, whereas the fine grains are mudstone, which is slowly deposited by settling out of suspension in low-flow water, leading the researchers to posit that _____

👉 解释粗细颗粒对应的沉积环境（流动水沉积砂岩 vs 低流速沉积泥岩），并引出结论空白部分。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 提出研究对象和水文沉积的可能性。 |
| 第二句 | 介绍研究方法和发现：粗颗粒与细颗粒分布及干涸迹象。 |
| 第三句 | 解释沉积物类型与对应沉积环境，准备总结结论。 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅（正确）
> a lake existed at the Murray Formation for a prolonged period, though the lake occasionally experienced drying and there were periods in which one or more streams were present.

正确。文章指出细颗粒泥岩由低流速水沉积，且有周期性干涸的迹象，说明存在长期的湖泊（低流速水环境）并偶尔干涸；粗颗粒砂岩由流水沉积，表明有流动水（如溪流）存在。选项A完全符合文章描述。

错误。文章表明湖泊存在时间较长（“most of the sediment consists of fine grains”说明长期沉积），而不是短暂存在；且没有说溪流先于湖泊存在。

错误。文章明确提到细颗粒有“episodic desiccation”（周期性干涸）迹象，说明湖泊也经历了干涸，而非“湖泊未干涸”。

错误。文章明确有湖泊沉积（细颗粒泥岩），说明湖泊确实形成了，排除“未形成湖泊”的说法。

## 题目类型说明

这是一道逻辑补全题，核心任务是根据前文论述内容，选择最合逻辑、最贴切的句子完成文章论点。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> From November 1980 to February 1981, oil prices rose 45%, creating what economists term an oil shock.

👉 引入背景事实，提出“oil shock”的定义和实例。

**第2句：**
> Although oil shocks have occurred multiple times since 1945, a broadly applicable description of how oil shocks affect economies at the national level has proved elusive, a problem typically attributed to the fact that oil shocks' effects are substantially conditioned on country-specific characteristics (oil import-export ratios, most importantly).

👉 说明问题：虽然油价冲击多次发生，但通用的描述难以达成，通常归因于国家特征（尤其是进出口比）的差异。

**第3句：**
> Recently, however, Gbadebo Oladosu et al. showed that economists' estimates of national economies' responsiveness to oil shocks are highly heterogeneous even within a given country and time frame—ranging by more than a factor of five in the case of the United States during a recent oil shock, for instance—suggesting that _____

👉 提出新发现：即使在同一国家、同一时期，经济学家对油价冲击反应的估计也差异巨大，暗示了某种新的解释。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容逻辑功能 |
|:---------|:-------------|
| 第一句 | 引入油价上涨实例，定义“oil shock” |
| 第二句 | 说明研究难点及传统归因（国家特征差异） |
| 第三句 | 新发现：单一国家内部估计差异大，提出需要新的解释 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌【方向相反】
> controlling for variations in countries' oil import-export ratios may have obscured inconsistencies in economists' findings about the effects of oil shocks at national levels.

错误原因：文章中第二句已将国家特征（尤其是进出口比）视作解释难点，第三句新发现是在同一国家内部也存在巨大差异，这说明进出口比控制并未完全解释差异，A选项却暗示控制进出口比反而掩盖了不一致，与文意相反。

**B 选项** ❌【无中生有】
> economists' conventional measures of national economic activity may be insufficiently sensitive to the effects of oil shocks.

错误原因：文中并未提及经济活动指标的敏感性问题，B选项引入了文章未涉及的新概念，属于无中生有。

**C 选项** ✅
> methodological discrepancies in studies of oil shocks may have contributed to economists' inability to provide a generalized model of oil shocks' effects on national economies

正确原因：文章指出即使控制了国家特征，估计仍高度异质，暗示研究方法的差异可能是根本原因，C选项恰好总结出“方法论差异导致难以建立通用模型”，与文意完全吻合。

**D 选项** ❌【方向相反】
> differences in oil import-export ratios from one country to another may account for more of the differences in the effects of oil shocks on those countries' economies than economists previously believed.

错误原因：文章第二句已提及进出口比是公认的重要影响因素，且新发现显示在同一国家内部差异仍大，暗示进出口比解释力有限，D选项却强化了进出口比的作用，方向与文意不符。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题核心在于抓住转折词“however”和“even within a given country and time frame”所指的新发现，识别出传统归因（国家特征差异）无法完全解释估计差异，因而推断出“方法论差异”是更合理的解释。选项中需避免与此逻辑相悖的内容，排除强化国家特征作用或引入无关概念的选项。关键词“heterogeneous”、“suggesting”指向因果推论，锁定答案为C。

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Biologists Rebecca M. Calisi-Rodríguez and George E. Bentley examined research on white-throated sparrows and Nuttall's white-crowned sparrows, both of which have been studied in the laboratory as well as in the wild, to see how studies' settings might have affected their results.

**第2句：**

👉 表示转折：虽然实验室研究方便控制变量，但环境会显著影响麻雀激素水平。

**第3句：**

👉 因果推论和引出结论：因此，科学家们发现了某种与环境有关的激素水平差异。

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> captive sparrows and wild sparrows usually exhibited very similar hormone levels.

与原文“surroundings can significantly affect their hormone levels”矛盾，表示环境对激素水平有显著影响，因此不能是“相似水平”。【方向相反】

**B 选项** ❌
> significant differences in hormone levels between individuals were found for both captive sparrows and wild sparrows.

原文重点是环境对激素水平的影响，选项中强调“个体之间差异”，与文章主旨不符，且未体现环境因素。【无中生有】

**C 选项** ❌
> hormone levels were higher in wild males than in captive male Nuttall's white-crowned sparrows.

文中提到的是“white-throated sparrows”受到环境影响，且未比较野生和圈养雄性Nuttall's sparrows的激素水平，且这不符合“实验室容易控制变量”的逻辑。【过度推断】

**D 选项** ✅
> baseline levels of the hormone corticosterone are higher in captive sparrows than they are in wild sparrows.

符合文章逻辑：环境显著影响激素水平，且实验室环境可能导致激素基线水平升高，呼应“surroundings can significantly affect their hormone levels”，合理完成段落。

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关注转折词“but”和因果词“Therefore”，理解环境对激素水平的显著影响；排除选项时注意与原文“significantly affect”相反或无关的表述；选项需呼应环境影响导致激素水平差异的结论。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Studying animals in a laboratory allows variables to be systematically controlled, but removing animals from their wild habitats can affect their behavior and biology in unforeseen ways.

👉 对比实验室研究和野外研究，指出两者各自的优缺点。

**第2句：**
> Given this, biologists Rebecca M. Calisi-Rodríguez and George E. Bentley examined research on brown-throated three-toed sloths and white-throated sparrows to see whether results from studies in the wild were consistent with the results of studies in the laboratory.

👉 说明研究者的目的：比较野外和实验室研究结果是否一致。

**第3句：**
> Therefore, data showing that brown-throated three-toed sloths tend to sleep fewer than 10 hours per day in the wild would be irrelevant to Calisi-Rodríguez and Bentley's investigation if _____

👉 提出假设：如果某种情况成立，那么某些野外数据对研究者的调查将无关紧要。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 对比实验室研究和野外研究的优缺点 |
| 第二句 | 介绍研究者对两种动物的研究目的：验证野外与实验室结果是否一致 |
| 第三句 | 提出假设，说明在何种情况下，野外数据对研究无关紧要 |

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> they tend to sleep more than 15 hours per day in the lab.

这说明实验室睡眠时间与野外睡眠时间不同，体现结果不一致，但文章并未说这会让野外数据“无关紧要”，而是研究的关键。故不符文中“irrelevant”的条件。
错误类型：【方向相反】

**B 选项** ❌
> white-throated sparrows have low levels of corticosterone hormones outside of the breeding season in the wild.

与题干中棕喉三趾树獭睡眠时间无关，且没有说明数据是否对研究无关紧要，属于无关信息。
错误类型：【无中生有】

**C 选项** ✅
> this behavior pattern has not been studied in the lab.

若实验室中没有对该行为模式的研究，那么野外数据就无法与实验室数据比较，因而对研究者检验一致性的调查无关紧要，符合逻辑推理。

**D 选项** ❌
> such data have been collected for white-throated sparrows in laboratory settings but not in the wild.

这是说白喉雀的实验室数据有而野外数据没有，跟题干讨论的棕喉三趾树獭野外睡眠数据无关，且不能说明棕喉树獭的野外数据无关紧要。
错误类型：【无中生有】

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题考查因果逻辑推理，题干关键词“would be irrelevant if”提示找条件使野外数据无关紧要，结合前文研究目的“比较野外与实验室数据一致性”，逻辑上只有“实验室没有该行为研究”（选项C）才能使野外数据无从比较，从而无关紧要。其他选项要么无关要么方向相反，利用关键词“irrelevant”和“if”锁定答案。

there may not be significant differences in the water that each ecosystem inhabit, but there are significant differences in each ecotype’s resistance to zinc pollution.

## 题目类型说明

本题为逻辑补全题，核心任务是根据前文实验设计和结果，选择最合理的句子来完整说明研究结论。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Duckweed is a small freshwater plant that is often exposed to zinc pollution.

👉 引入研究对象和背景：水生植物鸭跖草常接触锌污染。

**第2句：**
> Sofia Vámos and colleagues collected samples of four duckweed ecotypes (genetically and geographically distinct populations within a species), along with water from each ecosystem’s habitat.

👉 介绍研究对象的多样性和样本采集：采集4种遗传地理不同的鸭跖草生态型及其栖息地水样。

**第3句：**
> Hypothesizing that each ecosystem is adapted to its local conditions in ways that bolster its growth and resistance to pollutants, the researchers grew each ecosystem in all four water samples and with three levels of zinc (none, low, high).

👉 阐明研究假设和实验设计：假设每生态系统对本地环境适应，测试所有生态型在不同水样及锌浓度下的生长。

**第4句：**
> (The researchers did not replicate local differences in light or temperature.)

👉 补充说明实验中未控制的变量：光照和温度未复制。

**第5句：**
> They found that the ecotypes grew equally well in all four water samples and that adding zinc consistently enhanced growth, regardless of concentration, suggesting that _______.

👉 结果总结和提出待补全结论：生态型在所有水样中生长相似，锌添加促进生长，暗示……

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                             |
|:---------|:-------------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 引入鸭跖草及其常见锌污染背景                     |
| 第二句   | 介绍采集的四种遗传地理不同的生态型和水样         |
| 第三句   | 说明研究假设及实验设计，测试生态型在不同水样和锌浓度下生长 |
| 第四句   | 说明未控制光照和温度差异                         |
| 第五句   | 实验结果：生态型在所有水样中生长相似，锌促进生长，提出待补结论 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅（正确）
> if each ecosystem is indeed locally adapted as the researchers hypothesized, those adaptations are to other environmental conditions than the water each ecosystem inhabit.

此选项正确。原文表明生态型在所有水样中生长表现相同，说明“水环境”不是局部适应的因素，符合“如果生态系统局部适应，适应的是除水质外的其他环境条件”这一逻辑，直接呼应前文假设和实验结果。

**B 选项** ❌（错误）
> while the ecotypes are genetically and geographically distinct, those differences do not represent adaptations to local environmental conditions.

该选项错误，因实验只排除了水质适应，未否定所有局部适应可能，且文章未直接否定局部适应，故此结论过于绝对。【过度推断】

**C 选项** ❌（错误）
> there may not be significant differences in the water that each ecosystem inhabit, but there are significant differences in each ecotype’s resistance to zinc pollution.

该选项错误，原文中实验结果是“锌添加促进所有生态型生长”，未体现生态型间锌抗性差异。【无中生有】

**D 选项** ❌（错误）
> although the researchers’ hypothesis does not appear to be supported, this may be because the levels of zinc exposure the plants in the experiment received did not match their exposure in their natural environments.

该选项错误，研究者假设未被直接否定，且文中未提实验锌浓度不匹配为原因。【无中生有】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于理清实验设计和结果：实验中生态型在不同水样中生长无差异，锌促进生长，暗示“水样不是局部适应因素”，结合假设锁定答案。注意“suggesting that”后应为对实验结果的合理推论，避免过度否定假设或无中生有。关键词“equally well in all four water samples”和“suggesting that”是解题突破口。

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅（正确）
> methodological discrepancies in studies of oil shocks may have contributed to economists’ inability to provide a generalized model of oil shocks’ effects on national economies.

前文提到“同一国家同一时期内估计差异巨大”，说明问题可能在研究方法上而非仅仅国家特征，故A选项符合“暗示”的逻辑，解释了为何难以建立普适模型。

**B 选项** ❌（错误）【方向相反】
> controlling for variations in countries’ oil import-export ratios may have obscured inconsistencies in economists’ findings about the effects of oil shocks at national levels.

文章第二句明确说“国家特征（如进出口比例）”是影响因素，不是“掩盖”问题，而是大家普遍认为的原因，B选项和文意相反。

**C 选项** ❌（错误）【无中生有】
> economists’ conventional measures of national economic activity maybe insufficiently sensitive to the effects of oil shocks.

文中无任何关于“经济指标敏感度不足”的讨论，C选项无据可依。

**D 选项** ❌（错误）【以偏概全】
> differences in oil import-export ratios from one country to another may account for more of the differences in the effects of oil shocks on those countries’ economies than economists previously believed.

文中说“国家特征是通常归因”，新研究发现同一国家内部估计差异大，说明不能单纯归因于国家差异，D选项与此矛盾，且没有支持文中新发现的意义。

这句话强调，尽管存在显著的区域差异（政治、经济、空间），但这些差异对城市聚集模式影响有限。符合文中“分组基于区域差异”与“普遍趋势出现”的关系，说明趋势跨区域普遍存在，直接对应了“发现的含义”。

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> the purchase probability of a brand is affected by the purchase probability of the particular product category to which it belongs, and thus brands in categories that are rarely purchased tend to have low purchase probabilities regardless of market share.

该选项强调的是“产品类别的购买概率影响品牌购买概率”，与文中市场份额与购买概率“反向关系”的结论不符，且未解释反向关系的原因。
错误类型：【无中生有】

**B 选项** ❌
> as a brand's market share increases, the number of competing brands in the same product category tends to decrease, and thus the rate of increase in market share tends to accelerate as a brand's market share grows.

此选项说明市场份额增长加速，但文中强调的是“市场份额与购买概率增加的反向关系”，两者逻辑方向不一致，且无对应研究数据支持。
错误类型：【方向相反】

**C 选项** ✅
> brands with high market share have high purchase probability regardless of whether the other product in the pair is purchased and thus have less potential to increase in purchase probability than brands with low market share do.

该选项精准解释了“市场份额与购买概率提升的反向关系”：高市场份额品牌本身购买概率已高，故“购买概率提升”潜力有限；低市场份额品牌购买概率基数低，提升空间大，符合文中反向关系的合理归因。

**D 选项** ❌
> consumers tend to be less familiar with brands with low market share than brands with high market share and thus may purchase both products in a pair with low market share without recognizing that the products are the same brand.

该选项提出消费者对低市场份额品牌不熟悉的假设，但并未解释为何市场份额与购买概率增加存在反向关系，且推断缺乏文中数据支持。

> 💡 本题核心在于把握“broad inverse relationship”（广泛的反向关系）这一关键词，理解市场份额高的品牌购买概率已然较高，因而增长潜力有限，而市场份额低的品牌则有更大提升空间。选项中只有C明确回应这一逻辑，其他选项未能紧扣“反向关系”因果，故可排除。关注转折词“thus”引导的因果推论，有助锁定正确答案。

## 题目类型说明
本题属于**逻辑补全题**，核心任务是根据上下文逻辑合理推断出最合适的句子，完成文章的论述。**特别注意空格前的引导短语 "caution against concluding that"——它决定了空格内填入的内容必须是"研究者警告读者不要得出的那个结论"，方向上必须是被否定的判断。**

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Exclusively inhabiting tropical countries such as Senegal, wild chimpanzees lack adaptations to seasonal variations in ultraviolet B (UVB) irradiance from sunlight;

👉 说明野生黑猩猩生活环境及其缺乏对季节性UVB变化的适应。

**第2句：**
> since UVB exposure enables vertebrates to synthesize vitamin D, Sophie Moittie and colleagues studied zoo chimpanzees in Italy and other mid-latitude countries to see how vitamin D levels are affected by the seasonal variations in UVB irradiance that occur in those locations.

👉 解释研究背景和目的，即UVB对维生素D合成的重要性及研究对象和地点。

**第3句：**
> They found that chimpanzees' vitamin D levels were significantly lower in winter than in summer and appeared unaffected by oral supplementation of vitamin D administered by zookeepers.

👉 报告研究发现：冬季维生素D水平下降，且补充维生素D**似乎无效**（appeared unaffected）。

**第4句：**
> Moittie and colleagues point out, however, that supplementation was rare, highly varied, and poorly tracked, and therefore they caution against concluding that _____

👉 转折，指出补充本身存在三大问题（罕见、剂量差异大、记录不全），并据此**警告不要下某个结论**。
**关键语法点：** "caution against concluding that X" = 警告不要得出 X 这个结论。所以空格里填的，必须是研究者**反对的、不希望被人轻易接受的那个判断**。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 野生黑猩猩生活在热带，无季节性UVB适应 |
| 第二句 | UVB与维生素D合成关系；研究对象及地点 |
| 第三句 | 研究发现冬季维生素D低，补充看似无效 |
| 第四句 | 补充数据不足，**警示不要轻易下"补充无效"的结论** |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌【无中生有】
> vitamin D levels among zoo chimpanzees in Italy and other mid-latitude countries likely show different seasonal patterns than do vitamin D levels among wild chimpanzees in Senegal and other tropical countries.

文章未对比圈养与野生黑猩猩维生素D的季节变化模式，仅说明野生黑猩猩缺乏季节性适应。A 选项引入了原文没有讨论的对比，属于无中生有。

**B 选项** ❌【方向相反——本题最大陷阱】
> the lack of an observed effect of supplemental vitamin D on zoo chimpanzees in Italy and other mid-latitude countries may reflect shortcomings in the data rather than actual ineffectiveness.

**致命错误在于与 "caution against" 的方向冲突。** 把 B 代入完整句子：
> "they caution against concluding that **the lack of an observed effect... may reflect shortcomings in the data rather than actual ineffectiveness**."
> （研究者警告不要得出"没观察到效果可能是数据缺陷而非真的无效"这个结论。）

这完全反了。B 描述的内容——"观察到的无效可能是数据问题造成的"——**正是研究者自己的观点**，是他们用来支撑警告的理由，而不是他们想否定的结论。把研究者自己的立场放进 "caution against concluding that" 之后，等于让研究者反对自己。逻辑方向彻底颠倒。

**B 看似贴合"数据有缺陷"这一信息点，但忽略了 "caution against" 的否定性引导——这是命题人设置的最大陷阱。**

**C 选项** ✅（正确）
> providing zoo chimpanzees in Italy and other mid-latitude countries with supplemental vitamin D has no promise as a strategy for offsetting winter reductions in their vitamin D levels.

代入完整句子：
> "they caution against concluding that **providing... supplemental vitamin D has no promise as a strategy**."
> （研究者警告不要得出"补充维生素D作为策略毫无前景"这个结论。）

**完全契合。** 逻辑链严密：
- 研究观察到 "appeared unaffected"（补充看似无效）
- 但数据本身存在 "rare, highly varied, and poorly tracked" 三大缺陷
- **因此**（therefore）不能据此就断定"补充无效/无前景"
- C 正好提供了那个被否定的结论：**"补充毫无前景"——这正是研究者警告读者不要轻易下的判断**

C 的内容方向、语法契合度、与 "however...therefore" 的因果链都精准对应。

**D 选项** ❌【无中生有 + 偏离主题】
> winter reductions in UVB irradiance in Italy and other mid-latitude countries can contribute to variations in zoo chimpanzees' vitamin D levels.

文中确实提及冬季维生素D下降与UVB季节变化相关，但这是研究的**背景前提**，不是研究者警告人们不要下的结论。第四句的重点是对**补充效果**的警示，与 UVB 自然变化无关。D 偏离主题。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 **本题关键在于识别 "caution against concluding that" 这一否定性引导结构。** 空格内必须填入研究者**反对**的那个结论，而不是研究者自己支持的观点。
>
> **避坑提醒：** 当遇到 caution against / warn against / argue against / reject the idea that 这类**否定性引导短语**时，要做"双重反转"判断：
> - 先问：研究者真正想表达的立场是什么？
> - 再问：那么他们反对的、不希望读者下的结论是什么？
> - 选项要填的是**后者**，不是前者。
>
> B 选项之所以是 42% 学生掉进去的陷阱，就是因为它的内容方向贴合"研究者自己的观点"——但题干要求填的是"研究者反对的结论"。**内容贴近研究者立场 ≠ 答案正确**，必须经过 "caution against" 这一逻辑反转后才能确定选项。
>
> 利用"补充稀少、变化大、记录差"作为判断依据：研究者意识到数据不足，所以拒绝下"补充无效/无前景"（C）这种武断的负面判断。

| 第二句   | 与之对比，中期20世纪土著画家更倾向于欧洲裔美国人主导的抽象表现主义风格。 |
| 第三句   | 因此，Scholder一代土著抽象画的身份认定方式有所不同，待补全。 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> place a greater emphasis on the artist's biography than on the aesthetic merit of the painting.

错误。文章无任何暗示或对比说他们更重视艺术家生平而非作品审美，且重点在于风格与身份认定，不是生平与审美的权衡。【无中生有】

**B 选项** ❌
> obscure the indigenous origins of certain motifs associated with Abstract Expressionism.

错误。文中提到Scholder采用的是“欧洲裔美国人主导的抽象表现主义”，并非“源自土著的motifs”，而且强调风格不同，并未说模糊了土著motifs的起源。【方向相反】

**C 选项** ✅
> depend not on stylistic details but instead on an awareness of the artist's identity.

正确。文章对比了两代人的风格差异，指出中期土著画家采用主流抽象表现主义风格，难以从风格本身认定其土著身份，因此身份认定更依赖对艺术家身份的认识，符合“depend not on stylistic details but instead on awareness of the artist's identity”。

**D 选项** ❌
> deny the extent to which cultural identity influences an artist's work.

错误。文中强调的是文化身份如何影响艺术风格认定，绝无否认文化身份影响的意思。【无中生有】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于“in contrast”和“thus”两个转折因果词，前文对比两代土著艺术家风格差异，后文因果说明身份认定方式的变化。选项中唯一符合因果逻辑且与“风格”无关、依赖“artist's identity”认定身份的是C选项，其他选项均无文中依据或逻辑相悖。锁定关键短语“not on stylistic details but instead on an awareness of the artist's identity”即可排除错误选项。

**第1句：**
> The subscription economy has rapidly expanded to include a wide range of products — from books to cloud storage — in part because consumers appreciate the convenience of automatic payments.

👉 进一步解释研究发现，主动续订决策会促使更多用户停止订阅。

**第4句：**
> The researchers therefore concluded that a regulation requiring all subscribers to complete payments manually would likely

| 第二句 | 研究显示消费者对自动付款不关注，长期订阅已无价值的服务。 |

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> deter attentive consumers from subscribing in the first place but would have little effect on whether inattentive consumers decide to subscribe.

错误原因：文章未提及“专注的消费者”或其行为，也未区分两类消费者的订阅意愿，属于【无中生有】。

**B 选项** ❌

**C 选项** ✅
> enable dissatisfied subscribers to save more money than they would without such a regulation in place but at the expense of a feature that may have induced them to subscribe initially.

正确原因：文章指出自动续订便利让用户“不关注且持续订阅价值消失的服务”，手动续订能让不满意用户省钱，但会失去自动付款的便利（可能是诱因）。选项内容与文章逻辑相符。

**D 选项** ❌

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 注意文中转折词“But”和因果词“therefore”，文章强调自动付款导致用户不关注续订，手动续订会促使取消订阅，结论应围绕这一点展开。选项中需体现“手动续订降低用户盲目订阅，节省不满意用户的钱，但失去自动付款便利”这一核心逻辑，排除无中生有和过度推断的选项。

## 题目类型说明

本题属于逻辑补全题，核心任务是根据前文信息和逻辑关系，选择最合适的句子来合理且自然地完成文章。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> The ratio of methane to other atmospheric constituents—represented by a measure called the methane mole fraction—influences a variety of meteorological phenomena, notably precipitation and humidity.

👉 说明甲烷比例（methane mole fraction）对气象现象（降水和湿度）有重要影响（提出背景和核心概念）。

**第2句：**
> For Titan, Saturn's largest moon, the observational data that exist are too sparse and discrepant to fully constrain the range of the methane mole fraction at various atmospheric levels.

👉 指出土卫六的观测数据稀少且不一致，难以准确确定不同大气层的甲烷比例（说明问题现状）。

**第3句：**
> Juan Lora and colleagues point out that outputs of the IPSL atmospheric model of Titan, which track closely to observations in some respects, reflect how the model's developers responded to this challenge: by prescribing a uniform methane mole fraction for the lowest level of the atmosphere.

👉 介绍科学家如何应对观测数据不足的挑战：模型采用了最低层大气统一的甲烷比例（解释解决方案及模型特点）。

**第4句：**
> It is therefore important to note that ______

👉 逻辑引导句，提示后文将说明该模型做法的某种重要含义或后果。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                                         |
|:---------|:-------------------------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 甲烷比例影响气象现象（降水和湿度）                            |
| 第二句   | 土卫六的观测数据稀少且不一致，难以准确确定甲烷比例             |
| 第三句   | IPSL模型采用最低层统一甲烷比例，反映开发者应对观测不足的策略   |
| 第四句   | 引出需要注意该模型做法的某种重要结论                           |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> even though the model's outputs sometimes agree with observational data, Titan's real methane mole fraction is likely higher than the methane mole fraction used in the model.

错误原因：文章未提及模型中甲烷比例一定偏低，也未暗示真实甲烷比例高于模型值，是无依据的推断。
错误类型：【过度推断】

**B 选项** ❌
> inconsistencies across the model's simulations of Titan's precipitation and humidity could be attributable to variations in the moon's methane mole fraction.

错误原因：文中未提及模型输出存在不一致，且模型的做法是统一甲烷比例，B选项“模型模拟不一致”与文章信息不符。
错误类型：【无中生有】

**C 选项** ✅
> some disagreements between the model's simulations of Titan's precipitation and humidity and the moon's actual precipitation and humidity are to be expected.

正确原因：文章强调观测数据稀少且模型采用统一甲烷比例，暗示模型与实际存在差异是合理预期，C选项顺理成章地指出“模型和实际存在一定分歧”符合逻辑。

**D 选项** ❌
> further observations of Titan may clarify the moon's methane mole fraction sufficiently for the model to employ a single value rather than a range.

错误原因：文中指出目前模型已采用单一甲烷比例，D选项与文中情况相反（文中是“用单一值”，非“用范围”），与事实不符。
错误类型：【方向相反】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于注意转折词“therefore important to note that”引导的结论句，结合前文“观测数据稀少且不一致”与“模型用统一甲烷比例”的描述，合理推断模型与实际存在差异是正常预期，从而排除过度推断和方向错误选项，锁定强调“合理预期分歧”的C选项。

article: The recently observed gamma ray burst GRB 230307A lasted for 200 seconds, _____ for a burst generated by the merger of neutron stars. Bursts caused by neutron mergers typically last fewer than 2 seconds.

## 题目类型说明

完形填空题，核心任务是根据句意和逻辑选择最合适的连接词或短语完成句子。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> The recently observed gamma ray burst GRB 230307A lasted for 200 seconds, _____ for a burst generated by the merger of neutron stars.

👉 说明GRB 230307A持续时间很长，这一持续时间与中子星合并产生的爆发持续时间不符，后半句缺少对比或描述这一异常的词语。

**第2句：**
> Bursts caused by neutron mergers typically last fewer than 2 seconds.

👉 说明中子星合并产生的爆发通常持续时间极短（少于2秒），与前句形成对比，突出GRB 230307A的异常。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                               |
|:---------|:---------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍GRB 230307A持续时间异常长      |
| 第二句   | 说明中子星合并爆发通常持续时间很短 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> an incident

“incident”意为事件，语义过于普通，无法突出GRB 230307A持续时间与预期的不同，未能体现异常或对比。【无中生有】

**B 选项** ✅
> an oddity

“oddity”意为奇异之处，能准确表达GRB 230307A持续时间异常，与“typically last fewer than 2 seconds”形成明显对比，符合文意。

**C 选项** ❌
> a reprieve

“reprieve”意为暂缓、缓刑，与句意无关，无法表达持续时间异常的含义。【无中生有】

**D 选项** ❌
> a coincidence

“coincidence”意为巧合，不符合句中强调时间持续异常的语境，且不构成合理对比。【方向相反】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关注句中对比结构：“lasted for 200 seconds, _____ for a burst generated by the merger of neutron stars”以及下一句“typically last fewer than 2 seconds”，寻找表达“异常”或“不同寻常”的词语，排除语义无关或弱的选项，锁定表达“奇异、异常”的“an oddity”。

## 题目类型说明

完形填空题，核心任务是根据上下文语境选择最符合逻辑且语义精准的词语完成句子。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> The reception of Andrea Wang's book Watercress has been very good.

👉 这句话提出了整体观点，说明这本书受到了积极的评价。

**第2句：**
> Many reviewers, booksellers, and librarians have____the book, and it won the Asian/Pacific American Award for Literature.

👉 这句话继续说明书的评价情况，强调多个群体对书的态度，并通过奖项佐证书的成功。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                   |
|:---------|:-----------------------|
| 第一句   | 说明书籍的整体反响很好 |
| 第二句   | 介绍具体群体对书的态度，并提及奖项证明其成功 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> misunderstood（误解）

与第一句“reception…has been very good”矛盾，误解通常带有负面含义，不符合文中整体积极评价。 【方向相反】

**B 选项** ❌
> overlooked（忽视）

如果被忽视，书就不可能获得奖项或受到广泛关注，与文意不符。 【方向相反】

**C 选项** ✅
> recommended（推荐）

推荐与“reception…has been very good”相符，且符合后文奖项的正面评价，逻辑连贯且语义精准。

**D 选项** ❌
> attacked（抨击）

抨击带有强烈负面评价，完全违背第一句的“very good”评价。 【方向相反】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关注首句“reception…has been very good”中的情感色彩，锁定正面词汇；结合后文提及奖项来验证书的成功，排除所有负面含义选项，最终选择语义最匹配的“recommended”。关键词“very good”和“won the award”是解题关键。

article: Although our knowledge of the Pleistocene epoch and the lives of hominids during this time was once ______, recent analyses of fossils like that of the individual known as Misliya-1, discovered in Israel in 2002, have sharpened our picture of what a day in the life of Misliya-1 may have looked like.

---

## 题目类型说明

这是词汇题，考查对上下文语境中词义的理解和搭配的准确把握，核心任务是选择最符合句意且逻辑连贯的词语完成句子。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Although our knowledge of the Pleistocene epoch and the lives of hominids during this time was once ______, recent analyses of fossils like that of the individual known as Misliya-1, discovered in Israel in 2002, have sharpened our picture of what a day in the life of Misliya-1 may have looked like.

👉 这是一个转折句，前半句描述过去的知识状态，后半句介绍新发现改善了理解，表示知识从模糊变得更清晰。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                   |
|:---------|:-------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 过去对更新世及古人类生活的了解曾是…，但新化石分析让我们对Misliya-1的生活有了更清晰的认识 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> unprecedented（史无前例的）

该词通常表示“前所未有的”，不符合句意中描述“过去知识状态”的含义，且语义不通顺。文中是说过去知识状态不清晰，“史无前例”与上下文不符。【方向相反】

**B 选项** ❌
> concrete（具体的，确凿的）

句子后半部说明“recent analyses … have sharpened our picture”，即新分析使认识更具体，说明过去知识不具体，故用“concrete”描述过去的知识状态不合逻辑。【方向相反】

**C 选项** ❌
> intricate（复杂的，错综的）

“intricate”侧重复杂性，不符合句子强调知识模糊、不清晰的语境，且句子转折意图是从模糊到清晰，不是从简单到复杂。【无中生有】

**D 选项** ✅
> nebulous（模糊的，朦胧的）

“nebulous”准确表达了过去对更新世及古人类生活知识模糊、不清晰的状态，与后文“recent analyses … have sharpened our picture”形成鲜明对比，逻辑清晰，符合上下文语义。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题核心在于识别转折句中对比关系，注意句首“Although”表示前后状态对立，前半句描述过去的知识状态，后半句说明新发现使认识变得更清晰。关键词“sharpened our picture”暗示过去知识是模糊的，选项中只有“nebulous”符合“模糊”的语义，从而锁定答案并排除其余选项。

## 题目类型说明

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> The fact that publications by University of Minnesota economist Ellen R. McGrattan, who studies financial policy, are so frequently cited in other scholars' work ______ the usefulness of her research for her peers—other economists clearly find her studies valuable for their own scholarship.

👉 句子说明了麦格拉坦教授的论文被频繁引用，体现了她研究的价值，空格处需要填入能表达“证实”或“强调”这一逻辑关系的词。

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> forestalls

“forestalls”意为“预防，阻止”，与句意中“论文被引用体现研究有用性”不符，且语义冲突。
错误类型：【方向相反】

**B 选项** ❌
> belies

“belies”意为“掩饰，与事实不符”，与文中强调被频繁引用证明研究有价值的意思相反。
错误类型：【方向相反】

**C 选项** ✅
> underscores

“underscores”意为“强调，突出”，符合句中“频繁引用体现研究的有用性”的逻辑。
根据句意，频繁引用正是强调其研究对同行的价值。

**D 选项** ❌
> overshadows

“overshadows”意为“使…相形见绌，遮蔽”，不符合句中“引用体现价值”的积极含义，且语义偏离。
错误类型：【无中生有】

👉 举例说明这种倾向带来的具体后果，即研究者可能无意中忽视作品中的细微差别，只关注与哈莱姆文艺复兴明显对应的风格特点。

**A 选项** ✅（正确）
> discount

“Discount subtleties”意为“忽视细节”，与后文“overlook nuances”（忽视细节）形成因果呼应，符合上下文逻辑。文章指出归类倾向使研究者忽视细微差别，discount正是表达这一意思的最佳词汇。

**B 选项** ❌（错误）

“Scrutinize”意为“仔细审查”，与句意相反。文中强调的是忽视细节，非仔细观察。错误类型：【方向相反】

“Denounce”意为“谴责、批评”，与“忽视细节”的语境不符，且文中无批评作者风格的含义。错误类型：【无中生有】

**D 选项** ❌（错误）
> magnify

“Magnify”意为“放大”，与文中“忽视”细节的意思相反。错误类型：【方向相反】

## 核心解题技巧

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> The Lao Securities Exchange in Vientiane, Laos, is a dedicated exchange for investing in companies operating in Laos, ensuring those companies receive certain regulatory oversight.

👉 介绍老挝证券交易所的功能和作用。

**第2句：**

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> convey（传达）

“传达”指的是传递信息，而句中主语是“Knowing this”，即“了解这一点”，后面应该描述这种了解带来的心理效果，不是传递信息的动作。【方向相反】

**B 选项** ✅
> assuage（缓和，减轻）

文中“Knowing this can ______ potential investors' worries”意为“了解这一点可以减轻潜在投资者对官僚细节的担忧”，符合语境和逻辑，且与后文“allow them to focus”因果关系紧密。

**C 选项** ❌

“指定”不符合句意，句子讲的是“了解这一点”对投资者担忧的影响，不涉及“指定”行为。【无中生有】

**D 选项** ❌
> amplify（放大）

“放大”与句中“allow them to focus”形成矛盾，原文表达的是减少担忧而非增加担忧。【方向相反】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关注句中“Knowing this can ______ potential investors' worries”和“thereby allow them to instead focus”之间的因果关系，worries的情感色彩为负，需用能减轻担忧的词；选项中“assuage”准确表达“缓和、减轻”忧虑，排除语义相反或不符的选项。

article: Although our knowledge of the Pliocene epoch and the lives of the hominids during this time was once ______, recent analyses of fossils like that of the individual known as KNM-KP 271, discovered in Kenya in 1963, have sharpened our picture of what a day in the life of KNM-KP 271 may have looked like.

## 题目类型说明

这是词汇题，核心任务是根据句意选择最符合语境且逻辑合理的词语填空。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Although our knowledge of the Pliocene epoch and the lives of the hominids during this time was once ______, recent analyses of fossils like that of the individual known as KNM-KP 271, discovered in Kenya in 1963, have sharpened our picture of what a day in the life of KNM-KP 271 may have looked like.

👉 这句话先提出了过去对某事物的认知状态（知识是怎样的），然后通过转折词although引出现在通过新的化石分析对该认知的提升。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 说明过去对更新世（Pliocene epoch）及当时人类的认知状态，并用转折词although连接后文，表明现有研究使认知更加清晰。 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅（正确）
> nebulous

“nebulous”意为模糊不清的，符合句中“once ______”后面跟转折“recent analyses...have sharpened our picture”的逻辑，即过去认知模糊，现在更清晰。句中“sharpened”与“nebulous”形成因果对比。

**B 选项** ❌（错误）
> intricate

“intricate”意为复杂的，精细的。文中强调认知由模糊变得清晰，而非由复杂变简单，且“intricate”并不能很好地与“sharpened our picture”形成对比。属于【方向相反】。

**C 选项** ❌（错误）
> unprecedented

“unprecedented”意为前所未有的，文中并未强调认知的独特性，而是其模糊程度，且“once unprecedented”语义不通，属于【无中生有】。

**D 选项** ❌（错误）
> concrete

“concrete”意为具体的，确切的。句子结构是“our knowledge...was once ______, recent analyses...have sharpened...”，两者形成因果或转折对比，“once concrete”后面再说“sharpened”不合逻辑，属于【方向相反】。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关键在于把握转折词“Although”和后半句“have sharpened our picture”之间的逻辑关系，前半句描述过去认知状态应与后半句形成对比，因此选项中含义为“模糊不清”的“nebulous”最符合语境，排除含义与“sharpened”不符的选项。

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌

**C 选项** ❌

“先驱”通常是褒义词，指先行者，不符合“最初遭遇负面”的语境，且与后文“地位更稳固”形成冲突，属于【方向相反】。

**D 选项** ✅
> detractors（批评者，贬低者）

“detractors”指的是批评者或贬低者，符合句中“最初遭遇负面”的语境，且与后文“现在评价更积极”形成合理对比，符合逻辑。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题核心在于识别句中转折词“Although”引导的让步状语从句，暗示前半句表达负面情况，后半句表达积极变化；“may have had some _____ at the time of their initial release”中空格应填表示负面态度的人或事。结合后文“their place... is now more secure”和“critics described... especially pointed/exuberant”可判断前半句为“最初遭遇批评”，从而选“detractors”，排除其他选项的词义不符或情感色彩不符。

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Some robots such as Surena (developed in 2008) and COMAN (developed in 2012) are designed to resemble humans so that people will find it easier to interact with them.

👉 说明机器人设计成类人的目的——便于人机交互。

**第2句：**
> To this end, certain features such as the ability to respond to voice commands can help to create the comforting semblance of humanity,

👉 解释为了实现上述目的，机器人具备的某些特征（如语音响应）能营造“安慰人心”的类人假象。

**第3句：**
> but a robot that appears too similar to humans can make people feel more unsettled than ______

👉 转折，指出过于像人的机器人反而可能令人感到不安，接下来需要填补一句与“不安”对比的词。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                           |
|:---------|:------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍类人机器人及其设计目的       |
| 第二句   | 说明类人特征如何帮助人机交互     |
| 第三句   | 转折，指出过度类人带来的不安感   |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅（正确）
> soothed

“soothed”意为“被安慰的、平静的”，与“unsettled”（不安）形成鲜明对比，符合句意“机器人过于像人会让人比平时更不安”，这里应填入“比平时更少安慰/更少平静”的词，故“soothed”最合适。

**B 选项** ❌（错误）
> indifferent

“indifferent”意为“冷漠的、无动于衷的”，无法与“unsettled”形成直接对比，且文中强调的是情感上的安慰与不安，冷漠不符合逻辑。【方向相反】

**C 选项** ❌（错误）
> revolted

“revolted”意为“感到厌恶、反感”，虽也是负面情绪，但与“unsettled”不构成恰当的对比，且语气过强，不符合“more unsettled than ______”的语境。【过度推断】

**D 选项** ❌（错误）
> vindicated

“vindicated”意为“被证明无辜或正确”，与情感状态无关，完全不符合上下文逻辑。【无中生有】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 注意句中转折词“but”引出对比，后半句需与“unsettled”（不安）形成对立的情感状态，选择含义相反且贴切的词汇“soothed”最合适；排除与情感无关或语义强烈不符的选项。

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Some pieces of music might have many meanings—the compositions of Albertine Caron-Legris can _____ as many different interpretations as there are people to listen to them—

👉 说明作曲作品能够产生多种不同的解读，强调音乐作品意义的多样性。

**第2句：**
> and so as long as a listener's interpretation isn't willfully absurd or the result of inattention, it is difficult to justify the claim that the listener has misunderstood the piece.

## 结构总结

|:---------|:-------------------------------------------------------------|

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅（正确）
> yield

“yield as many different interpretations”意为“产生多种不同的解读”，符合上下文对音乐多义性的描述，语义准确且逻辑通顺。

**B 选项** ❌（错误）
> refute

“refute”意为“驳斥”，与句意不符，音乐作品不会“驳斥”不同解读，违背文意。【方向相反】

**C 选项** ❌（错误）
> counteract

“counteract”意为“抵消、对抗”，不符合音乐作品产生多重解读的语境，语义不搭。【无中生有】

**D 选项** ❌（错误）
> partition

“partition”意为“分割”，虽然有“分成多部分”的意思，但文中强调的是“产生多种解读”，而非“分割”，不够准确且不符合搭配习惯。【偷换概念】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 重点关注动词与“many different interpretations”搭配的合理性，常见搭配是“yield interpretations”（产生解读）。转折词“and so”引导因果推论，说明前半句需表达“产生多种解读”的动作。排除语义与音乐作品功能不符的选项。

> replace

错误类型：【无中生有】

**D 选项** ❌
> disguise

“disguise distinctions”意为“掩饰区分”，语义不符，文章语境强调融合和拒绝区分，而非掩盖，且后文例子也不支持。
错误类型：【无中生有】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关键词“distinctions between Indigenous music and other musical styles”提示这里谈论的是对差异的态度。后文举例音乐家融合不同风格，说明他们不认可这种区分，故用“reject”最恰当。理解“reject distinctions”与举例融合的语义一致性是关键，排除其他选项的语义偏差。

## 题目类型说明

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> In the 2010s, the price of vintage Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles action figures rose dramatically, which had the counterintuitive effect of _____ demand: buyers who hadn't previously wanted to purchase old action figures thronged the market, believing prices would continue to rise and the toys could be resold later at a profit.

👉 说明价格上涨导致了一个“反直觉”的结果，具体是对需求产生了某种影响；后半句解释了这种影响，即原本不想买的人开始大量涌入市场。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                         |
|:---------|:----------------------------|
| 第一句   | 价格上涨导致反直觉的需求变化 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> monetizing

“Monetizing”意为“变现”，强调将某物转化为金钱收益，不符合“影响需求”的语境。原文强调的是价格上涨导致需求发生变化，而非需求被“变现”。【偷换概念】

**B 选项** ❌
> appraising

“Appraising”意为“评估、估价”，与句中描述的“需求变化”不符。句意应表达需求的增加，而非对需求进行估价。【无中生有】

**C 选项** ✅
> engendering

“Engendering”意为“引起，产生”，恰好符合“价格上涨导致需求增加”的因果关系，且与“counterintuitive effect”逻辑一致，句意完整流畅。

**D 选项** ❌
> exploiting

“Exploiting”意为“利用、剥削”，语义偏离需求变化，且不符合句中“反直觉”的因果关系。此处强调的是需求的增长，而非利用需求。【方向相反】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关注句中关键词“counterintuitive effect”和后半句对需求变化的解释，寻找表达“引起、导致需求变化”的词；排除与需求变化无关或语义不符的选项，如“monetizing”“appraising”“exploiting”，最终锁定含义明确且符合因果关系的“engendering”。

## 题目类型说明

这是词汇题，核心任务是根据上下文语境选择最合适的词语，准确表达两种数据来源之间的关系。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> In the search for new impact craters on Mars, the roles of seismic monitoring and orbital imaging as data sources are ____: when vibrations detected with seismic monitoring indicate roughly where an impact has occurred, researchers can use orbital images of that relatively limited area of the rocky surface to precisely locate a new crater.

👉 这句话提出了两种数据来源的关系，并通过后半句具体描述了二者如何协作完成任务。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 说明两种数据来源（seismic monitoring和orbital imaging）在寻找火星撞击坑中各自的角色，并指出它们之间的关系；后半句举例说明两者如何配合使用。 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> redundant

错误原因：文中明确说明seismic monitoring提供的是“roughly where”，orbital imaging用于“precisely locate”，两者功能不同且互补，非冗余。
错误类型：【方向相反】

**B 选项** ❌
> exhaustive

错误原因：“exhaustive”意为“详尽无遗”，但文中并未表达两种方法覆盖所有信息或完全替代，只是强调二者协同工作。
错误类型：【无中生有】

**C 选项** ✅
> complementary

正确原因：文章描述了两种方法各司其职，互相补充——地震监测给出大致位置，轨道成像精确定位，完全符合“互补”的含义。

**D 选项** ❌
> interchangeable

错误原因：如果是“interchangeable”，意味着二者可以互相替代，但文章明确表明两者作用不同，无法替代。
错误类型：【方向相反】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于理解句中冒号后举例句的逻辑关系——地震监测提供大致位置，轨道成像精确定位，表明两者功能不同但互补。关键词“when... indicate..., researchers can use...”揭示先后顺序和协作关系，排除“redundant”和“interchangeable”选项，锁定“complementary”。

## 题目类型说明

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Although the clustering of cutlery manufacturing firms in Sheffield, UK, is often cited as typical of industrial agglomeration, Giulia Faggio et al. use UK data to show that the mix of factors driving the phenomenon is _______ across industries:

👉 这句话提出对工业集聚现象驱动因素多样性的观点，指出不同产业驱动因素不同。

**第2句：**
> while access to specialized suppliers can prompt agglomeration, collocation among refined petroleum product manufacturers occurs for different reasons.

👉 举例说明前句观点，表明不同产业集聚的原因不同，强调驱动因素的多样性。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 提出尽管谢菲尔德餐具制造业的集聚被视为典型工业集聚，但驱动这一现象的因素在各产业间存在差异。 |
| 第二句 | 举例说明：餐具制造业因专门供应商促成集聚，而石油制品制造业的集聚原因不同。 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> imperative（必要的）

文中强调驱动因素在产业间不同，imperative表示“必要的”，与“不同”矛盾，且句意需表达多样性，非单一必要性。
错误类型：【方向相反】

**B 选项** ❌
> credible（可信的）

文中讨论的是驱动因素的性质差异，不是可信度问题，credible与上下文无关。
错误类型：【无中生有】

**C 选项** ✅
> heterogeneous（异质的，多样的）

文中通过对比不同产业的驱动因素，明确指出因素的多样性和差异性，heterogeneous精准表达“多样化”含义，符合逻辑和语境。

**D 选项** ❌
> decisive（决定性的）

decisive强调“决定性”，文中需表达“多样性”，决定性与多样性概念不符，且文中举例对比驱动因素不同，说明非单一决定因素。
错误类型：【方向相反】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题核心在于理解句中因果关系和对比结构，关键词“while”引出不同产业驱动因素的对比，暗示空缺处需表达“多样性”或“差异性”，heterogeneous最符合；同时排除强调单一性质或可信度的选项。注意转折词“although”和对比连接词“while”提示对比逻辑。

## 题目类型说明

这是词汇填空题，核心任务是选择一个既符合语境又准确表达句意的词语，完成句子含义的逻辑延续。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> The adult false tiger moth appears to have a bright yellow and black pattern as a result of pigmented scales that cover its wings and body.

👉 说明了假虎蛾成虫的外观特征及其产生颜色和图案的原因。

**第2句：**
> Although scales are widely known as the source of a moth's color and pattern, the _____ of these scales goes beyond visual display: they also detach when moths are caught in a spiderweb.

👉 表明鳞片除了视觉展示功能外，还有其他用途，提出转折并引出新的信息。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                                         |
|:---------|:-------------------------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 描述假虎蛾的颜色和图案由覆盖其翅膀和身体的有色鳞片形成。     |
| 第二句   | 转折说明鳞片不仅用于视觉展示，还能在被蜘蛛网困住时脱落。       |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> frailty

“frailty”意为脆弱性，强调鳞片的易碎性，但句子后半部分强调鳞片脱落是有功能的表现，不是单纯的脆弱，且“frailty”未体现鳞片的“用途”或“功能”，与句中“goes beyond visual display”逻辑不符。
错误类型：【方向相反】

**B 选项** ✅
> utility

“utility”意为“用途、功能”，与句意完美匹配，句中强调鳞片不仅仅有视觉展示的作用，还能通过脱落保护蛾子，体现鳞片的多重“功能”，逻辑严密且准确。

**C 选项** ❌
> tendency

“tendency”意为“倾向”，不符合句中强调的“鳞片的某种特性或功能”，且后半句说明鳞片“脱落”，是具体动作，与“倾向”抽象含义不符。
错误类型：【偷换概念】

**D 选项** ❌
> attractiveness

“attractiveness”意为“吸引力”，虽然与视觉展示相关，但句中转折表明鳞片的作用超出了视觉展示，选此词会重复且逻辑不通。
错误类型：【以偏概全】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题考察词义与上下文逻辑的匹配，关键在于转折词“Although”和短语“goes beyond visual display”，提示我们寻找一个表明鳞片除了“视觉功能”之外还有“实用功能”的词，因此“utility”精准表达了鳞片的多重用途，排除了仅强调脆弱性、倾向性或吸引力的选项。

article: The following text is from Amy Tan's 1989 novel The Joy Luck Club. The narrator describes practicing the piano when she was a child. For the talent show, I was to play a piece called "Pleading Child" from Schumann's Scenes From Childhood. It was a simple, moody piece that sounded more difficult than it was. I was supposed to memorize the whole thing, playing the repeat parts twice to make the piece sound longer. But I dawdled over it, playing a few bars and then cheating, looking, up to see what notes followed. I never really listened to what I was playing. I daydreamed about being somewhere else, about being someone else.
stem: Based on the text, when the narrator describes herself as "cheating," what does she most likely mean?

options.content: She was violating an expectation about how to perform the piece.
She was deceiving her piano teacher.
She was gaining an unfair advantage over other contestants in the talent show.
She was lying to herself about her musical ability.

## 题目类型说明

本题为细节理解题，核心任务是根据文章对“cheating”一词的描述，准确理解叙述者当时的行为含义。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> For the talent show, I was to play a piece called "Pleading Child" from Schumann's Scenes From Childhood.

👉 交代背景和任务：参加才艺表演，需要演奏一首钢琴曲。

**第2句：**
> It was a simple, moody piece that sounded more difficult than it was.

👉 解释曲子的特点：曲子看似复杂其实简单。

**第3句：**
> I was supposed to memorize the whole thing, playing the repeat parts twice to make the piece sound longer.

👉 说明要求：需要全曲背诵并重复演奏某些部分。

**第4句：**
> But I dawdled over it, playing a few bars and then cheating, looking, up to see what notes followed.

👉 转折，描述自己学习态度不认真，“cheating”即偷看后续琴谱。

**第5句：**
> I never really listened to what I was playing.

👉 进一步说明缺乏专注，未真正用心弹奏。

**第6句：**
> I daydreamed about being somewhere else, about being someone else.

👉 描述精神状态，心不在焉。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                                         |
|:---------|:-------------------------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 交代参加才艺表演，需演奏“Pleading Child”曲目                  |
| 第二句   | 描述曲子简单但听起来复杂                                       |
| 第三句   | 说明演奏要求：全曲记忆并重复某些部分                           |
| 第四句   | 转折，叙述者拖延练习并“作弊”——偷看琴谱                        |
| 第五句   | 强调没有真正专注弹琴                                           |
| 第六句   | 叙述者精神恍惚，心不在焉                                       |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅（正确）
> She was violating an expectation about how to perform the piece.

正确。文中“cheating”指的是“looking up to see what notes followed”，即偷看琴谱，违反了“memorize the whole thing”的要求，符合“违反演奏曲目要求”的意思。

**B 选项** ❌（错误）
> She was deceiving her piano teacher.

错误。文中没有提到她在欺骗老师，只是偷看琴谱。老师是否知道无法判断，且重点是违反规定，而非欺骗教师。
错误类型：【过度推断】

**C 选项** ❌（错误）
> She was gaining an unfair advantage over other contestants in the talent show.

错误。文中“cheating”是指自己偷看琴谱，表现出拖延和不专注，反而没有体现任何“获得不公平优势”的意思。
错误类型：【无中生有】

**D 选项** ❌（错误）
> She was lying to herself about her musical ability.

错误。文中并无“欺骗自己”的描述，叙述者只是心不在焉和偷看谱子，未涉及自我欺骗。
错误类型：【无中生有】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于理解“cheating”一词结合上下文的具体行为——“looking up to see what notes followed”，与“memorize the whole thing”的要求形成对比，体现违反演奏规则。转折词“But”提示行为负面，排除选项中不符合文意的“欺骗老师”“获得优势”或“自我欺骗”，锁定A选项。

## 题目类型说明

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> The striped marlin is an ectothermic (cold-blooded) fish, whereas the Pacific bluefin tuna is a regional endotherm; unlike that of ectotherms, its body temperature remains above the ambient water temperature.

👉 对比两种鱼类的体温调节方式，提出背景信息。

**第2句：**
> The basking shark had been classified as a full ectotherm, but researchers Haley R. Dolton et al. found that its body temperature remains 1.0 to 1.5°C above ambient, which is _____ that classification.

👉 提出新发现并指出该发现与之前分类之间的关系，需填充一个表达“与该分类不符”的词语。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                     |
|:---------|:----------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 对比两种鱼的体温调节机制，解释什么是ectotherm和regional endotherm |
| 第二句   | 介绍basking shark曾被归为ectotherm，但新研究发现其体温高于环境温度，提示分类存在问题 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> indicative of

“indicative of”意为“表明”，若用此词，句意为“其体温高于环境温度表明该分类”，与语境相反，文中新发现对原分类构成挑战，非支持。
错误类型：【方向相反】

**B 选项** ❌
> subordinate to

“subordinate to”意为“从属于”，搭配“classification”语义不通，且文中意在表示发现与分类不符，非“从属于”。
错误类型：【无中生有】

**C 选项** ✅
> incongruous with

“incongruous with”意为“与……不一致”，完美表达“新发现的体温高于环境温度与basking shark被归类为ectotherm不一致”的意思，符合逻辑和语境。

**D 选项** ❌
> opportune for

“opportune for”意为“对……合适”，语义与文意不符，且搭配不合理，文中需表达“与分类不符”，非“合适于”。
错误类型：【无中生有】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 该题关键在于理解上下文对比关系，前文指出basking shark被归为“全ectotherm”，后文新发现其体温高于环境，暗示分类错误。句中空格前后的“which is”提示需填入形容与前述分类关系的形容词短语，转折关系指向“与分类不符”。因此，“incongruous with”（不一致）精准匹配语境，排除表肯定、无关或错误搭配的选项。

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> *October*, painted in the realist style by Jules Bastien-Lepage, depicts peasant women picking potatoes.

👉 介绍画作和画家的风格及主题。

**第2句：**
> The realists' emphasis on accurately portraying the experiences of average working people was largely a rejection of the romantic style evident in many paintings by Jean-Victor Schnetz, which instead ____ their subjects' beauty or heroism while hiding all imperfection.

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> mock

“mock”意为“嘲笑”，与句中浪漫主义强调美和英雄气概的描述不符，且原文无嘲讽意味。【方向相反】

**B 选项** ✅
> exaggerate

“exaggerate”意为“夸大”，符合浪漫主义画风“突出美或英雄气概”的语境，且与“掩盖缺陷”相辅相成。

**C 选项** ❌
> correct

**D 选项** ❌
> undermine

“undermine”意为“削弱”，与句中“突出美或英雄气概”相反，浪漫主义是强化而非削弱主题。【方向相反】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关注句中关键词“emphasis on accurately”、“rejection of the romantic style”以及“while hiding all imperfection”，浪漫主义画风强调美和英雄气概，掩盖瑕疵，故选“exaggerate”最符合“突出和美化”的含义，排除表达嘲讽、纠正或削弱的选项。

article: Cybersecurity experts often encourage users to create passwords that are fairly complicated and therefore difficult to guess. ## 题目类型说明

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Cybersecurity experts often encourage users to create passwords that are fairly complicated and therefore difficult to guess.

👉 说明专家建议密码应复杂以增强安全性。

**第2句：**
> Nonetheless, research has shown that the more _____ approach to password selection seems to favor convenience over security: for example, the second most commonly used password in 2016 was the easily remembered “password.”

👉 转折指出一种不同的密码选择方式，更倾向于方便而非安全，并举例说明。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                           |
|:---------|:------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 专家建议密码应复杂以增强安全性 |
| 第二句   | 研究发现另一种更倾向方便的密码选择方式，举例说明 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> creative

“creative”（有创造力的）与“favor convenience over security”矛盾，因为创造性密码一般更复杂安全，文中强调“方便”而非“创造性”。【方向相反】

**B 选项** ❌
> useful

“useful”（有用的）无具体指向性，且与后文举例“最常用密码”为“password”无逻辑关联，无法体现“favor convenience over security”的含义。【无中生有】

**C 选项** ✅
> popular

“popular”（流行的）恰好符合后文“第二常用密码是‘password’”的说明，且“more popular approach”与“favor convenience over security”逻辑吻合，体现用户倾向于选择方便记忆的流行密码。

**D 选项** ❌
> complex

“complex”（复杂的）与前文“favor convenience over security”矛盾，因为复杂密码通常不方便，且前文已有“experts encourage complicated passwords”作为对比。【方向相反】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关注转折词“Nonetheless”和后半句“favor convenience over security”，对比前文“complicated”，排除与复杂相反或无关的选项；结合举例“second most commonly used password”，锁定表达“流行”含义的选项，从而选出“popular”。

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅
> withhold

**B 选项** ❌【方向相反】
> celebrate

错误。celebrate意为“庆祝”，与文中“with little backstory or explanation”矛盾，文中强调的是“少量解释”，非“强调或赞美”细节。

**C 选项** ❌【无中生有】

错误。combine意为“结合”，文中无任何暗示宫崎骏将奇幻元素与细节“结合”这一动作，且与“with little exposition”矛盾。

**D 选项** ❌【无中生有】

错误。invent意为“发明”，文中未提宫崎骏“发明”细节和解释，只讲述他对细节和解释的处理方式。

## 核心解题技巧

article:
The following text is from a 1955 translation of Samuel Beckett's 1951 novel Molloy (translated by the author and Patrick Bowles). In the text, Molloy has arrived at the town ramparts, an elevated walkway atop the city walls.

And having cleared the ramparts I had to confess the sky was clearing, prior to its winding in the other shroud, night. Yes, the great cloud was ravelling, discovering here and there a pale and dying sky, and the sun, already down, was manifest in the livid tongues of fire darting towards the zenith, falling and darting again, ever more pale and languid, and doomed no sooner lit to be extinguished.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

词汇题，核心任务是根据上下文语境准确理解单词“manifest”的含义。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> And having cleared the ramparts I had to confess the sky was clearing, prior to its winding in the other shroud, night.

👉 描述作者登上城墙后观察到的天空变化，提出观点：天空开始变得明朗。

**第2句：**
> Yes, the great cloud was ravelling, discovering here and there a pale and dying sky,

👉 解释原因，说明云层正在消散，露出苍白而暗淡的天空。

**第3句：**
> and the sun, already down, was manifest in the livid tongues of fire darting towards the zenith, falling and darting again, ever more pale and languid, and doomed no sooner lit to be extinguished.

👉 举例说明，描绘太阳虽然已落，但依然清晰可见，其光芒如火舌般明灭，渐趋暗淡。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                     | 逻辑功能           |
|:---------|:------------------------|:------------------|
| 第一句   | 天空开始变得明朗         | 提出观点           |
| 第二句   | 云层消散，露出苍白天空   | 解释原因           |
| 第三句   | 太阳虽落但依然清晰可见   | 举例描写，细节说明 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> Situated

“Manifest”在文中形容太阳的状态，指太阳清晰可见，而非“位于某处”。文中说太阳“manifest in the livid tongues of fire”，意指太阳的光芒显现出来，不是位置描述。【偷换概念】

**B 选项** ✅
> Perceptible

文中“manifest”强调太阳虽然已落但仍能被看见，其光芒“darting... ever more pale and languid”，说明太阳“manifest”即“可感知的、显现的”，符合语境。

**C 选项** ❌
> Realized

“Realized”意为“实现”，不符合太阳在此处的描述。太阳并非“实现”了什么，而是“显现”出来。【无中生有】

**D 选项** ❌
> Dwindling

虽然文中提到太阳光芒“ever more pale and languid”，确实在减弱，但“manifest”本身指“显现”，而非“逐渐减少”。“dwindling”是描述状态变化，不是“manifest”的含义。【方向相反】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 观察“manifest”所在句中描述太阳的光芒“darting towards the zenith... ever more pale and languid”，关键词“already down”（太阳已落）和“manifest”紧密相连，提示此处“manifest”意为“显现、可感知”，而非位置、实现或衰减；结合上下文光芒的“明灭”描写，锁定“Perceptible”为正确选项，排除其他词义偏离语境。

## 题目类型说明

完形填空题，核心任务是根据上下文语境选择最符合逻辑且准确的词汇完成句子。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> In the Metropolitan Museum of Art's Costume Institute's innovative multisensory exhibit of garments and accessories spanning four centuries, an emphasis on the _____ of fashion was conveyed both by the exhibit's theme of perpetual renewal in nature and, more, subtly, by its scientific re-creations of ephemeral elements (like a fragrance worn with a dress more than a century ago).

👉 说明展览主题强调时尚的某种特质，这一特质通过“自然的永恒更新”和“科学再现短暂元素（如百年前的香水）”体现出来。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 全句 | 介绍展览强调时尚的某种特质，这一特质通过“自然的永恒更新”和“科学再现短暂元素”表现 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅
> transience

该词意为“短暂性，瞬息性”，与“perpetual renewal（永恒更新）”和“ephemeral elements（短暂元素）”高度契合，符合文中强调时尚易逝、瞬息万变的主题，逻辑严密且精准。

**B 选项** ❌
> definitiveness

意为“确定性，明确性”，与文中“永恒更新”和“短暂元素”相矛盾，主题强调的是变化和短暂，而非确定和永久。【方向相反】

**C 选项** ❌
> superficiality

意为“肤浅，表面性”，文中无提及时尚的肤浅特质，且“perpetual renewal”和“ephemeral elements”更侧重时间属性，不涉及表层深度。【无中生有】

**D 选项** ❌
> partiality

意为“偏袒，偏见”，与上下文语境无关，展览主题也未涉及偏见或选择性，只讨论时尚的某种特质。【无中生有】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于捕捉上下文中的关键词“perpetual renewal（永恒更新）”和“ephemeral elements（短暂元素）”，它们共同指向“短暂性（transience）”这一概念，排除与之相悖的选项即可锁定正确答案。注意辨别词义与文意是否匹配，防止被方向相反或无关词汇干扰。

---

| 第二句 | 指出这种归类的理由可能看似某种方式，但这种归类可能忽略了她作品风格中的细微差异。 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> pretentious（自命不凡的，做作的）

该词含义偏向负面，暗示归类理由带有做作或虚假成分，文章语气并未表达这种批评，而是讨论归类的合理性及细节忽略，故不符语境。
错误类型：【无中生有】

**B 选项** ❌
> incongruous（不协调的，不一致的）

如果理由“不协调”，则和后半句“但归类可能忽略细节”的转折关系不符，前后逻辑冲突，且句子暗示理由看似合理，转折在于忽视细节。
错误类型：【方向相反】

**C 选项** ✅
> irrefutable（无可辩驳的，不可否认的）

该词意指理由非常有力、无法反驳，符合句意：归类理由看似无可否认，但仍有忽略细节的风险，逻辑严密且衔接自然。

**D 选项** ❌
> provocative（挑衅性的，激怒人的）

理由“挑衅性”与上下文语义不符，句子无表达对归类理由激烈反应或争议的含义。
错误类型：【无中生有】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于理解句中转折“but”前后关系，前半句描述归类理由的性质，后半句指出归类可能带来的问题。正确答案应表达理由“看似合理且难以反驳”，故选“irrefutable”。识别转折词“but”帮助判断前后语义对比，排除与转折逻辑冲突的选项（如“incongruous”）。

👉 说明浪漫主义画派的特点：对主题的某种处理方式，突出美或英雄气质，同时掩盖缺陷，要求填入一个表达“突出/强调”含义的词。

**A 选项** ❌
> counteract

**B 选项** ✅
> accentuate

“accentuate”意为“强调、突出”，符合句意：浪漫主义作品“突出”主题的美或英雄气质，同时掩盖缺陷。
原文提示“while hiding all imperfection”与“accentuate their subjects' beauty or heroism”相辅相成。

**C 选项** ❌
> rectify

“rectify”意为“纠正”，不符合文意。浪漫主义不是“纠正”主题的美或英雄气质，而是强调它们。
错误类型：【无中生有】

**D 选项** ❌
> obscure

“obscure”意为“掩盖、使模糊”，与句中“while hiding all imperfection”重复，且句意为浪漫主义“突出”主题美或英雄气质，不是掩盖它们。

**第2句：**

👉 表明人形特征有助于激发人们的舒适感，但过于像人反而会引起不安，形成“恐怖谷”效应。

> engender

**C 选项** ❌

**D 选项** ❌

## 核心解题技巧

## 逐项分析选项

> assertive

**D 选项** ❌

## 核心解题技巧
