## 题目类型说明

词汇题，核心任务是根据上下文语义选择最符合语境的词填空。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> In 2016, Norway, which has strong democratic institutions, experienced an inflation rate of 3.55%, much higher than the 0.86% rate seen in Cameroon, which has relatively weak democratic institutions.

👉 描述事实对比，提出两个国家的通胀率差异及其民主机构强弱的背景。

**第2句：**
> Such a result is ____, however: Raj Desai et al. have shown that democratic institution strength tends to restrain inflationary pressures.

👉 转折句，表达上述结果与已有研究结论不符，预示填空处应为表示“异常”或“例外”的词。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                   |
|:---------|:-------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍2016年挪威和喀麦隆的通胀率对比及民主制度强弱 |
| 第二句   | 表明该结果与研究结论相悖，提示填空词应表达“异常” |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> facetious

“facetious”意为“轻浮的，滑稽的”，与句意“结果异常”无关，文中语境强调结果与预期不符，非轻浮或滑稽，属于【无中生有】。

**B 选项** ✅
> anomalous

“anomalous”意为“异常的，反常的”，恰好符合上下文“Such a result is ____”中强调该结果与普遍规律不符的含义，符合“however”转折逻辑。

**C 选项** ❌
> inexplicable

“inexplicable”意为“无法解释的”，虽然也可表达异常，但文中后面紧接研究指出民主制度一般会抑制通胀，暗示该现象不是无法解释，而是例外，故该词语气过强，属于【过度推断】。

**D 选项** ❌
> unfounded

“unfounded”意为“无根据的”，通常用来形容观点或指控不成立，不适合形容“结果”，且文中研究并未否定结果的真实性，属于【偷换概念】。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 注意转折词“however”后句子结构和含义，表明前后信息冲突，需要表达“异常”的词；结合后半句研究结论，排除语义过强或不匹配的词，锁定表示“反常”的“anomalous”。

👉 这句话介绍了musical stenography的目的，即用快速的符号记录现场表演中因演奏者即兴偏离乐谱而产生的某些特征。

## 结构总结

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> inevitable

错误原因：文中强调的是“impromptu deviations”（即兴偏离），而“inevitable”（不可避免的）侧重必然性，与“即兴”含义不符，属于【方向相反】。

**B 选项** ❌
> inconspicuous

错误原因：“inconspicuous”（不显眼的）与文中强调的“preserve... features”（保存某些特征）不匹配，且没有体现“即兴”特征，属于【无中生有】。

**C 选项** ✅
> extemporaneous

正确原因：“extemporaneous”意为“即兴的”，完美呼应了文中“impromptu deviations”（即兴偏离），语义精准且逻辑严密。

**D 选项** ❌
> meticulous

错误原因：“meticulous”（一丝不苟的）强调细致严谨，与文中“impromptu”（即兴）形成矛盾，属于【方向相反】。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于理解句中“impromptu deviations”指的是演奏者的即兴偏差，空格处应填能表达“即兴、临时”的词。选项中“extemporaneous”与“impromptu”语义相符，其他选项均因含义偏离或逻辑矛盾被排除。锁定关键词“impromptu”是解题关键。

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅（正确）
> corroborated

“corroborated”意为“证实，支持”，符合上下文Schwartz通过数字分析来支持两张脸的相似性论断。与句意高度匹配。

**B 选项** ❌（错误）

**C 选项** ❌（错误）
> promulgated

“promulgated”意为“公布，传播”，不符合上下文中数字分析的作用，数字分析是用来证实观点，而非传播观点。【无中生有】

**D 选项** ❌（错误）
> consolidated

“consolidated”意为“巩固，强化”，虽然有支持的意思，但通常指加强已有的立场或力量，不如“corroborated”精确表达“证实证据”的意思，且用法不够准确。【偷换概念】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关键词“by subjecting both works to digital analysis”（通过数字分析）暗示这一行为是为了“证实”两者的相似性，需选表达“证实、支持”含义的词。选项中“corroborated”是学术论文和证据论证中常用的表达，精准匹配逻辑。其余选项要么意义偏离，要么用法不当，利用词义精准度和上下文搭配排除错误选项。

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 描述两股风相遇冲突，争夺“mastery”，暗示争夺控制权或支配权。 |
| 第二句 | 具体描写陆地风的冷冽和气味，营造环境氛围。 |

## 逐项分析选项

**B 选项** ✅

“meet and conflict as though each strove for the mastery of the air”明确暗示两股风争夺对空气的支配权，最符合“domination”的含义。

**C 选项** ❌

文中无任何信息表明风对空气的“理解”，而是强调冲突和争夺，故此选项不符。【无中生有】

**D 选项** ❌
> Skillfulness（熟练，技巧）

“mastery”在此指的是对空气的控制或统治，不是技巧或熟练程度，故此选项错误。【偷换概念】

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于捕捉句中“meet and conflict as though each strove for the mastery of the air”中“conflict”（冲突）和“strove”（努力争取）表达的竞争关系，暗示“mastery”是“支配”或“统治”的意思，从而排除表达“熟悉”“理解”“技巧”的选项，锁定“domination”。

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> The ____ of horse populations across Eurasia today reflects the competitive advantages of the highly mobile DOM2 breed that emerged through domestication and selective breeding in the 3rd millennium BCE.

👉 这句话提出观点，说明马群的某种特征反映了DOM2品种的竞争优势。

**第2句：**
> DOM2 spread quickly and extensively, completely supplanting other horse breeds in places like El Acequión, Spain, and Hohler Stein bei Schwabthal, Germany, by the end of the 2nd millennium BCE.

👉 这句话解释原因，说明DOM2品种快速扩散并完全取代其他品种。

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                                         |

| 第一句   | 说明马群的某种特征反映了DOM2品种的竞争优势                   |

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> profusion（大量，丰富）

错误原因：profusion强调数量多，但文中重点是DOM2取代其他品种，体现的是单一品种的普遍性，而非数量众多。【方向相反】

**B 选项** ✅
> homogeneity（同质性，单一性）

正确原因：文章强调DOM2取代其他品种，导致马群变得单一，体现了“同质性”，符合“reflects the competitive advantages”这一因果关系。

**C 选项** ❌
> ubiquity（普遍存在，无处不在）

错误原因：虽然DOM2“spread quickly and extensively”，但“ubiquity”侧重普遍存在，并未准确表达种群内部的统一性。【以偏概全】

**D 选项** ❌
> variability（变异性，多样性）

错误原因：文中强调DOM2取代其他品种，说明多样性降低，与variability含义相反。【方向相反】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 通过后文“completely supplanting other horse breeds”判断，空白处应表达品种的单一化趋势；关键词“competitive advantages”提示因果关系，锁定强调“同质性”（homogeneity）而非数量或多样性，从而排除强调数量（profusion）、普遍存在（ubiquity）和多样性（variability）的选项。

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**

👉 说明玩家对数据收集有一定认知且愿意以隐私为代价换取乐趣。

**第2句：**
> But the games are often quite _____ about what data they collect and why.

👉 转折句，指出游戏公司在数据收集方面的态度或表现存在问题，需填入形容词描述这种状态。

**第3句：**
> Because of this, data-privacy advocates are seeking to expand online players' knowledge of data collection practices and improve their ability to navigate privacy-setting features in games.

👉 因果关系，说明正因为游戏公司在数据收集上的态度问题，隐私保护倡导者努力提高玩家的相关认知和操作能力。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                                         |
|:---------|:-------------------------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 玩家知道游戏会收集数据，愿意为乐趣牺牲部分隐私               |
| 第二句   | 转折，指出游戏公司在数据收集方面的态度问题（需填词）         |
| 第三句   | 因果，隐私倡导者试图提升玩家对数据收集的认知和隐私设置能力   |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅
> opaque

“opaque”意为“不透明的，难以理解的”，符合上下文中“游戏公司在数据收集方面态度不明确或不公开”的语境，且第3句指出“正因为此，隐私倡导者需要增强玩家认知”，与“不透明”逻辑吻合。

**B 选项** ❌
> ambivalent

“ambivalent”意为“矛盾的，态度不定的”，文中并未暗示游戏公司对数据收集感到矛盾或犹豫，只是说态度不明确，且“ambivalent”侧重内心矛盾，不符合“外在表现不透明”的语境。
错误类型：【方向相反】

**C 选项** ❌
> abrasive

“abrasive”意为“粗鲁的，伤人感情的”，与句意不符，句中谈论的是数据收集的态度和透明度，而非态度粗暴。
错误类型：【无中生有】

**D 选项** ❌
> outspoken

“outspoken”意为“直言不讳的，坦率的”，与上下文“游戏公司态度不明确，导致隐私倡导者介入”的逻辑相反。
错误类型：【方向相反】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关注转折词“But”引出游戏公司态度问题，结合因果句“Because of this”说明问题是“态度不透明”，从而锁定含义为“不透明、难以理解”的词“opaque”，同时排除与“不明确”相反或无关的选项，如“outspoken”“abrasive”等。

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Difficulties of documenting nocturnal pollinator visits and a general focus on diurnal invertebrate pollinators, such as *Volucella bombylans*, have resulted in ___ of information on nocturnal moth pollination of plants such as *Rubus fruticosus* L. aggregate, but Max Anderson et al. have addressed this by utilizing infrared technology.

👉 说明由于记录夜间传粉者困难和普遍关注白天传粉者，导致了关于夜间蛾类传粉的信息出现缺乏，但Max Anderson等人通过红外技术解决了这个问题。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                             |
|:---------|:--------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 说明夜间传粉者研究难度和白天传粉者的研究偏重，导致夜间蛾类传粉信息不足，但通过红外技术得到解决。 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> an abatement

“abatement”意为减少、减轻，语义偏向减少某种负面状态，不符合“信息不足”的表达。文中语境是“信息的缺乏”，而非“信息的减少”，属于【偷换概念】。

**B 选项** ❌
> an aggregation

“aggregation”意为聚集、集合，和信息不足相反，语义方向错误。文中强调信息“缺乏”，非“聚集”，属于【方向相反】。

**C 选项** ✅
> a dearth

“dearth”意为缺乏、稀缺，符合句意，表示由于困难和研究偏重，导致夜间蛾类传粉“信息缺乏”，最精准贴切。

**D 选项** ❌
> a dissonance

“dissonance”意为不和谐、不一致，与句意不符，文中讨论的是信息量不足，不是信息冲突，属于【无中生有】。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关键在于理解句中“have resulted in ___ of information”结构，后面需填入表达“信息缺乏”的词。注意上下文中强调“困难”和“关注偏重”导致的信息“不足”，排除与“减少”、“聚集”、“不一致”等含义不符的选项，锁定表示“缺乏”的“dearth”。此外，转折词“but”引出解决方案，强调之前存在问题，更加确定了“信息不足”的语境。

**第2句：**

| 第二句 | 现代鸟类也有类似结构，古生物学家据此将鸟类呼吸系统视为恐龙呼吸系统的某种对应或代表。 |

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> harbingers of（…的先驱/预兆）

“harbingers”意为“预兆”或“先驱”，强调时间上的先后关系，文章中是现代鸟类的结构，而恐龙是古老的，时间顺序相反，且文中强调的是结构对应而非预示关系。

**B 选项** ❌
> emissaries for（…的使者）

“emissaries”指“使者”，强调传递信息或代表他人行动，语义不符合生物结构的对应关系，且文中无“代表传递”之意。
错误类型：【无中生有】

**C 选项** ❌
> subordinates of（…的下属/从属）

“subordinates”强调从属关系，暗示鸟类呼吸系统在某种等级或权力结构中处于下位，与文中描述的科学比较无关。
错误类型：【偷换概念】

**D 选项** ✅
> proxies for（…的代表/替代物）

“proxies”意为“代表”或“替代物”，符合文意中“鸟类呼吸系统作为恐龙呼吸系统的代表”的逻辑。文中用现代鸟类结构推断古恐龙结构，故此选最贴切。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关注句中因果关系词“which is why”引出古生物学家对鸟类呼吸系统的看法，结合上下文“结构相似”提示两者存在对应关系；排除强调时间、等级或角色的选项，锁定表达“代表、对应”关系的“proxies”。

## 文章逻辑拆解

**D 选项** ✅

“abated”意为“减弱、减少”，符合句意“随着非石油能源使用增加，油价冲击与经济活动的关系减弱”，且第二句研究结果呼应该词含义。

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关注句中因果关系词“as”和句尾句号前的空格提示，结合后文“effect... was only slightly greater than zero”判断影响趋势。关键词“increased”对应影响应“减弱（abated）”，排除含义相反或无关选项。转折和递进逻辑帮助锁定答案。

## 题目类型说明

完形填空题，核心任务是根据上下文语境选择最符合语义且逻辑连贯的词语完成句子。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Despite stated claims of the ______ of the research, much analysis of income inequality performed in the 2010s suffered from a myopic focus on a few countries in North America and Western Europe, partly due to limited data availability.

👉 说明研究声称具备某种特质，但实际上存在局限，导致研究集中在少数几个国家。

**第2句：**
> Researchers would later remedy this shortcoming after gaining new access to administrative records located in nations in Africa, such as Ivory Coast, and Eastern Europe, such as Poland.

👉 说明研究者后来通过获取更多国家的数据，弥补了之前研究的不足。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 介绍研究声称具备某特质，但实际研究局限于少数国家，原因是数据有限。 |
| 第二句 | 说明研究者后来通过新数据弥补了研究局限。 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> novelty（新颖性）

文中强调研究被批评局限于少数国家，说明并非强调“新颖性”，而是研究范围的问题，且后文强调弥补局限，说明研究不是因为新颖而被批评。
错误类型：【无中生有】

**B 选项** ❌
> immutability（不可变性）

研究被批评焦点狭窄，且后文提到“弥补”这一缺陷，说明研究内容是可变的，不符合“immutability”含义。
错误类型：【方向相反】

**C 选项** ✅
> exhaustiveness（全面性）

文中说“尽管声称……”，但实际分析局限于少数国家，表明研究声称具有全面性，但实际上不够全面，后文说通过新数据弥补，逻辑一致。
符合“stated claims of the exhaustiveness”意为“尽管声称研究全面”，与上下文逻辑吻合。

**D 选项** ❌
> pervasiveness（普遍性）

研究的普遍性并非上下文重点，文中强调的是覆盖面和数据范围，而非普遍存在性，且弥补的是覆盖范围，不是普遍性。
错误类型：【以偏概全】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关注句首“Despite stated claims of the ______”，提示空白处为研究所声称的特点；紧接着的转折“Despite”强调实际情况与声称不符，结合后文“suffered from a myopic focus”和“remedy this shortcoming”，可判断此处应填表示“全面性”的词，排除表示“新颖性”、“不可变性”、“普遍性”的选项，锁定“exhaustiveness”最符合语境。

**第1句：**
> It is tempting to treat the clustering of car manufacturing firms in Detroit, Michigan, as representative of industrial agglomeration generally,

👉 说明一种常见的倾向或误区，即人们容易将底特律汽车制造企业的聚集视为工业集聚的典型代表。

**第2句：**
> but Giulia Faggio et al. caution against _____ this one example:

👉 转折，提出警告或反对意见，强调不应轻易用这个例子来推断整体情况。

**第3句：**
> the existence of labor pools, a dominant driver of collocation in this industry, was largely absent from the game and toy manufacturing industry.

👉 解释原因，指出汽车行业集聚的主要驱动力“劳动力池”在其他行业（如玩具制造业）中并不存在，暗示不能简单类比。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 指出人们倾向于将底特律汽车制造业的集聚视为工业集聚的普遍代表。 |
| 第二句 | 转折，引用学者警告不要以此单一例子做泛化。 |
| 第三句 | 解释警告原因，指出劳动力池驱动在其他行业缺失，说明不能简单套用。 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> convening with

“convening with”意为“召集、集合”，语义与句中“caution against”搭配不合，也不能表达“不要以此例泛化”之意。此处需表达“反对基于此例推断整体”，A项偏离语境。【方向相反】

**B 选项** ✅
> extrapolating from

“extrapolating from”意为“从……推断/外推”，与句中“caution against”搭配恰当，符合文意警告不要“从这个例子推断整体情况”，且后文通过举例说明原因，支撑此选项正确。

**C 选项** ❌
> corroborating

“corroborating”意为“证实”，与“caution against”语义矛盾，句意不通，文中意在警告不要轻易推广，而非证实。【方向相反】

**D 选项** ❌
> scrutinizing

“scrutinizing”意为“仔细审查”，文中表达的是警告不要基于此例做泛化，不是说不要审查，语义不符。【无中生有】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关注转折词“but”和动词短语“caution against”，提示后半句表达反对或警告，且结合句尾解释说明“不应简单以此例推断”，“extrapolating from”符合“推断”语境，迅速排除其他选项的语义不符或搭配不当，从而锁定正确答案B。

## 题目类型说明

这是词汇题，核心任务是选择一个最符合上下文语境且逻辑精准的动词填空。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Until 1917, there was no formal measure in the United States Senate that could be _____ to end a debate that had been excessively prolonged as a tactic to block voting on a matter.

👉 说明在1917年前，参议院没有正式的措施用来结束被拖延的辩论。

**第2句：**
> In that year, a procedure was created to allow a majority of senators to curtail deliberation and force a vote.

👉 说明1917年制定了一个程序，允许多数参议员限制讨论并强制投票。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                     |
|:---------|:----------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 说明1917年前没有正式措施可以结束拖延辩论 |
| 第二句   | 说明1917年制定了新程序以限制辩论并强制投票 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> partitioned

“partitioned”意为“划分”，与结束辩论没有逻辑联系，且句意为“用某措施结束辩论”，此词不符合语境。
错误类型：【无中生有】

**B 选项** ❌
> improvised

“improvised”意为“即兴的”，强调临时性，语义与“正式措施”不符，且文中强调“formal measure（正式措施）”，因此不合适。
错误类型：【方向相反】

**C 选项** ❌
> abolished

“abolished”意为“废除”，原句是指“用某措施来结束辩论”，而不是“废除”辩论，且“abolish debate”搭配不自然。
错误类型：【偷换概念】

**D 选项** ✅
> invoked

“invoked”意为“调用、援引”，符合句意，即“可以调用正式措施来结束辩论”，与后文“procedure was created to allow...curtail deliberation”语义一致。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关键在于理解句意“用某措施结束辩论”，动词需表达“调用/启用”含义，且与“formal measure”搭配；“invoked”符合语义及搭配习惯。排除无相关或语义不符的选项，锁定正确答案。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> A conclusive demonstration of the logical certainty of the honeycomb conjecture, posed in the first century BCE, ______ mathematicians’ efforts until Thomas C. Hales presented the first valid proof of the conjecture in 1999.

👉 该句主干表明蜂巢猜想自古代提出以来，直到1999年首次有效证明之前，与数学家的努力之间存在某种关系，空白处需要填入一个动词，描述这段时间的状态。

## 结构总结

|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 阐述蜂巢猜想自公元前一世纪提出以来，直到1999年首次有效证明之前，数学家们的努力与之关系密切，空缺动词需表达这种关系 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅
> defied

“defied”意为“违抗，反抗”，这里表达“蜂巢猜想的逻辑确定性证明长期未被数学家攻克”，符合句意。原文中“直到1999年首次有效证明”暗示此前证明一直未被完成，数学家努力未能成功，故用“defied”最贴切。

**B 选项** ❌
> prefigured

“prefigured”意为“预示，预兆”，与句意不符。句中强调的是证明未被实现，而非预示某事发生。【方向相反】

**C 选项** ❌
> epitomized

“epitomized”意为“成为…的典范”，与句中描述“长期未被完成”的含义冲突，且语义不符。【无中生有】

**D 选项** ❌
> displaced

“displaced”意为“取代，替换”，与句意无关，句子强调的是证明未被实现，而非被取代。【无中生有】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关键在于理解句中“until Thomas C. Hales presented the first valid proof”表示此前一直未实现证明，动词需表达“未被攻克”的状态，故“defied”（反抗、未被攻破）最符合逻辑；其他选项要么语义相反，要么与上下文不符，通过“until”这一转折时间词锁定正确答案。

## 题目类型说明

这是词汇填空题，核心任务是选择一个最符合语境且逻辑严密的词语，完成句子，使上下文关系清晰且符合因果或相关逻辑。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> During the 2007–2010 financial crisis, the United States furnished billions of dollars to selected countries' central banks via mechanisms called swap lines.

👉 说明背景事实，介绍美国通过swap lines向部分国家中央银行提供资金。

**第2句：**
> Aditi Sahasrabuddhe found that countries' policy environments seem to have been _____ swap-line decisions: the probability that banks would be granted swap lines was 0.20 in countries open to foreign-capital inflows and 0.03 in countries with policies restricting such inflows.

👉 说明研究发现，国家的政策环境与swap line决策之间存在某种关系，并用概率数据具体说明政策环境对决策的影响。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                   |
|:---------|:-------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍美国在金融危机期间通过swap lines向部分国家中央银行提供资金。 |
| 第二句   | 介绍研究发现政策环境与swap line决策的关系，并给出具体概率数据。 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅
> material to

“material to”意为“对……重要的，有实质影响的”，与句意完全吻合：政策环境对swap line决策有实质影响，符合后文概率差异说明的逻辑。原文强调不同政策环境导致不同概率，说明政策环境对决策“重要且相关”。

**B 选项** ❌
> mediated by

“mediated by”意为“被……中介、调节”，暗示政策环境是决策的中介环节，但原文并无中介逻辑，仅说明政策环境与决策直接相关，非通过第三方调节。【无中生有】

**C 选项** ❌
> decoupled from

“decoupled from”意为“与……无关”，与后文概率差异完全矛盾，原文显示政策环境与决策有明显联系，概率差异说明两者紧密相关。【方向相反】

**D 选项** ❌
> predicated on

“predicated on”意为“以……为基础”，表明决策完全基于政策环境，但文中只说“seem to have been _____”，且概率差异显示相关性，不是完全依赖，过度强调因果关系。【过度推断】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题核心在于准确理解句中“countries' policy environments”和“swap-line decisions”的关系，注意概率对比说明“政策环境对决策有重要影响”，故选“material to”最合适。转折词“seem to have been”提示对关系的估计，排除过于绝对或方向相反的选项。理解固定搭配“material to”与“predicated on”的细微差别，避免“mediated by”引入无文中支持的中介逻辑。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> The 2023 anthology *The Big Book of Cyberpunk* contains 108 stories, including Fritz Leiber's "Coming Attraction" (1950) and Erica Satifka's "Act of Providence" (2021).

👉 介绍2023年选集《The Big Book of Cyberpunk》及其涵盖的故事数量和时间跨度，提出其内容丰富且时间跨度长。

**第2句：**
> With its chronological scope, it is more comprehensive than the much shorter 1986 cyberpunk anthology *Mirrorshades*,

👉 说明该选集因时间跨度而比1986年的《Mirrorshades》更加全面。

**第3句：**
> but *Mirrorshades'* careful selection of stories makes that anthology more ______.

👉 转折句，指出《Mirrorshades》虽然篇幅短，但因故事选择谨慎而在某方面优于前者，需要补全描述其特点的词。

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                     |
|:---------|:----------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍2023年选集内容和时间跨度             |
| 第二句   | 对比两选集，强调2023年选集更全面         |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> capacious（容量大的，宽敞的）

此词强调容量或范围，与文中"careful selection"形成的对比不符，文意强调《Mirrorshades》因挑选而更有价值，非容量大。【方向相反】

**B 选项** ❌
> outmoded（过时的）

文中无任何暗示《Mirrorshades》过时，且“careful selection”通常带正面含义，故此词不符语境。【无中生有】

**C 选项** ❌
> cursory（粗略的，草率的）

与“careful selection”完全相反，文中强调《Mirrorshades》故事选择精心，此词不符。【方向相反】

**D 选项** ✅
> discerning（有鉴赏力的，眼光敏锐的）

“careful selection”对应“discerning”表示选择有眼光，符合文中逻辑转折，强调《Mirrorshades》因精选故事而更具品味和辨识度。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于转折连词“but”和短语“careful selection”提示对比的方向，表示虽然篇幅短但选得精。选项要表达“有鉴赏力的”或“精选的”含义，排除与“careful”含义相反的词（如cursory）和无关词（如capacious、outmoded）。锁定D选项“discerning”准确对应文章逻辑。

**第1句：**

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅
> preceded

**C 选项** ❌
> supplanted

“supplanted”意为“取代”，暗示作品取代了丰富的文学历史，这与文章强调的文学传承和影响明显矛盾。【方向相反】

**D 选项** ❌
> overlooked

“overlooked”意为“忽视”，表明作品忽视了丰富的文学历史，与文章整体肯定传统和影响的语气完全相反。【方向相反】

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于理解动词需表达作品与“丰富文学历史”之间的传承或影响关系，且第二句通过具体传统故事和作家举例强化这一点。词义对比中，preceded（先于、受影响）最符合上下文语境，其他选项均与传承关系相悖，从而快速排除。注意辨别表示传承（preceded）与表示取代（supplanted）、忽视（overlooked）或总结（summarized）的区别。

## 题目类型说明

完形填空题，核心任务是根据上下文语境和逻辑关系，选择最合适的词语完成句子。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> The plaice is ectothermic, or cold-blooded, and the southern bluefin tuna is a regional endotherm, meaning that parts of its body are typically warmer than the surrounding water.

👉 介绍两种鱼类的体温调节方式，分别定义冷血动物和区域温血动物。

**第2句：**
> The basking shark had been classified as a full ectotherm, a position that became ____ after researchers Haley R. Dolton and colleagues showed that the basking shark's body temperature is consistently 1.0 to 1.5°C warmer than the water.

👉 说明“basking shark”原先被认为是全冷血动物，但此观点因新研究发现其体温高于水温而发生变化。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                                       |
|:---------|:----------------------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍plaice为冷血动物，bluefin tuna为部分体温高于水的区域温血动物 |
| 第二句   | 介绍basking shark原被视为冷血动物，但新研究显示其体温高于水温，导致该观点发生变化 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> inconsolable（无法安慰的）

该词意为“无法安慰的”，与句意“观点发生变化”无关，属于【无中生有】。

**B 选项** ✅
> untenable（站不住脚的）

文中指出原先分类“basking shark为全冷血动物”的观点因新证据被挑战，故“untenable”（站不住脚的）最符合语境。

**C 选项** ❌
> unequivocal（明确的）

该词意为“明确的”，与句意“观点被推翻”相反，属于【方向相反】。

**D 选项** ❌
> unanticipated（未预料到的）

虽然研究结果可能出乎意料，但空格前主语是“a position”（观点），其“become unanticipated”不符合习惯搭配，且句意强调观点不再成立，属于【偷换概念】。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 观察句中关键词“a position that became ____ after researchers showed...”，后半句给出新证据推翻旧观点，暗示空格词应表达“观点站不住脚”或“被推翻”的意思。排除情感词和表达“明确”或“未预料到”的词，锁定逻辑性强的词“untenable”。

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Quantitative analysis of vast historical data sets and other tools of abstraction allow historians to examine broad phenomena, but such methods ____ the particularity of individual actors.

👉 这句话提出对比观点：量化分析和抽象工具能研究宏观现象，但缺点是影响个体细节的呈现。

**第2句：**
> By focusing on singular individuals and incidents in exhaustive detail, Paul Seaver's *Wallington's World* and other microhistories aim to show how broader phenomena were experienced at a human level.

👉 这句话通过举例说明微观史学通过细致描写个体来弥补宏观分析的不足。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                           |
|:---------|:------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 说明量化分析能看宏观但忽略个体 |
| 第二句   | 举例微观史学关注个体细节，弥补不足 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> misconstrue（误解）

“misconstrue”意为“误解”，文中强调的是宏观方法对个体“细节”的影响，强调的是“抹去”或“忽视”个体特性，而非“误解”。此处语义不符。
错误类型：`【方向相反】`

**B 选项** ✅
> efface（抹去，消除）

“efface”意为“抹去、消除”，符合句意：量化方法虽然能研究宏观现象，但“抹去了”个体的特殊性。与后文微观史学“细致描写个体”形成对比，语义精准且逻辑通顺。

**C 选项** ❌
> exempt（免除）

“exempt”意为“免除”，语义偏离文意，无法表达宏观方法对个体细节的影响。
错误类型：`【无中生有】`

**D 选项** ❌
> accentuate（强调）

“accentuate”意为“强调”，与句中“but”转折逻辑冲突，文意是宏观方法忽视个体，选“强调”与上下文矛盾。
错误类型：`【方向相反】`

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于识别转折词“but”，前半句讲宏观方法的优势，后半句必须表达其缺点，即“忽视”或“抹去”个体特性；结合后文微观史学“细节描写”形成对比，排除语义相反或无关选项，锁定“efface”最符合语境。

## 题目类型说明

完形填空题，核心任务是根据上下文语义和逻辑选择最合适的词语完成句子，使句意通顺且准确。

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Any effort to raise the toll that drivers must pay to use the Lewis and Clark Bridge, which spans the Ohio River to connect Indiana and Kentucky, should explain why a higher toll is necessary;

👉 说明提出提高收费的努力需要给出合理解释，是对提高收费行为的条件设定。

**第2句：**
> no amount of justification, however, is likely to persuade some drivers who believe the current toll is ______.

👉 表明无论如何解释，都无法说服那些认为当前收费“某种状态”的司机，起到转折和限定效果。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                              |
|:---------|:---------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 提出提高收费应说明合理性           |
| 第二句   | 但无法说服认为当前收费“某种状态”的司机 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅（正确）
> exorbitant（过高的，过分的）

文中指出无论如何解释都无法说服那些认为当前收费“过高”的司机，符合逻辑，且“exorbitant”常用来形容“收费过高”，契合语境。

**B 选项** ❌（错误）
> contentious（有争议的，引起争论的）

文中强调司机的态度是“坚信收费是……”，而非“收费本身引起争论”，且“contentious”强调争论性，不符合“无论如何劝说都无法改变看法”的语境。【方向相反】

**C 选项** ❌（错误）
> equivocal（模棱两可的，含糊的）

收费本身是具体事实，不可能模糊不清；且句意是司机“坚信”而非“模糊不清”，不符语境。【无中生有】

**D 选项** ❌（错误）
> warranted（合理的，有理由的）

若司机认为收费“合理”，则不会无论如何劝说都无法说服，因为他们本就认同收费合理，逻辑矛盾。【方向相反】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关注转折词“however”引出转折语义，句意为“无论如何解释，都说服不了那些坚信收费过高的司机”，锁定描述负面评价且表示“过高”的词“exorbitant”；排除语义相反或不符合语境的选项。

## 题目类型说明

这是词汇题，核心任务是根据上下文逻辑选择一个最合适且精准的词语填入空白处，使句意连贯且符合文意。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Because cyanobacteria and other microphytobenthos (MPB)—microscopic organisms inhabiting tidal flats—are consumed by mussels as well as by certain shorebirds and fish, MPB are ___ estuary ecosystems.

👉 说明因果关系：指出MPB被多种生物食用，因此它们在河口生态系统中具有某种重要地位。

**第2句：**
> Decreased MPB abundance, which may be caused by environmental stressors, thus has a direct, negative impact on coastal food webs.

👉 进一步解释MPB数量减少会对沿海食物网造成直接负面影响，强调MPB的重要性。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                 |
|:---------|:------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | MPB被多种生物食用，因此它们在河口生态系统中非常重要。|
| 第二句   | MPB数量减少会直接影响沿海食物网，说明其重要性。   |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅
> imperative for

“imperative for”意为“对……来说是必不可少的”，完全符合句中MPB被多种生物食用且数量减少会影响食物网的逻辑，强调MPB对生态系统的重要性。原文中“Decreased MPB abundance... has a direct, negative impact”直接支持这一点。

**B 选项** ❌
> emblematic of

“emblematic of”意为“象征性的”，但句中强调的是MPB对生态系统的功能和重要性，而非象征意义，属于【无中生有】。

**C 选项** ❌
> subordinate to

“subordinate to”意为“从属于”，与文中MPB对生态系统的核心作用相反，属于【方向相反】。

**D 选项** ❌
> interchangeable with

“interchangeable with”意为“可互换的”，文中并无MPB可被替代的意思，且减少MPB数量有负面影响，说明不可替代，属于【过度推断】。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关键词“Because... are consumed by...”，“Decreased MPB abundance... has a direct, negative impact”构建了因果关系，强调MPB对生态系统的不可缺少性，故选择表达“必不可少”的“imperative for”，排除其他词义偏离或不符合因果逻辑的选项。

## 题目类型说明

词汇题，核心任务是根据上下文语境选择最恰当的词填空，确保句意连贯且逻辑合理。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Using data from Argentina and nineteen other countries, Filazzola et al. compared sites where livestock grazing is active with sites where it has been eliminated.

👉 介绍研究背景和方法，说明研究对象和比较内容。

**第2句：**
> They found that wild-animal abundance positively correlated with duration of grazer exclusion,

👉 报告研究发现，野生动物数量与禁牧时间正相关。

**第3句：**
> indicating that following the removal of livestock (e.g., cattle), one adverse effect on co-occurring animal species imposed by grazing livestock may _____ over time.

👉 推论说明：随着家畜被移除，牧草放牧对共存动物的不良影响可能会随时间发生某种变化。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                             |
|:---------|:------------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍研究方法和比较对象（有牧草放牧与无放牧的地点） |
| 第二句   | 发现野生动物数量与禁牧时间正相关                  |
| 第三句   | 推论：禁牧后牧草放牧对动物的不良影响可能随时间发生变化 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> abound

“abound”意为“大量存在”，与句中“不良影响随时间变化”语境不符。原文强调“不良影响可能随时间消退”，用“abound”则表示不良影响增多，方向相反。
错误类型：【方向相反】

**B 选项** ❌
> emanate

“emanate”意为“发出，散发”，通常指气味、光线等，不适用于描述“不良影响”随时间的变化，语义不精确且不符合上下文。
错误类型：【无中生有】

**C 选项** ✅
> abate

“abate”意为“减轻，减弱”，与文中“不良影响随时间减少”逻辑吻合，且与前文“wild-animal abundance positively correlated with duration of grazer exclusion”相呼应，说明禁牧时间越长，不良影响越减轻，野生动物越多。

**D 选项** ❌
> prevail

“prevail”意为“盛行，占优势”，表示不良影响持续存在或占主导地位，与文意“不良影响减少”相反。
错误类型：【方向相反】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题核心在于理解句中“wild-animal abundance positively correlated with duration of grazer exclusion”说明禁牧时间越长，野生动物越多，暗示牧草放牧带来的不良影响应随时间减弱。因而选项要表达“减少”或“减弱”的含义，利用因果关系和关键词“may _____ over time”锁定表示“减轻”的“abate”，排除表达相反或不符合语境的选项。

## 题目类型说明

词汇题，核心任务是根据上下文语境选择最符合逻辑和语义的词汇填空。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Yuen Yuen Ang et al. argue that merely tallying the number of patents filed per year ______ the degree of innovation occurring: truly novel patents—those, like a 2011 patent for an automated navigation system for planes, that combine previously unaffiliated technological domains—are vastly outnumbered by nonnovel patents (e.g., a 2008 patent for a method of making soup).

👉 提出观点并对“仅仅统计专利数量”这一做法与创新程度之间的关系进行说明和限定。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                                         |
|:---------|:-------------------------------------------------------------|
| 全句     | 论述仅仅统计专利数目不能准确反映创新程度，并举例说明真正新颖的专利被大量非新颖专利所淹没。 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅
> belies

“belies”意为“掩饰/与…不符”，符合文意中“仅统计专利数量不能真实反映创新程度”的含义。文中“truly novel patents... are vastly outnumbered”说明数量统计与创新程度不符，故用“belies”最合适。

**B 选项** ❌
> portends

“portends”意为“预示”，文中并无预测未来的含义，且句意为指出统计数量与创新程度不符，非预测关系。【方向相反】

**C 选项** ❌
> thwart

“thwart”意为“阻碍”，句中并非说统计数量阻碍创新，而是统计方法与创新程度不符。【无中生有】

**D 选项** ❌
> maligns

“maligns”意为“诽谤”，文中无负面攻击或诋毁含义，【无中生有】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 词汇题中重点关注句中转折结构和因果关系，“merely tallying... ______ the degree”提示空格处应为表达“掩盖/不准确反映”之意的词。对比选项语义，“belies”符合“表面与真实不符”的语境，其他选项多涉及预测、阻碍或诽谤，均不符合句意。通过句中“truly novel patents... are vastly outnumbered”这一事实支撑，锁定“belies”为最佳答案。

## 题目类型说明

完形填空题，核心任务是根据上下文语境选择最合适且逻辑连贯的词语填空。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Lady Grant and colleagues ____ pots of sterilized soil with slurries of live microbes collected from soil in five sites across Colorado, including areas of sagebrush and ponderosa pine forest.

👉 描述实验步骤，说明研究人员对灭菌土壤进行了某种处理，目的是引入活微生物。

**第2句：**
> Grant and team then grew mustard plants in the pots to see if the different microbial slurries affected levels of spicy glucosinolates like butenyl in the plants' seeds.

👉 说明实验目的，即检测不同微生物混悬液对芥菜种子中辣味成分的影响。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                             |
|:---------|:--------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍研究人员对灭菌土壤进行处理，引入微生物混悬液 |
| 第二句   | 说明实验目的是观察微生物对植物化学成分的影响   |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> precluded

“precluded”意为“阻止、排除”，与句意不符。句中强调向土壤“添加”微生物，非阻止或排除。
错误类型：【方向相反】

**B 选项** ❌
> estimated

“estimated”意为“估计”，与对土壤的操作动作无关，语义不搭配。
错误类型：【无中生有】

**C 选项** ❌
> sanitized

“sanitized”意为“消毒”，但文中土壤已是“sterilized”（灭菌），此处动作应是对灭菌土壤进行“加入”微生物，非再次消毒。
错误类型：【方向相反】

**D 选项** ✅
> populated

“populated”意为“使…居住、填充”，符合“用活微生物混悬液填充灭菌土壤”的语境，逻辑和语义最准确。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 重点关注句中实验步骤的动作逻辑，已知土壤是“sterilized”，下一步应是“加入微生物”，因此选择表示“填充、引入”的动词“populated”；排除语义不符或与上下文动作不连贯的选项。关键词“sterilized soil”与“live microbes”构成因果关系，帮助锁定答案。

## 题目类型说明

完形填空题，核心任务是根据上下文逻辑关系选择最合适的词语完成句子，使句意连贯且符合因果关系。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> For most of its length, the Pungue River has sufficiently high flow velocity to suspend sedimentary particles,

👉 说明河流的大部分河段流速足够高，能够悬浮沉积颗粒（提出背景事实）。

**第2句：**
> but when the river reaches the calmer waters of the Indian Ocean, its channel widens and divides, reducing flow velocity and thereby _____ sedimentary particle suspension.

👉 说明河流到达印度洋水域时，河道变宽分叉导致流速降低，从而对沉积颗粒悬浮产生某种影响（转折并引出因果关系）。

**第3句：**
> Particles are thus deposited, eventually forming deltaic lobes.

👉 说明由于上述变化，颗粒沉积，最终形成三角洲（因果结果）。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                         |
|:---------|:--------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍河流流速高，能悬浮沉积颗粒               |
| 第二句   | 河流入海后河道变宽流速降低，从而对悬浮产生影响 |
| 第三句   | 颗粒沉积形成三角洲                             |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> compounding（加重，复合）

文中是说流速降低，导致沉积颗粒悬浮的某种变化，悬浮应该减少而非加重。选项含义与文意方向相反。
错误类型：【方向相反】

**B 选项** ❌
> obscuring（遮蔽，模糊）

“遮蔽悬浮”语义不通，悬浮不是视觉现象，且文中描述的是流速降低对悬浮的影响，非“模糊”或“遮蔽”。
错误类型：【无中生有】

**C 选项** ✅
> interrupting（中断，停止）

流速降低导致沉积颗粒悬浮被中断，符合句意“降低流速，从而中断悬浮”，使颗粒沉积。与后文颗粒沉积形成三角洲逻辑吻合。

**D 选项** ❌
> expediting（加快，促进）

流速降低不可能加快沉积颗粒悬浮，且与“颗粒沉积”相矛盾。
错误类型：【方向相反】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关注转折词“but”和因果词“thereby”，判断流速降低对沉积颗粒悬浮的影响应是减少或中断，结合后文“Particles are thus deposited”推断悬浮被中断，排除表示加强、模糊的选项，锁定“interrupting”为最佳答案。

## 题目类型说明

词汇理解题，核心任务是通过上下文理解文中比喻性短语“pine from your own yard”的含义，从而选择最贴切的解释。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
>Poe must suffer by his originality.

👉 观点句，提出Poe因其原创性而遭受痛苦。

**第2句：**
>Invent that which is new, even if it be made of *pine from your own yard,* and there's none to know what you have done.

👉 举例说明原创作品即使用自己本地的材料（比喻）创作，也不会被理解或认可。

**第3句：**
>It is because there's no name.

👉 解释原因，即缺乏公认的名字或身份导致不被理解。

**第4句：**
>This is the cause of Poe's lack of recognition.

👉 因果推论，说明前述原因导致Poe不被认可。

**第5句：**
>He was American.

👉 补充说明Poe身份，暗示其“美国性”是原因之一。

**第6句：**
>He was the astounding, inconceivable growth of his locality.

👉 进一步说明Poe是其本地文化或环境中独特且难以理解的产物。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                     |
|:---------|:----------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | Poe因原创性而受苦                        |
| 第二句   | 即使用“自己院子里的松木”创造新东西，也无人识别 |
| 第三句   | 缺乏名字是原因                          |
| 第四句   | 这导致Poe缺乏认可                      |
| 第五句   | Poe是美国人                            |
| 第六句   | Poe是其本地环境的惊人产物              |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌【过度推断】
> Personal experiences that are hard for others to comprehend

“pine from your own yard”比喻的是“本地材料”，文中强调的是“locality”（当地环境），而非个人经历，选项过度推断了含义。

**B 选项** ❌【方向相反】
> Ideas you have never previously expressed

文中并未强调“前所未有的想法”，而是强调“用本地的材料（文化）创造”，因此此选项方向不符。

**C 选项** ✅（正确）
> Elements of the culture in which you live

“pine from your own yard”直译为“自己院子里的松木”，隐喻“本地文化元素”，且文中“the astounding, inconceivable growth of his locality”支持此理解。

**D 选项** ❌【无中生有】
> Inspiration you received while reading independently

文中无任何关于“独立阅读获得灵感”的信息，此选项无依据。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于理解“pine from your own yard”作为比喻指代“本地材料”或“本地文化元素”，结合上下文“locality”及Poe作为“美国人”的描述，排除偏离“本地”含义的选项，从而确定答案。注意把握比喻与上下文的语义对应关系，避免过度或无中生有的解读。

> salvage

**B 选项** ❌

**C 选项** ❌

**D 选项** ❌

## 核心解题技巧

**D 选项** ❌（错误）
> idiosyncratic

意为“特有的，个人的”，形容金额不符合常规表达，也与实验设计无关。

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于理解“low financial stakes”指金额较小，结合短语“amounts of money”常用搭配，锁定词汇“nominal”（名义上的、小额的）；其他选项均不符合金额的明确性和实验语境，利用搭配常识和语境排除干扰选项。

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第一句：**

**第三句：**

| 第二句   | 说明该系列鼓励读者猜测作者，体现文学神秘的时代兴趣。|

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> preliminary

“preliminary”意为“初步的、预备的”，与上下文中强调的匿名和神秘性质不符，且无法体现“允许Alcott尝试新风格”的含义。

**B 选项** ✅
> clandestine

“clandestine”意为“秘密的、隐秘的”，与文中“匿名出版”和“读者猜测作者身份”的语境完全契合，且能准确表达该出版方式的神秘特征。
符合“匿名”与“文学神秘”的描述，是最精确的词。

**C 选项** ❌
> unequivocal

“unequivocal”意为“明确的、毫不含糊的”，与“匿名出版”带来的神秘和不确定感相反，语义方向相反。
错误类型：【方向相反】

**D 选项** ❌
> inexplicable

“inexplicable”意为“无法解释的”，强调无法理解或解释，文中并未表达该出版方式难以理解，而是强调其秘密和匿名。

**A 选项** ❌
> summarized

**C 选项** ❌

**D 选项** ✅
> preceded

正确原因：preceded意为“在……之前”，说明丰富的文学历史先于作品存在，符合句子逻辑和上下文中强调的历史传承关系。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于理解句中“whose work is _____ by a rich literary history”的因果和时间关系，rich literary history作为历史背景，必然先于作品出现，故用“preceded”最合适。通过选项词义辨析，排除表达“总结”“忽视”“取代”等相反或不合逻辑的词，锁定时间先后顺序词汇。

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Researchers have long hypothesized that woolly mammoths were hunted to extinction in North America by humans using spears with grooved tips known as Clovis points.

👉 提出背景观点：介绍已有的假设，即用Clovis尖头矛狩猎导致猛犸象灭绝。

**第2句：**
> One anthropologist set out to test this hypothesis.

👉 说明目的：有人通过实验验证上述假设。

**第3句：**
> Using a mechanical spear-thrower, he launched spears with Clovis points into mounds of clay—substitutes for the animals' large bodies.

👉 介绍实验方法：用机械投矛器向泥块投掷带Clovis尖头的矛。

**第4句：**
> The projectiles generally penetrated only a few inches into the clay, an amount insufficient to have harmed most woolly mammoths.

👉 实验结果及分析：矛只深入几英寸，不足以对猛犸象造成伤害。

**第5句：**
> This led the anthropologist to conclude that hunters using spears with Clovis points likely weren't the principal drivers of the extinction.

👉 得出结论：基于实验结果，认为Clovis尖头矛不是灭绝的主要原因。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                             |
|:---------|:--------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍已有假设：Clovis矛导致猛犸象灭绝 |
| 第二句   | 说明有学者进行实验验证该假设       |
| 第三句   | 描述实验方法：机械投矛器和泥块     |
| 第四句   | 实验结果：矛穿透不足以致命         |
| 第五句   | 结论：怀疑Clovis矛是灭绝主因       |

**D 选项** ✅

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Spanning the 1920s to the 1980s, Mexican architect Luis Barragán's prolific career evolved through distinct phases.

👉 文章开篇提出主题，概括介绍了Barragán职业生涯的时间跨度和“演变阶段”的总体框架。

**第3句：**
> Extensive travels abroad later sparked an engagement with modernist and functionalist aesthetics—styles whose emphasis on utility and whose repudiation of traditional architecture's more ornamental elements are readily apparent in Barragán's Ortega House.

👉 解释Barragán职业后期的转变，说明他的广泛旅行促使其接受现代主义和功能主义美学，并用Ortega House作为典型例证。

**B 选项** ✅

完全对应文章结构：先总述Barragán职业生涯的“演变阶段”，接着描述早期设计方法，再解释后期风格的转变。

**C 选项** ❌

文章中没有“著名项目→原始灵感→较不知名项目”这一结构，也没有提及“较不知名项目”。
错误类型：【无中生有】

**D 选项** ❌
> It summarizes the career of a particular architect, states how that architect's heritage influenced his career choice, and then emphasizes the impact of that architect's career.

文章虽总结职业生涯，但未提及“遗产影响其职业选择”或“强调职业影响力”的内容。
错误类型：【无中生有】

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> It offers historical context that accounts for a particular group of artists' shared style and then indicates the circumstances under which several members of that group began exploring more unconventional themes.

错误原因：文章确实提到时间背景，但并未解释为何形成共同风格，也没有说明“几个成员开始探索非传统主题”的情况。

**B 选项** ❌
> It describes the common perception that a particular group of artists' works are derivative and then provides a specific piece of evidence that reinforces that perception.

错误原因：文章提到作品“reiteration”（重复），但没有表现出“衍生”或“模仿”的贬义，也没有强化这种负面评价，而是强调了个性化。
错误类型：【偷换概念】

**C 选项** ❌
> It explains how a particular group of artists began collaborating and then recounts how one member of that group became especially influential among them.

错误原因：文中没有提及该群体是如何合作的，也未说Johnny Daniels“尤其有影响力”。
错误类型：【无中生有】

**D 选项** ✅
> It describes an aesthetic framework shared by a particular group of artists and then makes and illustrates the claim that individuals introduced variations within that framework.

正确原因：文章先描述了共有的构图和主题（aesthetic framework），随后指出个别艺术家（Johnny Daniels）在该框架内做出个性化变化（variations），并通过举例加以说明。

article: In what is now Washington state, the Tulalip Tribes operate the Hibulb Cultural Center. Relying on traditional knowledge to guide the design of exhibits, this institution presents Tulalip history and culture to the tribes’ citizens. The Turtle Mountain Band of Chippewa, a tribe in North Dakota, employs a similar strategy in its own cultural center. Both centers contrast with museums that aren’t Indigenous-led; when displaying Indigenous artifacts, such museums tend to anticipate mainly non-Indigenous audiences and rely on Euro-centric strategies for designing exhibits.

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> In what is now Washington state, the Tulalip Tribes operate the Hibulb Cultural Center.

👉 介绍具体的部落文化中心作为背景信息。

**第2句：**
> Relying on traditional knowledge to guide the design of exhibits, this institution presents Tulalip history and culture to the tribes’ citizens.

👉 说明该文化中心展览设计的原则及其展示对象。

**第3句：**
> The Turtle Mountain Band of Chippewa, a tribe in North Dakota, employs a similar strategy in its own cultural center.

👉 引入另一个部落文化中心，指出其采用类似的展览设计策略。

**第4句：**
> Both centers contrast with museums that aren’t Indigenous-led; when displaying Indigenous artifacts, such museums tend to anticipate mainly non-Indigenous audiences and rely on Euro-centric strategies for designing exhibits.

**A 选项** ❌

**B 选项** ❌

错误原因：文章没有讨论部落成员对展览的反应，也没有推测非土著观众的反应。

**C 选项** ✅

> 💡 本题关注文章整体结构，关键在于识别文章先介绍“现象”（convergent evolution），再给出“两项研究例子”，最后提到“第三项综合研究”的顺序。选项中“描述现象 + 两个研究 + 第三个研究”是核心信号词，有助锁定A选项，排除其他带有“发展过程”“批评”“假设”的选项。

article:
The following text is from H.D.'s 1916 poem "Mid Day." In the poem, the speaker is on a path in an outdoor setting.

A slight wind shakes the seed pods—
my thoughts are spent
as the black seeds.
My thoughts tear me,
I dread their fever.
I am scattered in its whirl.
I am scattered like
the hot shriveled seeds.
stem: Which choice best describes the function of the underlined portion in the text as a whole?

options.content: It presents an observation of an occurrence in the natural world that the speaker then expands on to convey a sense of a turbulent interior state.
It establishes an example of consistency in the natural landscape that the speaker then contrasts with the unpredictability of human emotions.
It illustrates a change in the natural environment that the speaker implies is responsible for the growing misgivings described in the text.
It evokes the ordinariness of an event in nature to suggest that the critical self-evaluation the speaker engages in is a common pursuit.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

本题是文章细节理解题，核心任务是理解划线句在全文中的作用，即它如何为后续描写的内心情感状态服务。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句（划线句）：**
> A slight wind shakes the seed pods—

👉 观察自然现象，描绘外部环境的动态变化。

**第2句：**
> my thoughts are spent

👉 表达内心思想的疲惫或耗尽。

**第3句：**
> as the black seeds.

👉 用“黑色种子”比喻思想的状态，暗示思想的消散或耗尽。

**第4句：**
> My thoughts tear me,

👉 进一步描写思想带来的内心撕裂感，突出内心冲突。

**第5句：**
> I dread their fever.

👉 表达对思想激烈状态（“热病”）的恐惧。

**第6句：**
> I am scattered in its whirl.

👉 描述自己被这种思想的旋涡所扰乱，情绪失控。

**第7句：**
> I am scattered like

👉 比喻句引出下文，准备将自身状态与某物对比。

**第8句：**
> the hot shriveled seeds.

👉 用“干枯的种子”形象化内心的破碎和无力。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                                 |
|:---------|:-----------------------------------------------------|
| 第1句    | 观察自然界中轻风摇动种荚的场景                       |
| 第2-3句  | 把思想比作种子，表达思想的耗尽                       |
| 第4-5句  | 描述思想带来的内心撕裂和恐惧                         |
| 第6-8句  | 用“旋涡”和“干枯种子”比喻内心的混乱和破碎状态       |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅
> It presents an observation of an occurrence in the natural world that the speaker then expands on to convey a sense of a turbulent interior state.

正确。划线句通过自然界的“轻风摇动种荚”引出后文对思想状态的描写（“my thoughts are spent”，“My thoughts tear me”），自然景象与内心动荡形成呼应，符合“观察自然现象并扩展内心状态”的功能。

**B 选项** ❌
> It establishes an example of consistency in the natural landscape that the speaker then contrasts with the unpredictability of human emotions.

错误。划线句描写的是动态变化（轻风摇动），而非“稳定一致”，全文并无将自然的稳定与人类情绪的不可预测形成对比。【方向相反】

**C 选项** ❌
> It illustrates a change in the natural environment that the speaker implies is responsible for the growing misgivings described in the text.

错误。虽然划线句描述了自然变化，但诗中并未暗示这种自然变化是内心恐惧和撕裂的原因，更多是用作比喻或引出内心状态。【过度推断】

**D 选项** ❌
> It evokes the ordinariness of an event in nature to suggest that the critical self-evaluation the speaker engages in is a common pursuit.

错误。划线句虽然描述自然事件，但全文并未表达自我批判是“普遍”行为，且强调的是内心的痛苦和散乱，而非“普遍性”或“普通性”。【无中生有】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题核心在于识别诗中自然景象与内心情感的联系。划线句描绘的自然动态（“A slight wind shakes”）通过比喻引出内心的“turbulent”状态，故选项需体现“由自然现象引发或映射内心状态”的逻辑，排除强调稳定、因果或普遍性的选项。关键词“shakes”和“thoughts are spent”构成情感映射的桥梁，帮助锁定答案为A。

article: Scholarly interest in literary juvenilia—writings by children and teenagers—tends to focus on unpublished works by authors who became famous as adults, such as Charles Dickens’s poem “The Bill of Fare,” which he wrote around the ages of 18–20, because they offer insights into their authors’ artistic development. But some scholars also argue that recovering juvenilia by lesser-known writers is essential to understanding literary history: Daisy Ashford’s novels, which she published as a child, were widely read by contemporaries and are therefore deserving of closer attention.
stem: Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?

options.content: To describe the challenges famous writers encountered when seeking to publish works written in their childhood

## 题目类型说明

这是主旨大意题，核心任务是概括文章整体内容，准确把握作者写作目的。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Scholarly interest in literary juvenilia—writings by children and teenagers—tends to focus on unpublished works by authors who became famous as adults, such as Charles Dickens’s poem “The Bill of Fare,” which he wrote around the ages of 18–20, because they offer insights into their authors’ artistic development.

👉 说明学术界关注儿童青少年作品的普遍情况及原因。

**第2句：**
> But some scholars also argue that recovering juvenilia by lesser-known writers is essential to understanding literary history: Daisy Ashford’s novels, which she published as a child, were widely read by contemporaries and are therefore deserving of closer attention.

👉 转折，提出另一种观点：研究不那么著名作家的儿童作品也很重要。

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                   |
|:---------|:--------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍学者关注著名作家儿童作品的原因及例子 |
| 第二句   | 转折，强调研究不著名作家儿童作品的重要性和理由 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> To describe the challenges famous writers encountered when seeking to publish works written in their childhood

文中没有提到著名作家在出版童年作品时遇到的挑战，完全无中生有。【无中生有】

**B 选项** ✅
> To present reasons why literary scholars consider juvenilia to be valuable resources

文章第一句说明著名作家的童年作品能洞见艺术发展，第二句补充研究不著名作家的童年作品也有助于理解文学史，均为说明童年作品价值的理由，符合主旨。

**C 选项** ❌
> To compare the accomplishments of young writers with those of their adult contemporaries

文章未涉及对比年轻作家与成年同时代作家的成就。【无中生有】

**D 选项** ❌
> To argue that Ashford’s novels have more literary merit than Dickens’s juvenilia do

文章只是说Ashford作品值得关注，未比较优劣，更无说法表明其文学价值超过狄更斯。【过度推断】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关注文章转折词“But”，前后分别给出对著名作家和非著名作家的童年作品价值的理由，说明全文目的在于展示文学学者为何重视juvenilia，排除无关选项时注意文中未提及的细节（如出版难题、比较优劣）避免无中生有和过度推断。

article:
The following text is from Jerome K. Jerome's 1889 novel Three Men in a Boat.

We are creatures of the sun, we men and women. We love light and life. That is why we crowd into the towns and cities, and the country grows more and more deserted every year. In the sunlight—in the daytime, when Nature is alive and busy all around us, we like the open hillsides and the deep woods well enough: but in the night, when our Mother Earth has gone to sleep, and left us waking, oh! the world seems so lonesome, and we get frightened, like children in a silent house. Then we sit and sob, and long for the gas-lit streets, and the sound of human voices, and the answering throb of human life.
stem: Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?

options.content: To indicate that crowded areas can cause people to feel as though they are children again
To caution people not to be so quick to dismiss the natural beauty that can be found in rural areas
To address common traits that motivates many people to choose to live in urban environments
To illustrate the idea that most people tend to prefer hillsides in the country to certain aspects of towns and cities

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

主旨大意题，核心任务是把握全文中心思想，选择最准确表达作者写作目的的选项。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> We are creatures of the sun, we men and women.

👉 提出观点，说明人类本性是爱光和生命。

**第2句：**
> We love light and life.

👉 进一步强调人类喜爱阳光和生命的特点。

**第3句：**
> That is why we crowd into the towns and cities, and the country grows more and more deserted every year.

👉 因果推论，解释人们聚集城市的原因导致乡村荒芜。

**第4句：**
> In the sunlight—in the daytime, when Nature is alive and busy all around us, we like the open hillsides and the deep woods well enough:

👉 举例和转折，说明白天时人们喜欢乡村自然环境。

**第5句：**
> but in the night, when our Mother Earth has gone to sleep, and left us waking, oh! the world seems so lonesome, and we get frightened, like children in a silent house.

👉 转折，说明夜晚乡村让人感到孤独害怕。

**第6句：**
> Then we sit and sob, and long for the gas-lit streets, and the sound of human voices, and the answering throb of human life.

👉 因果推论，说明夜晚人们渴望城市的灯光和人声。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第1句 | 提出人类是“阳光的生物”，喜欢光和生命 |
| 第2句 | 强调人类对光和生命的喜爱 |
| 第3句 | 因此人们聚集城市，乡村逐渐荒废 |
| 第4句 | 白天喜欢乡村自然环境 |
| 第5句 | 夜晚乡村使人孤独害怕 |
| 第6句 | 夜晚渴望城市的灯光和人声 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> To indicate that crowded areas can cause people to feel as though they are children again

错误，文中说“我们像孩子一样害怕”是指乡村夜晚孤独恐惧，而非城市让人感觉像孩子。与原文表达方向相反。
错误类型：【方向相反】

**B 选项** ❌
> To caution people not to be so quick to dismiss the natural beauty that can be found in rural areas

错误，文章虽提及白天喜欢乡村，但主要强调夜晚的孤独和人们聚居城市的原因，没有劝诫或提醒读者珍惜乡村。
错误类型：【无中生有】

**C 选项** ✅
> To address common traits that motivates many people to choose to live in urban environments

正确，文章核心是解释人们为何选择城市生活，原因在于对白天阳光和生命的爱以及夜晚乡村的孤独害怕。

**D 选项** ❌
> To illustrate the idea that most people tend to prefer hillsides in the country to certain aspects of towns and cities

错误，文章虽然说白天喜欢乡村，但整体强调人们最终选择城市，夜晚乡村令人害怕，故不能说“多数人倾向于乡村”。
错误类型：【以偏概全】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题核心在于抓住文章因果关系及转折词：“That is why”、“but”、“then”，明确作者写作目的是解释人们为何“crowd into towns and cities”，排除与主题无关或方向相反的选项。注意区别白天对乡村的喜爱与夜晚的恐惧，理解整体倾向于城市生活的动机。

---

article:
The following text is from Jerome K. Jerome's 1889 novel Three Men in a Boat (To Say Nothing of the Dog). The narrator and two friends are taking a boat down the River Thames in England.
In a boat, I have always noticed that it is the fixed idea of each member of the crew that he is doing everything. Harris's notion was, that it was he alone who had been working, and that both George and I had been imposing upon him. George, on the other hand, ridiculed the idea of Harris's having done anything more than eat and sleep, and had a cast-iron opinion that it was he—George himself—who had done all the labour worth speaking of.
stem: Which choice best describes the main purpose of the text?

options.content: To present the narrator's generalization along with supporting examples from a specific situation
To give an overview of a particular situation that the narrator finds puzzling
To convey the narrator's confidence that he understands the role expected of him in a group
To explain how the narrator and his friends each contributed to solving a problem

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

这是主旨大意题，核心任务是理解作者写作的主要目的，即这段文字想要传达的中心思想是什么。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> In a boat, I have always noticed that it is the fixed idea of each member of the crew that he is doing everything.

👉 提出观点：作者概括了一个普遍现象，即每个人都坚信自己承担了所有工作。

**第2句：**
> Harris's notion was, that it was he alone who had been working, and that both George and I had been imposing upon him.

👉 举例说明：具体举出Harris的看法，强调他认为自己是唯一在工作的人。

**第3句：**
> George, on the other hand, ridiculed the idea of Harris's having done anything more than eat and sleep, and had a cast-iron opinion that it was he—George himself—who had done all the labour worth speaking of.

👉 举例对比：说明George的看法与Harris相反，强调自己才是主要劳动力。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 提出普遍现象：每个人都认为自己做了所有的工作 |
| 第二句 | 举例Harris的观点：只有他自己在工作 |
| 第三句 | 举例George的观点：只有他自己做了重要劳动 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅（正确）
> To present the narrator's generalization along with supporting examples from a specific situation

本段开头提出了一个普遍现象（generalization），后面紧跟两个具体例子（Harris和George的看法）作为支持，符合文章结构和内容。

**B 选项** ❌（错误）
> To give an overview of a particular situation that the narrator finds puzzling

文中并未表现出“困惑”或“难以理解”的情绪，更多是幽默描述和观察，故此选项错误。【无中生有】

**C 选项** ❌（错误）
> To convey the narrator's confidence that he understands the role expected of him in a group

文中没有体现叙述者对自己角色的自信或理解，反而重点在于他观察到其他人的看法，故此选项错误。【无中生有】

**D 选项** ❌（错误）
> To explain how the narrator and his friends each contributed to solving a problem

文中未涉及解决问题的内容，仅描述各自对工作的不同看法，故此选项错误。【无中生有】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于抓住首句提出的普遍现象（generalization）及后文具体举例支持的结构。理解选项时，要注意文章的情感色彩和叙述重点，排除带入“困惑”、“自信”或“解决问题”等未出现的内容，从而准确锁定A选项。

## 题目类型说明

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Researchers César A. Hidalgo, Elisa Casta'er, and Andres Sevtsuk created a computer model to predict the mix of gyms, beauty salons, and other businesses found in a given neighborhood.

**B 选项** ✅

**C 选项** ❌

错误原因：文章没有总结城市发展趋势，也没有明确指出城市规划中的问题，只是介绍了研究方法和模型应用。【无中生有】

**D 选项** ❌
> It explains why urban planners are interested in understanding the locations of certain businesses, details a study that has addressed this question, and identifies one key finding.
错误原因：文章未提及城市规划者的兴趣动机，也没有明确展示研究的“关键发现”，而是更多聚焦方法和应用前景。【无中生有】

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于抓住文章的三步结构：介绍研究团队及研究（第1句），解释研究方法（第2句），展望研究应用（第3句）。选项中描述“研究团队”“研究方法”“应用前景”的B项与文章内容完全对应，其他选项多包含文章未提及的信息，属于无中生有，故排除。注意识别选项中是否准确对应文章信息，避免被无关或错误信息干扰。

## 题目类型说明

这是一道主旨大意题，核心任务是确定文章的主要目的，即作者写这段话想表达的中心思想。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Elio Sucena and colleagues have explored how convergent evolution—a phenomenon that occurs when the same trait evolves independently in two reproductively separate lineages—can result from a genetic mechanism shared by both lineages.

**第2句：**
> Meanwhile, Michael D. Shapiro and colleagues have investigated how convergence occurs through different genetic mechanisms, but the relative prevalence of convergence through shared and different genetic processes is still poorly understood.

👉 介绍Shapiro及其团队的研究，关注趋同进化通过不同遗传机制发生的情况，同时指出两种机制的相对普遍性尚不清楚。

**第3句：**
> This motivated biologists Delbert A. Green II and Cassandra G. Extavour to evaluate both types of convergence in a single study for their 2012 paper.

👉 引出Green和Extavour的研究动机和目标，即在一项研究中评估这两种趋同进化类型。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                                         |
|:---------|:-------------------------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍Sucena团队关于趋同进化通过共享遗传机制的研究             |
| 第二句   | 介绍Shapiro团队关于趋同进化通过不同遗传机制的研究及存在的问题 |
| 第三句   | 说明Green和Extavour受前人研究启发，开展综合两种机制的研究     |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> To suggest that Green and Extavour’s conclusions would be more persuasive if they incorporated findings from the studies by Sucena and colleagues and Shapiro and colleagues

错误原因：文中并未暗示Green和Extavour的结论需要借助其他研究来增强说服力，只是说明了他们的研究动机和背景。
错误类型：【无中生有】

**B 选项** ❌
> To summarize Green and Extavour’s criticism of the study by Sucena and colleagues

错误原因：文中没有提及Green和Extavour对Sucena团队研究的批评，只是说明了两者研究内容的不同和衔接。
错误类型：【无中生有】

**C 选项** ❌
> To argue that Green and Extavour’s study revealed a previously unrecognized issue that evolutionary biologists need to address

错误原因：文中没有指出Green和Extavour发现了新的未被认识的问题，只是说他们的研究是基于前人研究中的不足。
错误类型：【过度推断】

**D 选项** ✅
> To situate Green and Extavour’s study in the context of their field

正确原因：文章通过介绍Sucena和Shapiro两组研究，展示了Green和Extavour研究的背景和定位，符合“将Green和Extavour的研究置于其领域背景中”的表述。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于抓住文章介绍的逻辑脉络：前两句分别介绍两种趋同进化的研究现状和存在的知识空白，第三句点明Green和Extavour的研究是基于此背景展开，体现了“背景介绍+研究定位”的结构。选项中只有D准确反映了文章的主旨定位，其他选项均为无中生有或过度推断。锁定关键词“motivated”、“evaluate both types”、“single study”，这些词汇强调的是研究的动机和定位，而非评价或批判。

But other critics argue that the books should not be thought of as discrete texts with traditional beginnings and endings but as a single incredibly long work, similar to other multivolume stories, such as Marcel Proust's In Search of Lost Time.
stem: Which choice best describes the function of the underlined portion in the text as a whole?

options.content: It presents a reason most critics think the Aubrey/Maturin series should have the literary renown of similar works like In Search of Lost Time.
It argues that the unusual structure that O'Brian uses for The Thirteen-Gun Salute makes it one of his most entertaining books.
It explains why many critics find the Aubrey/Maturin novels to be entertaining despite flaws in the novels' structures.
It summarizes a positive assessment of a particular characteristic of the Aubrey/Maturin novels.

## 题目类型说明

这是主旨功能题，核心任务是判断文中划线部分在全文中起到的论述功能。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> The *Thirteen-Gun Salute*, first published in 1989, is a novel in Patrick O'Brian's Aubrey/Maturin series, which includes twenty completed books.
👉 介绍背景，说明《十三响礼炮》是奥布莱恩奥布莱恩系列中的一本小说。

**第2句：**
> Some critics have found fault with the abrupt endings of *The Thirteen-Gun Salute* and other books in the series, saying that they do not finish conclusively but arbitrarily stop.
👉 提出观点，介绍部分批评家对该系列小说结尾处理的负面评价。

**第3句（划线部分）：**
> But other critics argue that the books should not be thought of as discrete texts with traditional beginnings and endings but as a single incredibly long work, similar to other multivolume stories, such as Marcel Proust's *In Search of Lost Time.*
👉 转折反驳，介绍另一部分批评家对该系列的正面评价，强调整体视角看待作品结构。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容与逻辑功能                             |
|:---------|:-----------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍小说及其系列背景                       |
| 第二句   | 介绍部分批评家对小说结尾的负面评价         |
| 第三句   | 转折，介绍另一批评家对整体结构的正面看法   |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌【过度推断】
> It presents a reason most critics think the Aubrey/Maturin series should have the literary renown of similar works like *In Search of Lost Time.*
该划线部分仅说“其他批评家认为应将其视为整体长篇作品，类似普鲁斯特”，没有提及“多数批评家”或“应享有文学声誉”，过度推断了“literary renown”。

**B 选项** ❌【方向相反】
> It argues that the unusual structure that O'Brian uses for *The Thirteen-Gun Salute* makes it one of his most entertaining books.
划线部分没有提到“使其成为最有趣的书”，而是强调作品整体结构的看法，与娱乐性无关。

**C 选项** ❌【无中生有】
> It explains why many critics find the Aubrey/Maturin novels to be entertaining despite flaws in the novels' structures.
原文中没有提到“许多批评家觉得小说有趣”或“尽管结构有缺陷仍有趣”，此选项无事实依据。

**D 选项** ✅（正确）
> It summarizes a positive assessment of a particular characteristic of the Aubrey/Maturin novels.
划线部分正是对该系列作品结构的正面评价的总结，符合文意。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关注划线部分的转折词“But other critics argue”，明确其功能为对前文批评的转折反驳，表明另一种积极看法。结合题干“功能”，要找总结性、评价性内容，排除与“娱乐性”“多数批评家”等无关或无根据选项，锁定正面评价的总结选项。

article: Though John Crowley, author of Engine Summer, is not as well known as the most commercially successful American writers of the past fifty years, his work has had several influential champions, including the poet John Hollander and the literary critic Harold Bloom. In his afterword to Crowley's book Little, Big, Bloom argues that the novel adroitly blends what playwright Friedrich Schiller termed the naive and sentimental modes—while Schiller thought works could be classified as either naive (seeking to describe reality) or sentimental (seeking to develop ideas), Little, Big fuses both modes of writing.
stem: Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?

options.content: It accounts for a writer's lack of popular appeal, cites a literary figure who appreciates that writer, and summarizes the qualities that make the writer's work unique.
It describes a writer's successful career, presents two literary figures who were supporters of that writer's career, and explains why the writer was able to achieve what he did.
It identifies a writer whose work is regarded as difficult to read, brings up two admirers of that writer's work, and gives information that may make the writer's work more accessible to new readers.
It mentions a writer whose work is not widely known, presents two people who hold a positive opinion of that writer, and gives a reason why one of those people holds that opinion.

## 题目类型说明

这是一道文章结构题，核心任务是理解文章整体的逻辑脉络，准确把握段落之间的关系和文章主旨，从而选择最符合全文结构描述的选项。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Though John Crowley, author of *Engine Summer*, is not as well known as the most commercially successful American writers of the past fifty years, his work has had several influential champions, including the poet John Hollander and the literary critic Harold Bloom.

👉 先提出观点：John Crowley知名度不高，但有有影响力的人士支持他的作品。

**第2句：**
> In his afterword to Crowley's book *Little, Big*, Bloom argues that the novel adroitly blends what playwright Friedrich Schiller termed the naive and sentimental modes—

👉 介绍Bloom对Crowley作品的评价，说明Bloom在文学上对Crowley作品的独到见解。

**第3句：**
> while Schiller thought works could be classified as either naive (seeking to describe reality) or sentimental (seeking to develop ideas), *Little, Big* fuses both modes of writing.

👉 解释原因和细节：Schiller的分类标准与Crowley作品的特点结合，强调作品独特性。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                                         |
|:---------|:------------------------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍John Crowley不广为人知，但有有影响力的支持者（Hollander和Bloom）。 |
| 第二句   | 引入Bloom对Crowley《Little, Big》的评价，指出作品融合了两种写作模式。 |
| 第三句   | 解释Schiller的“naive”和“sentimental”分类，并说明Crowley作品如何融合二者。 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> It accounts for a writer's lack of popular appeal, cites a literary figure who appreciates that writer, and summarizes the qualities that make the writer's work unique.

选项中说“summarizes the qualities that make the writer's work unique”部分过于泛化，文章重点在于介绍Bloom如何具体评价《Little, Big》的写作模式，且没有全面总结作品所有独特品质。
错误类型：【过度推断】

**B 选项** ❌
> It describes a writer's successful career, presents two literary figures who were supporters of that writer's career, and explains why the writer was able to achieve what he did.

文章开头明确提到Crowley“不如最成功的作家知名”，并非“successful career”；因此此选项方向错误。
错误类型：【方向相反】

**C 选项** ❌
> It identifies a writer whose work is regarded as difficult to read, brings up two admirers of that writer's work, and gives information that may make the writer's work more accessible to new readers.

文中没有提及作品“难读”或“使作品更易懂”的内容，属于无中生有。
错误类型：【无中生有】

**D 选项** ✅
> It mentions a writer whose work is not widely known, presents two people who hold a positive opinion of that writer, and gives a reason why one of those people holds that opinion.

准确对应文章结构：先提Crowley“not as well known”，然后介绍两位支持者，最后详细说明Bloom为何赞赏作品的理由。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于捕捉文章首句的转折词“Though”以及“not as well known”表明作者地位不高，接着点明“influential champions”即支持者，再由Bloom的具体评价提供“给出理由”，通过这些信号词层层递进，排除强调成功或难读的选项，锁定D选项。选项中的“lack of popular appeal”和“positive opinion”与文章原文直接对应，避免了过度推断和无中生有的陷阱。

The following text is from Lady Gregory's 1904 play Spreading the News. Mrs. Tarpey, Bartley, and Mrs. Fallon have been buying and selling goods at the local fair.

MRS. TARPEY: Good morrow, Bartley Fallon; good morrow, Mrs. Fallon. Well, Bartley, you'll find no cause for complaining to-day; they are all saying it was a good fair.

BARTLEY: (Raising his voice.) It was not a good fair, Mrs. Tarpey. It was a scattered sort of a fair. If we didn't expect more, we got less. That's the way with me always; whatever I have to sell goes down and whatever I have to buy goes up. If there's ever any misfortune coming to this world, it's on myself it pitches, like a flock of crows on seed potatoes.
stem: Which choice best describes the function of the underlined portion in the text as a whole?

options.content: It discusses an event that Mrs. Tarpey believes is unlikely to occur.
It presents a vivid image to emphasize a claim that Bartley makes.
It mounts a counterargument to a claim that Bartley made about the fair.
It describes a scene that Bartley witnessed at the fair.

---

## 题目类型说明

这是细节理解题，核心任务是理解文中画线比喻的功能，判断它在表达观点时的作用。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> MRS. TARPEY: Good morrow, Bartley Fallon; good morrow, Mrs. Fallon. Well, Bartley, you'll find no cause for complaining to-day; they are all saying it was a good fair.

👉 提出观点：Mrs. Tarpey认为今天的集市很好，没有理由抱怨。

**第2句：**
> BARTLEY: (Raising his voice.) It was not a good fair, Mrs. Tarpey. It was a scattered sort of a fair. If we didn't expect more, we got less. That's the way with me always; whatever I have to sell goes down and whatever I have to buy goes up.

👉 反驳与解释：Bartley反驳说集市并不好，阐述自己总是亏本的情况。

**第3句：**
> If there's ever any misfortune coming to this world, it's on myself it pitches, like a flock of crows on seed potatoes.

👉 形象比喻：用“像一群乌鸦落在种子土豆上”这个生动形象强调自己的厄运集中降临。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                               |
|:---------|:----------------------------------|
| 第一句   | Mrs. Tarpey表达对集市满意的观点。  |
| 第二句   | Bartley反驳，表达自己对集市的不满。|
| 第三句   | Bartley用比喻形象强调自己倒霉。    |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌【无中生有】
> It discusses an event that Mrs. Tarpey believes is unlikely to occur.
文中画线部分是Bartley说的比喻，不涉及Mrs. Tarpey对事件可能性的讨论，且没有提及“不太可能发生的事件”。

**B 选项** ✅（正确）
> It presents a vivid image to emphasize a claim that Bartley makes.
画线比喻“like a flock of crows on seed potatoes”形象生动，强调Bartley所说的“厄运都降临在我身上”，符合原文功能。

**C 选项** ❌【方向相反】
> It mounts a counterargument to a claim that Bartley made about the fair.
画线部分并非反驳Bartley自己的观点，而是强化他的观点。

**D 选项** ❌【以偏概全】
> It describes a scene that Bartley witnessed at the fair.
比喻是形象表达厄运的集中，并非描述具体场景。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于识别画线部分的修辞作用。画线处为比喻，常用于强调观点而非提出新论点或反驳。注意人物发言主体和语境，转折词（如“like”）提示这是形象描写，帮助锁定正确选项B，排除与事件真实性或反驳相关的选项。

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Founded in Denver in 1991, the Museo de Las Americas is dedicated to art from Latin America, including the art of Indigenous peoples.

## 结构总结

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> It explains how one cultural institution was founded, then explains its plans to expand further.

错误类型：【无中生有】

**B 选项** ❌
> It describes a trend among cultural institutions in the United States, then identifies an institution that rejects that trend.

错误原因：文章没有提到任何趋势或某机构反对趋势的内容，仅是介绍了两个机构。
错误类型：【无中生有】

**C 选项** ❌
> It defines a certain type of cultural institution, then argues that this type of institution decisively influences society.

错误原因：文章没有给出定义，也没有讨论机构的社会影响。
错误类型：【无中生有】

**D 选项** ✅
> It discusses one cultural institution, then discusses a more recently founded cultural institution.

正确原因：文章先介绍了1991年成立的Museo de Las Americas，然后介绍了时间更近的Latino Cultural Center，符合选项描述。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关注文章时间顺序词汇（如“Founded in 1991”，“More recently founded”），判断文章结构是先后介绍两个文化机构；排除选项时注意是否有文章未涉及的信息（扩展计划、趋势、影响力等），避免无中生有的选项。

article: Argyroxiphium sandwicense is a species in a family of plants known collectively as the silversword alliance, all of which grow only on the Hawaiian Islands. Members of this alliance exhibit an extraordinary range of phenotypes, with some species maturing into vines and others into shrubs and trees. All species in the alliance descended from a single ancestral tarweed plant that arrived on the islands around 5 million years ago. The tarweed's descendants diversified into distinct species as they adapted to live in the wide variety of habitats found on the Hawaiian Islands.
stem: Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?

options.content: To advance the claim that all plants on the Hawaiian Islands are part of the silversword alliance and list possible ancestors of the plants that make up the alliance
To indicate the specific tarweed ancestor of all plants that grow on the Hawaiian Islands and explain why the plants have such varied physical characteristics
To describe the silversword alliance and explain how the plant family became so varied
To describe the specific habitat where Argyroxiphium sandwicense are found and identify other plants that share a common ancestor with them

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

这是一道主旨大意题，核心任务是确定文章的主要目的或中心思想。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Argyroxiphium sandwicense is a species in a family of plants known collectively as the silversword alliance, all of which grow only on the Hawaiian Islands.

👉 介绍主角植物及其所属植物家族，并指出它们的地理分布范围。

**第2句：**
> Members of this alliance exhibit an extraordinary range of phenotypes, with some species maturing into vines and others into shrubs and trees.

👉 描述该植物家族成员的多样性（表型差异）。

**第3句：**
> All species in the alliance descended from a single ancestral tarweed plant that arrived on the islands around 5 million years ago.

👉 说明该家族植物的共同起源，即单一祖先。

**第4句：**
> The tarweed's descendants diversified into distinct species as they adapted to live in the wide variety of habitats found on the Hawaiian Islands.

👉 解释物种多样性的原因——适应不同的栖息地导致分化。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 介绍Argyroxiphium sandwicense及其所属的silversword alliance，强调地理范围（夏威夷群岛） |
| 第二句 | 说明silversword alliance植物表现出极大的形态多样性 |
| 第三句 | 阐述所有这些植物来源于5百万年前抵达夏威夷的单一祖先tarweed |
| 第四句 | 解释植物多样化是由于适应不同夏威夷栖息地造成的 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> To advance the claim that all plants on the Hawaiian Islands are part of the silversword alliance and list possible ancestors of the plants that make up the alliance

错误原因：文章只说了silversword alliance植物生长于夏威夷群岛，未声称“所有夏威夷植物”都属于该联盟，也未列举多个祖先，只提到一个祖先tarweed。
错误类型：【无中生有】

**B 选项** ❌
> To indicate the specific tarweed ancestor of all plants that grow on the Hawaiian Islands and explain why the plants have such varied physical characteristics

错误原因：文章没有说所有夏威夷植物都起源于该tarweed祖先，只限于silversword alliance植物；且没有具体指出“是哪种特定tarweed”，只是泛指“单一祖先tarweed”。
错误类型：【偷换概念】

**C 选项** ✅
> To describe the silversword alliance and explain how the plant family became so varied

正确原因：文章确实介绍了silversword alliance植物及其多样性，并解释了多样性的形成原因（适应不同栖息地）。完全符合文章主旨。

**D 选项** ❌

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Mexican textile artist Victoria Villasana weaves stories of triumph, using her unique method of applying colorful yarn to photographs of people.

| 段落位置 | 内容                           |

| 第一句   | 介绍艺术家及其独特艺术手法     |
| 第二句   | 说明部分作品聚焦文化偶像并举例 |
| 第三句   | 转折，说明另一部分作品描绘普通人并举例 |
| 第四句   | 总结两种创作方式的共同意义     |

**B 选项** ❌
> To offer an overview of Villasana artistic style
错误，划线部分仅举例说明她描绘普通人的作品，而非全面介绍艺术风格。【过度推断】

**C 选项** ❌
> To demonstrate the Villasana collaborates frequently with other artists
错误，文中无任何关于合作的描述，完全无中生有。【无中生有】

**D 选项** ✅
> To provide an example of an everyday individual whom Villasana has portrayed in her work
正确，划线句明确以“captivating portrayal of young girl sitting on a sidewalk”具体举例说明她描绘普通人的作品。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关注句中转折词“However”，它标示前后内容的对比，提示划线部分是补充说明而非重复；同时注意“as she does in…”结构，表明举例作用，锁定选项应为具体例子而非整体风格或偏好，排除无关选项。

Most other nocturnal mammals respond to lunar intensity variations similarly to Arizona pocket mice, but Azara's night monkeys (Aotus azarae) display the opposite pattern, as their heavy reliance on visual foraging results in a different balance of reward and risk.

It describes and accounts for a finding, characterizes the finding as representative of a general pattern, and then describes and accounts for an exception to that pattern.
It discusses two different responses to the same natural phenomenon, explains why one of those responses occurs, and then suggests that the other response still needs to be explained.

## 题目类型说明

本题为文章结构题，核心任务是理解文章整体内容的展开顺序及逻辑关系，从而选出最恰当的结构描述。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Joel Brown and colleagues showed that high moonlight intensity inhibits the activity of the Arizona pocket mouse (Perognathus amplus), a result explicable in terms of benefits and costs: greater lunar intensity may not enable the mice to increase foraging success enough to offset the higher chance of detection by predatory owls or hawks.

👉 介绍研究发现，并给出该现象的解释（提出观点+解释原因）。

**第2句：**
> Most other nocturnal mammals respond to lunar intensity variations similarly to Arizona pocket mice, but Azara's night monkeys (Aotus azarae) display the opposite pattern, as their heavy reliance on visual foraging results in a different balance of reward and risk.

👉 说明大多数夜行动物表现出类似反应，但Azara夜猴是例外，且给出例外的原因（对比+解释例外）。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                   |
|:---------|:-------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍一项研究结果，并解释该结果背后的原因 |
| 第二句   | 说明这一结果代表的普遍模式，并指出一个例外及其原因 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> It introduces an observation of a behavioral pattern, presents an explanation for the pattern, and then describes an exception to the pattern that casts doubt on that explanation.

错误在于“exception to the pattern that casts doubt on that explanation”不准确。文中例外（Azara夜猴）并没有“质疑”前面解释，只是“不同的平衡”，即不同原因导致不同反应，未否定原解释。
错误类型：【过度推断】

**B 选项** ✅
> It describes and accounts for a finding, characterizes the finding as representative of a general pattern, and then describes and accounts for an exception to that pattern.

准确概括文章结构：先描述并解释研究结果，接着指出这是普遍现象，最后说明一个例外及其解释。完全符合文章逻辑。

**C 选项** ❌
> It discusses two different responses to the same natural phenomenon, explains why one of those responses occurs, and then suggests that the other response still needs to be explained.

文中并未说“另一反应尚待解释”，而是明确给出了Azara夜猴不同反应的解释。
错误类型：【无中生有】

**D 选项** ❌
> It presents and explains a study result, indicates that the result is similar to the results of many other studies, and then attributes a conflicting study result to a difference in that study's methods.

文中没有提及“其他研究”或“方法差异”导致结果不同，只有说大多数夜行动物表现类似。
错误类型：【无中生有】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于捕捉文章结构的“顺序关系”：先“研究结果+解释”，再“普遍性说明”，最后“例外及解释”；注意选项中“质疑解释”“方法差异”“未解释”等表述，均未在文中出现，利用这些关键词排除错误选项，锁定准确描述整体结构的B选项。

## 题目类型说明

本题为细节理解题，核心任务是理解文中划线部分的作用，即判断该部分在全文中起到怎样的功能或表达了怎样的意思。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Cuttlefish and toads see in three dimensions (3D) by combining two images in their brains, one from each eye.

👉 说明某些动物（墨鱼和蟾蜍）如何实现3D视觉的机制。

**第2句：**
> This produces a sense of depth, helping the animals judge how close or far away an object is.

👉 解释上述机制的作用和功能。

**第3句：**
> Researchers have investigated 3D vision in praying mantises as well.

👉 引出研究对象——螳螂的3D视觉研究。

**第4句：**
> In one study, Vivek Nityananda and his team fitted mantises' faces with two different color filters, one covering each eye, much like the filters in 3D glasses once worn at movies.

👉 描述研究方法，划线部分通过比喻帮助读者理解所用的彩色滤镜。

**第5句：**
> By observing the mantises' reaction to projected images, the team confirmed that mantises do indeed have 3D vision, but it's unlike that of other animals.

👉 说明研究结果及其独特性。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 介绍墨鱼和蟾蜍如何通过两只眼睛的图像组合实现3D视觉。 |
| 第二句 | 解释这种视觉带来的深度感和判断距离的能力。 |
| 第三句 | 引出对螳螂3D视觉的研究。 |
| 第四句 | 描述研究方法，使用了类似电影3D眼镜的彩色滤镜（划线部分为比喻辅助理解）。 |
| 第五句 | 通过观察螳螂反应，确认其具备3D视觉，但不同于其他动物。 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> It identifies a potential problem that the researchers faced while studying the praying mantises.

划线部分为比喻说明滤镜的性质，并未提及任何研究中遇到的问题或困难。
错误类型：【无中生有】

**B 选项** ✅
> It offers a comparison meant to aid understanding of the praying mantis study.

划线部分通过“much like the filters in 3D glasses once worn at movies”将研究用滤镜与人们熟悉的3D电影眼镜做比较，帮助读者理解。
符合原文意图，正确。

**C 选项** ❌
> It emphasizes a difference between the research on praying mantis vision and research on other animals' vision.

划线部分没有强调差异，而是用比喻说明滤镜的功能，与差异无关。
错误类型：【方向相反】

**D 选项** ❌
> It describes an earlier use of a tool the researchers used in the praying mantis study.

划线部分并非描述滤镜的“早期使用”，而是用电影3D眼镜做比喻，强调相似性而非历史用途。
错误类型：【偷换概念】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题核心在于识别划线部分的修辞手法——比喻（comparison），关键短语“much like”是明显的比较信号词，提示该部分是用熟悉事物帮助理解研究工具，而非表达问题、差异或历史用途，从而快速排除A、C、D选项，锁定B选项。

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Community science, which involves professional scientists collaborating with amateur science enthusiasts to study a topic, is often an effective and engaging way to conduct research.

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> It introduces the topic of a scientific study, describes the study's importance, and then presents the study's results.

错误原因：文章并未聚焦某一科学研究的介绍、重要性和结果，而是先介绍“community science”的概念和优点，再用研究作为示例。

**B 选项** ❌
> It argues for a new approach to scientific research, comments on the public's opinion about the approach, and then describes how that approach was applied in a certain study.

**C 选项** ❌
> It describes the development of a type of scientific collaboration, shows how that type of collaboration has been used in a particular field of study, and then suggests future collaborative projects.

错误原因：文中没有描述该合作方式的发展历程，也没有提出未来的项目建议。
错误类型：【无中生有】

**D 选项** ✅
> It identifies a particular approach to research, lists some benefits of that approach, and then mentions a study in which that approach was used.

正确原因：文章首先定义了community science（“identifies a particular approach”），接着列举了它的好处（“lists some benefits”），最后用具体研究实例说明其应用（“mentions a study”），与文章结构完全对应。

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于捕捉文章结构关键词：“定义—列举优点—举例应用”，排除涉及公众看法、发展历程、未来建议等无文中依据的选项。关注文章的逻辑连接词和段落主题句，锁定答案方向。

article:
The following text is adapted from George Eliot's 1857 short story "The Sad Fortunes of the Rev. Amos Barton." The Countess Czerlaski is a newcomer to the town of Milby.

I am by no means sure that if the good people of Milby had known the truth about the Countess Czerlaski, they would not have been considerably disappointed to find that it was very far from being as bad as they imagined. Nice distinctions are troublesome. It is so much easier to make up your mind that your neighbour is good for nothing, than to enter into all the circumstances that would oblige you to modify that opinion.
stem: Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?

options.content: To speculate on the circumstances under which the unfavorable opinion of the Countess Czerlaski that is held by the people of Milby could be improved
To illustrate why the censure the Countess Czerlaski has received from the people of Milby may be somewhat justified
To draw out the reader's compassion for both the people of Milby and the Countess Czerlaski by suggesting that they all have legitimate grievances
To offer commentary on a human foible that may account for why the people of Milby view the Countess Czerlaski as they do

## 题目类型说明

主旨大意题，核心任务是准确把握文章主旨，即作者写作这段文字的主要目的是什么。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> I am by no means sure that if the good people of Milby had known the truth about the Countess Czerlaski, they would not have been considerably disappointed to find that it was very far from being as bad as they imagined.

👉 表达作者对米尔比镇民众对伯爵夫人的看法的怀疑，暗示民众对她的负面看法可能夸大了事实。

**第2句：**
> Nice distinctions are troublesome.

👉 观点句，提出“细致区分很麻烦”这一普遍的心理现象。

**第3句：**
> It is so much easier to make up your mind that your neighbour is good for nothing, than to enter into all the circumstances that would oblige you to modify that opinion.

👉 解释原因，说明人们更倾向于简单地下结论，而不愿花心思了解复杂的背景事实。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                   |
|:---------|:-------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 怀疑米尔比镇民众对伯爵夫人的负面看法，暗示真实情况没那么糟。 |
| 第二句   | 提出“细致区分麻烦”的观点。             |
| 第三句   | 解释人们为何宁愿简单判断而不愿深究事实。 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌【过度推断】
> To speculate on the circumstances under which the unfavorable opinion of the Countess Czerlaski that is held by the people of Milby could be improved

文章并未具体推测哪些具体情况会改善镇民的看法，只是泛泛地表达了真实情况未必像想象中那么坏，属于对细节的泛泛描述，非核心目的。

**B 选项** ❌【方向相反】
> To illustrate why the censure the Countess Czerlaski has received from the people of Milby may be somewhat justified

原文并未说明镇民的责难有合理依据，反而暗示他们的看法可能夸大了事实，故此选项方向错误。

**C 选项** ❌【无中生有】
> To draw out the reader's compassion for both the people of Milby and the Countess Czerlaski by suggesting that they all have legitimate grievances

文章没有表达对双方“合理抱怨”的同情或怜悯，只是讨论人们的认知倾向，属于无中生有。

**D 选项** ✅
> To offer commentary on a human foible that may account for why the people of Milby view the Countess Czerlaski as they do

文章核心在于评论人类的弱点——倾向于简单判断而非深入理解，这正是导致镇民对伯爵夫人负面看法的原因，符合文意。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题抓住关键句“Nice distinctions are troublesome”和“easier to make up your mind... than to enter into all the circumstances”揭示了作者写作目的：评论人类倾向简单判断的弱点。题干问主旨，选项中只有D准确反映这一点，其它选项要么误解文意，要么无事实依据，利用转折词“than”对比易与难，有助排除错误选项。

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> With a shell that measured 1.7 meters, the extinct mollusk *Parapuzosia seppenradensis* is the largest ammonite in the fossil record.

Gale, and colleagues concluded that *P. seppenradensis* may have evolved from *P. leptophylla* and gradually increased in size as larger ammonites were better able to escape being preyed on by mosasaurs.

## 逐项分析选项

> It states a long-standing scientific assumption and then shows how recent research has overturned that assumption.

**B 选项** ✅
> It describes a scientific mystery and then discusses a research team's attempt to solve that mystery.

正确原因：文章先提出科学难题（对巨大体型的困惑），随后描述研究团队的研究及结论，结构完全对应原文逻辑。

**C 选项** ❌

> It notes the discovery of a new ammonite species and then remarks on the importance of that discovery.

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于识别文章的逻辑线索词，如“Ever since… perplexed”（提出问题）和“After examining… concluded”（研究与解答），明确文章结构是“提出科学谜题—研究解决方案”，据此排除与结构不符的选项，锁定B为正确答案。

## 题目类型说明

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> In Egypt, use of solid fuel (e.g., coal, wood) as a share of total household fuel use fell by more than 90 percent between 2000 and 2015; such shifts are typically explained by appeal to the energy ladder, a model holding that fuel choice is mediated mainly by household income (specifically, high-technology fuels displace solid fuels as incomes rise).

**第2句：**
> Alemu Mekonnen and Gunnar Kohlin's study of fuel use in Ethiopia shows how reductive this model is, however:

👉 转折，指出该模型过于简化，暗示后文将提出反例或补充说明。

**第3句（划线部分）：**
> although income of course constrained fuel choice,

👉 承认收入确实对燃料选择有限制作用。

**第4句：**
> several circumstances, including the local availability of different fuel sources, influenced decisions.

👉 进一步说明除了收入外，还有其他多种因素影响燃料选择。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 介绍埃及燃料使用变化及energy ladder模型，强调收入对燃料选择的影响 |
| 第二句 | 通过埃塞俄比亚研究指出该模型过于简化（转折） |
| 第三句 | 承认收入确实限制了燃料选择（划线部分） |
| 第四句 | 补充指出其他因素（如燃料的可用性）也影响选择 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> It anticipates a potential objection to the description of a model that the text provides.

划线部分并未针对模型提出反驳的异议，而是承认收入的限制作用，属于承认而非反驳。【无中生有】

**B 选项** ❌
> It admits the superficial plausibility of an assumption that the text presents as lacking any empirical support.

文中未说收入假设“缺乏任何实证支持”，而是承认收入确实约束燃料选择，且后文提出的是模型的简化性，不是完全否定收入作用。【偷换概念】

**C 选项** ✅
> It acknowledges the role played by a factor whose importance the text suggests has been overstated.

划线部分承认收入对燃料选择有作用，但全文语境表明该模型“过于简化”，暗示收入的重要性被夸大，故此选正确。

**D 选项** ❌
> It concedes that a finding may not appear to support the main view that the text advances.

划线部分并非让步某发现不支持主观点，而是在整体转折中承认收入限制作用，主观点是该模型过于简化，非被划线句否定。【方向相反】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于理解转折句中划线部分的语气和逻辑，转折词"although"引导让步状语，表明“收入确实有限制作用”，但紧接着指出其他因素也很重要，表明收入作用被夸大。抓住“although”这一转折让步信号词，结合全文“reductive this model”定位收入作用被过度强调，排除过度否定或无中生有选项，锁定承认但弱化作用的C选项。

The following text is from Anne Spencer's 1922 poem "Translation."
We trekked into a far country,
My friend and I.
Our deeper content was never spoken,
But each knew all the other said.
He told me how calm his soul was laid
By the lack of anvil and strife.
"The wooing kestrel," I said, "mutes his mating-note
To please the harmony of this sweet silence."
stem: Which choice best describes the function of the reference to the "wooing kestrel"(a type of bird)in the text as a whole?

options.content: It emphasizes the speaker's belief that her friend is not sharing his true feelings with her.
It suggests that nature has secrets that humans are fundamentally incapable of discovering.
It illustrates the assertion that peace is a subjective state rather than an objective one.
It presents the natural world as aligning with the experience of the speaker and her friend.

## 题目类型说明

本题为细节理解题，核心任务是理解“wooing kestrel”比喻在全文中的作用，进而判断它在表达什么意图。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> We trekked into a far country, My friend and I.

👉 交代背景和主角，说明两人一起进入一个陌生或遥远的地方。

**第2句：**
> Our deeper content was never spoken, But each knew all the other said.

👉 表达两人虽未言明内心深意，但彼此心领神会，强调默契。

**第3句：**
> He told me how calm his soul was laid By the lack of anvil and strife.

👉 朋友表达内心平静，原因是远离了“anvil（铁砧）”和“strife（冲突）”，暗示一种宁静无争的状态。

**第4句：**
> "The wooing kestrel," I said, "mutes his mating-note To please the harmony of this sweet silence."

👉 通过“wooing kestrel（求偶的猎鹰）”主动压制求偶叫声来配合周围的宁静，象征自然界也顺应并体现这种和谐与平静。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 叙述两人一同进入陌生远方，设定场景。 |
| 第二句 | 强调两人虽无言但彼此心意相通，体现默契。 |
| 第三句 | 朋友表达内心的宁静，源于远离冲突和喧嚣。 |
| 第四句 | 以“wooing kestrel”比喻自然界也顺应宁静，呼应两人的平和心境。 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> It emphasizes the speaker's belief that her friend is not sharing his true feelings with her.

错误，因为文中明确写到“each knew all the other said”，两人内心是互通的，并非“未分享真情”。此处选项属于【方向相反】。

**B 选项** ❌
> It suggests that nature has secrets that humans are fundamentally incapable of discovering.

错误，诗中没有暗示自然界有无法被人类理解的秘密，反而是自然与人类情感达成了和谐。此选项属于【无中生有】。

**C 选项** ❌
> It illustrates the assertion that peace is a subjective state rather than an objective one.

错误，诗中更强调客观存在的“sweet silence”和“harmony”，并无突出主观感受与客观现实的对比，属于【过度推断】。

**D 选项** ✅
> It presents the natural world as aligning with the experience of the speaker and her friend.

正确，诗中“wooing kestrel mutes his mating-note To please the harmony of this sweet silence”形象地表现自然界与两人内心平静相呼应，体现了自然与人心的和谐统一。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于理解“wooing kestrel”象征意义，通过“mutes his mating-note To please the harmony”这句话锁定自然界配合并反映人物心境的和谐关系，排除强调隐秘、主观感受或误读人际关系的选项，选项D最贴切全文意境。

## 题目类型说明

本题为文章细节理解题，核心任务是理解划线句在全文中的功能，即它在论述结构中的作用和意义。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Shedding light on the thermal biology of fungi, research by Radames Cordero et al. indicates that certain mushrooms (including *Marasmius capillaris* and species from the genus *Russula*) can achieve a hypothermic state through evaporative cooling.

👉 介绍研究背景和核心发现：某些蘑菇通过蒸发冷却达到低温状态。

**第2句：**
> Effects of this thermoregulation were not limited to the fungi's fruiting bodies and root-like hyphae: temperature reductions were observed in the air immediately surrounding the mushrooms.

👉 进一步说明蒸发冷却的影响范围扩大至蘑菇周围空气的温度降低。

**第3句：**
> Though slight, the reductions inspired an air-cooling device; using approximately 400 grams of mushrooms, the team's prototype lowered the air temperature in a controlled environment by 10°C in forty minutes.

👉 介绍由上述发现启发的实际应用——利用蘑菇制造空气降温装置。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                     |
|:---------|:----------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍研究及发现某些蘑菇通过蒸发冷却达到低温状态 |
| 第二句   | 说明蒸发冷却效应不仅限于蘑菇本体，还影响周围空气温度（划线句） |
| 第三句   | 介绍由这一发现启发的空气降温装置及其实验效果     |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> It presents a tangential finding about thermoregulation in certain fungal species that the experiment described later in the text was designed to explain.

错误原因：划线部分并非“无关发现”，而是直接支持了蒸发冷却的效应，并且为后续实验应用提供基础，非“离题”内容。【无中生有】

**B 选项** ❌
> It provides empirical evidence to bolster the claim made earlier in the text that certain fungal species maintain a hypothermic state.

错误原因：划线句强调的是“温度降低不仅限于蘑菇本体，还包括周围空气”，而非单纯证明蘑菇自身保持低温状态，焦点不同。【偷换概念】

**C 选项** ❌
> It identifies an unexpected observation that motivated the study of evaporative cooling in fungi that is discussed earlier in the text.

错误原因：蒸发冷却的研究是前文介绍的，划线句是在说明该研究的一个具体发现，而非“激发研究”的起点，时间顺序错误。【方向相反】

**D 选项** ✅
> It establishes a finding central to the text's discussion of a practical application resulting from the team's study of fungal thermal biology.

正确原因：划线句指出蘑菇周围空气温度降低这一关键发现，为后文蘑菇制冷装置的实际应用奠定基础，体现了从研究到应用的逻辑关系。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关键在于抓住划线句与上下文的因果关系及逻辑衔接。划线句描述的是“温度降低扩展到周围空气”，为后文“空气降温装置”提供依据，体现“研究成果—发现—应用”的链条，选项中要找体现这一点的描述，排除无关、时间顺序错乱和概念不符的选项。关键词包括“effects not limited to”、“temperature reductions in air”和“practical application”等，均指向选项D。

**B 选项** ❌

## 核心解题技巧
