| 第三句   | 介绍白颈蜂鸟大小和产地     |
| 第四句   | 描述白颈蜂鸟特征           |
| 第五句   | 介绍红宝石蜂鸟大小和产地   |
| 第六句   | 描述红宝石蜂鸟特征         |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> *Birds of Northern South America* is an expertly compiled guidebook by ornithologists Robin Restall, Clemencia Rodner, and Miguel Lentino.

与强调两只鸟的相似性无关，仅重复第1句内容，未涉及鸟的特征。【无中生有】

**B 选项** ❌
> The ruby-topaz hummingbird is a small hummingbird identifiable by its crimson crown and its short, black, curved bill.

只描述红宝石蜂鸟特征，未提及白颈蜂鸟，更未强调相似点。【以偏概全】

**C 选项** ✅
> While each exhibits unique traits of its own, the white-necked jacobin and the ruby-topaz hummingbird both have black bills.

准确使用第4句和第6句信息，指出两只蜂鸟的共同特征——“black bills”，同时承认它们各自的独特性，符合题意强调相似点。

**D 选项** ❌
> Though they share several traits in common, the white-necked jacobin is larger than the ruby-topaz hummingbird.

虽提及相似点，但重点放在大小差异上，突出不同而非相似，未有效强调相似性。【方向相反】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于找出题干“强调相似性”的信号词“similarity”、“both”，并定位描述两鸟共同特征的句子（第4句和第6句均提到“short, black bills”）。选项中C通过“both have black bills”直接呼应，且用转折词“While”承认差异，恰当平衡相似与不同，故为正确答案。其他选项要么无关，要么偏重差异，未紧扣题意。

article:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
Generally, an object will heat up when twisted.
The twisting of an object is known as torsion.
A 2019 study led by Zunfeng Liu and Ray Baughman tested the torsional heating of various fibers.
When a 3-millimeter-thick sample of thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) fiber was twisted, its average surface temperature increased by 6°C.
When a 4-millimeter-thick sample of styrene-ethylene-butylene-styrene (SEBS) rubber fiber was twisted, its average surface temperature increased by 3.5°C.
stem: The student wants to contrast the two samples. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.content: Twisting an object will generally cause its temperature to increase, a process known as torsional heating.
In 2019, researchers studied the effect of torsional heating on various fibers, including samples of SEBS rubber and TPU.
When the fibers were twisted as part of the 2019 study, the surface temperature of both samples increased.
The SEBS rubber sample used in the 2019 study was thicker than the TPU sample.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

本题为信息对比题，核心任务是利用笔记中关于两种样品的具体数据，明确有效地对比这两个样品的差异。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Generally, an object will heat up when twisted.
👉 说明普遍现象：扭曲物体通常会发热。

**第2句：**
> The twisting of an object is known as torsion.
👉 解释专有名词“torsion”。

**第3句：**
> A 2019 study led by Zunfeng Liu and Ray Baughman tested the torsional heating of various fibers.
👉 介绍一项2019年的研究背景。

**第4句：**
> When a 3-millimeter-thick sample of thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) fiber was twisted, its average surface temperature increased by 6°C.
👉 具体说明TPU纤维样品的厚度和温度变化。

**第5句：**
> When a 4-millimeter-thick sample of styrene-ethylene-butylene-styrene (SEBS) rubber fiber was twisted, its average surface temperature increased by 3.5°C.
👉 具体说明SEBS橡胶纤维样品的厚度和温度变化。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                      |
|:---------|:----------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 扭曲物体通常会升温（普遍现象）。          |
| 第二句   | 定义扭曲动作为“torsion”。                |
| 第三句   | 介绍2019年研究torsional heating的实验。 |
| 第四句   | TPU纤维样品（3毫米厚）扭曲后温度升高6°C。 |
| 第五句   | SEBS橡胶纤维样品（4毫米厚）扭曲后温度升高3.5°C。 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌【以偏概全】
> Twisting an object will generally cause its temperature to increase, a process known as torsional heating.
选项只说明了扭曲导致温度升高的普遍现象，未涉及两种样品的对比，未能完成题干“对比两个样品”的要求。

**B 选项** ❌【无中生有】
> In 2019, researchers studied the effect of torsional heating on various fibers, including samples of SEBS rubber and TPU.
虽然提到了两种纤维样品，但“包括”一词暗示研究范围更广，且未体现对比，信息泛泛而无对比焦点。

**C 选项** ❌【偷换概念】
> When the fibers were twisted as part of the 2019 study, the surface temperature of both samples increased.
选项只强调两者温度都升高，没有体现温度升高幅度或厚度差异，未体现对比效果。

**D 选项** ✅
> The SEBS rubber sample used in the 2019 study was thicker than the TPU sample.
选项准确引用原文中“4毫米厚的SEBS样品比3毫米厚的TPU样品更厚”信息，直接对比两样品的厚度，符合题干要求。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在锁定“对比”任务，需关注笔记中具体数据（厚度、温度变化）来区分样品。题干要求“contrast”，选项中只有D选项明确对比了两者厚度，其他选项要么泛泛而谈，要么未体现差异。重点关注定量信息和比较词（如“thicker”）是解题关键。

article:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
An isthmus is a strip of land that connects two larger pieces of land across an expanse of water.
It is also known as a land bridge.
The Isthmus of Korea is located in East Asia.
It connects the Korean Peninsula to mainland Asia.
stem: The student wants to provide a specific example of an isthmus. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.content: One example of an isthmus is the Isthmus of Korea in East Asia.
There is a land bridge in East Asia.
In East Asia, the Korean Peninsula is connected to mainland Asia.
An isthmus, also known as a land bridge, is a strip of land that connects two larger pieces of land across an expanse of water.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

本题为信息整合与应用题，核心任务是从笔记中提取并有效整合相关信息，准确给出一个具体的“isthmus”（地峡）实例。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> An isthmus is a strip of land that connects two larger pieces of land across an expanse of water.

👉 定义“isthmus”的基本含义。

**第2句：**
> It is also known as a land bridge.

👉 解释“isthmus”的同义称呼。

**第3句：**
> The Isthmus of Korea is located in East Asia.

👉 提供“isthmus”的具体实例及其地理位置。

**第4句：**
> It connects the Korean Peninsula to mainland Asia.

👉 进一步说明该实例的具体功能，即连接两个较大土地块。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                   |
|:---------|:-------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 定义isthmus，强调连接两大片土地的狭长陆地 |
| 第二句   | 说明isthmus也称为land bridge          |
| 第三句   | 给出具体例子——朝鲜地峡及其地理位置     |
| 第四句   | 说明朝鲜地峡连接朝鲜半岛和亚洲大陆      |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅（正确）
> One example of an isthmus is the Isthmus of Korea in East Asia.

准确给出具体实例（朝鲜地峡）并指出其地理位置，完全符合题干要求，直接使用了第3句和第1句的信息。

**B 选项** ❌（错误）
> There is a land bridge in East Asia.

表述过于笼统，只说存在“land bridge”，未明确指出具体实例。缺乏具体性，未完成题干“提供具体例子”的要求。
错误类型：【以偏概全】

**C 选项** ❌（错误）
> In East Asia, the Korean Peninsula is connected to mainland Asia.

虽然描述了连接关系，但没有明确指出“isthmus”或“land bridge”的概念，也未明确说明这是一个具体的“isthmus”例子。
错误类型：【偷换概念】

**D 选项** ❌（错误）
> An isthmus, also known as a land bridge, is a strip of land that connects two larger pieces of land across an expanse of water.

仅仅重复了定义，没有给出具体实例，未满足题干要求。
错误类型：【无中生有】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于识别题干要求“提供具体例子”，需同时包含定义和具体实例信息。转折词“example”指向具体事例，锁定选项中包含“具体地名（Isthmus of Korea）”的答案（A）。其他选项或过于笼统，或缺乏实例，或仅重复定义，均不能满足题意。

article:
Thomas Edison is regarded as one of the most important inventors in US history.
Having received little formal schooling, Edison relied on specialist employees at his various laboratories and offices to complete the technical work for many of his inventions.
William Joseph Hammer was a laboratory assistant who worked at the Menlo Park laboratory.
He is best known for curating the most comprehensive collection of historic light bulbs anywhere in the world.
William Symes Andrews was an electrical engineer who worked at the Edison Electric Light Company.
He is best known for establishing more than thirty power plants across New York and Pennsylvania.
stem: Which choice most effectively uses information from the given sentences to emphasize Edison’s reliance on Hammer?

options.content: William Joseph Hammer, a laboratory assistant, worked at the Menlo Park laboratory.
William Joseph Hammer, a laboratory assistant, was known for his valuable contribution to the field of technology.

Most of Thomas Edison’s employees had successful careers independent of working for him; for example, William Joseph Hammer, who worked at the Menlo Park laboratory, was an accomplished laboratory assistant.
Having received little formal education, Thomas Edison depended on specialized employees, including laboratory assistant William Joseph Hammer, for many of his inventions.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

本题为细节理解与信息整合题，核心任务是从原文中提取并整合信息，强调爱迪生对Hammer的依赖关系。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Thomas Edison is regarded as one of the most important inventors in US history.
👉 介绍主题人物爱迪生的重要性。

**第2句：**
> Having received little formal schooling, Edison relied on specialist employees at his various laboratories and offices to complete the technical work for many of his inventions.
👉 说明爱迪生因缺乏正规教育，依赖专业员工完成技术工作。

**第3句：**
> William Joseph Hammer was a laboratory assistant who worked at the Menlo Park laboratory.
👉 介绍Hammer的身份和工作地点。

**第4句：**
> He is best known for curating the most comprehensive collection of historic light bulbs anywhere in the world.
👉 说明Hammer知名的成就。

**第5句：**
> William Symes Andrews was an electrical engineer who worked at the Edison Electric Light Company.
👉 介绍另一员工Andrews及其职位。

**第6句：**
> He is best known for establishing more than thirty power plants across New York and Pennsylvania.
👉 说明Andrews的成就。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 爱迪生是美国重要发明家。 |
| 第二句 | 爱迪生因缺少正规教育，依赖专业员工完成技术发明。 |
| 第三句 | Hammer是Menlo Park实验室的实验助理。 |
| 第四句 | Hammer以收集历史灯泡闻名。 |
| 第五句 | Andrews是爱迪生电灯公司的电气工程师。 |
| 第六句 | Andrews以建立多座发电厂闻名。 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> William Joseph Hammer, a laboratory assistant, worked at the Menlo Park laboratory.
仅重复原文第3句内容，没有强调爱迪生对Hammer的依赖。
错误类型：`【无中生有】`，因为未体现题干要求的“强调依赖”。

**B 选项** ❌
> William Joseph Hammer, a laboratory assistant, was known for his valuable contribution to the field of technology.
原文中并未提及Hammer对技术领域的“valuable contribution”，而是强调其收藏灯泡成就，属于`【过度推断】`。

**C 选项** ❌
> Most of Thomas Edison’s employees had successful careers independent of working for him; for example, William Joseph Hammer, who worked at the Menlo Park laboratory, was an accomplished laboratory assistant.
原文未提及员工独立成功，且强调依赖的句子与此矛盾，属于`【方向相反】`。

**D 选项** ✅
> Having received little formal education, Thomas Edison depended on specialized employees, including laboratory assistant William Joseph Hammer, for many of his inventions.
准确整合第2句（爱迪生依赖专业员工）和第3句（Hammer身份）信息，强调了爱迪生对Hammer的依赖，符合题意。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关注题干关键词“强调依赖”，锁定原文中关于爱迪生依赖员工的句子（第2句），并结合介绍Hammer身份的句子（第3句），寻找选项是否体现两者关系；排除无关或过度推断信息。关键词“depended on”、“specialized employees”是判断依据。

---

article:

Grimanesa Amoros is a Peruvian American artist well known for her LED light sculptures.
Her sculpture Watch Your Step is made of smooth multicolored LED domes.

Her sculpture Golden Connection is made of entangled blue and white LED tubes.

stem: The student wants to emphasize a similarity between Watch Your Step and Golden Connection. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.content: Grimanesa Amoros is the artist behind Watch Your Step—a sculpture made of smooth multicolored LED domes.

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Grimanesa Amoros is a Peruvian American artist well known for her LED light sculptures.

👉 介绍艺术家身份及其知名领域。

**第2句：**

👉 描述作品《Watch Your Step》的材质和外观特征。

👉 描述另一作品《Golden Connection》的材质和外观特征。

| 第四句   | 介绍《Golden Connection》的材料和外观 |

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> Grimanesa Amoros is the artist behind *Watch Your Step*—a sculpture made of smooth multicolored LED domes.

此选项只提及《Watch Your Step》及艺术家，没有涉及《Golden Connection》，无法强调两者相似性。【以偏概全】

**B 选项** ❌

此选项强调两作品的体积差异，突出对比而非相似点，违背题目“强调相似性”要求。【方向相反】

此选项直接指出两件作品都是由同一艺术家创作，且都是LED灯光雕塑，准确强调了它们的相似性，符合题意。

**D 选项** ❌
> The smooth LED domes of Grimanesa Amoros's *Watch Your Step* stand in contrast to the entangled LED tubes of *Golden Connection*.

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在锁定题干“强调相似性”的指令，选项中出现的对比词（如“cuts a larger figure”，“stand in contrast”）均为排除信号。正确答案需用表述两作品共同点的句子，抓住“both made by same artist”和“both LED light sculptures”等关键信息，避免被强调差异的选项误导。

article:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
A U-shaped curve in a river channel is called a meander.
A meander forms when water erodes sediment from one side of the riverbank and redeposits that sediment on the opposite side.
Meanders will gradually change shape and migrate downstream over time.
A river with high sinuosity has many meanders, and a river with low sinuosity has few.
The Powder River in the United States has high sinuosity.
stem: The student wants to identify what causes meanders. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.content: The meanders in the Powder River will change shape and shift downstream over time.
High sinuosity is caused by the formation of many meanders, or curves, in a riverbank over time.
Over time, many meanders have formed in the Powder River, a river in the United States with high sinuosity.
The erosion and redepositing of sediment from one side of a riverbank to the other forms meanders, or curves, over time.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

本题属于信息筛选题，核心任务是从笔记中筛选出最直接且相关的信息，准确回答“是什么导致了meanders（河流弯曲）”的成因。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> A U-shaped curve in a river channel is called a meander.

👉 定义说明，明确“meander”的含义。

**第2句：**
> A meander forms when water erodes sediment from one side of the riverbank and redeposits that sediment on the opposite side.

👉 说明形成原因，解释meander的成因机制。

**第3句：**
> Meanders will gradually change shape and migrate downstream over time.

👉 说明meander的动态变化过程。

**第4句：**
> A river with high sinuosity has many meanders, and a river with low sinuosity has few.

👉 解释“sinuosity”（曲折度）与meander数量的关系。

**第5句：**
> The Powder River in the United States has high sinuosity.

👉 举例说明，指出具体河流的曲折度情况。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                             |
|:---------|:--------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 定义meander，即河流中的U形曲线   |
| 第二句   | 解释meander形成的原因             |
| 第三句   | 描述meander随时间的变化           |
| 第四句   | 说明河流曲折度与meander数量的关系 |
| 第五句   | 举例说明Powder河具有高曲折度     |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> The meanders in the Powder River will change shape and shift downstream over time.

错误原因：选项描述的是meander的变化过程，而非形成原因。与题干“causes meanders”目标不符。
错误类型：【方向相反】

**B 选项** ❌
> High sinuosity is caused by the formation of many meanders, or curves, in a riverbank over time.

错误原因：此选项解释的是“高曲折度”由“多个meanders形成”导致，关注点偏离了“meander形成原因”，属于间接描述。
错误类型：【以偏概全】

**C 选项** ❌
> Over time, many meanders have formed in the Powder River, a river in the United States with high sinuosity.

错误原因：只是陈述了meander的存在和形成数量，没有解释形成原因。
错误类型：【无中生有】

**D 选项** ✅
> The erosion and redepositing of sediment from one side of a riverbank to the other forms meanders, or curves, over time.

正确原因：直接引用了第2句原文，明确说明了meander形成的成因机制，且符合题干要求。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题核心在于锁定“causes meanders”的因果关系，重点关注含有因果词（如forms when, causes）和解释过程的句子，排除描述结果或状态的选项，确保答案直接对应“形成原因”而非变化或结果描述。选择与题干关键词高度匹配的选项，避免选项内容偏离问题焦点。

---

article:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
The exoplanet GJ 357 b (31 light-years from Earth) doesn't emit enough light to be observed by Earth-or space-based telescopes.
Astronomers were able to detect the exoplanet indirectly by the transit method of planetary detection.
In this method, astronomers analyzed the periodic dimming of the light emitted by a distant star.
They determined that this dimming was caused by the orbit of an unseen exoplanet (GJ 357 b) passing between the star and the observation point.
As of February 2024, the transit method had been used to detect 4,153 exoplanets.
stem: The student wants to explain an advantage of the transit method. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.content: The transit method of planetary detection was used to detect GJ 357 b, an exoplanet located 31 light-years from Earth.

In the transit method, astronomers observe the light emitted by a distant star for signs of dimming, which is caused by the orbit of an unseen exoplanet passing between the star and the observation point.

Used to detect exoplanets by the periodic dimming they cause in the light of the stars they orbit, the transit method allows for the discovery of distant exoplanets not bright enough to be observed directly.
As of February 2024, the transit method of planetary detection had been used to discover 4,153 exoplanets, including GJ 357 b.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

本题是细节理解与信息整合题，核心任务是从笔记中提取与“过境法优势”相关的内容，选择最有效表达该优势的选项。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> The exoplanet GJ 357 b (31 light-years from Earth) doesn't emit enough light to be observed by Earth-or space-based telescopes.

👉 说明了GJ 357 b本身光线不足，无法直接观测。

**第2句：**
> Astronomers were able to detect the exoplanet indirectly by the transit method of planetary detection.

👉 介绍过境法是一种间接探测该行星的方法。

**第3句：**
> In this method, astronomers analyzed the periodic dimming of the light emitted by a distant star.

👉 解释过境法的基本原理：分析恒星光线的周期性变暗。

**第4句：**
> They determined that this dimming was caused by the orbit of an unseen exoplanet (GJ 357 b) passing between the star and the observation point.

👉 阐述变暗的原因：行星经过星与观察点之间。

**第5句：**
> As of February 2024, the transit method had been used to detect 4,153 exoplanets.

👉 强调过境法的广泛应用和成功案例数量。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容与逻辑功能                             |
|:---------|:-----------------------------------------|
| 第1句     | 说明GJ 357 b光线微弱，无法直接观测（提出问题）       |
| 第2句     | 介绍过境法作为间接探测方法（提出解决方案）          |
| 第3句     | 解释过境法的工作原理（解释原因）                   |
| 第4句     | 具体说明光线变暗是因行星经过恒星和观察点之间（因果推论） |
| 第5句     | 展示过境法已成功探测大量系外行星（举例支持）         |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> The transit method of planetary detection was used to detect GJ 357 b, an exoplanet located 31 light-years from Earth.

错误原因：该选项只是陈述事实，没有说明过境法的优势或原因，缺乏“优势”信息。【以偏概全】

**B 选项** ❌
> In the transit method, astronomers observe the light emitted by a distant star for signs of dimming, which is caused by the orbit of an unseen exoplanet passing between the star and the observation point.

错误原因：选项仅解释了过境法的原理，没有突出其优势，未说明为何该方法有效或优于直接观测。【以偏概全】

**C 选项** ✅
> Used to detect exoplanets by the periodic dimming they cause in the light of the stars they orbit, the transit method allows for the discovery of distant exoplanets not bright enough to be observed directly.

正确原因：该选项明确指出过境法的优势，即“能够发现那些光线不足以直接观测的遥远系外行星”，准确对应第1句（光线不足）和第3句、第4句（方法原理），且强调了优势（间接检测光线不足的行星），符合题意。

**D 选项** ❌
> As of February 2024, the transit method of planetary detection had been used to discover 4,153 exoplanets, including GJ 357 b.

错误原因：选项仅陈述过境法的使用广泛和成果数量，没有说明其优势。【以偏概全】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题考查对信息整合和优势表达的理解。关键在于捕捉“光线不足无法直接观测”和“过境法通过恒星光线变暗实现间接探测”的因果关系，选项中含有“not bright enough to be observed directly（无法直接观测）”和“allows for the discovery（允许发现）”等关键词，锁定了正确答案C，同时排除仅描述过程或事实的选项。

| 第4句    | 苹果中抗坏血酸的具体含量（6mg/100g）                |
| 第5句    | 人体不能合成抗坏血酸，必须从食物摄取                |
| 第6句    | 抗坏血酸即维生素C                                  |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> Brussels sprouts contain vitamin C (also known as ascorbic acid)—80 mg in every 100g, to be exact.
只提到了球芽甘蓝的维生素C含量，没有涉及苹果的比较，未完成“比较两者”的任务。【信息不全】

明确指出两者都含维生素C，并且球芽甘蓝含量更高，准确使用了第1、2、3、4句中的相关信息，完成了比较任务。

> Brussels sprouts are vegetables, and apples are fruits.

article:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

The black-footed ferret is a mammal species.
Up until 1981, it was believed to be extinct.
That year, a live black-footed ferret was identified in the wild in the United States.
The black-footed ferret is considered a Lazarus species.
"Lazarus species" is a term for living species of organisms that were once believed to be extinct.
stem: The student wants to define the term "Lazarus species" and provide an example of one. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish these goals?

options.content: The term "Lazarus species" describes a living species of organism, such as the black-footed ferret, that was once believed to be extinct.
Sometimes, a species once believed to be extinct is later found living in the wild.
The black-footed ferret, a species of mammal, was identified in the wild in 1981.
One example of a Lazarus species is the black-footed ferret, a mammal species that was identified in the wild in the United States in 1981.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

定义题+信息整合题，核心任务是用笔记中的信息准确且简洁地定义“Lazarus species”并举出一个恰当的例子。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> The black-footed ferret is a mammal species.
👉 说明黑足雪貂的基本生物学分类。

**第2句：**
> Up until 1981, it was believed to be extinct.
👉 说明该物种曾被认为已经灭绝，提供背景。

**第3句：**
> That year, a live black-footed ferret was identified in the wild in the United States.
👉 介绍该物种被重新发现的关键事实。

**第4句：**
> The black-footed ferret is considered a Lazarus species.
👉 明确指出黑足雪貂是“Lazarus species”的例子。

**第5句：**
> "Lazarus species" is a term for living species of organisms that were once believed to be extinct.
👉 定义“Lazarus species”的含义。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 黑足雪貂是一种哺乳动物 |
| 第二句 | 1981年之前被认为灭绝 |
| 第三句 | 1981年在美国野外重新发现活体 |
| 第四句 | 黑足雪貂被认为是“Lazarus species” |
| 第五句 | “Lazarus species”定义：曾被认为灭绝但仍存活的物种 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅（正确）
> The term "Lazarus species" describes a living species of organism, such as the black-footed ferret, that was once believed to be extinct.
准确结合了第5句的定义和第4句举的例子，既给出定义又提供了具体实例，符合题干要求。

**B 选项** ❌（错误）【过度推断】
> Sometimes, a species once believed to be extinct is later found living in the wild.
这句话没有定义“Lazarus species”且没有举具体例子，信息不完整，且“sometimes”属于推断，笔记未提及频率。

**C 选项** ❌（错误）【以偏概全】
> The black-footed ferret, a species of mammal, was identified in the wild in 1981.
只举例没有定义“Lazarus species”，未达到题目要求。

**D 选项** ❌（错误）【偷换概念】
> One example of a Lazarus species is the black-footed ferret, a mammal species that was identified in the wild in the United States in 1981.
虽然举了例子，但没有定义“Lazarus species”，定义是题干的核心要求，缺失定义信息。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于题干要求同时完成“定义”和“举例”两项任务，需重点关注笔记中“Lazarus species”的定义句（第5句）和例子句（第4句），选项A准确整合了两者信息。选项中若缺少定义或缺少例子均无法满足题意，且要注意避免选项出现未在文中明示的推断词（如“sometimes”）或信息不完整。

article:
The A.M. Turing Award is a prestigious award given by the Association for Computing Machinery (ACM).
The ACM gives the award for "major contributions of lasting importance to computing."
Shafi Goldwasser won the award in 2012 for transformative work that laid the foundations for digital cryptography.
stem: Which choice most effectively uses information from the given sentences to emphasize when Shafi Goldwasser won the A.M. Turing Award?

options.content: For transformative work that laid the foundations for digital cryptography, Shafi Goldwasser won the A.M. Turing Award.
The prestigious A.M. Turing Award is given for "major contributions of lasting importance to computing."

Shafi Goldwasser is one winner of the A.M. Turing Award.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

本题为细节强调题，核心任务是选出最有效利用文章信息，突出“Shafi Goldwasser获奖时间”的选项。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> The A.M. Turing Award is a prestigious award given by the Association for Computing Machinery (ACM).

👉 介绍奖项及颁发机构，起背景说明作用。

**第2句：**
> The ACM gives the award for "major contributions of lasting importance to computing."

👉 说明奖项授予的标准和意义，进一步解释奖项价值。

**第3句：**
> Shafi Goldwasser won the award in 2012 for transformative work that laid the foundations for digital cryptography.

👉 具体说明获奖者、获奖时间及获奖原因，是核心事实句。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                             |
|:---------|:--------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍A.M. Turing Award及颁奖机构  |
| 第二句   | 阐述奖项授予标准和重要性          |
| 第三句   | 说明Shafi Goldwasser获奖时间及理由 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌【以偏概全】
> For transformative work that laid the foundations for digital cryptography, Shafi Goldwasser won the A.M. Turing Award.

此句强调获奖原因，但未提及获奖时间“2012”，无法突出时间信息。

**B 选项** ❌【无中生有】
> The prestigious A.M. Turing Award is given for "major contributions of lasting importance to computing."

此句只是重复第1、2句背景信息，未涉及Shafi Goldwasser或获奖时间，与题意无关。

**C 选项** ✅（正确）
> It was in 2012 that Shafi Goldwasser won the A.M. Turing Award.

此句通过强调结构“It was... that...”有效突出获奖时间“2012”，准确使用了第3句信息，符合题目要求。

**D 选项** ❌【偷换概念】
> Shafi Goldwasser is one winner of the A.M. Turing Award.

此句只简单说明获奖身份，未强调获奖时间，且信息过于笼统。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题考查对强调结构的理解与运用，题干关键词“emphasize when”指向时间信息，选项中只有C句通过“It was... that...”结构明确突出时间“2012”，其余选项或忽略时间，或无关内容，故优先选择C。注意锁定关键词“when”帮助排除与时间无关选项。

article:

stem: The student wants to specify how much vitamin C is in blackberries. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.content: Many animals can make ascorbic acid, which is also known as vitamin C, in their bodies, but humans cannot.

## 题目类型说明

本题为细节信息整合题，核心任务是从笔记中提取并准确表达黑莓中维生素C的含量信息。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Blackberries are fruits that contain ascorbic acid, an essential nutrient for humans.

👉 说明黑莓含有维生素C（抗坏血酸），且维生素C对人体必需。

**第2句：**
> Every 100 grams (g) of blackberries contains 21 milligrams (mg) of ascorbic acid.

👉 具体说明黑莓中维生素C的含量。

**第3句：**
> Many animals can make ascorbic acid in their bodies, but humans cannot.

👉 对比动物和人类体内维生素C合成能力的差异。

**第4句：**
> Human must get ascorbic acid from foods, including fruits and vegetables.

👉 说明人类必须通过食物摄取维生素C。

**第5句：**
> Ascorbic acid is also known as Vitamin C.

👉 解释“抗坏血酸”即“维生素C”的同义关系。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                                         |
|:---------|:-------------------------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 黑莓含有对人体必需的抗坏血酸（维生素C）                       |
| 第二句   | 每100克黑莓含21毫克抗坏血酸                                   |
| 第三句   | 多数动物能体内合成抗坏血酸，人类不能                           |
| 第四句   | 人类必须通过食物摄取抗坏血酸                                  |
| 第五句   | 抗坏血酸即维生素C                                            |

> Many animals can make ascorbic acid, which is also known as vitamin C, in their bodies, but humans cannot.

错误原因：此选项主要说明动物和人类合成维生素C能力的差异，并未具体说明黑莓中维生素C的含量，不符合题干要求。
错误类型：【无中生有】

**B 选项** ✅
> There is 21 mg of vitamin C in every 100 g of blackberries.

正确原因：准确提取了笔记中关于黑莓中维生素C含量的具体数据（第2句），且表达简洁明了，完全符合题干要求。

**C 选项** ❌
> Since humans cannot make vitamin C in their bodies, they must get this essential nutrient from foods like blackberries.

错误原因：强调了人类必须从食物摄取维生素C的事实，但未具体说明黑莓中含有多少维生素C，信息不够精准。
错误类型：【过度推断】

**D 选项** ❌
> Blackberries contain vitamin C, which humans must get from food.

错误原因：虽说明黑莓含维生素C且人类必须摄取，但未给出具体含量，不满足“specify how much vitamin C”的要求。
错误类型：【信息不全】

## 核心解题技巧

article:

An isthmus is a strip of land that connects two larger pieces of land across an expanse of water.

The Auckland isthmus is located in New Zealand.

stem: The student wants to emphasize a similarity between the Isthmus of Suez and the Auckland isthmus. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.content: An isthmus, or land bridge, is a strip of land that connects two larger pieces of land across an expanse of water.
The Auckland Isthmus connects the North Island to Auckland.
The Isthmus of Suez and the Auckland isthmus both connect two larger pieces of land across an expanse of water.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

本题为细节归纳与信息整合题，核心任务是根据笔记内容找出能有效强调两个地峡相似点的句子。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> An isthmus is a strip of land that connects two larger pieces of land across an expanse of water.

👉 定义“isthmus”（地峡），说明其基本特征。

**第2句：**
> It is also known as a land bridge.

👉 解释“isthmus”的同义称呼，补充定义。

**第3句：**
> The Isthmus of Suez is located in North Africa.

👉 介绍第一个具体实例的位置。

**第4句：**
> It connects the Mediterranean Sea to the Red Sea.

👉 说明苏伊士地峡连接的水域。

**第5句：**
> The Auckland isthmus is located in New Zealand.

👉 介绍第二个具体实例的位置。

**第6句：**
> It connects the North Island to Auckland.

👉 说明奥克兰地峡连接的地点。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                |
|:---------|:----------------------------------|
| 第1句    | 定义地峡，连接两大片陆地，隔水而立    |
| 第2句    | 地峡的别称——陆桥                    |
| 第3句    | 苏伊士地峡所在北非                   |
| 第4句    | 苏伊士地峡连接地中海和红海           |
| 第5句    | 奥克兰地峡所在新西兰                 |
| 第6句    | 奥克兰地峡连接北岛和奥克兰           |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> An isthmus, or land bridge, is a strip of land that connects two larger pieces of land across an expanse of water.

此选项仅定义“isthmus”，未涉及苏伊士地峡和奥克兰地峡的相似点。【以偏概全】

**B 选项** ❌
> The Auckland Isthmus connects the North Island to Auckland.

只提及奥克兰地峡，未体现与苏伊士地峡的相似性。【无中生有】

**C 选项** ✅
> The Isthmus of Suez and the Auckland isthmus both connect two larger pieces of land across an expanse of water.

准确指出两者共同特征，直接体现“相似点”，符合题意。原文第1句定义及两地峡事实支持此结论。

**D 选项** ❌
> The Isthmus of Suez is a land bridge, located in North Africa.

仅说明苏伊士地峡的别称和位置，未涉及与奥克兰地峡的相似性。【以偏概全】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 题干关键词“emphasize a similarity”要求找出两者共同点，注意选项中同时提及两者且体现相似特征的句子最为关键。利用原文定义（“connects two larger pieces of land across an expanse of water”）和两个实例事实锁定答案，排除只涉及单一地峡或仅定义的选项。

stem: The student wants to compare the hardness of talc and quartz. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.content: The Mohs scale of mineral hardness can be used to order fluorite, talc, and quartz by their ability to scratch other minerals.
A mineral with a Mohs number of 4, like fluorite, is harder than one with a Mohs number of 1, like talc.
Quartz can leave visible scratches on fluorite, which is why quartz has a higher number than fluorite on the Mohs scale of mineral hardness.
Quartz can leave visible scratches on talc, which means that quartz is harder than talc.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

这是信息应用题，核心任务是利用笔记中的相关信息，有效比较两种矿物的硬度。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> The Mohs scale of mineral hardness is a ten-point scale that orders minerals by hardness based on their ability to scratch other minerals.

👉 介绍摩氏硬度表的定义和排序依据。

**第2句：**
> Minerals with larger numbers are harder than minerals with smaller numbers and can leave visible scratches on them.

👉 解释硬度数值越大，矿物越硬且能划伤硬度较小的矿物。

**第3句：**
> Minerals with smaller numbers are softer than minerals with larger numbers and cannot leave visible scratches on them.

👉 进一步说明硬度数值较小的矿物较软，不能划伤硬度较大的矿物。

**第4句：**
> The mineral talc has a Mohs scale number of 1.

👉 给出矿物滑石的硬度数值。

**第5句：**
> The mineral fluorite has a Mohs scale number of 4.

👉 给出矿物萤石的硬度数值。

**第6句：**
> The mineral quartz has a Mohs scale number of 7.

👉 给出矿物石英的硬度数值。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                                         |
|:---------|:-------------------------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍摩氏硬度表及其排序依据                                   |
| 第二句   | 说明数值大的矿物更硬，能划伤数值小的矿物                   |
| 第三句   | 说明数值小的矿物较软，不能划伤数值大的矿物                 |
| 第四句   | 给出滑石的硬度数值为1                                       |
| 第五句   | 给出萤石的硬度数值为4                                       |
| 第六句   | 给出石英的硬度数值为7                                       |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> The Mohs scale of mineral hardness can be used to order fluorite, talc, and quartz by their ability to scratch other minerals.

错误原因：虽然选项内容正确，但题干要求比较的是滑石和石英的硬度，选项涉及了萤石，且没有直接比较滑石和石英，未聚焦题干目标。【以偏概全】

**B 选项** ❌
> A mineral with a Mohs number of 4, like fluorite, is harder than one with a Mohs number of 1, like talc.

错误原因：虽然正确描述了萤石比滑石硬，但题干要求比较的是滑石和石英，未涉及石英，信息不完整，未有效完成任务。【以偏概全】

**C 选项** ❌
> Quartz can leave visible scratches on fluorite, which is why quartz has a higher number than fluorite on the Mohs scale of mineral hardness.

错误原因：选项涉及石英和萤石的比较，而非题干要求的滑石和石英，且未直接比较滑石和石英。【以偏概全】

**D 选项** ✅
> Quartz can leave visible scratches on talc, which means that quartz is harder than talc.

正确原因：选项直接使用了“石英能划伤滑石”的信息，符合第二句和第三句关于硬度和划痕的定义，且直接比较了滑石和石英，准确完成了题干要求。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 题干要求比较“滑石和石英”的硬度，需定位笔记中关于两者的硬度数值及划痕关系（句2、3、4、6句）。关键词“harder than”“can leave visible scratches”是判断硬度关系的关键，通过它们确认石英硬度大于滑石，锁定选项D为最有效答案，排除未涉及两者直接比较的选项。

**B 选项** ❌

**C 选项** ❌

此选项只是泛泛地说明两作品都融合了原住民元素，没有强调两者的不同点。【无中生有】

**D 选项** ✅

准确使用原文细节指出两作品分别融入的不同原住民音乐元素，明确强调了区别，符合题意。

---

## 核心解题技巧

options.content: Browner's writing discusses Ballard, the classical music composer responsible for Cacēga Ayuwípí.
Consistent with Browner's observation that Ballard's music "relies on Indigenous instruments, rhythms, forms,...and other musical elements," Cacēga Ayuwípí incorporates a Ute eagle-bone whistle.
Discussing Ballard's body of works, Browner observes that it relies on elements of various Native musical traditions.

Browner notes that Ballard’s music "relies on Indigenous instruments, rhythms, forms,...and other musical elements," further indicating that it synthesizes Western classical music with elements of various Native music traditions.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

本题属于细节对应题，核心任务是将Browner的引述与Ballard具体作品《Cacēga Ayuwípí》中的相关信息准确关联，体现引用内容的具体应用。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Louis Ballard was a classical composer and citizen of the Quapaw Tribe.

👉 介绍Ballard的身份和背景。

**第2句：**
> He sought to synthesize Western classical music with elements of various Native musical traditions.

👉 说明Ballard音乐创作的目标和风格特征。

**第3句：**
> Ballard's composition *Cacēga Ayuwípí* incorporates a Ute eagle-bone whistle, a traditional Native instrument.

👉 举例说明Ballard作品中具体采用了印第安传统乐器。

**第4句：**
> Ethnomusicologist Tara Browner writes that Ballard's classical music "relies on Indigenous instruments, rhythms, forms,...and other musical elements."

👉 引用专家观点总结Ballard音乐中印第安元素的广泛运用。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 介绍Ballard的身份和民族背景。 |
| 第二句 | 阐述Ballard融合西方古典音乐与印第安音乐元素的创作目的。 |
| 第三句 | 举例说明其作品《Cacēga Ayuwípí》具体采用了传统印第安乐器。 |
| 第四句 | 引用Browner观点强调Ballard音乐依赖印第安乐器、节奏等元素。 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> Browner's writing discusses Ballard, the classical music composer responsible for *Cacēga Ayuwípí*.

错误原因：选项只是笼统说明Browner写Ballard与该作品有关，但未具体连接Browner的引述和作品细节，缺少具体关联。
错误类型：【无中生有】

**B 选项** ✅
> Consistent with Browner's observation that Ballard's music "relies on Indigenous instruments, rhythms, forms,...and other musical elements," *Cacēga Ayuwípí* incorporates a Ute eagle-bone whistle.

正确原因：明确用Browner的引述与《Cacēga Ayuwípí》具体使用土著乐器的事实相联系，契合题干要求的“连接引述和具体作品”。
证据：第四句引述Browner观点，第三句举例作品使用印第安乐器。

**C 选项** ❌
> Discussing Ballard's body of works, Browner observes that it relies on elements of various Native musical traditions.

错误原因：虽然描述了Browner对整体作品的看法，但未提及具体作品，也未体现与题干要求的“连接引用到具体作品”的目标。
错误类型：【过度推断】

**D 选项** ❌
> Browner notes that Ballard’s music "relies on Indigenous instruments, rhythms, forms,...and other musical elements," further indicating that it synthesizes Western classical music with elements of various Native music traditions.

错误原因：该选项将“综合西方古典音乐”的信息归于Browner，但原文中这部分观点是第二句作者叙述，不是Browner说的。
错误类型：【偷换概念】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于识别Browner引述的具体内容（依赖印第安元素）与具体作品细节（使用Ute鹰骨笛）的对应关系，锁定选项中同时包含两者的句子；同时注意区分作者叙述和专家观点，防止错误归因。关键词“consistent with”和引号内引用是连接引述和作品的信号，帮助排除无关或概括性选项。

article:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
A 2022 study analyzed geotagged social media posts to assess the effect of parks on happiness in 25 US cities.
The happiness score for posts made in a given city was calculated by comparing the frequencies of words with positive and negative connotations.
The happiness benefit of a city’s parks was the numeric difference between the happiness scores of posts made in parks and posts made elsewhere.
The park happiness benefit in Boston, Massachusetts, was about 0.05.
The park happiness benefit in Phoenix, Arizona, was about 0.11.
The average happiness benefit of parks across all cities was 0.10.
stem: The student wants to contrast the effect of parks on happiness in Boston with that in Phoenix. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.content: Although parks in both cities had a positive influence on happiness, this benefit was somewhat greater in Phoenix than in Boston.
While Phoenix’s parks had a positive happiness benefit, this was not true of Boston’s parks, whose happiness benefit was below average.
The study found parks in Boston and Phoenix to have a happiness benefit of 0.10, on average.
To contrast the effect of parks on happiness in Boston and Phoenix, the study analyzed geotagged social media posts.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

本题为细节对比题，核心任务是利用笔记中的具体数据对比波士顿与菲尼克斯两个城市公园对幸福感的影响差异。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> A 2022 study analyzed geotagged social media posts to assess the effect of parks on happiness in 25 US cities.

👉 介绍研究背景和方法。

**第2句：**
> The happiness score for posts made in a given city was calculated by comparing the frequencies of words with positive and negative connotations.

👉 解释幸福感评分的计算方法。

**第3句：**
> The happiness benefit of a city’s parks was the numeric difference between the happiness scores of posts made in parks and posts made elsewhere.

👉 定义公园幸福感效益的具体计算方式。

**第4句：**
> The park happiness benefit in Boston, Massachusetts, was about 0.05.

👉 给出波士顿公园的幸福感效益具体数值。

**第5句：**
> The park happiness benefit in Phoenix, Arizona, was about 0.11.

👉 给出菲尼克斯公园的幸福感效益具体数值。

**第6句：**
> The average happiness benefit of parks across all cities was 0.10.

👉 给出所有城市公园幸福感效益的平均值。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                             |
|:---------|:--------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍研究主题和方法               |
| 第二句   | 解释幸福感评分的计算方法         |
| 第三句   | 定义公园幸福感效益的计算方式     |
| 第四句   | 波士顿公园幸福感效益为0.05       |
| 第五句   | 菲尼克斯公园幸福感效益为0.11     |
| 第六句   | 所有城市公园幸福感效益平均为0.10 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅（正确）
> Although parks in both cities had a positive influence on happiness, this benefit was somewhat greater in Phoenix than in Boston.

正确。笔记中波士顿的幸福感效益为0.05，菲尼克斯为0.11，均为正值且菲尼克斯更高，完全符合选项内容。

**B 选项** ❌（错误）
> While Phoenix’s parks had a positive happiness benefit, this was not true of Boston’s parks, whose happiness benefit was below average.

错误。波士顿的幸福感效益为0.05，虽低于平均值0.10，但仍为正值，说明有正向影响，选项错误断言“不是正向影响”。【方向相反】

**C 选项** ❌（错误）
> The study found parks in Boston and Phoenix to have a happiness benefit of 0.10, on average.

错误。笔记显示波士顿为0.05，菲尼克斯为0.11，二者平均为(0.05+0.11)/2=0.08，不是0.10。【无中生有】

**D 选项** ❌（错误）
> To contrast the effect of parks on happiness in Boston and Phoenix, the study analyzed geotagged social media posts.

错误。该选项描述的是研究方法，而非直接对比两城市公园幸福感效益的数据，未完成题干要求的“对比”任务。【以偏概全】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题核心在于精准定位数值对比信息。题干要求对比两城市公园幸福感影响，需关注波士顿和菲尼克斯的具体幸福感效益数值（0.05 vs. 0.11）及其正负关系。选项中包含转折词“Although”提示两者均正向但程度不同，帮助锁定正确答案A。错误选项则多因对数值的误读或未完成对比任务而被排除。

---

article:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
1926: The US Congress gave the US Commerce Department authority to regulate safety standards in the fledgling commercial airline industry.
1938: Congress transferred this authority to a new independent government agency called the Civil Aeronautics Authority (CAA).
1958: Congress transferred authority from the CAA to the newly established Federal Aviation Administration (FAA).
The FAA's first administrator, Elwood R. Quesada, updated safety standards and technologies for the era of commercial jets.
The FAA remains the regulatory authority for airline safety.
stem: The student wants to specify the order in which different government entities were given the authority to regulate airline safety in the US. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.content: The authority to regulate US airline safety transferred from the US Commerce Department to the CAA in 1938, then from the CAA to the FAA in 1958.
The CAA had the authority to regulate safety for US airlines from 1938 until 1958, at which point authority was transferred to the US Commerce Department by Elwood R. Quesada.
The FAA, CAA, and the US Commerce Department all had the authority to regulate US airline safety, but they possessed this authority at different times.
The FAA has regulated airline safety since it was established by the US Congress in 1958.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

本题为细节事实题，核心任务是根据笔记内容准确梳理和表述各政府机构获得监管航空安全权力的时间顺序。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> 1926: The US Congress gave the US Commerce Department authority to regulate safety standards in the fledgling commercial airline industry.

👉 说明最初由美国商务部获得航空安全监管权。

**第2句：**
> 1938: Congress transferred this authority to a new independent government agency called the Civil Aeronautics Authority (CAA).

👉 说明监管权于1938年由商务部转移到CAA。

**第3句：**
> 1958: Congress transferred authority from the CAA to the newly established Federal Aviation Administration (FAA).

👉 说明监管权于1958年由CAA转移到FAA。

**第4句：**
> The FAA's first administrator, Elwood R. Quesada, updated safety standards and technologies for the era of commercial jets.

👉 介绍FAA首任管理员及其工作，但未涉及权力转移。

**第5句：**
> The FAA remains the regulatory authority for airline safety.

👉 说明FAA至今仍掌管航空安全监管。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                       |
|:---------|:-----------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 1926年，美国商务部首次获得航空安全监管权。 |
| 第二句   | 1938年，监管权由商务部转移给CAA。           |
| 第三句   | 1958年，监管权由CAA转移给FAA。              |
| 第四句   | FAA首任管理员Elwood R. Quesada更新安全标准。 |
| 第五句   | FAA至今仍是航空安全监管机构。                |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅（正确）
> The authority to regulate US airline safety transferred from the US Commerce Department to the CAA in 1938, then from the CAA to the FAA in 1958.

选项准确反映了监管权的时间顺序和转移过程，与笔记第1-3句完全对应。

**B 选项** ❌（错误）
> The CAA had the authority to regulate safety for US airlines from 1938 until 1958, at which point authority was transferred to the US Commerce Department by Elwood R. Quesada.

错误在于说1958年权力转回商务部，且将转移人为Elwood R. Quesada，原文显示权力转移到FAA，且Quesada是FAA首任管理员，不是权力转移者。
错误类型：【方向相反】【无中生有】

**C 选项** ❌（错误）
> The FAA, CAA, and the US Commerce Department all had the authority to regulate US airline safety, but they possessed this authority at different times.

选项表述模糊，虽然大体正确，但未指明具体时间顺序，且“they possessed this authority at different times”表述过于笼统，不能有效完成题干要求的“指定顺序”的任务。
错误类型：【过度推断】

**D 选项** ❌（错误）
> The FAA has regulated airline safety since it was established by the US Congress in 1958.

选项忽略了之前商务部和CAA的监管权，未体现权力转移过程，未满足“指定顺序”的要求。
错误类型：【以偏概全】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在锁定“权力转移顺序”这一核心信息。题干要求“指定顺序”，故答案必须清楚列出时间点及权力转移链条。原文中的时间词（1926，1938，1958）和权力转移动词“transferred”是解题核心。选项中准确反映这些时间顺序且没有错误信息的才是正确答案，错误选项多因时间顺序混淆或信息缺失被排除。

---

article:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
In the 1800s, some actors also managed theaters.
They were known as actor-managers.
William Charles Macready managed the Covent Garden Theatre (London) from 1837 to 1839.
He starred in a production of Henry V there in 1838.
Laura Keene managed Laura Keene's Theatre (New York) from 1856 to 1863.
She starred in a production of The Seven Sisters there in 1860.
stem: The student wants to emphasize a similarity between Macready and Keene. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.content: Both Macready and Keene were managers of the Covent Garden Theatre in London, where they also starred in various plays.
In the 1800s, some actors (such as Keene) also managed theaters, they were thus considered actor managers.
Macready managed a London theater whereas Keene managed one in New York.
As actor-managers, both Macready and Keene managed theaters where they also performed.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

本题为归纳总结题，核心任务是从笔记中提取两位演员经理的共同点，并用恰当的选项表达这种相似性。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> In the 1800s, some actors also managed theaters.

👉 说明历史背景和演员兼任经理的现象。

**第2句：**
> They were known as actor-managers.

👉 给上述现象命名，定义“演员经理”这一身份。

**第3句：**
> William Charles Macready managed the Covent Garden Theatre (London) from 1837 to 1839.

👉 举例说明Macready作为演员经理管理的具体剧院及时间。

**第4句：**
> He starred in a production of Henry V there in 1838.

👉 补充说明Macready不仅管理剧院，还在该剧院主演戏剧。

**第5句：**
> Laura Keene managed Laura Keene's Theatre (New York) from 1856 to 1863.

👉 举例说明Keene作为演员经理管理的具体剧院及时间。

**第6句：**
> She starred in a production of The Seven Sisters there in 1860.

👉 补充说明Keene不仅管理剧院，还在该剧院主演戏剧。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                               |
|:---------|:---------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 说明19世纪演员兼任剧院经理的现象 |
| 第二句   | 给这一身份命名为“演员经理”       |
| 第三句   | 举例Macready管理伦敦剧院          |
| 第四句   | Macready主演该剧院的戏剧          |
| 第五句   | 举例Keene管理纽约剧院             |
| 第六句   | Keene主演该剧院的戏剧             |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> Both Macready and Keene were managers of the Covent Garden Theatre in London, where they also starred in various plays.

错误原因：Macready管理的是Covent Garden Theatre，但Keene管理的是“Laura Keene's Theatre”位于纽约，非Covent Garden Theatre。此处地点错误。
错误类型：【无中生有】

**B 选项** ❌
> In the 1800s, some actors (such as Keene) also managed theaters, they were thus considered actor managers.

错误原因：该选项只提及Keene，忽略了Macready，未强调两者相似点，且叙述较笼统，未突出共同特征。
错误类型：【以偏概全】

**C 选项** ❌
> Macready managed a London theater whereas Keene managed one in New York.

错误原因：选项只是陈述两人管理剧院的地点不同，强调差异而非相似性，未达到题干要求“强调相似性”的目的。
错误类型：【方向相反】

**D 选项** ✅
> As actor-managers, both Macready and Keene managed theaters where they also performed.

正确原因：准确表达两人作为演员经理的共同点——管理剧院且在剧院中表演，完全符合笔记内容，且突出了相似性。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 题干要求强调两人的“相似性”，应聚焦两人共同特点，如“都管理剧院且主演戏剧”；选项中注意地点信息是否准确，避免因细节错误排除正确答案；关键词“both”“managed theaters”“performed”指向D选项；排除强调差异或只谈单方面信息的选项。

article:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
Long House is an Ancestral Puebloan dwelling site located in southwestern Colorado.
It was built under a rock overhang and inhabited from approximately 1200–1280 CE.
The overhanging rock ledges offered protection from heavy rain and snow.
Albert Porter Pueblo is an Ancestral Puebloan dwelling site located in southwestern Colorado.
It was built on relatively flat terrain and inhabited from approximately 1000–1300 CE.
This level surface allowed for the construction of large terraced buildings.
stem: The student wants to explain an advantage of the Long House dwelling site. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.content: The relatively flat terrain on which Long House was built allowed for the construction of large terraced buildings.
Since it was built under a rock overhang, Long House was naturally protected from heavy rain and snow.
Located in southwestern Colorado, Long House is an Ancestral Puebloan dwelling site that was inhabited from approximately 1200–1280 CE.
The location of Long House, an Ancestral Puebloan dwelling site in southwestern Colorado, provided an advantage to its inhabitants.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

本题为细节理解题，核心任务是根据笔记内容准确找出关于Long House居住地优势的相关信息。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Long House is an Ancestral Puebloan dwelling site located in southwestern Colorado.
👉 介绍Long House的基本位置和身份。

**第2句：**
> It was built under a rock overhang and inhabited from approximately 1200–1280 CE.
👉 说明Long House的建筑环境及使用时间。

**第3句：**
> The overhanging rock ledges offered protection from heavy rain and snow.
👉 解释Long House建筑环境的优势，即岩石悬垂提供的自然保护。

**第4句：**
> Albert Porter Pueblo is an Ancestral Puebloan dwelling site located in southwestern Colorado.
👉 介绍另一个居住地Albert Porter Pueblo及其位置。

**第5句：**
> It was built on relatively flat terrain and inhabited from approximately 1000–1300 CE.
👉 说明Albert Porter Pueblo的建筑环境及使用时间。

**第6句：**
> This level surface allowed for the construction of large terraced buildings.
👉 解释Albert Porter Pueblo建筑环境的优势，即平坦地形便于建造大型梯田式建筑。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容及逻辑功能                             |
|:---------|:-----------------------------------------|
| 第1句    | Long House的身份和位置（介绍）            |
| 第2句    | Long House的建筑环境和使用时间（补充说明）|
| 第3句    | Long House建筑环境的优势（因果解释）      |
| 第4句    | Albert Porter Pueblo的身份和位置（介绍）  |
| 第5句    | Albert Porter Pueblo的建筑环境和使用时间  |
| 第6句    | Albert Porter Pueblo建筑环境的优势（因果解释）|

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> The relatively flat terrain on which Long House was built allowed for the construction of large terraced buildings.
错误原因：原文中“relatively flat terrain”和“大型梯田建筑”是Albert Porter Pueblo的特征，不是Long House的。【偷换概念】

**B 选项** ✅
> Since it was built under a rock overhang, Long House was naturally protected from heavy rain and snow.
正确原因：完全对应原文第2句和第3句，说明了Long House建于岩石悬垂下，因而能防雨雪，准确表达了其优势。

**C 选项** ❌
> Located in southwestern Colorado, Long House is an Ancestral Puebloan dwelling site that was inhabited from approximately 1200–1280 CE.
错误原因：仅是基本事实介绍，没有说明任何优势信息。【无中生有】

**D 选项** ❌
> The location of Long House, an Ancestral Puebloan dwelling site in southwestern Colorado, provided an advantage to its inhabitants.
错误原因：泛泛而谈，没有具体说明何种优势，缺乏针对性信息。【无中生有】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于定位“Long House的优势”相关内容，注意区分两处不同居住地的特点。通过关键词“under a rock overhang”和“protection from heavy rain and snow”锁定正确选项，排除与Albert Porter Pueblo相关的“flat terrain”和“large terraced buildings”信息，避免偷换概念。避免选项中无关事实或泛泛而谈的表述，优先选取具体因果关系明确的陈述。

While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
The ratio of the total mass of an element to the combined mass of all elements in a given environment is called the mass fraction.
The mass fraction of chromium (Cr) on Earth is 4,700 parts per million (ppm).
This indicates that the relative abundance of chromium on Earth is 0.479%.
The ratio of the total number of atoms of an element to the total number of all atoms in a given environment is called the mole fraction.
The mole fraction of chromium on Earth is 2,300,000 parts per billion (ppb).
This indicates that the relative abundance of chromium on Earth is 0.23%.
stem: The student wants to emphasize a similarity between mass fraction and mole fraction. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.content: On Earth, the mass fraction of chromium is 4,700 ppm, or 0.47%, and the mole fraction is 2,300,000 ppb, or 0.23%.
While mass fraction is a measure of relative mass and mole fraction is a measure of relative atom count, both indicate the relative abundance of elements on Earth.
Both mass and mole fraction express the relative abundance of chromium on Earth as a ratio of the total mass of chromium to the combined mass of all atoms.
The mass fraction of chromium indicates its relative mass; in addition, the element's mole fraction indicates the relative number of chromium atoms.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

这是主旨归纳题，核心任务是找出最有效表达“mass fraction”和“mole fraction”之间相似性的选项。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> The ratio of the total mass of an element to the combined mass of all elements in a given environment is called the mass fraction.

👉 定义质量分数（mass fraction）。

**第2句：**
> The mass fraction of chromium (Cr) on Earth is 4,700 parts per million (ppm).

👉 给出铬元素地球上的质量分数具体数值。

**第3句：**
> This indicates that the relative abundance of chromium on Earth is 0.479%.

👉 说明质量分数对应的相对丰度百分比。

**第4句：**
> The ratio of the total number of atoms of an element to the total number of all atoms in a given environment is called the mole fraction.

👉 定义物质的量分数（mole fraction）。

**第5句：**
> The mole fraction of chromium on Earth is 2,300,000 parts per billion (ppb).

👉 给出铬元素地球上的物质的量分数具体数值。

**第6句：**
> This indicates that the relative abundance of chromium on Earth is 0.23%.

👉 说明物质的量分数对应的相对丰度百分比。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第1句 | 质量分数的定义 |
| 第2句 | 铬的质量分数数值 |
| 第3句 | 铬质量分数对应的相对丰度百分比 |
| 第4句 | 物质的量分数的定义 |
| 第5句 | 铬的物质的量分数数值 |
| 第6句 | 铬物质的量分数对应的相对丰度百分比 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> On Earth, the mass fraction of chromium is 4,700 ppm, or 0.47%, and the mole fraction is 2,300,000 ppb, or 0.23%.

此选项只是简单罗列了数值，没有强调两者的相似性，即都表示元素的“相对丰度”，属于【过度堆砌数据】且未完成题干“强调相似性”的核心任务。

**B 选项** ✅
> While mass fraction is a measure of relative mass and mole fraction is a measure of relative atom count, both indicate the relative abundance of elements on Earth.

选项正确点明了两者的区别（质量vs原子数）同时强调了共同点（都表示元素的相对丰度），符合题干“强调相似性”的要求，且用词准确，信息直接对应笔记内容。

**C 选项** ❌
> Both mass and mole fraction express the relative abundance of chromium on Earth as a ratio of the total mass of chromium to the combined mass of all atoms.

错误地将“mole fraction”定义为质量比，实质上mole fraction是原子数比，属于【偷换概念】。

**D 选项** ❌
> The mass fraction of chromium indicates its relative mass; in addition, the element's mole fraction indicates the relative number of chromium atoms.

选项正确区分了两者的定义，但仅是说明区别，没有突出两者的共同点，即“相似性”，未完成题干要求，属于【信息不全】。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题核心是“强调相似性”，需注意选项是否同时提及两者的共同点。关键词“both indicate the relative abundance”直接呼应题干核心。选项中同时提到“mass fraction”和“mole fraction”的定义区别和共同点，且用“both”并列强调共同属性，是锁定正确答案的关键。排除选项时注意不要被单纯罗列数据（A）、错误定义（C）或只强调区别（D）所迷惑。

article:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
Researchers Gwangsu Kim et al. sought to explore the relationship between the brain's ability to process natural sounds and its ability to process music.
They used an artificial deep neural network (DNN) that models how the brain processes auditory information. The DNN had been trained to detect natural sounds (excluding music).
Finding: The DNN spontaneously developed neurons that responded to music but not to other auditory stimuli.
Conclusion: The brain's ability to process music may arise as a by-product of natural sound processing.
stem: The student wants to present the aim of the study. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.content: Using an artificial deep neural network the researchers sought to explore the relationship between the brain's ability to process natural sounds and its ability to process music.
The researchers used an artificial deep neural network, which spontaneously developed neurons that responded to music but not to other auditory stimuli.
By training an artificial deep neural network, the researchers aimed to establish that the brain's ability to process natural sounds arises as a by-product of processing music.
In their study, the researchers evaluated whether an artificial deep neural network trained only on natural sounds would develop neurons that respond to music.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

本题为细节理解题，核心任务是从学生笔记中准确提炼出研究的“目的（aim）”，并用最相关且准确的信息表述该目的。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Researchers Gwangsu Kim et al. sought to explore the relationship between the brain's ability to process natural sounds and its ability to process music.

👉 明确指出研究的目的，即探索大脑处理自然声音和音乐能力之间的关系。

**第2句：**
> They used an artificial deep neural network (DNN) that models how the brain processes auditory information.

👉 说明研究方法，使用DNN模拟大脑处理听觉信息的方式。

**第3句：**
> The DNN had been trained to detect natural sounds (excluding music).

👉 进一步说明DNN训练内容，重点是排除音乐。

**第4句：**
> Finding: The DNN spontaneously developed neurons that responded to music but not to other auditory stimuli.

👉 报告主要发现，DNN对音乐产生了响应。

**第5句：**
> Conclusion: The brain's ability to process music may arise as a by-product of natural sound processing.

👉 总结推论，提出大脑处理音乐能力可能是处理自然声音的副产品。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 研究目的：探索大脑处理自然声音与音乐能力的关系。 |
| 第二句 | 研究方法：使用模拟大脑听觉处理的DNN。 |
| 第三句 | 训练细节：DNN仅训练检测自然声音，不包括音乐。 |
| 第四句 | 研究发现：DNN自发产生对音乐响应的神经元。 |
| 第五句 | 结论：音乐处理能力可能是自然声音处理的副产品。 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅（正确）
> Using an artificial deep neural network the researchers sought to explore the relationship between the brain's ability to process natural sounds and its ability to process music.

该选项准确表述了研究目的，强调“探索大脑处理自然声音和音乐能力的关系”，完全符合第一句原文内容。且简洁明了，体现研究核心。

**B 选项** ❌（错误）
> The researchers used an artificial deep neural network, which spontaneously developed neurons that responded to music but not to other auditory stimuli.

此选项描述的是研究方法和发现，而非研究目的，混淆了“目的”和“发现”的区别。【偷换概念】

**C 选项** ❌（错误）
> By training an artificial deep neural network, the researchers aimed to establish that the brain's ability to process natural sounds arises as a by-product of processing music.

此选项将结论倒置，原文结论是音乐能力是自然声音处理的副产品，而非相反，方向错误。【方向相反】

**D 选项** ❌（错误）
> In their study, the researchers evaluated whether an artificial deep neural network trained only on natural sounds would develop neurons that respond to music.

该选项描述了研究的具体实验设计和假设验证，属于研究过程和发现，未直接表达“研究目的”。【以偏概全】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题核心在于区分“研究目的（aim）”与“研究方法、发现、结论”之间的区别。题干要求表达目的，因此应重点锁定含“seek to explore”或“aim to explore”之类表达研究目标的句子。选项中出现具体实验细节、发现或结论的都非目的表述，需排除。关注关键词“relationship between …”帮助定位正确答案。

article:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
Leaders of the Province of Guatemala declared independence for Central America from the Spanish Empire on September 15, 1821.
The accompanying Declaration of Independence was written by Honduran scholar and politician José Cecilio del Valle.
The 1812 Spanish Constitution had provided some degree of independence for Central America, but it was repealed by the Spanish king in 1814.
Valle, a loyal advisor to the Spanish Empire’s administrators in Central America, had long opposed independence.
He changed his mind after Colonel Rafael del Riego’s 1820 revolt, which demanded the return of rights lost in 1814.
stem: The student wants to place the 1821 Declaration of Independence in the context of Valle’s changing political beliefs. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.content: A change in Valle’s political beliefs that occurred when the Spanish king repealed the 1812 constitution led to Valle writing Central America's Declaration of Independence.
Long an opponent of Central American independence, Valle changed his mind after an 1820 revolt and wrote the 1821 declaration.
The writing of Central America’s Declaration of Independence may not have happened were it not for Colonel Riego’s 1820 revolt.
Colonel Riego’s revolt was the inspiration that Valle, a long-standing opponent of Central American independence, needed to change his political beliefs.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

这是主旨归纳与信息整合题，核心任务是根据笔记内容准确表达瓦列（Valle）政治立场的变化及其与1821年独立宣言的关系。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Leaders of the Province of Guatemala declared independence for Central America from the Spanish Empire on September 15, 1821.

👉 介绍历史事件背景——中美洲于1821年宣布独立。

**第2句：**
> The accompanying Declaration of Independence was written by Honduran scholar and politician José Cecilio del Valle.

👉 说明独立宣言的作者是瓦列。

**第3句：**
> The 1812 Spanish Constitution had provided some degree of independence for Central America, but it was repealed by the Spanish king in 1814.

👉 介绍1812年宪法赋予部分独立权，但1814年被废除，构成政治背景。

**第4句：**
> Valle, a loyal advisor to the Spanish Empire’s administrators in Central America, had long opposed independence.

👉 阐述瓦列原本反对独立的立场。

**第5句：**
> He changed his mind after Colonel Rafael del Riego’s 1820 revolt, which demanded the return of rights lost in 1814.

👉 说明瓦列政治立场转变的原因是1820年里埃戈的起义。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                       |
|:---------|:------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 1821年中美洲宣布独立                       |
| 第二句   | 独立宣言由瓦列撰写                         |
| 第三句   | 1812年宪法赋予独立权，1814年被废除         |
| 第四句   | 瓦列长期反对独立                           |
| 第五句   | 1820年起义促使瓦列改变立场                 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> A change in Valle’s political beliefs that occurred when the Spanish king repealed the 1812 constitution led to Valle writing Central America's Declaration of Independence.

错误原因：瓦列的政治转变发生在1820年起义之后，而非1814年宪法废除时，文中明确说“changed his mind after Colonel Rafael del Riego’s 1820 revolt”，这里时间点错误。
错误类型：【方向相反】

**B 选项** ✅
> Long an opponent of Central American independence, Valle changed his mind after an 1820 revolt and wrote the 1821 declaration.

正确原因：该选项准确反映瓦列长期反对独立，且在1820年起义后改变立场，并撰写1821年独立宣言，完全符合原文信息。

**C 选项** ❌
> The writing of Central America’s Declaration of Independence may not have happened were it not for Colonel Riego’s 1820 revolt.

错误原因：该选项过度推断“独立宣言的撰写可能完全依赖于1820年起义”，文中只说明瓦列政治立场因起义改变，但未明确宣言必然因起义而写。
错误类型：【过度推断】

**D 选项** ❌
> Colonel Riego’s revolt was the inspiration that Valle, a long-standing opponent of Central American independence, needed to change his political beliefs.

错误原因：虽然此选项大体正确，但用“inspiration”一词带有较强的主观情感色彩，文中仅说明瓦列“changed his mind after”起义，没有明确表明起义是“灵感”或“启发”，存在一定的偷换概念。
错误类型：【偷换概念】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于准确把握瓦列政治立场变化的时间顺序和因果关系，注意“changed his mind after Colonel Rafael del Riego’s 1820 revolt”这一因果链条。选项中时间点、因果关系和措辞的细微差别决定了正确答案。排除选项时，重点关注原文明确的时间节点和立场转变描述，避免“过度推断”或“偷换概念”。

While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

A nonnative species is considered invasive if it causes environmental or economic harm in an ecosystem.
Curly pondweed is a species of aquatic plant native to parts of Eurasia.
It can also be found in the northern and western US.
There, it crowds out native plants and impedes aquatic recreation.
It is considered an invasive species in the US.
stem: The student wants to provide an example of an invasive species. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.content: In the northern and western US, curly pondweed is an invasive aquatic plant that crowds out native plants and impedes aquatic recreation.
One way a nonnative species of plant could cause harm in an ecosystem is by crowding out native plants and impeding aquatic recreation.
A nonnative species that crowds out native plants and impedes aquatic recreation, causing environmental or economic harm, is considered invasive.
Curly pondweed is an example of an invasive species that causes environmental or economic harm in parts of Eurasia.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

本题是信息整合题，核心任务是从笔记中筛选并准确整合相关信息，写出一个明确且符合要求的入侵物种实例。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> A nonnative species is considered invasive if it causes environmental or economic harm in an ecosystem.
👉 解释“入侵物种”的定义条件。

**第2句：**
> Curly pondweed is a species of aquatic plant native to parts of Eurasia.
👉 介绍曲叶藻的原生地理分布。

**第3句：**
> It can also be found in the northern and western US.
👉 说明曲叶藻在美国的分布，暗示它是非本地种。

**第4句：**
> There, it crowds out native plants and impedes aquatic recreation.
👉 描述曲叶藻在美国对环境和经济造成的具体危害。

**第5句：**
> It is considered an invasive species in the US.
👉 明确指出曲叶藻在美国被认定为入侵物种。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 解释入侵物种定义：非本地且造成环境或经济损害 |
| 第二句 | 曲叶藻原产于欧亚部分地区 |
| 第三句 | 曲叶藻也出现在美国北部和西部 |
| 第四句 | 曲叶藻在美国威胁本地植物并影响水上娱乐 |
| 第五句 | 曲叶藻被视为美国的入侵物种 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅（正确）
> In the northern and western US, curly pondweed is an invasive aquatic plant that crowds out native plants and impedes aquatic recreation.
该选项准确结合了曲叶藻的地理位置（美国北部和西部）、入侵物种身份及其对环境和经济的危害（挤压本地植物，阻碍水上活动），完全符合笔记信息。

**B 选项** ❌（错误）
> One way a nonnative species of plant could cause harm in an ecosystem is by crowding out native plants and impeding aquatic recreation.
该选项只是泛泛说明入侵物种可能造成的危害，未提及具体实例“曲叶藻”，未能完成“举例”任务。
错误类型：【以偏概全】

**C 选项** ❌（错误）
> A nonnative species that crowds out native plants and impedes aquatic recreation, causing environmental or economic harm, is considered invasive.
该选项只重复了入侵物种定义及危害，没有提供具体实例，未完成题目要求。
错误类型：【无中生有】（未举实例）

**D 选项** ❌（错误）
> Curly pondweed is an example of an invasive species that causes environmental or economic harm in parts of Eurasia.
该选项错误指出曲叶藻在欧亚地区造成危害，实际上笔记说曲叶藻是欧亚的原生种，且入侵危害发生在美国。
错误类型：【方向相反】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于锁定“举例说明入侵物种”的任务，需同时满足“具体实例”、“地理位置”和“入侵危害”三方面信息。选项中是否明确提到“曲叶藻”、“美国北部和西部”、以及“挤压本地植物和阻碍水上活动”等关键词是判定标准。错误选项多因缺失实例或地理错误而被排除。

Gabriel de Vallseca was a fifteenth-century Majorcan cartographer of portolan charts.

stem: The student wants to make a distinction between the two portolan traditions. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

## 题目类型说明

这是一道信息区分题，核心任务是根据笔记内容准确区分Majorcan和Venetian两种portolan地图传统的不同特征。

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Gabriel de Vallseca was a fifteenth-century Majorcan cartographer of portolan charts.

**第2句：**
> Domenico Pizigano was a fifteenth-century Venetian cartographer of portolan charts.

**第3句：**
> Portolan charts were early nautical charts that mapped the waterways of the Mediterranean and Black Seas.
👉 解释portolan charts的定义和用途。

**第4句：**
> Portolan charts in the Venetian tradition tended to be sparse in illustrations.
👉 描述Venetian传统地图的特点：插图较少。

**第5句：**
> Those in the Majorcan tradition tended to be richly illustrated.
👉 描述Majorcan传统地图的特点：插图丰富。

**第6句：**
> In Majorcan charts, the Atlas Mountains are depicted as a palm tree, and the Tagus River is depicted as a shepherd’s crook.
👉 举例说明Majorcan地图插图的具体表现。

## 结构总结

|:---------|:-----|
| 第1句 | 介绍Majorcan制图师Gabriel de Vallseca |
| 第2句 | 介绍Venetian制图师Domenico Pizigano |
| 第3句 | 解释portolan charts定义和用途 |
| 第4句 | Venetian传统地图插图稀少的特点 |
| 第5句 | Majorcan传统地图插图丰富的特点 |
| 第6句 | Majorcan地图中具体插图实例 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> Unlike Venetian portolan charts, which could include illustrations of palm trees and shepherds’ crooks, Majorcan charts were sparse in illustration.
