stem: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?

options.content: Rhoden and colleagues were the first to confirm that several of Saturn's moons contain hidden oceans.
Research has failed to identify signs that there is an ocean hidden beneath the surface of Mimas.
Rhoden and colleagues created a new computer model that identifies moons with hidden oceans without needing to analyze the moons' rotation.
Research has revealed that an oddity in the rotation of Mimas could be explained by an ocean hidden beneath its surface.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

主旨大意题，核心任务是准确把握文章中心思想，选出最能概括全文的选项。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> NASA's Cassini probe has detected an unusual wobble in the rotation of Mimas, Saturn's smallest moon.
👉 介绍研究背景和发现——发现Mimas自转中的异常摆动。

**第2句：**
> Using a computer model to study Mimas's gravitational interactions with Saturn and tidal forces, geophysicist Alyssa Rhoden and colleagues have proposed that this wobble could be due to a liquid ocean moving beneath the moon’s icy surface.
👉 解释原因——通过模型推测摆动可能由隐藏的液态海洋引起。

**第3句：**
> The researchers believe other moons should be examined to see if they too might have oceans hidden beneath their surfaces.
👉 展望和建议——研究人员建议继续探查其他卫星是否也有隐藏海洋。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                                         |
|:---------|:-------------------------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍Mimas自转中发现的异常摆动                                 |
| 第二句   | 通过计算模型推测摆动原因是地下液态海洋                         |
| 第三句   | 研究人员建议检查其他卫星是否也有隐藏海洋                       |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> Rhoden and colleagues were the first to confirm that several of Saturn's moons contain hidden oceans.
错误原因：文中只提到对Mimas的推测，且只是提出假说，并未确认，也没有涉及“多个卫星”。【无中生有】

**B 选项** ❌
> Research has failed to identify signs that there is an ocean hidden beneath the surface of Mimas.
错误原因：文中明确提出了地下海洋可能解释摆动，说明发现了“迹象”，与选项内容方向相反。【方向相反】

**C 选项** ❌
> Rhoden and colleagues created a new computer model that identifies moons with hidden oceans without needing to analyze the moons' rotation.
错误原因：文中模型是用来分析Mimas的自转摆动，且依赖自转数据，选项描述与文意不符。【无中生有】

**D 选项** ✅
> Research has revealed that an oddity in the rotation of Mimas could be explained by an ocean hidden beneath its surface.
正确原因：准确概括了文章核心内容，即“发现Mimas自转异常，推测由隐藏海洋引起”。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 主旨题关键在于把握全文焦点，注意文章的转折和因果关系词（如“proposed”，“could be due to”），排除过度绝对或与原文不符的选项，选项应与原文事实和表述严格对应。

article:
The following text is adapted from Ann Petry's 1946 novel The Street. Lutie lives in an apartment in Harlem, New York.

The glow from the sunset was making the street radiant. The street is nice in this light, [Lutie] thought. It was swarming with children who were playing ball and darting back and forth across the sidewalk in complicated games of tag. Girls were skipping double dutch rope, going tirelessly through the exact center of a pair of ropes, jumping first on one foot and then the other.
stem: Which choice best describes what is happening in the text?

options.content: Lutie is observing the appearance of the street at a particular time of day and the events occurring on it.
Lutie is annoyed by the noise of children playing games on her street.
Lutie is puzzled by the rules of certain children's games.
Lutie is spending time alone in her apartment because she doesn't want to interact with her neighbors.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

本题是细节理解题，核心任务是准确把握文章描写的场景和人物的观察内容。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> The glow from the sunset was making the street radiant.

👉 描写环境光线，营造温暖美好的氛围。

**第2句：**
> The street is nice in this light, [Lutie] thought.

👉 通过Lutie的内心独白表达对街道景象的肯定和喜爱。

**第3句：**
> It was swarming with children who were playing ball and darting back and forth across the sidewalk in complicated games of tag.

👉 具体描写街上孩子们活跃的情景，突出热闹与生动。

**第4句：**
> Girls were skipping double dutch rope, going tirelessly through the exact center of a pair of ropes, jumping first on one foot and then the other.

👉 进一步细节描绘儿童们玩跳绳游戏的具体动作，展现街道的活力。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                   |
|:---------|:-------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 描述夕阳余晖使街道显得光彩照人         |
| 第二句   | Lutie内心感受，认为街道在此时光线下很美 |
| 第三句   | 街上孩子们玩球和复杂的捉迷藏游戏       |
| 第四句   | 女孩们跳双绳游戏的详细动作描写         |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅
> Lutie is observing the appearance of the street at a particular time of day and the events occurring on it.

正确。文章中明确写道“Lutie thought”街道在夕阳下很美，且详细描绘了街上孩子们的活动，吻合选项内容。

**B 选项** ❌
> Lutie is annoyed by the noise of children playing games on her street.

错误，文中无任何表示Lutie感到恼怒的语句，反而是“the street is nice in this light”，表现出积极感受。【无中生有】

**C 选项** ❌
> Lutie is puzzled by the rules of certain children's games.

错误，文中没有任何疑惑或不解的描写，只有细致的观察和描述。【无中生有】

**D 选项** ❌
> Lutie is spending time alone in her apartment because she doesn't want to interact with her neighbors.

错误，文中没有提及Lutie独处或避免与邻居互动的内容，全文关注的是她对街景的观察。【无中生有】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于捕捉人物内心独白及环境描写的语气，“Lutie thought”和“the street is nice”表明积极观察态度，结合细节描写孩子们的活动，排除带有情绪色彩或推断的选项，锁定描述观察事实的A选项。关键词“thought”、“nice”、“children playing”是判断的关键。

article: Psychologists wanted to test how young children think about rewards and fairness. In an experiment, two teachers handed out rewards while children (ages four to six) watched. The teachers gave out the same number of rewards, but one of them counted the rewards out loud. The children were then asked who was fairer. 73% chose the teacher who counted. The psychologists think that counting showed the children that the teacher wanted to be fair. The children may have believed that the teacher who did not count did not care about fairness.
stem: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?

options.content: Psychologists think children cannot understand the concept of fairness until they are six years old.
An experiment found that counting out loud is the best way to teach mathematical concepts to children.
An experiment showed that the way rewards are given out may affect whether young children think the situation is fair.
Psychologists think young children expect to be rewarded when the children show that they care about fairness.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

主旨大意题，核心任务是准确把握文章的中心思想，选出最能概括全文内容的选项。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Psychologists wanted to test how young children think about rewards and fairness.

👉 引出研究目的，提出研究问题。

**第2句：**
> In an experiment, two teachers handed out rewards while children (ages four to six) watched.

👉 介绍实验背景和参与者。

**第3句：**
> The teachers gave out the same number of rewards, but one of them counted the rewards out loud.

👉 说明实验的关键变量：是否数数。

**第4句：**
> The children were then asked who was fairer.

👉 说明实验的测量标准：孩子们的公平感知。

**第5句：**
> 73% chose the teacher who counted.

👉 实验结果，孩子们更倾向于认为数数的老师更公平。

**第6句：**
> The psychologists think that counting showed the children that the teacher wanted to be fair.

👉 解释结果，数数行为被视为公平意愿的表现。

**第7句：**
> The children may have believed that the teacher who did not count did not care about fairness.

👉 进一步推测孩子的心理，未数数老师被认为不在意公平。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 提出研究目的：儿童如何看待奖励和公平 |
| 第二句 | 描述实验设计和参与者 |
| 第三句 | 介绍实验变量：数数与否 |
| 第四句 | 说明实验测量：谁更公平 |
| 第五句 | 实验结果：多数孩子选数数老师 |
| 第六句 | 解释结果：数数显示公平意愿 |
| 第七句 | 推测孩子心理：未数数老师被认为不关心公平 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> Psychologists think children cannot understand the concept of fairness until they are six years old.

错误原因：文章未提及儿童理解公平的年龄限制，只说明4-6岁儿童的反应，且无“不能理解公平”这一结论。【无中生有】

**B 选项** ❌
> An experiment found that counting out loud is the best way to teach mathematical concepts to children.

错误原因：文章焦点是“公平感知”，非“数学概念教学”。数数只是展示公平意愿的手段，不是数学教学内容。【偷换概念】

**C 选项** ✅
> An experiment showed that the way rewards are given out may affect whether young children think the situation is fair.

正确原因：文章核心内容即是实验发现“给奖励的方式（是否数数）影响孩子对公平的判断”，完全吻合原文。

**D 选项** ❌
> Psychologists think young children expect to be rewarded when the children show that they care about fairness.

错误原因：文章无提及孩子“期待奖励”与“表现关心公平”的关系，且研究重点是孩子如何看待老师的公平行为。【无中生有】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题抓住“main idea”关键词，锁定文章的研究主题和实验结论。重点关注因果关系词（如“think”、“showed”）和实验描述部分，排除与公平无关或无文中依据的选项。选项C准确表达了实验核心发现，其他选项均存在信息缺失或偏离主题的问题。

article: To make her art more widely available, graphic artist Elizabeth Catlett turned to linocuts. In linocut printing, an artist carves an image into a sheet of linoleum to create a stamp that is used to mass-produce prints. In the linocut series The Black Woman (1946–1947), Catlett depicts the everyday experiences of Black women alongside the achievements of well-known Black women. This pairing invites the viewer to draw connections among the women. The linocut process enabled Catlett's work to reach a wide audience and supported her aim to unite Black women through her art.
stem: According to the text, what is significant about Catlett's use of linocut printing?

options.content: Linocut printing helped Catlett use art to connect people, especially Black women.
Catlett was one of the first Black artists to use linocut printing.
Catlett became commercially successful once she started using linocut printing.
Linocut printing involved using materials that were readily available to Catlett.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

这是细节理解题，核心任务是准确把握文章中关于Catlett使用linocut印刷技术的重要意义。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> To make her art more widely available, graphic artist Elizabeth Catlett turned to linocuts.
👉 说明Catlett选择linocut的目的——让艺术更广泛传播。

**第2句：**
> In linocut printing, an artist carves an image into a sheet of linoleum to create a stamp that is used to mass-produce prints.
👉 解释linocut印刷的基本工艺。

**第3句：**
> In the linocut series *The Black Woman* (1946–1947), Catlett depicts the everyday experiences of Black women alongside the achievements of well-known Black women.
👉 介绍Catlett的作品内容，强调描绘黑人女性的日常和成就。

**第4句：**
> This pairing invites the viewer to draw connections among the women.
👉 说明作品意图——促使观众联想到黑人女性之间的联系。

**第5句：**
> The linocut process enabled Catlett's work to reach a wide audience and supported her aim to unite Black women through her art.
👉 总结linocut技术的意义：帮助作品广泛传播，支持Catlett团结黑人女性的目标。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                                         |
|:---------|:------------------------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | Catlett采用linocut技术以使作品更广泛传播                     |
| 第二句   | 解释linocut印刷的工艺                                        |
| 第三句   | 描述Catlett作品内容，表现黑人女性的日常和成就                 |
| 第四句   | 作品促使观众联想黑人女性之间的联系                           |
| 第五句   | linocut技术使作品广泛传播，支持Catlett团结黑人女性的艺术目标 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅（正确）
> Linocut printing helped Catlett use art to connect people, especially Black women.
正确。文章最后一句明确指出linocut技术支持了她“unite Black women through her art”的目标，体现了用艺术连接黑人女性。

**B 选项** ❌（错误）
> Catlett was one of the first Black artists to use linocut printing.
文章未提及Catlett是否是最早使用linocut的黑人艺术家，属于【无中生有】。

**C 选项** ❌（错误）
> Catlett became commercially successful once she started using linocut printing.
文章没有提到商业成功，只有“make her art more widely available”，属于【过度推断】。

**D 选项** ❌（错误）
> Linocut printing involved using materials that were readily available to Catlett.
文章解释了工艺但未提及材料是否易得，属于【无中生有】。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关注题干关键词“significant about Catlett's use of linocut printing”，结合文章中“to make her art more widely available”和“enabled Catlett's work to reach a wide audience and supported her aim to unite Black women”两处因果关系，锁定选项A，排除其他无文本支持的选项。关键词“connect people”，“especially Black women”与文章意图高度吻合。

article: Microplastics are pieces of plastic that are smaller than a grain of rice. These small plastics can be found in large quantities in ocean waters. Ecologist Jessica Reichert and her team are studying the role reef-building corals have in capturing microplastics from ocean waters. Through research, her team has found that these corals may be storing up to 20 million kilograms of microplastics each year in their skeletons and tissues.
stem: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?

options.content: Ecologists are interested in learning more about how certain corals build large reefs.
Microplastics are small pieces of plastic that can be found in ocean waters.
Questions remain around the impact certain corals have on ocean ecosystems.
Ecologists predict that corals store large amounts of microplastics from ocean waters.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

主旨大意题，核心任务是准确把握文章的中心思想，选出最能概括全文主旨的选项。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Microplastics are pieces of plastic that are smaller than a grain of rice.

👉 定义microplastics，为后文讨论做铺垫。

**第2句：**
> These small plastics can be found in large quantities in ocean waters.

👉 说明microplastics在海洋中的普遍存在。

**第3句：**
> Ecologist Jessica Reichert and her team are studying the role reef-building corals have in capturing microplastics from ocean waters.

👉 引入研究主题和研究对象（珊瑚及其捕捉microplastics的作用）。

**第4句：**
> Through research, her team has found that these corals may be storing up to 20 million kilograms of microplastics each year in their skeletons and tissues.

👉 给出研究发现，指出珊瑚每年可能储存大量microplastics。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                                         |
|:---------|:-------------------------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 定义microplastics是什么                                       |
| 第二句   | 说明microplastics在海洋中的大量存在                           |
| 第三句   | 介绍研究对象和研究方向——珊瑚捕捉microplastics的作用          |
| 第四句   | 研究发现珊瑚每年可能储存多达2000万公斤microplastics           |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> Ecologists are interested in learning more about how certain corals build large reefs.

错误，文中没有提及生态学家研究珊瑚如何建造大珊瑚礁，研究重点是珊瑚捕捉microplastics的作用。【无中生有】

**B 选项** ❌
> Microplastics are small pieces of plastic that can be found in ocean waters.

虽然该句确实是文中信息，但只是事实陈述，未体现文章的主要研究内容或主旨，太片面。【以偏概全】

**C 选项** ❌
> Questions remain around the impact certain corals have on ocean ecosystems.

文中未提及“疑问仍然存在”，而是明确指出了珊瑚可能储存大量microplastics的发现，错误表达研究状态。【无中生有】

**D 选项** ✅
> Ecologists predict that corals store large amounts of microplastics from ocean waters.

正确，准确反映了文章核心信息：生态学家研究发现珊瑚每年储存大量microplastics。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题考查对文章主旨的把握，关键在于捕捉文章最后一句核心研究发现（"her team has found... may be storing up to 20 million kilograms"），以及研究对象和内容（珊瑚捕捉microplastics），排除仅陈述事实或引入信息的选项，锁定体现整体研究结论的选项D。关键词“storing large amounts”、“ecologists”等指向正确答案。

article: Scrapbooks of saved fabric pieces were commonly kept by women in the nineteenth-century United States, but few are as meticulously detailed as Hannah Ditzler Alspaugh's work. Alongside each piece of fabric, Alspaugh recorded intimate memories, such as dressmaking with her sister. Additionally, she listed the prices and how she used the fabric. Historians note that by representing fifty years of changing textures, patterns, and dress styles, the scrapbook is a record of nineteenth-century textiles and dressmaking as well as Alspaugh's life.
stem: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?

options.content: Fabric scrapbooks were a popular hobby for many women in the nineteenth-century United States.
Alspaugh’s scrapbook provides a detailed account of her life and historical record of fashion trends in the nineteenth-century United States.
Historians rely on fabric scrapbooks to understand how fashions changed throughout the nineteenth century United States.
Alspaugh inspired other women to save pieces of fabric in scrapbooks and provide historical records of nineteenth-century fashions in the United States.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

主旨大意题，核心任务是总结文章的中心思想，选出最准确概括全文内容的选项。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Scrapbooks of saved fabric pieces were commonly kept by women in the nineteenth-century United States, but few are as meticulously detailed as Hannah Ditzler Alspaugh's work.

👉 介绍背景事实（十九世纪美国女性普遍制作布料剪贴簿）并突出Alspaugh剪贴簿的独特细致。

**第2句：**
> Alongside each piece of fabric, Alspaugh recorded intimate memories, such as dressmaking with her sister.

👉 说明Alspaugh剪贴簿的具体内容之一：记录了与布料相关的亲密回忆。

**第3句：**
> Additionally, she listed the prices and how she used the fabric.

👉 进一步补充剪贴簿内容：记录价格和用途。

**第4句：**
> Historians note that by representing fifty years of changing textures, patterns, and dress styles, the scrapbook is a record of nineteenth-century textiles and dressmaking as well as Alspaugh's life.

👉 总结剪贴簿的历史价值：既是纺织品和服饰变迁的记录，也是Alspaugh个人生活的见证。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 介绍十九世纪美国女性普遍制作布料剪贴簿，突出Alspaugh作品的细致 |
| 第二句 | 说明Alspaugh剪贴簿记录了亲密回忆 |
| 第三句 | 说明剪贴簿还记录了价格和用途 |
| 第四句 | 总结剪贴簿是历史纺织品和服饰变迁以及Alspaugh生活的记录 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> Fabric scrapbooks were a popular hobby for many women in the nineteenth-century United States.

错误原因：文章虽提到布料剪贴簿常见，但并未强调是“热门爱好”，且未体现Alspaugh剪贴簿的特殊性。【以偏概全】

**B 选项** ✅
> Alspaugh’s scrapbook provides a detailed account of her life and historical record of fashion trends in the nineteenth-century United States.

正确原因：准确概括全文主旨，既体现Alspaugh剪贴簿的细致记录，也包含其历史价值，符合第1句和第4句内容。

**C 选项** ❌
> Historians rely on fabric scrapbooks to understand how fashions changed throughout the nineteenth century United States.

错误原因：文章仅说“historians note”该剪贴簿的价值，未说他们“依赖”所有布料剪贴簿来理解时尚变迁，范围扩大了。【过度推断】

**D 选项** ❌
> Alspaugh inspired other women to save pieces of fabric in scrapbooks and provide historical records of nineteenth-century fashions in the United States.

错误原因：文章未提及Alspaugh对其他女性的影响，属于无依据的推断。【无中生有】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题考查对文章主旨的把握。文章开头提出背景并突出Alspaugh剪贴簿的独特细节，结尾总结其历史和个人生活价值。选项中需同时涵盖这两点，注意排除范围过大或无依据的推断。关键词如“detailed account”、“historical record”指向选项B，帮助锁定正确答案。

article: Xin Wang and colleagues have discovered the earliest known example of a flower bud in a 164-million-year-old plant fossil in China. The researchers have named the new species Florigerminis jurassica. They believe that the discovery pushes the emergence of flowering plants, or angiosperms, back to the Jurassic period, which occurred between 145 million and 201 million years ago.
stem: According to the text, how old was the fossil that Wang and colleagues discovered?
text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

细节理解题，核心任务是准确从文章中找到关于化石年龄的具体数据信息。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Xin Wang and colleagues have discovered the earliest known example of a flower bud in a 164-million-year-old plant fossil in China.

👉 说明发现了一个164百万年前的植物化石，是已知最早的花蕾实例。

**第2句：**
> The researchers have named the new species *Florigerminis jurassica*.

👉 介绍该化石被命名为新物种。

**第3句：**
> They believe that the discovery pushes the emergence of flowering plants, or angiosperms, back to the Jurassic period, which occurred between 145 million and 201 million years ago.

👉 解释该发现将被子植物起源时间推前至侏罗纪时期（145-201百万年前）。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                           |
|:---------|:------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍发现了一个164百万年前的花蕾化石 |
| 第二句   | 说明新物种的命名                |
| 第三句   | 说明该发现推前了被子植物的起源时期 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> 150 million years old

文章中明确指出是164百万年，不是150百万年，数字不符。【无中生有】

**B 选项** ❌
> 145 million years old

145百万年是侏罗纪的起始时间，不是化石的具体年龄。【偷换概念】

**C 选项** ✅
> 164 million years old

文章第一句明确指出植物化石年龄为164百万年，完全符合题意。

**D 选项** ❌
> 201 million years old

201百万年是侏罗纪的结束时间，不是化石的具体年龄。【偷换概念】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于锁定文章中明确的数字信息“164-million-year-old”，注意区分文中提到的化石具体年龄与侏罗纪时期的时间范围，避免被区间时间（145-201百万年）误导，从而准确选出具体的化石年龄。

article:
The following text is adapted from Frances Hodgson Burnett's 1911 novel The Secret Garden. Mary, a young girl, recently found an overgrown hidden garden.
Mary was an odd, determined little person, and now she had something interesting to be determined about, she was very much absorbed, indeed. She worked and dug and pulled up weeds steadily, only becoming more pleased with her work every hour instead of tiring of it. It seemed to her like a fascinating sort of play.
stem: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?

options.content: Mary hides in the garden to avoid doing her chores.
Mary is getting bored with pulling up so many weeds in the garden.
Mary is clearing out the garden to create a space to play.
Mary feels very satisfied when she's taking care of the garden.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

主旨大意题，核心任务是找出文章最主要表达的中心思想。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Mary was an odd, determined little person, and now she had something interesting to be determined about, she was very much absorbed, indeed.

👉 描述Mary的性格及她对新事物产生兴趣的状态。

**第2句：**
> She worked and dug and pulled up weeds steadily, only becoming more pleased with her work every hour instead of tiring of it.

👉 说明Mary持续努力工作并且越做越开心的情况。

**第3句：**
> It seemed to her like a fascinating sort of play.

👉 解释Mary将工作看作一种有趣的游戏，表达她的积极心态。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                 |
|:---------|:------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 描述Mary性格及她对园艺工作的专注和兴趣 |
| 第二句   | 说明Mary不断努力且越来越喜欢拔草的过程 |
| 第三句   | 表明Mary将园艺工作当作有趣的游戏看待   |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> Mary hides in the garden to avoid doing her chores.

错误，文中无任何提及Mary“躲藏”或“逃避家务”的内容，且她是积极工作的。
错误类型：【无中生有】

**B 选项** ❌
> Mary is getting bored with pulling up so many weeds in the garden.

错误，原文明确写到“only becoming more pleased with her work every hour instead of tiring”，说明她没有厌烦，反而更开心。
错误类型：【方向相反】

**C 选项** ❌
> Mary is clearing out the garden to create a space to play.

错误，文中提到她把工作看成“a fascinating sort of play”，是她的感受，而非她清理花园的明确目的。
错误类型：【过度推断】

**D 选项** ✅
> Mary feels very satisfied when she's taking care of the garden.

正确，文中“only becoming more pleased with her work every hour”与“like a fascinating sort of play”直接支持了这一选项。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 主旨题需抓住文章反复强调的情感态度词（如“pleased”、“fascinating”），排除与原文情感相反或无关的选项，同时注意作者描述的是Mary的内心感受而非行为动机，避免过度推断。关键词“more pleased”“fascinating sort of play”是锁定正确答案的关键。

article: In 1935 Hallie Flanagan was chosen to lead the Federal Theatre Project (FTP). This project was part of the new Works Progress Administration (WPA), a program created by President Franklin D. Roosevelt to provide jobs for unemployed people during the Great Depression. As the director of the FTP, Flanagan created jobs for over 12,500 performers, designers, and other theater professionals across the country. She also kept ticket prices low for the shows they staged, which meant that many people could afford to experience theater for the first time.
stem: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?

options.content: Jobs provided by the FTP were intended mainly for performers, designers, and other theater professionals.
President Roosevelt created the WPA to provide jobs for unemployed people.
During the Great Depression, many people couldn't afford to buy theater tickets.
As the director of the FTP, Flanagan succeeded in creating many jobs and introducing people to theater.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

这是主旨大意题，核心任务是总结文章的中心思想，选择能够准确概括全文内容的选项。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> In 1935 Hallie Flanagan was chosen to lead the Federal Theatre Project (FTP).

👉 介绍人物和背景，提出主角及其职位。

**第2句：**
> This project was part of the new Works Progress Administration (WPA), a program created by President Franklin D. Roosevelt to provide jobs for unemployed people during the Great Depression.

👉 解释FTP的隶属关系及WPA项目的目的，交代背景原因。

**第3句：**
> As the director of the FTP, Flanagan created jobs for over 12,500 performers, designers, and other theater professionals across the country.

👉 说明Flanagan的具体贡献——创造大量就业岗位。

**第4句：**
> She also kept ticket prices low for the shows they staged, which meant that many people could afford to experience theater for the first time.

👉 进一步说明她的工作效果——让更多人首次有机会看戏。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 介绍Flanagan及其担任FTP领导的身份 |
| 第二句 | 说明FTP属于WPA，WPA由罗斯福总统设立以提供失业救济 |
| 第三句 | 说明Flanagan创造了大量剧院相关工作岗位 |
| 第四句 | 说明Flanagan降低票价，让更多人能首次观看戏剧 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> Jobs provided by the FTP were intended mainly for performers, designers, and other theater professionals.

错误原因：文中提到“Flanagan created jobs for over 12,500 performers, designers, and other theater professionals”，这句是事实，但选项说“intended mainly for”过于狭隘，忽略了项目的更大意义和成果，且未涵盖让更多人观剧这一重要信息。【以偏概全】

**B 选项** ❌
> President Roosevelt created the WPA to provide jobs for unemployed people.

错误原因：这句话确实是文中的信息（“a program created by President Franklin D. Roosevelt to provide jobs for unemployed people”），但它只是背景信息，非文章的主旨。【无中生有】（未涵盖全文主旨）

**C 选项** ❌
> During the Great Depression, many people couldn't afford to buy theater tickets.

错误原因：文中提到“kept ticket prices low ... many people could afford to experience theater for the first time”，并没有明确说“许多人买不起票”，这个选项是对信息的过度推断。【过度推断】

**D 选项** ✅
> As the director of the FTP, Flanagan succeeded in creating many jobs and introducing people to theater.

正确原因：该选项准确总结了文章两大核心内容——创造大量就业岗位和使更多人首次接触剧院，完全符合文章主旨。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题考查主旨大意，关键在于抓住文中反复出现的两大信息：“创造就业岗位”（第三句）和“让更多人首次体验剧院”（第四句）。选项D同时涵盖这两点，符合文章整体逻辑。其他选项要么只抓住局部信息（A、B），要么无中生有或过度推断（C）。注意区分背景信息与主旨，避免只选事实句而忽视文章核心意义。

article: In the 1960s, Chavela Vargas became an unlikely star in ranchera, a style of traditional Mexican music. Most ranchera singers had clear, polished voices and performed with a full band. But Vargas accompanied her raspy voice with just her guitar. Dressed in men's trousers and a poncho, she would perform classic songs that had been written from a male point of view and were usually sung by men. She also altered those songs by performing them much more slowly than other ranchera singers did. The slower tempo allowed her to express the emotional quality of the lyrics more fully.
stem: According to the text, what is one way that Vargas differed from other ranchera singers?

options.content: She possessed a voice that was clear and polished.
She avoided singing songs written from a male point of view.
She altered classic songs by slowing them down.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

这是细节理解题，核心任务是根据文章内容准确找到描述Vargas与其他ranchera歌手不同之处的具体细节。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> In the 1960s, Chavela Vargas became an unlikely star in ranchera, a style of traditional Mexican music.

👉 引出主角和背景，介绍Vargas成为ranchera音乐明星的时间和风格。

**第2句：**
> Most ranchera singers had clear, polished voices and performed with a full band.

👉 描述大多数ranchera歌手的典型特征，为后面对比做铺垫。

**第3句：**
> But Vargas accompanied her raspy voice with just her guitar.

👉 转折，指出Vargas与众不同的声音特质和伴奏方式。

**第4句：**
> Dressed in men's trousers and a poncho, she would perform classic songs that had been written from a male point of view and were usually sung by men.

👉 进一步说明她的服装风格及她演唱的歌曲种类，强调她突破性地演唱男性视角的经典歌曲。

**第5句：**
> She also altered those songs by performing them much more slowly than other ranchera singers did.

👉 说明她演唱方式的改变——放慢速度，突出个性。

**第6句：**
> The slower tempo allowed her to express the emotional quality of the lyrics more fully.

👉 解释放慢速度的原因和效果，突出情感表达。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                         |
|:---------|:----------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍Vargas成为ranchera明星    |
| 第二句   | 说明大多数ranchera歌手的特点  |
| 第三句   | Vargas声音嘶哑，伴奏简单     |
| 第四句   | 她穿男装，唱男性视角的经典歌  |
| 第五句   | 她放慢歌曲速度以示区别       |
| 第六句   | 慢速使她更好表达歌词情感     |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> She possessed a voice that was clear and polished.

错误，文章明确说大多数歌手是“clear, polished voices”，而Vargas的声音是“raspy voice”，与此相反。
错误类型：【方向相反】

**B 选项** ❌
> She avoided singing songs written from a male point of view.

错误，文章说她“would perform classic songs that had been written from a male point of view”，说明她并没有避免，而是专门演唱此类歌曲。
错误类型：【方向相反】

**C 选项** ❌
> She disliked performing classic songs.

错误，文章没有任何表示她不喜欢唱经典歌曲的内容，反而说她“would perform classic songs”，表明她演唱经典歌曲。
错误类型：【无中生有】

**D 选项** ✅
> She altered classic songs by slowing them down.

正确，文章明确指出“She also altered those songs by performing them much more slowly”，与选项描述完全吻合。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题考察细节对比，关键在于抓住转折词“But”和“also”，以及描述Vargas与其他歌手不同的具体细节（声音特质、伴奏、演唱风格）。特别注意选项与文中细节的对应，排除与原文相反或无中生有的选项。

article:
The following text is from Beatrice Harraden's 1894 novel Ships that Pass in the Night.

In an old second-hand bookshop in London, an old man sat reading Gibbon's History of Rome. He did not put down his book when the postman brought him a letter. He just glanced indifferently at the letter, and impatiently at the postman. Zerviah Holme did not like to be interrupted when he was reading Gibbon; and as he was always reading Gibbon, an interruption was always regarded by him as an insult.
stem: Based on the text, how did Zerviah Holme most likely feel when the letter was delivered?

options.content: He felt relieved because he had been expecting an important letter.
He felt excited because the letter was from a good friend.
He felt sad because the postman did not stop to talk with him before leaving.
He felt annoyed because he was interrupted while reading his favorite author.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

本题属于细节理解题，核心任务是根据文章细节推断人物情绪反应。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> In an old second-hand bookshop in London, an old man sat reading Gibbon's *History of Rome*.

👉 描述场景和人物行为，交代背景。

**第2句：**
> He did not put down his book when the postman brought him a letter.

👉 说明人物对来信的反应——未放下书，表现出专注或不愿被打扰。

**第3句：**
> He just glanced indifferently at the letter, and impatiently at the postman.

👉 进一步描写人物态度，表现出冷漠和不耐烦。

**第4句：**
> Zerviah Holme did not like to be interrupted when he was reading Gibbon; and as he was always reading Gibbon, an interruption was always regarded by him as an insult.

👉 解释原因，说明他对被打断的厌恶及其强烈程度。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                             |
|:---------|:--------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 交代人物和场景，老人专注读书       |
| 第二句   | 描述老人收到信时未放下书           |
| 第三句   | 老人对信件和邮递员表现冷漠和不耐烦 |
| 第四句   | 解释老人讨厌被打断的原因及强烈反感 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> He felt relieved because he had been expecting an important letter.

原文并未提及老人期待信件，且其对信件表现冷漠和不耐烦，和“感到宽慰”相反。
错误类型：【方向相反】

**B 选项** ❌
> He felt excited because the letter was from a good friend.

文中无任何关于信件来源或老人激动的描述，反而表明他不耐烦和冷漠。
错误类型：【无中生有】

**C 选项** ❌
> He felt sad because the postman did not stop to talk with him before leaving.

文中未提及老人因邮递员离开而感到难过，且老人对邮递员表现的是不耐烦而非悲伤。
错误类型：【无中生有】

**D 选项** ✅
> He felt annoyed because he was interrupted while reading his favorite author.

原文明确说明老人“did not like to be interrupted when he was reading Gibbon”且“an interruption was always regarded by him as an insult”，直接支持此选项。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关注人物情绪的直接描写词汇（indifferently, impatiently, did not like to be interrupted, regarded as insult），这些负面情绪词精准锁定老人对打断的厌恶，从而排除情绪积极或悲伤的选项，确认答案为D。关键词“interrupted”和“annoyed”形成因果对应，帮助定位正确答案。

---

article:
The following text is adapted from Charles W. Chesnutt's 1901 novel The Marrow of Tradition.
Mrs. Ochiltree was a woman of strong individuality, whose comments upon her acquaintance[s], present or absent, were marked by a frankness at times no less than startling. This characteristic caused her to be more or less avoided. Mrs. Ochiltree was aware of this sentiment on the part of her acquaintance[s], and rather exulted in it.
stem: Based on the text, what is true about Mrs. Ochiltree's acquaintances?

options.content: They try to refrain from discussing topics that would upset Mrs. Ochiltree.
They are unable to spend as much time with Mrs. Ochiltree as she would like.
They are too preoccupied with their own concerns to speak with Mrs. Ochiltree.
They are likely offended by what Mrs. Ochiltree has said about them.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

这是细节理解题，核心任务是根据文中对Mrs. Ochiltree与其熟人关系的描述，判断她的熟人对她的态度。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Mrs. Ochiltree was a woman of strong individuality, whose comments upon her acquaintance[s], present or absent, were marked by a frankness at times no less than startling.

👉 描述Mrs. Ochiltree性格鲜明且直言不讳，对熟人评论坦率甚至令人吃惊。

**第2句：**
> This characteristic caused her to be more or less avoided.

👉 说明她坦率的性格导致熟人或多或少地回避她。

**第3句：**
> Mrs. Ochiltree was aware of this sentiment on the part of her acquaintance[s], and rather exulted in it.

👉 她知道熟人对她的回避，但对此感到自豪。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                           |
|:---------|:------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 描述Mrs. Ochiltree性格及其坦率评论熟人的特点 |
| 第二句   | 她的坦率导致熟人回避她         |
| 第三句   | 她知道熟人回避且对此感到得意   |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> They try to refrain from discussing topics that would upset Mrs. Ochiltree.

文中无任何信息显示熟人会刻意避免让Mrs. Ochiltree难受，反而是他们回避她，说明是被她影响而非反过来。【无中生有】

**B 选项** ❌
> They are unable to spend as much time with Mrs. Ochiltree as she would like.

文章只说熟人“回避”她，并未提及时间或陪伴的多少。【无中生有】

**C 选项** ❌
> They are too preoccupied with their own concerns to speak with Mrs. Ochiltree.

文中熟人回避原因是她的坦率和评论令人吃惊，而非因为忙碌或关注自身。【方向相反】

**D 选项** ✅
> They are likely offended by what Mrs. Ochiltree has said about them.

根据“她的坦率评论导致熟人回避她”可推断熟人可能对她的言论感到冒犯或不快，故此选项正确。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关注文中因果关系词“caused”（导致）和情感词“exulted”（欣喜），理解Mrs. Ochiltree的“frankness”是熟人回避她的直接原因，从而排除与此因果关系不符的选项，锁定熟人因被冒犯而回避的答案。

article:
The following text is from Anton Chekhov's 1898 short story "Ionitch" (translated by Marian Fell in 1915). The text is set in a Russian city referred to as the city of S.

If newcomers to the little provincial city of S. complained that life there was monotonous and dull, its inhabitants would answer that, on the contrary, S. was a very amusing place, indeed, that it had a library and a club, that balls were given there, and finally, that very pleasant families lived there with whom one might become acquainted. And they always pointed to the Turkins as the most accomplished and most enlightened family of all.
stem: What does the text suggest about the Turkins?

options.content: They are relative newcomers to the city of S.
They have a unique status in the city of S.
They have long disliked living in the city of S.
They are amused by the other residents of the city of S.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

本题为细节理解题，核心任务是根据文中信息准确判断关于Turkins家族的描述。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> If newcomers to the little provincial city of S. complained that life there was monotonous and dull, its inhabitants would answer that, on the contrary, S. was a very amusing place, indeed, that it had a library and a club, that balls were given there, and finally, that very pleasant families lived there with whom one might become acquainted.

👉 说明城市居民对外来者抱怨的反驳，突出城市生活的丰富和有趣。

**第2句：**
> And they always pointed to the Turkins as the most accomplished and most enlightened family of all.

👉 强调Turkins家族在城市中的特殊地位，是最有成就和开明的家庭。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 介绍外来者抱怨与居民的反驳，强调城市生活不单调，有文化活动和社交场合。 |
| 第二句 | 具体指出Turkins家族是最有成就和最开明的家庭，代表城市的“精英”地位。 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> They are relative newcomers to the city of S.

文中并无任何关于Turkins家族是否为新来的信息，且“always pointed to the Turkins”暗示其存在时间较长。【无中生有】

**B 选项** ✅
> They have a unique status in the city of S.

文中明确指出Turkins是“the most accomplished and most enlightened family”，这表明他们在城市中拥有独特且崇高的地位。

**C 选项** ❌
> They have long disliked living in the city of S.

文中没有任何关于他们是否喜欢或不喜欢城市生活的描述。【无中生有】

**D 选项** ❌
> They are amused by the other residents of the city of S.

文中说的是居民们觉得城市“amusing”，而不是Turkins被动“amused by others”，且没有证据支持此项。【无中生有】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于抓住“always pointed to the Turkins as the most accomplished and most enlightened family”这一表述，明确Turkins家族的独特和崇高地位，从而排除无关或无据选项。注意区分“居民认为城市有趣”与“Turkins的态度”，避免偷换主体。

article:
The following text is from Ahmet Hamdi Tanpinar's 1961 novel The Time Regulation Institute (translated from the Turkish in 2014 by Maureen Freely and Alexander Dawe). The narrator was once involved with the Time Regulation Institute, a fictional bureaucracy that regulates the time of Turkey's clocks.

I may be the most humble and absurd man in the world and, as my wife says, the most slovenly creature you may ever meet—that is, before the founding of our institute—but I did come to know a truly great man who possessed a natural genius for invention. I spent years at his side. I watched the way he worked. I witnessed how an idea would suddenly catch fire in his mind and take shape, like a tree sprouting shoots and branches, before coming into being.
stem: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?

options.content: A person was fortunate enough to have found love despite his obvious shortcomings.
An exceptionally talented person professes humility to avoid intimidating others.
A person appreciates the extensive time he passed in the company of someone he deeply admired.
A truly brilliant person lets ideas mature in his mind before expressing them aloud.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

主旨大意题，核心任务是概括文章的中心思想，准确把握作者表达的主要内容。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> I may be the most humble and absurd man in the world and, as my wife says, the most slovenly creature you may ever meet—that is, before the founding of our institute—

👉 作者自我描述，为后文对比或说明做铺垫。

**第2句：**
> but I did come to know a truly great man who possessed a natural genius for invention.

👉 转折，介绍作者遇见了一个天才人物。

**第3句：**
> I spent years at his side.

👉 说明作者长期陪伴这位伟人。

**第4句：**
> I watched the way he worked.

👉 观察描写，强调作者对这位伟人的细致关注。

**第5句：**
> I witnessed how an idea would suddenly catch fire in his mind and take shape, like a tree sprouting shoots and branches, before coming into being.

👉 具体描述这位伟人思维过程，形象比喻表达其创造力。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                 | 逻辑功能       |
|:---------|:------------------------------------|:---------------|
| 第一句   | 自我谦逊且邋遢的自我介绍             | 提出观点       |
| 第二句   | 遇见一位天才发明家                   | 转折，提出新观点|
| 第三句   | 长期陪伴这位天才                     | 说明时间投入   |
| 第四句   | 观察这位天才的工作方式               | 举例说明       |
| 第五句   | 形象描述天才如何构思并孕育创意       | 细节描写，举例 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌【无中生有】
> A person was fortunate enough to have found love despite his obvious shortcomings.

文章中未提及“爱情”或“幸运找到爱情”的内容，选项内容超出原文信息。

**B 选项** ❌【方向相反】
> An exceptionally talented person professes humility to avoid intimidating others.

文中并无天才者“假装谦逊”的描述，谦逊的是叙述者自己，且无避人之意。

**C 选项** ✅（正确）
> A person appreciates the extensive time he passed in the company of someone he deeply admired.

选项准确概括了叙述者长期陪伴并钦佩这位天才的主旨，符合原文“spent years at his side”和“truly great man”。

**D 选项** ❌【以偏概全】
> A truly brilliant person lets ideas mature in his mind before expressing them aloud.

虽然文中描写了天才构思过程，但没有提及“表达”或“言语”相关内容，选项过度简化且未涵盖全文主旨。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题通过转折词“but”连接作者自谦与遇见天才的内容，核心在于理解叙述者对天才人物的钦佩和长期陪伴，排除无关或未提及的信息（如爱情、谦逊的动机、表达过程），从整体语境把握主旨。关键词“spent years at his side”是锁定正确答案的关键。

article:
The following text is adapted from Robert Louis Stevenson's 1883 novel Treasure Island. Bill is a sailor staying at the Admiral Benbow, an inn run by the narrator's parents.
Every day when [Bill] came back from his stroll he would ask if any seafaring men had gone by along the road. At first we thought it was the want of company of his own kind that made him ask this question, but at last we began to see he was desirous to avoid them. When a seaman did [stay] at the Admiral Benbow (as now and then some did) he would look in at him through the curtained door before he entered the parlour; and he was always sure to be as silent as a mouse when any such was present.
stem: According to the text, why does Bill regularly ask about "seafaring men"?

options.content: He's hoping to find an old friend and fellow sailor.
He's trying to secure a job as part of the crew on a new ship.
He isn't sure that other guests at the inn will be welcoming of sailors.
He doesn't want to encounter any other sailor unexpectedly.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

这是细节理解题，核心任务是根据文中描写准确判断Bill询问“seafaring men”的真正原因。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Every day when [Bill] came back from his stroll he would ask if any seafaring men had gone by along the road.

👉 叙述Bill每天都会问是否有水手经过的事实。

**第2句：**
> At first we thought it was the want of company of his own kind that made him ask this question,

👉 叙述者最初的猜测：Bill想找同类陪伴。

**第3句：**
> but at last we began to see he was desirous to avoid them.

👉 转折，纠正前述猜测，指出Bill其实想避开水手。

**第4句：**
> When a seaman did [stay] at the Admiral Benbow (as now and then some did) he would look in at him through the curtained door before he entered the parlour;

👉 具体举例说明Bill如何小心翼翼地观察水手。

**第5句：**
> and he was always sure to be as silent as a mouse when any such was present.

👉 进一步说明Bill遇到水手时表现得非常安静，以示避让。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                                         |
|:---------|:-------------------------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | Bill每天回来问是否有水手经过。                               |
| 第二句   | 叙述者最初以为Bill是想找同类陪伴。                           |
| 第三句   | 转折，实际上Bill想避开水手。                                 |
| 第四句   | 举例说明Bill见到水手时的行为举止。                           |
| 第五句   | 说明Bill遇到水手时非常安静，进一步体现其避让意图。           |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌【方向相反】
> He's hoping to find an old friend and fellow sailor.

文中明确说“at first we thought... but at last we began to see he was desirous to avoid them”，即最初以为他想找同类，但事实是想避开，故A选项与文意相反。

**B 选项** ❌【无中生有】
> He's trying to secure a job as part of the crew on a new ship.

文中无任何关于Bill想找工作或船员身份的描述，此选项无据。

**C 选项** ❌【无中生有】
> He isn't sure that other guests at the inn will be welcoming of sailors.

文中没有提及Bill担心其他客人是否欢迎水手，且重点在Bill自己对水手的态度，非其他客人，故此选项无依据。

**D 选项** ✅
> He doesn't want to encounter any other sailor unexpectedly.

文中“we began to see he was desirous to avoid them”以及“he was always sure to be as silent as a mouse when any such was present”明确说明Bill想避开水手，符合此选。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关键在于抓住转折词“but at last we began to see”，这是对前文“最初以为”的否定与修正，提示真正原因是“想避开水手”，从而排除选项A的“想找同类”；同时通过描述Bill“look in at him through the curtained door”和“as silent as a mouse”强化其回避行为，锁定正确答案为D。其他选项均无文中依据，属于无中生有或方向相反。

article:
The following text is from Ezra Pound's 1909 poem "Hymn III," based on the work of Marcantonio Flaminio.
    As a fragile and lovely flower unfolds its gleaming
    foliage on the breast of the fostering earth, if
    the dew and the rain draw it forth;
    So doth my tender mind flourish, if it be fed with the
    sweet dew of the fostering spirit,
    Lacking this, it beginneth straightway to languish,
    even as a floweret born upon dry earth, if the
    dew and the rain tend it not.
stem: Based on the text, in what way is the human mind like a flower?

options.content: It becomes increasingly vigorous with the passage of time.
It draws strength from changes in the weather.
It requires proper nourishment in order to thrive.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

这是细节理解题，核心任务是根据文章比喻内容准确找出人类心智与花朵相似的具体方面。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> As a fragile and lovely flower unfolds its gleaming foliage on the breast of the fostering earth, if the dew and the rain draw it forth;

👉 通过花朵在湿润环境中展开叶片的比喻，提出花朵的成长依赖于露水和雨水。

**第2句：**
> So doth my tender mind flourish, if it be fed with the sweet dew of the fostering spirit,

👉 将人的心智比作花朵，指出心智如果得到“滋养精神的甘露”就会成长。

**第3句：**
> Lacking this, it beginneth straightway to languish, even as a floweret born upon dry earth, if the dew and the rain tend it not.

👉 说明缺少滋养时，心智会衰弱，就像缺少雨露的花朵一样。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                         |
|:---------|:----------------------------|
| 第一句   | 花朵在湿润环境中展开叶片，比喻成长依赖水分 |
| 第二句   | 心智如花朵，需“滋养精神的甘露”方能成长  |
| 第三句   | 缺少滋养时，心智衰弱，如同缺水的花朵      |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌【方向相反】
> It becomes increasingly vigorous with the passage of time.
文章未提及时间对心智成长的影响，重点在于是否有滋养，而非时间流逝。

**B 选项** ❌【偷换概念】
> It draws strength from changes in the weather.
原文强调露水和雨水对花的滋养，非“天气变化”，选项偷换了概念。

**C 选项** ✅（正确）
> It requires proper nourishment in order to thrive.
原文明确指出“if it be fed with the sweet dew… it flourish”，强调适当滋养是心智成长的必要条件。

**D 选项** ❌【无中生有】
> It perseveres despite challenging circumstances.
文中提到缺乏滋养时心智“languish”（衰弱），并无坚持不懈的含义。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 重点关注文章中的比喻和因果关系词，如“if”（条件）和“lacking”（缺少），锁定滋养与成长的关系，排除涉及时间、天气变化、坚持等无关或曲解原文的选项。

article: Microplastics are tiny pieces of plastic waste. Areas of the ocean with higher concentrations of microplastic particles also have smaller and fewer waves. A study by Yukun Sun and colleagues found that the concentration of microplastic particles cannot be the only reason for this reduced wave activity because the concentration of particles that would have the observed effect is much higher than that found in these areas of the ocean. However, they found that surfactants, chemicals often used to manufacture plastics, are released into the water from microplastics and have a much stronger wave-reducing effect.
stem: According to the text, what did Sun and colleagues discover about surfactants?

options.content: They have a much stronger effect on wave activity than microplastics alone do.
They are mainly composed of water.
They are helpful for removing microplastics from the ocean.
They can be used to contain microplastics within certain areas of the ocean.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

细节理解题，核心任务是准确把握文中关于surfuctants（表面活性剂）的具体发现。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Microplastics are tiny pieces of plastic waste.

👉 定义microplastics，奠定主题基础。

**第2句：**
> Areas of the ocean with higher concentrations of microplastic particles also have smaller and fewer waves.

👉 描述观察现象，指出微塑料浓度与海浪减少的相关性。

**第3句：**
> A study by Yukun Sun and colleagues found that the concentration of microplastic particles cannot be the only reason for this reduced wave activity because the concentration of particles that would have the observed effect is much higher than that found in these areas of the ocean.

👉 解释原因，否定微塑料浓度是唯一导致波浪减少的原因。

**第4句：**
> However, they found that surfactants, chemicals often used to manufacture plastics, are released into the water from microplastics and have a much stronger wave-reducing effect.

👉 转折，提出新的发现：表面活性剂释放自微塑料，对减少波浪有更强影响。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                         |
|:---------|:--------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 定义微塑料                                    |
| 第二句   | 描述微塑料浓度高的海域波浪减少现象              |
| 第三句   | 否定微塑料浓度是唯一波浪减少原因                |
| 第四句   | 发现表面活性剂释放自微塑料，对波浪减少作用更强 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅（正确）
> They have a much stronger effect on wave activity than microplastics alone do.

符合文中“surfuctants … have a much stronger wave-reducing effect”的描述，正确反映了研究发现。

**B 选项** ❌（错误）
> They are mainly composed of water.

文中未提及表面活性剂的成分，且“chemicals often used to manufacture plastics”表明不是水。【无中生有】

**C 选项** ❌（错误）
> They are helpful for removing microplastics from the ocean.

文中未提及表面活性剂有助于清除微塑料，反而是它们被释放出来影响波浪。【无中生有】

**D 选项** ❌（错误）
> They can be used to contain microplastics within certain areas of the ocean.

文中无此信息，表面活性剂作用是减少波浪，不是限制微塑料范围。【无中生有】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关注题干关键词“surfuctants”和文中转折词“However”，锁定研究新发现；对比“microplastics”与“surfuctants”的影响强度是解题关键，排除与文意无关或未提及信息的选项。

article: A common assumption among art historians is that the invention of photography in the mid-nineteenth century displaced the painted portrait in the public consciousness. The diminishing popularity of the portrait miniature, which coincided with the rise of photography, seems to support this claim. However, photography's impact on the portrait miniature may be overstated. Although records from art exhibitions in the Netherlands from 1820 to 1892 show a decrease in the number of both full-sized and miniature portraits submitted, this trend was established before the invention of photography.
stem: Based on the text, what can be concluded about the diminishing popularity of the portrait miniature in the nineteenth century?

options.content: Factors other than the rise of photography may be more directly responsible for the portrait miniature’s decline.
The popularity of the portrait miniature likely persisted for longer than art historians have assumed.
Although portrait miniatures became less common than photographs, they were widely regarded as having more artistic merit.
As demand for portrait miniatures decreased, portrait artists likely shifted their creative focus to photography.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

这是细节理解题，核心任务是根据文中信息判断导致肖像小画流行度下降的原因。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> A common assumption among art historians is that the invention of photography in the mid-nineteenth century displaced the painted portrait in the public consciousness.
👉 提出观点：艺术史学家普遍认为摄影发明取代了绘画肖像。

**第2句：**
> The diminishing popularity of the portrait miniature, which coincided with the rise of photography, seems to support this claim.
👉 举例说明：肖像小画的流行度下降与摄影兴起时间重合，似乎支持上述观点。

**第3句：**
> However, photography's impact on the portrait miniature may be overstated.
👉 转折：指出摄影对肖像小画的影响可能被夸大。

**第4句：**
> Although records from art exhibitions in the Netherlands from 1820 to 1892 show a decrease in the number of both full-sized and miniature portraits submitted, this trend was established before the invention of photography.
👉 解释原因并反驳：荷兰艺术展记录显示肖像画数量下降趋势早于摄影发明，说明下降原因可能不只是摄影。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 提出普遍观点：摄影发明取代了绘画肖像。 |
| 第二句 | 举例：肖像小画流行度下降与摄影兴起时间重合。 |
| 第三句 | 转折：摄影影响可能被夸大。 |
| 第四句 | 通过数据反驳：肖像画数量下降趋势早于摄影发明。 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅
> Factors other than the rise of photography may be more directly responsible for the portrait miniature’s decline.
选项正确。第4句明确指出肖像小画的下降趋势早于摄影发明，说明其他因素可能更直接导致下降，支持该选项。

**B 选项** ❌【无中生有】
> The popularity of the portrait miniature likely persisted for longer than art historians have assumed.
文中未提及肖像小画流行时间比学者想象的更长，且仅说下降趋势早于摄影发明，无关流行持续时间，故此选项无依据。

**C 选项** ❌【无中生有】
> Although portrait miniatures became less common than photographs, they were widely regarded as having more artistic merit.
文中未涉及肖像小画与摄影的艺术价值比较，属于无中生有。

**D 选项** ❌【无中生有】
> As demand for portrait miniatures decreased, portrait artists likely shifted their creative focus to photography.
文中未提及艺术家创作重心转移，属于无中生有。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于关注转折词“However”和因果提示“this trend was established before”，它们揭示了流行度下降早于摄影出现，提示寻找除摄影外的其他原因，从而排除将下降归因于摄影的选项。注意选项是否有文中依据，避免无中生有的选项。

article: Paleontologists searching for signs of ancient life have found many fossilized specimens of prehistoric human ancestors, including several from the Pleistocene era discovered in a geological formation in the Minatogawa quarry in Japan. However, to study the emergence of the earliest multicellular organisms to appear on Earth, researchers must turn elsewhere, such as to the Ediacaran geological formation at Mistaken Point in Canada. A UNESCO World Heritage Site, the 146-hectare reserve contains more than 10,000 fossils that together document a critical moment in evolutionary history.
stem: What does the text indicate about the geological formation at Mistaken Point?

options.content: It holds a greater number of fossils but from a smaller variety of species than the formation in the Minatogawa quarry does.
It has provided evidence that the earliest human species may have emerged before the Pleistocene era.
It contains specimens from an older time period than those found in the formation in the Minatogawa quarry.
It is widely considered by paleontologists to be the most valuable source of information about prehistoric life forms.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

本题为细节理解题，核心任务是根据文章内容准确定位关于Mistaken Point地质层的时间背景信息。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Paleontologists searching for signs of ancient life have found many fossilized specimens of prehistoric human ancestors, including several from the Pleistocene era discovered in a geological formation in the Minatogawa quarry in Japan.

👉 描述古生物学家在日本Minatogawa采石场发现的更新世（Pleistocene）时代的史前人类祖先化石，提出研究对象和地点。

**第2句：**
> However, to study the emergence of the earliest multicellular organisms to appear on Earth, researchers must turn elsewhere, such as to the Ediacaran geological formation at Mistaken Point in Canada.

👉 转折句，指出研究更早期多细胞生物起源需要转向加拿大Mistaken Point的埃迪卡拉纪地质层。

**第3句：**
> A UNESCO World Heritage Site, the 146-hectare reserve contains more than 10,000 fossils that together document a critical moment in evolutionary history.

👉 进一步说明Mistaken Point的规模及其重要性，强调其化石数量众多且见证了进化史上的关键时期。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                                         |
|:---------|:-------------------------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍Minatogawa采石场发现的更新世时代史前人类祖先化石。       |
| 第二句   | 转折说明研究更早多细胞生物需转向Mistaken Point埃迪卡拉纪地质层。 |
| 第三句   | 描述Mistaken Point的规模、化石数量及其在进化史上的重要性。   |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> It holds a greater number of fossils but from a smaller variety of species than the formation in the Minatogawa quarry does.

错误原因：文章仅提及Mistaken Point拥有超过10,000个化石，但没有比较物种多样性，也未提及Minatogawa的化石数量。此信息无据，属于【无中生有】。

**B 选项** ❌
> It has provided evidence that the earliest human species may have emerged before the Pleistocene era.

错误原因：文章中Mistaken Point涉及的是早期多细胞生物的出现，而非人类祖先，且没有暗示人类在更新世之前出现。属于【偷换概念】。

**C 选项** ✅
> It contains specimens from an older time period than those found in the formation in the Minatogawa quarry.

正确原因：文章第一句指出Minatogawa采石场化石属于更新世（Pleistocene），第二句指出Mistaken Point属于埃迪卡拉纪（Ediacaran），该时期比更新世更早，故选项准确反映了时间顺序。

**D 选项** ❌
> It is widely considered by paleontologists to be the most valuable source of information about prehistoric life forms.

错误原因：文章强调Mistaken Point重要，但未称其为“最有价值的”或“广泛认为”的顶级信息来源，属于【过度推断】。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关注转折词“However”引出对比，锁定Mistaken Point的时间背景，明确“Pleistocene era”和“Ediacaran geological formation”对应不同地质年代，利用地质时代词汇判断时间先后，从而排除未提及时间对比或范围的选项，选择准确反映时间关系的选项。

article: Biologists have predicted that birds' feather structures vary with habitat temperature, but this hadn't been tested in mountain environments. Ornithologist Sahas Barve studied feathers from 249 songbird species inhabiting different elevations—and thus experiencing different temperatures—in the Himalaya Mountains. He found that feathers of high-elevation species not only have a greater proportion of warming downy sections to flat and smooth sections than do feathers of low-elevation species, but high elevation species' feathers also tend to be longer, providing a thicker layer of insulation.
stem: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?

options.content: Barve’s investigation shows that some species of Himalayan songbirds have evolved feathers that better regulate body temperature than do the feathers of other species, contradicting previous predictions.
The results of Barve’s study suggest that the ability of birds to withstand cold temperatures is determined more strongly by feather length than feather structure, challenging an established belief.
Barve found an association between habitat temperature and feather structure among Himalayan songbirds, lending new support to a general prediction.
Barve discovered that songbirds have adapted to their environment by growing feathers without flat and smooth sections, complicating an earlier hypothesis.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

主旨大意题，核心任务是准确概括文章的主要观点，避免细节误导和错误推断。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Biologists have predicted that birds' feather structures vary with habitat temperature, but this hadn't been tested in mountain environments.

👉 介绍已有预测和研究空白（提出背景和研究意义）。

**第2句：**
> Ornithologist Sahas Barve studied feathers from 249 songbird species inhabiting different elevations—and thus experiencing different temperatures—in the Himalaya Mountains.

👉 说明具体研究对象和环境（介绍研究方法和范围）。

**第3句：**
> He found that feathers of high-elevation species not only have a greater proportion of warming downy sections to flat and smooth sections than do feathers of low-elevation species, but high elevation species' feathers also tend to be longer, providing a thicker layer of insulation.

👉 报告研究发现，支持预测（给出研究结果，验证假设）。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                                         |
|:---------|:-------------------------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍已有预测和研究空白，说明研究意义                         |
| 第二句   | 描述Barve对喜马拉雅山不同海拔鸟类羽毛的研究方法和对象       |
| 第三句   | 说明研究发现，羽毛结构和长度与海拔温度相关，支持原有预测     |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> Barve’s investigation shows that some species of Himalayan songbirds have evolved feathers that better regulate body temperature than do the feathers of other species, contradicting previous predictions.

错误原因：文章中明确说“Biologists have predicted...”，Barve的结果是“lending new support”（支持）而非“contradicting previous predictions”，故本选项错误。
错误类型：【方向相反】

**B 选项** ❌
> The results of Barve’s study suggest that the ability of birds to withstand cold temperatures is determined more strongly by feather length than feather structure, challenging an established belief.

错误原因：文章指出羽毛结构和长度均有关联，且没有表明长度比结构更重要，也没有挑战已有观点，故本选项错误。
错误类型：【过度推断】

**C 选项** ✅
> Barve found an association between habitat temperature and feather structure among Himalayan songbirds, lending new support to a general prediction.

正确原因：选项准确总结了Barve的研究发现（羽毛结构与栖息地温度相关）且表明结果支持了已有预测，完全符合文章主旨。

**D 选项** ❌
> Barve discovered that songbirds have adapted to their environment by growing feathers without flat and smooth sections, complicating an earlier hypothesis.

错误原因：文章说的是“high-elevation species have a greater proportion of warming downy sections to flat and smooth sections”，并未说完全“没有”平滑部分，且没有提到“complicating an earlier hypothesis”，故错误。
错误类型：【无中生有】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题核心在于抓住转折词“but”以及文章最后的研究发现部分，明确研究是验证（支持）了已有预测而非推翻，选项中涉及“支持”或“验证”的表述最有可能正确；同时警惕选项中“contradicting”“challenging”“complicating”等词语容易导致方向错误或过度推断。

article: To protect themselves when being attacked, hagfish—jawless marine animals that resemble eels—will release large quantities of slimy, mucus-like threads. Because these threads are unusually strong and elastic, scientist Atsuko Negishi and her colleagues have been trying to recreate them in a lab as an eco-friendly alternative to petroleum-based fibers that are often used in fabrics. The researchers want to reproduce the threads in the lab because farming hagfish for their slime would be expensive and potentially harmful to the hagfish.
stem: Which choice best states the text’s main idea?

options.content: Hagfish are not well suited to being raised in captivity.
The ability of hagfish to slime their attackers compensates for their being jawless.
Hagfish have inspired researchers to develop a new petroleum-based fabric.
The slimy threads that hagfish release might help researchers create a new kind of fabric.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

主旨大意题，核心任务是准确把握文章中心思想，选出最能概括全文内容的选项。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> To protect themselves when being attacked, hagfish—jawless marine animals that resemble eels—will release large quantities of slimy, mucus-like threads.
👉 介绍hagfish及其防御机制。

**第2句：**
> Because these threads are unusually strong and elastic, scientist Atsuko Negishi and her colleagues have been trying to recreate them in a lab as an eco-friendly alternative to petroleum-based fibers that are often used in fabrics.
👉 说明科学家因这些线的特性尝试在实验室复制它们，目的是环保替代石油基纤维。

**第3句：**
> The researchers want to reproduce the threads in the lab because farming hagfish for their slime would be expensive and potentially harmful to the hagfish.
👉 解释为什么选择实验室复制而非养殖hagfish，强调成本和动物保护考虑。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                                 |
|:---------|:-----------------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍hagfish释放粘液状线条的防御行为                    |
| 第二句   | 说明科学家尝试复制这些线条，作为环保替代石油纤维的材料  |
| 第三句   | 解释选择实验室复制的原因，避免养殖成本高且有害动物     |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> Hagfish are not well suited to being raised in captivity.
错误，因为文章只提到“养殖hagfish昂贵且可能伤害它们”，并未直接说“它们不适合被圈养”。【过度推断】

**B 选项** ❌
> The ability of hagfish to slime their attackers compensates for their being jawless.
错误，文章提到hagfish无颌且会释放粘液防御，但未说明这种能力是“补偿”无颌的不足。【无中生有】

**C 选项** ❌
> Hagfish have inspired researchers to develop a new petroleum-based fabric.
错误，文中明确说是开发“环保替代石油基纤维”的材料，而非开发石油基纤维。【方向相反】

**D 选项** ✅
> The slimy threads that hagfish release might help researchers create a new kind of fabric.
正确，完美概括了科学家因hagfish粘液线条的特性尝试开发新型环保面料的主旨。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关注文章首句引出主体（hagfish释放线条）及后续“scientists have been trying to recreate them”与“eco-friendly alternative”这类因果和目的表述，准确捕捉文章主旨是科学家基于hagfish粘液线条开发新面料，排除过度推断或与文意相反的选项。关键词如“trying to recreate”“eco-friendly alternative”是锁定正确答案的关键。

article: A contraction of “you all,” the pronoun"y'all" has long been used as a plural version of “you" in the South and in Black communities around the US. In recent decades, most other English-speaking communities in the US have begun to use "y'all.”What explains its rise in popularity? Many varieties of English have no pronoun that specifically addresses more than one person and instead must use "you" to address both one person and more than one. But "y'all"always refers to two or more people. As a result, it conveys the speaker’s meaning more precisely     than"you"can.
stem: Which question does the text most directly attempt to answer?

options.content: Is "y'all" commonly used in English-speaking regions of the world besides the US?
Why has the pronoun "y'all" become more widely used in the US?
How many other plural versions of the pronoun "you" are there in English, besides "y'all"?
When was the first recorded use of the pronoun "y'all" in the English language?

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

这是主旨问句，核心任务是确定文章主要回答了哪个具体问题。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> A contraction of “you all,” the pronoun "y'all" has long been used as a plural version of “you" in the South and in Black communities around the US.

👉 介绍“y'all”的来源及其在特定地区和群体中的长期使用。

**第2句：**
> In recent decades, most other English-speaking communities in the US have begun to use "y'all.”

👉 说明“y'all”近几十年在美国其他英语社区的流行趋势。

**第3句：**
> What explains its rise in popularity?

👉 提出文章要回答的核心问题——为什么“y'all”变得更流行。

**第4句：**
> Many varieties of English have no pronoun that specifically addresses more than one person and instead must use "you" to address both one person and more than one.

👉 解释英语中“you”同时指代单数和复数的现象。

**第5句：**
> But "y'all" always refers to two or more people.

👉 对比“you”和“y'all”，强调“y'all”专指复数。

**第6句：**
> As a result, it conveys the speaker’s meaning more precisely than "you" can.

👉 说明“y'all”更精确传达说话人意图，是其流行原因。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 介绍“y'all”的起源及其在南方和黑人社区的传统使用 |
| 第二句 | 说明“y'all”在其他美国英语社区的流行增长 |
| 第三句 | 提出“y'all”流行的原因这一核心问题 |
| 第四句 | 说明英语中“you”既指单数又指复数的情况 |
| 第五句 | 指出“y'all”专指复数 |
| 第六句 | 解释“y'all”因更准确表达复数意义而流行 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> Is "y'all" commonly used in English-speaking regions of the world besides the US?

文章只谈及美国内部的使用情况，没有涉及其他英语国家或地区，属于【无中生有】。

**B 选项** ✅
> Why has the pronoun "y'all" become more widely used in the US?

文章明确提出并回答了“y'all”流行的原因，符合原文核心问题。

**C 选项** ❌
> How many other plural versions of the pronoun "you" are there in English, besides "y'all"?

文章没有涉及其他复数“you”代词的数量，属于【无中生有】。

**D 选项** ❌
> When was the first recorded use of the pronoun "y'all" in the English language?

文章未提及“y'all”的首次使用时间，属于【无中生有】。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于抓住文章明确提出的疑问句“What explains its rise in popularity?”，它直接指向“为什么‘y'all’变得更流行”，排除了与时间、地域或其他复数代词数量无关的选项。转折词“as a result”连接原因和结果，帮助确认答案方向。

article: In many of his sculptures, artist Richard Hunt uses broad forms rather than extreme accuracy to hint at specific people or ideas. In his first major work, Arachne (1956), Hunt constructed the mythical character Arachne, a weaver who was changed into a spider, by welding bits of steel together into something that, although vaguely human, is strange and machine-like. And his large bronze sculpture The Light of Truth (2021) commemorates activist and journalist Ida B. Wells using mainly flowing, curved pieces of metal that create stylized flame.
stem: Which choice best states the text's main idea about Hunt?

options.content: He often depicts the subjects of his sculptures using an unrealistic style.
He uses different kinds of materials depending on what kind of sculpture he plans to create.
He tends to base his art on important historical figures rather than on fictional characters.
He has altered his approach to sculpture over time, and his works have become increasingly abstract.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

主旨大意题，核心任务是总结文章关于艺术家Richard Hunt的整体观点或创作风格。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> In many of his sculptures, artist Richard Hunt uses broad forms rather than extreme accuracy to hint at specific people or ideas.

👉 介绍Hunt的艺术风格，即用宽泛的形式而非精确细节来表现人物或思想。

**第2句：**
> In his first major work, *Arachne* (1956), Hunt constructed the mythical character Arachne, a weaver who was changed into a spider, by welding bits of steel together into something that, although vaguely human, is strange and machine-like.

👉 举例说明他的风格，作品《Arachne》用粗犷的钢铁焊接，表现模糊的人形但带机械感。

**第3句：**
> And his large bronze sculpture *The Light of Truth* (2021) commemorates activist and journalist Ida B. Wells using mainly flowing, curved pieces of metal that create stylized flame.

👉 再举一个例子，作品《The Light of Truth》用流畅曲线表现象征火焰，纪念真实人物。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 总述Hunt用宽泛形式表现特定人物或思想，强调不追求极致精确 |
| 第二句 | 例证《Arachne》，用钢铁焊接表现模糊人形且带机械感 |
| 第三句 | 例证《The Light of Truth》，用流畅曲线表现象征意义，纪念真实人物 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅（正确）
> He often depicts the subjects of his sculptures using an unrealistic style.

符合第一句“broad forms rather than extreme accuracy”（宽泛形式而非极致精确），体现其“unrealistic style”（不现实风格）。

**B 选项** ❌（错误）【无中生有】
> He uses different kinds of materials depending on what kind of sculpture he plans to create.

文中只提到“welding bits of steel” 和 “large bronze sculpture”，没有说明材料选择基于作品类型，属于无中生有。

**C 选项** ❌（错误）【以偏概全】
> He tends to base his art on important historical figures rather than on fictional characters.

文中提到两种作品，一是神话人物Arachne（虚构），一是历史人物Ida B. Wells（真实），不能说倾向于历史人物。

**D 选项** ❌（错误）【过度推断】
> He has altered his approach to sculpture over time, and his works have become increasingly abstract.

文中没有说明其风格随时间变化或变得更抽象，只有两个时间点作品描述，无法推断其风格演变。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关注文首总结句“broad forms rather than extreme accuracy”作为核心观点，文章通过两个具体作品例证这一点，选项中只有A直接反映“不现实风格”，其他选项均无文中依据或与文意冲突，因而被排除。关键词“broad forms”、“extreme accuracy”是锁定正确答案的关键。

article:
The following text is adapted from Christina Rossetti's 1881 poem "Monna Innominata 2."

I wish I could remember that first day,
First hour, first moment of your meeting me,
If bright or dim the season, it might be
Summer or Winter for [all] I can say;
So unrecorded did it slip away,
So blind was I to see and to foresee,
So dull to mark the budding of my tree
That would not blossom yet for many a May.
stem: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?

options.content: As the anniversary of the beginning of an important relationship approaches, the speaker feels conflicted about how best to commemorate it.
After years of neglecting a once valuable relationship, the speaker worries it may be too late for her to salvage the relationship.
The speaker celebrates how the passage of time has strengthened a relationship that once seemed unimportant.
Because the speaker did not anticipate how important a relationship would become, she cannot recall how the relationship began, which she regrets.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

主旨大意题，核心任务是准确把握诗歌内容的整体含义，理解作者对时间与关系的态度。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> I wish I could remember that first day,

👉 表达愿望，说明作者想回忆起某个重要的起始时刻。

**第2句：**
> First hour, first moment of your meeting me,

👉 具体指出想回忆的时间点，即与“你”相遇的最初时刻。

**第3句：**
> If bright or dim the season, it might be

👉 表示对当时环境细节的模糊记忆，强调记忆的不清晰。

**第4句：**
> Summer or Winter for [all] I can say;

👉 进一步说明对季节的模糊，表明记忆缺失。

**第5句：**
> So unrecorded did it slip away,

👉 说明当时的情景未被记住，悄然逝去。

**第6句：**
> So blind was I to see and to foresee,

👉 承认当时未能察觉未来的重要性，有盲目之意。

**第7句：**
> So dull to mark the budding of my tree

👉 以“树的萌芽”比喻关系的初期，表达自己当时未能注意到关系的成长。

**第8句：**
> That would not blossom yet for many a May.

👉 说明关系尚未开花结果，未来仍需时日，暗含遗憾和期望。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 表达想回忆重要相遇的起始时刻 |
| 第二句 | 具体定位相遇的“第一刻” |
| 第三四句 | 记忆模糊，无法确定季节和细节 |
| 第五句 | 描述当时情景未被记录，悄然流逝 |
| 第六句 | 承认自己未能预见这段关系的重要性 |
| 第七八句 | 以树的萌芽比喻关系的初期，表达遗憾和未来的期望 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> As the anniversary of the beginning of an important relationship approaches, the speaker feels conflicted about how best to commemorate it.

文章无任何关于“纪念”或“纪念日临近”的内容，且并未表现出“矛盾感情”，属于【无中生有】。

**B 选项** ❌
> After years of neglecting a once valuable relationship, the speaker worries it may be too late for her to salvage the relationship.

诗中没有“多年忽视”或“担心无法挽救”的描述，且关系尚处于萌芽期，非“曾经宝贵”，属于【无中生有】。

**C 选项** ❌
> The speaker celebrates how the passage of time has strengthened a relationship that once seemed unimportant.

作者表达的是“未能记住关系起始”和“盲目”，但未表达庆祝或关系已加强，属于【过度推断】。

**D 选项** ✅
> Because the speaker did not anticipate how important a relationship would become, she cannot recall how the relationship began, which she regrets.

选项准确反映了“未能预见关系重要性”“无法回忆起相遇细节”“带有遗憾”的诗意，符合原文：“So blind was I to see and to foresee,”和“I wish I could remember that first day,”。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于捕捉诗中“记忆缺失”和“未预见重要性”的情感线索，如“wish I could remember”，“So blind was I to see and to foresee”，这些词语揭示了作者对过去遗憾的情绪，排除无关“纪念”“挽救”或“庆祝”的选项，锁定表达遗憾与回忆模糊的选项D。

article: Utah is home to Pando, a colony of about 47,000 quaking aspen trees that all share a single root system. Pando is one of the largest single organisms by mass on Earth, but ecologists are worried that its growth is declining in part because of grazing by animals. The ecologists say that strong fences could prevent deer from eating young trees and help Pando start thriving again.
stem: According to the text, why are ecologists worried about Pando?

options.content: It isn't growing at the same rate it used to.
It isn't producing young trees anymore.
It can't grow into new areas because it is blocked by fences.
Its root system can't support many more new trees.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

这是细节理解题，核心任务是根据文章内容准确找出生态学家担忧Pando的具体原因。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Utah is home to Pando, a colony of about 47,000 quaking aspen trees that all share a single root system.
👉 介绍背景信息，说明Pando是什么及其规模。

**第2句：**
> Pando is one of the largest single organisms by mass on Earth, but ecologists are worried that its growth is declining in part because of grazing by animals.
👉 说明Pando的特殊性，同时提出生态学家的担忧及原因。

**第3句：**
> The ecologists say that strong fences could prevent deer from eating young trees and help Pando start thriving again.
👉 解释生态学家建议用围栏保护幼树，帮助Pando恢复生长。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 介绍Pando及其单一根系和树木数量 |
| 第二句 | 说明Pando体积巨大，生态学家担心其生长在下降，原因部分是动物啃食 |
| 第三句 | 生态学家建议用围栏阻止鹿吃幼树，帮助Pando恢复生长 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅（正确）
> It isn't growing at the same rate it used to.
理由：文章第二句明确指出“ecologists are worried that its growth is declining”，说明Pando的生长速度在下降，故此选项正确。

**B 选项** ❌（错误）【无中生有】
> It isn't producing young trees anymore.
理由：文章未提及Pando完全停止产生幼树，只说动物啃食幼树影响生长，未到不再产生的程度。

**C 选项** ❌（错误）【方向相反】
> It can't grow into new areas because it is blocked by fences.
理由：文章第三句提到围栏是生态学家建议用来保护幼树的措施，不是阻止其生长的原因，且围栏是解决方案，不是问题。

**D 选项** ❌（错误）【无中生有】
> Its root system can't support many more new trees.
理由：文中未提及根系无法支持新树，根系情况未被讨论，属于无中生有。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于定位生态学家担忧的原因，文章中“growth is declining”是核心信息；选项中涉及“生长速度下降”直接对应原文，其他选项要注意是否为文章未提及或与文意相反的内容，从而排除。关键词“worried”“growth is declining”“grazing”锁定正确答案A。

article: During the World War II era, some Mexican American women adopted a striking new look called pachuca style. They wore altered men's jackets or zoot suits (wide-legged, long-coated suits) and dramatic makeup, and they combed their hair into high, rounded shapes. Some people criticized pachuca style, saying it was dangerous and women should dress traditionally. But historians see things differently. They see pachuca style as a form of rebellion against the era's rigid social expectations for women. They say that it showed a desire for self-expression and freedom on the part of women who adopted the style.
stem: According to the text, how do historians view pachuca style?

options.content: They think that pachuca style was such a popular trend that it continues to influence fashion in the United States to the present day.
They think that pachuca style was a way for some Mexican American women to express themselves and resist strict social expectations.
They think that pachuca style was celebrated because it enabled some Mexican American women to show their support for the United States during World War II.
They think that pachuca style was similar to other fashion trends that different groups of women adopted in the same period.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

本题为细节理解题，核心任务是准确理解文章中“historians（历史学家）”对“pachuca style”的看法。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> During the World War II era, some Mexican American women adopted a striking new look called *pachuca* style.

👉 介绍背景和主题，说明“pachuca style”是什么。

**第2句：**
> They wore altered men's jackets or zoot suits (wide-legged, long-coated suits) and dramatic makeup, and they combed their hair into high, rounded shapes.

👉 具体描述“pachuca style”的特征。

**第3句：**
> Some people criticized *pachuca* style, saying it was dangerous and women should dress traditionally.

👉 说明当时部分人的负面评价，提出反对观点。

**第4句：**
> But historians see things differently.

👉 转折，表明历史学家与当时批评者的不同看法。

**第5句：**
> They see *pachuca* style as a form of rebellion against the era's rigid social expectations for women.

👉 说明历史学家的观点，认为这是对社会传统的反抗。

**第6句：**
> They say that it showed a desire for self-expression and freedom on the part of women who adopted the style.

👉 进一步解释历史学家的看法，强调自我表达和自由的愿望。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                             |
|:---------|:--------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍pachuca风格及其时代背景       |
| 第二句   | 描述pachuca风格的具体服饰和造型   |
| 第三句   | 说明当时部分人对该风格的批评       |
| 第四句   | 转折，提出历史学家的不同看法       |
| 第五句   | 历史学家认为这是对传统社会期望的反叛 |
| 第六句   | 历史学家强调风格体现了女性的自我表达和自由 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> They think that *pachuca* style was such a popular trend that it continues to influence fashion in the United States to the present day.

错误原因：文章未提及“pachuca”风格的流行程度及其对现代时尚的持续影响，属于【无中生有】。

**B 选项** ✅
> They think that *pachuca* style was a way for some Mexican American women to express themselves and resist strict social expectations.

正确原因：第5句和第6句明确指出历史学家认为这是“反抗时代严格社会期望”和“表现自我表达与自由的愿望”，选项与原文完全对应。

**C 选项** ❌
> They think that *pachuca* style was celebrated because it enabled some Mexican American women to show their support for the United States during World War II.

错误原因：文章没有提及“支持美国”这一观点，属于【无中生有】。

**D 选项** ❌
> They think that *pachuca* style was similar to other fashion trends that different groups of women adopted in the same period.

错误原因：文章未提及其他群体的时尚趋势，也未比较相似性，属于【无中生有】。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于定位“historians see things differently”及后续两句，转折词“But”表明观点转换，紧接着的两句明确表达历史学家的看法，锁定选项B。排除时注意选项中无文章依据的内容属于【无中生有】，可直接剔除。

article: Believing that living in an impractical space can heighten awareness and even improve health, conceptual artists Madeleine Gins and Shusaku Arakawa designed an apartment building in Japan to be more fanciful than functional. A kitchen counter is chest-high on one side and knee-high on the other; a ceiling has a door to nowhere. The effect is disorienting but invigorating: after four years there, filmmaker Nobu Yamaoka reported significant health benefits.
stem: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?

options.content: Although inhabiting a home surrounded by fanciful features such as those designed by Gins and Arakawa can be rejuvenating, it is unsustainable.
Designing disorienting spaces like those in the Gins and Arakawa building is the most effective way to create a physically stimulating environment.
As a filmmaker, Yamaoka has long supported the designs of conceptual artists such as Gins and Arakawa.
Although impractical, the design of the apartment building by Gins and Arakawa may improve the well-being of the building's residents.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

主旨大意题，核心任务是准确概括文章的中心思想，抓住文章最主要的信息点。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Believing that living in an impractical space can heighten awareness and even improve health, conceptual artists Madeleine Gins and Shusaku Arakawa designed an apartment building in Japan to be more fanciful than functional.

👉 说明观点：艺术家设计不实用但富于幻想的公寓，基于其对这种空间能提升意识和健康的信念。

**第2句：**
> A kitchen counter is chest-high on one side and knee-high on the other; a ceiling has a door to nowhere.

👉 举例说明：描述该公寓设计中具体不实用但奇特的细节。

**第3句：**
> The effect is disorienting but invigorating: after four years there, filmmaker Nobu Yamaoka reported significant health benefits.

👉 因果推论：虽然空间令人迷惑，但却令人振奋，且居住者报告了明显的健康改善。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 艺术家基于信念设计了一个不实用但幻想的公寓，意在提高意识和健康。 |
| 第二句 | 具体描述公寓中不符合常规的设计细节。 |
| 第三句 | 说明这种设计效果虽令人迷惑但振奋，并带来了健康益处。 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> Although inhabiting a home surrounded by fanciful features such as those designed by Gins and Arakawa can be rejuvenating, it is unsustainable.

错误原因：文中未提及该设计“不可持续”或“unsustainable”的内容，属于【无中生有】。

**B 选项** ❌
> Designing disorienting spaces like those in the Gins and Arakawa building is the most effective way to create a physically stimulating environment.

错误原因：文章只提到该设计带来健康益处，并未断言这是“最有效的方法”，属于【过度推断】。

**C 选项** ❌
> As a filmmaker, Yamaoka has long supported the designs of conceptual artists such as Gins and Arakawa.

错误原因：文中仅提及Yamaoka居住四年后报告健康改善，没有说明其“长期支持”，属于【无中生有】。

**D 选项** ✅
> Although impractical, the design of the apartment building by Gins and Arakawa may improve the well-being of the building's residents.

正确原因：精准概括文章主旨，强调设计“不实用”且“可能改善健康”，与原文“impractical”、“reported significant health benefits”完全对应。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 主旨题抓住文章关键词：文首提出设计理念（impractical, improve health），中间举例细节，结尾强调效果（disorienting but invigorating，reported significant health benefits）。选项中含有文中未提及内容（如unsustainable、最有效、长期支持）应排除，选项D完整准确体现文章中心思想。

article: The ancient writing system used in the Maya kingdoms of southern Mexico and Central America had a symbol for the number zero. The earliest known example of the symbol dates to more than 2,000 years ago. At that time, almost none of the writing systems elsewhere in the world possessed a zero symbol. And the use of zero in Mexico and Central America may be even more ancient. Some historians suggest that Maya mathematicians inherited it from the Olmec civilization, which flourished in the region 2,400–3,600 years ago.
stem: According to the text, what do some historians suggest about Maya civilization?

options.content: Maya civilization acquired the use of zero from the Olmec civilization.
Maya civilization respected its historians more than it respected its mathematicians.
Maya civilization was highly secretive about its intellectual achievements.
Maya civilization tried to introduce its writing system to other civilizations.

## 题目类型说明

本题为细节理解题，核心任务是根据文章内容准确找到关于玛雅文明的历史学家观点。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> The ancient writing system used in the Maya kingdoms of southern Mexico and Central America had a symbol for the number zero.

👉 提出观点：玛雅古代文字系统包含数字零的符号。

**第2句：**
> The earliest known example of the symbol dates to more than 2,000 years ago.

👉 说明事实：零符号最早的已知实例超过2000年历史。

**第3句：**
> At that time, almost none of the writing systems elsewhere in the world possessed a zero symbol.

👉 对比说明：当时世界其他文字系统几乎没有零符号。

**第4句：**
> And the use of zero in Mexico and Central America may be even more ancient.

👉 推测补充：墨西哥和中美洲使用零的历史可能更早。

**第5句：**
> Some historians suggest that Maya mathematicians inherited it from the Olmec civilization, which flourished in the region 2,400–3,600 years ago.

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                 |
|:---------|:------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 玛雅文字系统有零的符号               |
| 第二句   | 零符号最早实例超过2000年             |
| 第三句   | 当时世界其他文字系统几乎无零符号     |
| 第四句   | 墨西哥和中美洲使用零的历史可能更早   |
| 第五句   | 一些历史学家认为零是从奥尔梅克文明继承 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅（正确）
> Maya civilization acquired the use of zero from the Olmec civilization.

正确。文章明确指出“Some historians suggest that Maya mathematicians inherited it from the Olmec civilization”，与选项内容完全吻合。

**B 选项** ❌（错误）【无中生有】
> Maya civilization respected its historians more than it respected its mathematicians.

文章未提及玛雅文明对历史学家或数学家的尊重程度，属于无中生有。

**C 选项** ❌（错误）【无中生有】
> Maya civilization was highly secretive about its intellectual achievements.

文章未涉及玛雅文明是否对其智识成就保密，属于无中生有。

**D 选项** ❌（错误）【无中生有】
> Maya civilization tried to introduce its writing system to other civilizations.

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关注“some historians suggest”这一表达，锁定历史学家观点，定位文章最后一句，直接对应选项A。其他选项均为文章未涉及内容，属于“无中生有”，可快速排除。识别关键词“inherited”、“Olmec civilization”是解题关键。

article: Paleontologist Alan Tennyson and colleagues studied fossil bones found in New Zealand that are more than 55 million years old. The researchers determined that the fossil bones belonged to two previously unknown species of prehistoric penguins. Moreover, they estimated that one of the two penguin species was more than three times the size of the emperor penguin, which is the largest penguin species that exists today.
stem: Based on the text, which choice best describes the two previously unknown penguin species?

options.content: They are frequently studied by paleontologists.
They are no longer living species.
They were smaller than penguin species that exist today.
They spent little of their lives in water.
