## 题目类型说明

这是一道细节理解题，核心任务是根据文章内容准确判断文中对“两个未知企鹅物种”的描述。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Paleontologist Alan Tennyson and colleagues studied fossil bones found in New Zealand that are more than 55 million years old.

👉 介绍研究对象和研究背景（研究者及研究的化石时间和地点）。

**第2句：**
> The researchers determined that the fossil bones belonged to two previously unknown species of prehistoric penguins.

👉 说明研究结果：化石属于两个未知的史前企鹅物种。

**第3句：**
> Moreover, they estimated that one of the two penguin species was more than three times the size of the emperor penguin, which is the largest penguin species that exists today.

👉 进一步说明这两个物种的特征之一，即其中一个体型巨大，超过现存最大企鹅的三倍。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                     |
|:---------|:----------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍研究者及研究对象（超过5500万年化石） |
| 第二句   | 确认化石属于两个未知的史前企鹅物种          |
| 第三句   | 描述其中一个物种体型远大于现存最大企鹅        |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> They are frequently studied by paleontologists.

文中只提到“Alan Tennyson及其同事研究了这些化石”，并未说明这两个物种被“频繁研究”。【无中生有】

**B 选项** ✅
> They are no longer living species.

文章明确称这两个物种为“prehistoric penguins”（史前企鹅），且研究的是化石，说明它们不是现存物种，符合题意。

**C 选项** ❌
> They were smaller than penguin species that exist today.

文中明确指出其中一个物种体型是“现存最大企鹅皇帝企鹅的三倍”，与“更小”相反。【方向相反】

**D 选项** ❌
> They spent little of their lives in water.

文中没有涉及这两个物种生活习性的任何信息，无法推断。【无中生有】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于锁定“prehistoric”+“fossil bones”表明物种已经灭绝，排除与现存物种相关的选项；同时注意文中明确给出体型信息，排除与之矛盾的选项；无直接信息的选项应优先排除。

article: In West Africa, jalis have traditionally been keepers of information about family histories and records of important events. They have often served as teachers and advisers, too. ## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> A subject of much speculation, distinctive sets of parallel ridges mark the icy crust of Europa, Jupiter's smallest moon.

**第2句：**

👉 提出观点——研究者认为欧罗巴的脊状结构形成机制与格陵兰冰盖上的一对类似脊状结构相同。

**第3句：**
> There, surface water seeped through fissures in the sheet and formed a water pocket that subsequently disrupted the overlying ice, forcing fragments of it upward and outward into peaks, as the pocket froze and expanded.
👉 解释原因——描述格陵兰脊状结构形成的具体过程。

**第4句：**
> Although Europa lacks liquid surface water, the same process could be driven by the moon's subsurface ocean.

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅（正确）
> Researchers think that the ridges on Europa and the ridges in Greenland may have been formed by the same process even though Europa, unlike Greenland, doesn't have liquid water on its surface.
符合文章主旨，准确表达了研究者观点及欧罗巴与格陵兰脊形成机制的相似性和液态水存在的差异（第2句和第4句支持）。

文章开头明确说欧罗巴上的脊是“distinctive sets of parallel ridges”，两者均为平行脊状，故说格陵兰脊是“与欧罗巴不同的平行脊”错误，方向相反。

**C 选项** ❌（错误）【无中生有】

文中没有任何关于形成时间先后的信息，此选项属于无中生有。

**D 选项** ❌（错误）【过度推断】

Although galaxies that are surrounded by the CGM have been studied, researchers have been unable to directly observe low-density gas in the CGM in the "warm-hot" phase.
Researchers don't yet have a complete understanding of the process of galaxy evolution but have raised the possibility that galaxies interact with each other at times.
The Aspera mission is expected to produce the first direct observations of CGM gas in the "warm-hot" phase, which likely has an important role in the evolution of galaxies.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

主旨大意题，核心任务是准确概括文章主要内容，抓住关键信息并排除细节或偏题选项。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> NASA's Aspera mission, led by Carlos Vargas, will investigate the circumgalactic medium (CGM), the huge swaths of low-density gas that fill and surround galaxies.

👉 介绍Aspera任务的主题和研究对象（CGM）。

**第2句：**
> Specifically, the team will focus on portions of the gas that exist in a "warm-hot" phase: these portions haven't previously been observable but are thought to fuel new star formation and hold most of the mass that makes up a galaxy.

👉 说明研究重点是“warm-hot”阶段的气体，这部分气体之前无法观测，但被认为对星系质量和新星形成很重要。

**第3句：**
> Using a telescope capable of revealing these parts of the CGM, the Aspera mission should help answer long-standing questions about how galaxies emerge, change, and even interact.

👉 说明Aspera任务借助新望远镜将揭示CGM的“warm-hot”气体，帮助解答星系形成、演变和相互作用的科学问题。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                                        |
|:---------|:------------------------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍Aspera任务及其研究对象CGM                                 |
| 第二句   | 具体聚焦“warm-hot”气体，强调其重要性和之前无法观测的事实     |
| 第三句   | 说明任务通过新望远镜揭示这些气体，旨在解决星系演变相关问题     |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> As the leader of NASA's Aspera mission, Vargas will be the first person to investigate the makeup of the CGM.

错误原因：文章未提及Vargas是第一个研究CGM的人，只说他领导Aspera任务研究CGM。属于【无中生有】。

**B 选项** ❌
> Although galaxies that are surrounded by the CGM have been studied, researchers have been unable to directly observe low-density gas in the CGM in the "warm-hot" phase.

错误原因：文章未提及整体CGM已被研究，只说“warm-hot”部分之前未能观测，且选项断言“galaxies surrounded by CGM have been studied”是过度推断，存在【过度推断】。

**C 选项** ❌
> Researchers don't yet have a complete understanding of the process of galaxy evolution but have raised the possibility that galaxies interact with each other at times.

错误原因：文章提到Aspera任务将帮助回答星系“emerge, change, and even interact”问题，但没有说研究者已经提出过互动的可能性，且没有突出“不完整理解”的主题，属于【无中生有】。

**D 选项** ✅
> The Aspera mission is expected to produce the first direct observations of CGM gas in the "warm-hot" phase, which likely has an important role in the evolution of galaxies.

正确原因：准确反映了文章重点，Aspera任务将首次直接观测“warm-hot”阶段的CGM气体，且该气体对星系演变重要，符合原文“haven't previously been observable”、“thought to fuel new star formation and hold most of the mass”及“help answer... how galaxies emerge, change, and even interact”。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题抓住核心信息“warm-hot”阶段的CGM气体及其首次观测价值是解题关键；注意文章反复强调“之前未观测”和“重要作用”，选项中必须体现这些信息，排除过度推断和无关信息，尤其注意选项是否与文章事实精准对应。关键词“first direct observations”、“important role”是答案锁定信号。

article: Using the Stratospheric Observatory for Infrared Astronomy (SOFIA), a team of astronomers mapped out the magnetic field of G47, one of the Milky Way's galactic bones (dense clouds of gas and dust that run through the middle of the arm of a spiral galaxy). Surprisingly, the map revealed a magnetic field with no clear pattern or direction. The researchers had expected the magnetic field to be similar to the more uniform fields seen in galactic bones in other arms of the Milky Way.
stem: According to the text, what was surprising about the researchers' mapping of the magnetic field of galactic bone G47?

options.content: It implied that previous mappings of the magnetic field were inaccurate.
It produced magnetic field measurements similar to those for other galactic bones.
It revealed a magnetic field that wasn't uniform.
It showed a weaker magnetic field than expected.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

这是细节理解题，核心任务是准确找到文章中关于研究结果的具体描述，判断哪项符合文本内容。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Using the Stratospheric Observatory for Infrared Astronomy (SOFIA), a team of astronomers mapped out the magnetic field of G47, one of the Milky Way's galactic bones (dense clouds of gas and dust that run through the middle of the arm of a spiral galaxy).

👉 介绍研究对象和所使用的技术。

**第2句：**
> Surprisingly, the map revealed a magnetic field with no clear pattern or direction.

👉 报告研究结果，指出结果出乎意料。

**第3句：**
> The researchers had expected the magnetic field to be similar to the more uniform fields seen in galactic bones in other arms of the Milky Way.

👉 说明研究者的预期，与实际结果形成对比。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                             |
|:---------|:--------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍利用SOFIA观测银河系骨架G47的磁场 |
| 第二句   | 结果显示磁场没有明确模式或方向，令人惊讶 |
| 第三句   | 研究者原本预期磁场应像其他银河骨架那样均匀 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> It implied that previous mappings of the magnetic field were inaccurate.

错误，文章没有提及之前的磁场测量存在误差，研究者只表示这次结果与预期不符。【无中生有】

**B 选项** ❌
> It produced magnetic field measurements similar to those for other galactic bones.

错误，文章明确说研究者原本预期磁场应类似其他骨架，但实际映射结果没有相似的均匀性。【方向相反】

**C 选项** ✅
> It revealed a magnetic field that wasn't uniform.

正确，文章第二句明确指出磁场“with no clear pattern or direction”，即不均匀，符合选项表述。

**D 选项** ❌
> It showed a weaker magnetic field than expected.

错误，文章未提及磁场强度的强弱，只谈及磁场的模式和方向。【无中生有】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关注关键词“surprisingly”（令人惊讶）和“no clear pattern or direction”（无明确模式或方向），锁定研究结果的核心信息，排除与磁场强度或前人研究准确性相关的选项，准确选出描述磁场不均匀的选项。

article:
The following text is adapted from Edgar Allan Poe's 1849 story "Landor's Cottage."

During a pedestrian trip last summer, through one or two of the river counties of New York, I found myself, as the day declined, somewhat embarrassed about the road I was pursuing. The land undulated very remarkably; and my path, for the last hour, had wound about and about so confusedly, in its effort to keep in the valleys, that I no longer knew in what direction lay the sweet village of B——, where I had determined to stop for the night.
stem: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?

options.content: The narrator explains the difficulties he encountered on a trip and how he overcame them.
The narrator describes what he saw during a long trip through a frequently visited location.
The narrator recalls fond memories of a journey that he took through some beautiful river counties.
The narrator remembers a trip he took and admits to getting lost.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

主旨大意题，核心任务是准确把握文章的中心内容，判断哪一选项最准确地概括了全文主旨。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> During a pedestrian trip last summer, through one or two of the river counties of New York, I found myself, as the day declined, somewhat embarrassed about the road I was pursuing.

👉 说明作者在去年夏天徒步旅行时遇到了困境，暗示迷路的情境。

**第2句：**
> The land undulated very remarkably; and my path, for the last hour, had wound about and about so confusedly, in its effort to keep in the valleys, that I no longer knew in what direction lay the sweet village of B——, where I had determined to stop for the night.

👉 描述地形起伏和道路曲折，进一步强调作者迷路，不知道目的地方向。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 介绍徒步旅行及作者遇到困境，暗示迷路。 |
| 第二句 | 描述地形和道路的复杂，明确作者不知去向。 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> The narrator explains the difficulties he encountered on a trip and how he overcame them.

错误，因为原文只提到遇到困难和迷路，没有提及作者如何克服。
错误类型：【过度推断】

**B 选项** ❌
> The narrator describes what he saw during a long trip through a frequently visited location.

错误，原文没有描述具体景物，也没有说明该地是“frequently visited”，而且重点在迷路。
错误类型：【无中生有】

**C 选项** ❌
> The narrator recalls fond memories of a journey that he took through some beautiful river counties.

错误，原文语气并非“fond memories”，而且重点是迷路，不是美好回忆。
错误类型：【偷换概念】

**D 选项** ✅
> The narrator remembers a trip he took and admits to getting lost.

正确，准确概括了文章内容——作者回忆旅行并承认迷路。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 注意文中关键表达“somewhat embarrassed about the road I was pursuing”和“不再知道方向”，这些都指向迷路；选项中要找与迷路直接相关且没有额外信息的表述，排除包含额外信息或情感色彩的选项。

article: Many intellectual histories of the Black Power movement of the 1960s and 1970s rely heavily on essays and other explicitly ideological works as primary sources, a tendency that can overrepresent the perspectives of a small number of thinkers, most of whom were male. Historian Ashley D. Farmer has shown that expanding the array of primary sources to encompass more types of print material—including political cartoons, advertisements, and artwork—leads to a much better understanding of the movement and the crucial and diverse roles that Black women played in shaping it.
stem: Which choice best describes the main idea of the text?

options.content: Farmer's methods and research have enriched the historical understanding of the Black Power movement and Black women's contributions to it.
Before Farmer's research, historians had largely ignored the intellectual dimensions of the Black Power movement.
Other historians of the Black Power movement have criticized Farmer's use of unconventional primary sources.
The figures in the Black Power movement whom historians tend to cite would have agreed with Farmer's conclusions about women's roles in the movement.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

主旨大意题，核心任务是准确把握文章中心思想，选出最能概括全文内容的选项。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Many intellectual histories of the Black Power movement of the 1960s and 1970s rely heavily on essays and other explicitly ideological works as primary sources, a tendency that can overrepresent the perspectives of a small number of thinkers, most of whom were male.

👉 说明现有研究方法的局限性，即过度依赖有限的、主要由男性撰写的意识形态性文献，导致视角偏狭。

**第2句：**
> Historian Ashley D. Farmer has shown that expanding the array of primary sources to encompass more types of print material—including political cartoons, advertisements, and artwork—leads to a much better understanding of the movement and the crucial and diverse roles that Black women played in shaping it.

👉 介绍Farmer通过扩展史料类型，获得了对运动及黑人女性作用更全面深入的理解。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 说明传统研究依赖有限且男性为主的意识形态文献，导致视角偏狭。 |
| 第二句 | 介绍Farmer通过扩展史料类型，深化对运动及黑人女性多样角色的理解。 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅（正确）
> Farmer's methods and research have enriched the historical understanding of the Black Power movement and Black women's contributions to it.

准确概括了文章第二句的核心内容，即Farmer通过拓宽史料种类，丰富了对黑人权力运动和黑人女性贡献的历史理解。

**B 选项** ❌（错误）【无中生有】
> Before Farmer's research, historians had largely ignored the intellectual dimensions of the Black Power movement.

文章并未说之前的历史学家忽视了黑人权力运动的“智识层面”，而是说他们过度依赖某类史料，导致视角偏狭。

**C 选项** ❌（错误）【无中生有】
> Other historians of the Black Power movement have criticized Farmer's use of unconventional primary sources.

文中没有提及其他历史学家对Farmer方法的批评，纯属无中生有。

**D 选项** ❌（错误）【无中生有】
> The figures in the Black Power movement whom historians tend to cite would have agreed with Farmer's conclusions about women's roles in the movement.

文中没有涉及这些历史人物是否同意Farmer的观点，属于无中生有。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本文主旨题的关键在于抓住转折结构：第一句指出传统研究的局限，第二句提出Farmer的新方法及其成果，转折词“has shown that”是提示答案方向的核心信号词。选项需精准反映Farmer研究带来的理解深化，排除无中生有和与文意不符的选项。

article:
The following text is adapted from Guy de Maupassant's nineteenth-century short story "The Trip of Le Horla" (translated by Albert M. C. McMaster, A. E. Henderson, Mme. Quesada, et al.). The narrator is part of a group traveling in a hot-air balloon at night.

The earth no longer seems to exist, it is buried in milky vapors that resemble a sea. We are now alone in space with the moon, which looks like another balloon travelling opposite us; and our balloon, which shines in the air, appears like another, larger moon, a world wandering in the sky amid the stars, through infinity. We no longer speak, think nor live; we float along through space in delicious inertia. The air which is bearing us up has made of us all beings which resemble itself, silent, joyous, irresponsible beings, peculiarly alert, although motionless.
stem: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?

options.content: The narrator feels a growing sense of isolation even though his companions are nearby during the balloon ride.
The narrator and his companions are completely absorbed in the change in perspective they gain while riding in the balloon.
The narrator and his companions are troubled by the disorienting effects of the altitude while riding in the balloon.
The narrator is pleasantly surprised by his companions' unrestrained enthusiasm about the sensation of riding in the balloon.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

主旨大意题，核心任务是准确把握文章整体表达的中心思想。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> The earth no longer seems to exist, it is buried in milky vapors that resemble a sea.

👉 描绘地面景象，突出地球变得模糊，营造超脱现实的氛围。

**第2句：**
> We are now alone in space with the moon, which looks like another balloon travelling opposite us; and our balloon, which shines in the air, appears like another, larger moon, a world wandering in the sky amid the stars, through infinity.

👉 通过比喻强调身处高空的独特视角和奇妙景象。

**第3句：**
> We no longer speak, think nor live; we float along through space in delicious inertia.

👉 表达乘客们沉浸在宁静、放松的状态中，完全沉醉于漂浮的感觉。

**第4句：**
> The air which is bearing us up has made of us all beings which resemble itself, silent, joyous, irresponsible beings, peculiarly alert, although motionless.

👉 总结乘客们因空气承载而变得无忧无虑、喜悦且警觉的状态。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                     |
|:---------|:----------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 地球消失于迷雾中，营造超现实氛围         |
| 第二句   | 以月亮和气球比喻展现高空中奇特景象       |
| 第三句   | 描述乘客们沉浸于宁静、漂浮的感受         |
| 第四句   | 总结乘客们变得沉默、快乐且警觉的状态     |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> The narrator feels a growing sense of isolation even though his companions are nearby during the balloon ride.

错误，文中强调的是“we”（我们）共同的状态和感受，没有表现“孤立感”。【无中生有】

**B 选项** ✅
> The narrator and his companions are completely absorbed in the change in perspective they gain while riding in the balloon.

正确，文章多次用“we”、“all beings”表达共同感受，且描绘了“change in perspective”——从地面到太空的奇妙视角，完全沉醉于其中。

**C 选项** ❌
> The narrator and his companions are troubled by the disorienting effects of the altitude while riding in the balloon.

错误，文章没有表现出“troubled”或“disorienting”的负面情绪，反而是“delicious inertia”和“joyous”体现积极体验。【方向相反】

**D 选项** ❌
> The narrator is pleasantly surprised by his companions' unrestrained enthusiasm about the sensation of riding in the balloon.

错误，文中没有提到“companions’ unrestrained enthusiasm”，反而描述的是“silent, joyous, irresponsible beings”，没有强调“enthusiasm”的外露表现。【无中生有】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键词是“main idea”和文中反复出现的复数主语“we”，强调共同感受；“change in perspective”通过对比地球和太空的描绘锁定文章核心；同时形容词“silent, joyous, delicious inertia”排除负面选项，确保选出表达共同沉浸体验的选项B。

article: The recovery of a 1,000-year-old Chinese shipwreck in the Java Sea near present-day Indonesia has yielded a treasure trove of artifacts, including thousands of small ceramic bowls. Using a portable X-ray fluorescence analyzer tool, Lisa Niziolek and her team were able to detect the chemical composition of these bowls without damaging them. By comparing the chemical signatures of the bowls with those of the materials still at old Chinese kiln sites, Niziolek and her team can pinpoint which Chinese kilns likely produced the ceramic bowls.
stem: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?

options.content: Because of a new technology, researchers can locate and recover more shipwrecks than they could in the past.
Researchers have been able to identify the location of a number of Chinese kilns in operation 1,000 years ago.
With the help of a special tool, researchers have determined the likely origin of bowls recovered from a shipwreck.
Before the invention of portable X-ray fluorescence, researchers needed to take a small piece out of an artifact to analyze its components.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

主旨大意题，核心任务是准确把握文章的中心内容，选出最能概括全文主旨的选项。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> The recovery of a 1,000-year-old Chinese shipwreck in the Java Sea near present-day Indonesia has yielded a treasure trove of artifacts, including thousands of small ceramic bowls.

👉 介绍背景和发现的文物，为后文研究提供基础。

**第2句：**
> Using a portable X-ray fluorescence analyzer tool, Lisa Niziolek and her team were able to detect the chemical composition of these bowls without damaging them.

👉 说明使用了一种新技术（便携式X射线荧光分析仪）来检测陶碗的成分，突出技术优势。

**第3句：**
> By comparing the chemical signatures of the bowls with those of the materials still at old Chinese kiln sites, Niziolek and her team can pinpoint which Chinese kilns likely produced the ceramic bowls.

👉 解释研究方法和成果，即通过化学成分对比确定陶碗的产地。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句   | 介绍船只沉没及其出土的陶碗文物。 |
| 第二句   | 说明利用便携式X射线荧光仪检测陶碗成分，无损分析。 |
| 第三句   | 通过化学成分比对，确定陶碗可能的中国窑口产地。 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> Because of a new technology, researchers can locate and recover more shipwrecks than they could in the past.

错误原因：文章未提及“新技术帮助定位和打捞更多沉船”，而是强调对文物的成分分析。【无中生有】

**B 选项** ❌
> Researchers have been able to identify the location of a number of Chinese kilns in operation 1,000 years ago.

错误原因：文章说的是“通过陶碗化学成分推断产地”，而非“确定多个窑口位置”，且未明确说窑口的“在运作”。【过度推断】

**C 选项** ✅
> With the help of a special tool, researchers have determined the likely origin of bowls recovered from a shipwreck.

正确原因：准确概括了文章内容，即借助便携式X射线荧光仪确定沉船陶碗的可能产地。

**D 选项** ❌
> Before the invention of portable X-ray fluorescence, researchers needed to take a small piece out of an artifact to analyze its components.

错误原因：文章没有提及历史分析方法，也未对比过去与现在的分析手段。【无中生有】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于抓住文章主旨“利用便携式X射线荧光分析仪确定沉船陶碗产地”，注意选项中是否准确反映了“新技术”、“确定陶碗产地”两大核心信息；排除无关或过度延伸信息的选项。关键词“portable X-ray fluorescence analyzer”、“chemical composition”、“pinpoint kilns”是锁定正确选项的关键。

The research interests of Kristel Zilmer

article:
The following text is adapted from Jack London's 1903 novel The Call of the Wild. Buck is a sled dog living with John Thornton in Yukon, Canada.
Thornton alone held [Buck]. The rest of mankind was as nothing. Chance travellers might praise or pet him; but he was cold under it all, and from a too demonstrative man he would get up and walk away. When Thornton's partners, Hans and Pete, arrived on the long-expected raft, Buck refused to notice them till he learned they were close to Thornton; after that he tolerated them in a passive sort of way, accepting favors from them as though he favored them by accepting.
stem: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?

options.content: Buck has become less social since he began living with Thornton.
Buck mistrusts humans and does his best to avoid them.
Buck has been especially well liked by most of Thornton's friends.
Buck holds Thornton in higher regard than any other person.

## 题目类型说明

这是主旨大意题，核心任务是抓住文章中心思想，理解文中对Buck与人类关系的描写，选出最准确总结全文主旨的选项。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Thornton alone held [Buck]. The rest of mankind was as nothing.

👉 说明Buck只对Thornton有感情，其他人对他毫无意义，突出Buck对Thornton的特殊感情。

**第2句：**
> Chance travellers might praise or pet him; but he was cold under it all, and from a too demonstrative man he would get up and walk away.

👉 说明Buck对其他偶然遇到的人不热情，甚至冷漠，表现出Buck不喜欢普通人类的态度。

**第3句：**
> When Thornton's partners, Hans and Pete, arrived on the long-expected raft, Buck refused to notice them till he learned they were close to Thornton; after that he tolerated them in a passive sort of way, accepting favors from them as though he favored them by accepting.

👉 说明Buck对Hans和Pete也很冷淡，只有当他们靠近Thornton时才勉强接受，体现Buck对Thornton的忠诚和对其他人的冷淡。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | Buck只对Thornton有感情，其他人对他毫无意义。 |
| 第二句 | Buck对偶遇的陌生人冷漠，甚至主动回避。 |
| 第三句 | Buck对Thornton的伙伴也冷淡，只有与Thornton有关时才勉强接受。 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> Buck has become less social since he began living with Thornton.

Buck对Thornton的伙伴Hans和Pete仍表现出一定的容忍，只是冷淡而非不社交，文中无“变得更不合群”的对比描述。【过度推断】

**B 选项** ❌
> Buck mistrusts humans and does his best to avoid them.

Buck确实对大多数人冷淡，但文中并未明确说Buck“尽力避免”，且他接受Thornton伙伴的好意，态度并非完全回避。【过度推断】

**C 选项** ❌
> Buck has been especially well liked by most of Thornton's friends.

文中明确说Buck对Hans和Pete冷淡，只是“容忍”，并非“被特别喜欢”或“受欢迎”。【方向相反】

**D 选项** ✅
> Buck holds Thornton in higher regard than any other person.

文章第一句明确指出“Thornton alone held Buck”，其他人“as nothing”，准确表达Buck对Thornton的特别情感。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于抓住首句“Thornton alone held [Buck]”的绝对性表述，以及Buck对其他人的冷淡态度。转折词“but”和“after that”强调Buck对其他人的态度不如对Thornton，排除选项时注意是否与文中“only Thornton mattered”相符。选项D准确对应这一核心观点，其他选项则存在推断过度或与文意相反的问题。

---

**第1句：**
> Cats can judge unseen people's positions in space by the sound of their voices and thus react with surprise when the same person calls to them from two different locations in a short span of time.

👉 介绍研究背景和猫的能力，提出研究的核心现象——猫能根据声音判断位置并表现出惊讶。

**第2句：**
> Saho Takagi and colleagues reached this conclusion by measuring cats' levels of surprise based on their ear and head movements while the cats heard recordings of their owners' voices from two speakers spaced far apart.

👉 说明研究者是如何得出结论的，即通过观察猫的耳朵和头部动作来判断其惊讶程度。

**第3句：**
> Cats exhibited a low level of surprise when owners' voices were played twice from the same speaker, but they showed a high level of surprise when the voice was played once each from the two different speakers.

👉 具体描述实验结果，比较猫在不同声音来源下的惊讶反应差异。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                      |
|:---------|:-----------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍猫能通过声音判断人的位置并表现惊讶的现象 |
| 第二句   | 说明研究者通过观察猫的耳朵和头部动作来测量惊讶程度 |
| 第三句   | 展示实验结果：不同音源位置引起的惊讶程度差异     |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅（正确）
> They watched how each cat moved its ears and head.

正确。文中明确写道：“measuring cats' levels of surprise based on their ear and head movements”（通过观察猫的耳朵和头部动作来测量惊讶程度），与选项完全吻合。

**B 选项** ❌（错误）
> They examined how each cat reacted to the voice of a stranger.

错误。文中只提及“owners' voices”（主人的声音），没有提及陌生人的声音。【无中生有】

**C 选项** ❌（错误）
> They studied how each cat physically interacted with its owner.

错误。文中没有提到猫与主人之间的身体互动，研究仅限于声音和耳头动作的观察。【无中生有】

**D 选项** ❌（错误）
> They tracked how each cat moved around the room.

错误。文中没有提及观察猫的全身移动或在房间内的活动，仅关注耳朵和头部动作。【无中生有】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关注题干关键词“how did the researchers determine”（研究者如何判断），锁定文中描述测量“surprise levels”的具体方法部分，注意句中“ear and head movements”对应选项A，排除其他选项因文中无相关描述而错误。通过关键词定位和对比，有效排除无中生有选项。

article: In 1934 physicist Eugene Wigner posited the existence of a crystal consisting entirely of electrons in a honeycomb-like structure. The so-called Wigner crystal remained largely conjecture, however, until Feng Wang and colleagues announced in 2021 that they had captured an image of one. The researchers trapped electrons between two semiconductors and then cooled the apparatus, causing the electrons to settle into a crystalline structure. By inserting an ultrathin sheet of graphene above the crystal, the researchers obtained an impression—the first visual confirmation of the Wigner crystal.
stem: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?

options.content: Researchers have obtained the most definitive evidence to date of the existence of the Wigner crystal.
Researchers have identified an innovative new method for working with unusual crystalline structures.
Graphene is the most important of the components required to capture an image of a Wigner crystal.
It's difficult to acquire an image of a Wigner crystal because of the crystal's honeycomb structure.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

这是主旨大意题，核心任务是准确把握文章的中心思想，选出最能概括全文主要内容的选项。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> In 1934 physicist Eugene Wigner posited the existence of a crystal consisting entirely of electrons in a honeycomb-like structure.
👉 介绍Wigner提出的假设，即Wigner晶体的存在。

**第2句：**
> The so-called Wigner crystal remained largely conjecture, however, until Feng Wang and colleagues announced in 2021 that they had captured an image of one.
👉 说明Wigner晶体长期只是理论猜想，直到2021年研究团队获得了其图像。

**第3句：**
> The researchers trapped electrons between two semiconductors and then cooled the apparatus, causing the electrons to settle into a crystalline structure.
👉 解释研究人员是如何制造Wigner晶体的过程。

**第4句：**
> By inserting an ultrathin sheet of graphene above the crystal, the researchers obtained an impression—the first visual confirmation of the Wigner crystal.
👉 说明通过在晶体上方放置石墨烯薄片，获得了Wigner晶体的首次视觉确认。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                             |
|:---------|:------------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 提出Wigner晶体的理论假设                         |
| 第二句   | 说明该晶体长期为猜想，直至2021年获得图像证据    |
| 第三句   | 描述研究人员如何制造晶体                          |
| 第四句   | 介绍利用石墨烯薄片获得首次视觉确认               |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅（正确）
> Researchers have obtained the most definitive evidence to date of the existence of the Wigner crystal.
符合文章主旨，文章最后一句明确指出“the first visual confirmation”，即获得了迄今为止最明确的证据。

**B 选项** ❌（错误）【无中生有】
> Researchers have identified an innovative new method for working with unusual crystalline structures.
文章虽描述了实验方法，但重点不在“创新方法”，而在于确认Wigner晶体的存在，B选项内容超出文意。

**C 选项** ❌（错误）【以偏概全】
> Graphene is the most important of the components required to capture an image of a Wigner crystal.
文章提到石墨烯薄片用于获得印象，但并未强调其“最重要”，因此此选项夸大了石墨烯的作用。

**D 选项** ❌（错误）【无中生有】
> It's difficult to acquire an image of a Wigner crystal because of the crystal's honeycomb structure.
文章未提及难点原因是“蜂窝状结构”，该因果关系无文中依据。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 主旨题需抓住全文核心信息，注意文中转折词“however”指出长期为猜想，再通过“first visual confirmation”锁定研究突破点；排除选项时需判断是否与文章主旨紧密相关，避免无中生有或以偏概全。

stem: What does the text most strongly suggest about the songs sung by Rainey and Smith?

options.content: The songs have grown in popularity since Rainey and Smith first sang them.
There were more recordings made of Rainey's songs than there were of Smith's.
There were few, if any, reliable transcriptions of Smith's and Rainey's improvised lyrics when Davis began her research.
According to Davis, the songs sung by Rainey were more musically innovative than those sung by Smith typically were.

## 题目类型说明

这是细节理解题，核心任务是根据文章内容准确判断关于Raieny和Smith歌曲的具体信息。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> In her 1998 book *Blues Legacies* and *Black Feminism*, Angela Y. Davis bases her analysis in part on recordings of songs sung in the 1920s by Gertrude "Ma" Rainey and Bessie Smith.

👉 说明研究对象和研究基础（提出观点，交代背景）

**第2句：**
> Davis focuses on how Rainey and Smith improvised the lyrics—replacing the original lines with mischievous jokes and wordplay.

👉 具体说明研究内容：两位歌手即兴改编歌词（解释原因）

**第3句：**
> Davis's work was particularly labor intensive because in order to transcribe, or write down, the lyrics as Rainey and Smith sang them, Davis had to listen repeatedly to the vinyl recordings, which weren't very clear.

👉 说明Davis工作难度大，原因是录音不清晰且需反复聆听以转录歌词（因果推论）

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容与逻辑功能                             |
|:---------|:-----------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 交代研究对象和资料来源（提出观点）       |
| 第二句   | 说明研究的具体重点是歌词的即兴改编（解释原因） |
| 第三句   | 说明转录歌词的工作难度及原因（因果推论） |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> The songs have grown in popularity since Rainey and Smith first sang them.

文中未提及歌曲的流行度变化，缺乏任何相关信息，属于【无中生有】。

**B 选项** ❌
> There were more recordings made of Rainey's songs than there were of Smith's.

文中未提及两位歌手录音数量的比较，缺乏依据，属于【无中生有】。

**C 选项** ✅
> There were few, if any, reliable transcriptions of Smith's and Rainey's improvised lyrics when Davis began her research.

文中说明Davis“had to listen repeatedly to the vinyl recordings, which weren't very clear”来转录歌词，暗示之前缺少清晰、可靠的歌词转录，符合题意。

**D 选项** ❌
> According to Davis, the songs sung by Rainey were more musically innovative than those sung by Smith typically were.

文中未提及两人歌曲的音乐创新性比较，属于【无中生有】。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 重点关注文章中关于Davis转录歌词过程的描述，关键词“had to listen repeatedly”与“weren't very clear”暗示先前缺少可靠的转录，锁定与歌词转录相关选项，排除无关选项。注意题干问的是“most strongly suggest”，避免推断未提及内容。

article:
The following text is adapted from Lewis Carroll's 1889 satirical novel Sylvie and Bruno. A crowd has gathered outside a room belonging to the Warden, an official who reports to the Lord Chancellor.
One man, who was more excited than the rest, flung his hat high into the air, and shouted (as well as I could make out) "Who roar for the Sub-Warden?" Everybody roared, but whether it was for the Sub-Warden, or not, did not clearly appear: some were shouting "Bread!" and some "Taxes!", but no one seemed to know what it was they really wanted.
All this I saw from the open window of the Warden's breakfast-saloon, looking across the shoulder of the Lord Chancellor.
"What can it all mean?" he kept repeating to himself. "I never heard such shouting before—and at this time of the morning, too! And with such unanimity!"
stem: Based on the text, how does the Lord Chancellor respond to the crowd?

options.content: He asks about the meaning of the crowd's shouting, even though he claims to know what the crowd wants.
He indicates a desire to speak to the crowd, even though the crowd has asked to speak to the Sub-Warden.
He expresses sympathy for the crowd's demands, even though the crowd's shouting annoys him.
He describes the crowd as being united, even though the crowd clearly appears otherwise.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

这是细节理解题，核心任务是根据文章内容准确把握人物对情境的反应与态度。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> One man, who was more excited than the rest, flung his hat high into the air, and shouted (as well as I could make out) "Who roar for the Sub-Warden?"

👉 介绍场景中一个比其他人更激动的男子的举动。

**第2句：**
> Everybody roared, but whether it was for the Sub-Warden, or not, did not clearly appear: some were shouting "Bread!" and some "Taxes!", but no one seemed to know what it was they really wanted.

👉 描述群众的混乱吵闹，且他们的诉求不明确。

**第3句：**
> All this I saw from the open window of the Warden's breakfast-saloon, looking across the shoulder of the Lord Chancellor.

👉 叙述者的位置和视角，强调观察角度。

**第4句：**
> "What can it all mean?" he kept repeating to himself. "I never heard such shouting before—and at this time of the morning, too! And with such unanimity!"

👉 描述Lord Chancellor对混乱情景的疑惑和对群众“统一”喊叫的感慨。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 一名激动男子喊叫，掀起群众情绪 |
| 第二句 | 群众喊叫混乱，诉求不清 |
| 第三句 | 叙述者观察位置，透过Lord Chancellor视角 |
| 第四句 | Lord Chancellor困惑但感叹群众喊叫“统一” |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> He asks about the meaning of the crowd's shouting, even though he claims to know what the crowd wants.

错误原因：文中Lord Chancellor反复问“这意味着什么？”，并未显示他声称知道群众诉求，反而说明他并不清楚。
错误类型：【无中生有】

**B 选项** ❌
> He indicates a desire to speak to the crowd, even though the crowd has asked to speak to the Sub-Warden.

错误原因：文中无任何迹象表明Lord Chancellor想与群众讲话。
错误类型：【无中生有】

**C 选项** ❌
> He expresses sympathy for the crowd's demands, even though the crowd's shouting annoys him.

错误原因：文中Lord Chancellor表现出困惑和惊讶，没有表现出同情或厌烦情绪。
错误类型：【无中生有】

**D 选项** ✅
> He describes the crowd as being united, even though the crowd clearly appears otherwise.

正确原因：Lord Chancellor说“with such unanimity!”（如此一致地喊叫），但文章指出群众喊的是不同的口号，诉求不统一。
符合文中“some were shouting ‘Bread!’ and some ‘Taxes!’”与“no one seemed to know what it was they really wanted.”的描述。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关键词“unanimity”（一致性）和“did not clearly appear”（不清楚）形成对比，揭示Lord Chancellor误认为群众一致，实际群众诉求混乱。通过对比人物心理和实际情况，排除与此矛盾的选项，锁定正确答案D。

The following text is from Milan Kundera's 1984 novel The Unbearable Lightness of Being (translated by Michael Henry Heim in 1984). Karenin is a dog that belongs to Tomas and Tereza.

Karenin was not overjoyed by the move to Switzerland [from Prague]. Karenin hated change. Dog time cannot be plotted along a straight line; it does not move on and on, from one thing to the next. It moves in a circle like the hands of a clock, which—they, too, unwilling to dash madly ahead—turn round and round the face, day in and day out following the same path. In Prague, when Tomas and Tereza bought a new chair or moved a flower pot, Karenin would look on in displeasure. It disturbed his sense of time. It was as though they were trying to dupe the hands of the clock by changing the numbers on its face.

©1984 by Milan Kundera. Translation ©1984 by Harper & Row, Publishers, Inc.
stem: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?

options.content: As a dog, Karenin possesses a sense of time that involves a strong preference for predictability and an aversion to disruption.
After he's moved to a new home, Karenin's negative response to changes has become more pronounced.
Similar to Tomas and Tereza, Karenin comprehends time as circular rather than as a straightforward progression.
As is the case for other dogs, Karenin's sense of time seems to accelerate depending on the objects and places that surround him.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

主旨大意题，核心任务是找出准确概括全文主旨的选项。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Karenin was not overjoyed by the move to Switzerland [from Prague].

👉 介绍Karenin对搬家的情绪反应，提出文章背景。

**第2句：**
> Karenin hated change.

👉 直接表达Karenin讨厌变化的观点。

**第3句：**
> Dog time cannot be plotted along a straight line; it does not move on and on, from one thing to the next.

👉 解释狗对时间的感知不是线性发展的。

**第4句：**
> It moves in a circle like the hands of a clock, which—they, too, unwilling to dash madly ahead—turn round and round the face, day in and day out following the same path.

👉 用比喻说明狗的时间感知是循环的，强调对稳定的偏好。

**第5句：**
> In Prague, when Tomas and Tereza bought a new chair or moved a flower pot, Karenin would look on in displeasure.

👉 举例说明Karenin对生活中细微变化的不满。

**第6句：**
> It disturbed his sense of time.

👉 说明变化对Karenin时间感知的影响。

**第7句：**
> It was as though they were trying to dupe the hands of the clock by changing the numbers on its face.

👉 用比喻强调变化对Karenin来说是一种欺骗，进一步突出对变化的反感。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 介绍Karenin对搬家的负面情绪 |
| 第二句 | 直接表达Karenin讨厌变化 |
| 第三至四句 | 解释狗的时间感知是循环的、稳定的，不喜欢变化 |
| 第五句 | 举例说明Karenin对家中细微变化的不悦 |
| 第六句 | 说明变化扰乱了Karenin的时间感知 |
| 第七句 | 比喻变化对Karenin来说是一种欺骗，强调反感 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅（正确）
> As a dog, Karenin possesses a sense of time that involves a strong preference for predictability and an aversion to disruption.

准确总结文章主旨：Karenin作为狗，时间感知是循环的，讨厌变化，喜欢可预测性。符合“Karenin hated change”和“Dog time…moves in a circle”等原文内容。

**B 选项** ❌（错误）【过度推断】
> After he's moved to a new home, Karenin's negative response to changes has become more pronounced.

原文只说Karenin不喜欢搬家，没有说他对变化的反应“变得更强烈”，属于无根据的推断。

**C 选项** ❌（错误）【以偏概全】
> Similar to Tomas and Tereza, Karenin comprehends time as circular rather than as a straightforward progression.

原文中没有提到Tomas和Tereza对时间的理解，仅说狗的时间感知是循环的，此选项错误地将人的感知与狗混淆。

**D 选项** ❌（错误）【无中生有】
> As is the case for other dogs, Karenin's sense of time seems to accelerate depending on the objects and places that surround him.

原文没有提到时间感知“加速”或依赖周围物体，属于无中生有。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于抓住文中反复出现的“Karenin讨厌变化”“狗的时间感知是循环的、不喜欢变化”的核心信息；排除选项时要注意是否有无原文支持的推断（如B、D），以及是否偷换概念（如C将人的时间感知与狗等同）。关注关键词“hated change”“moves in a circle”“disturbed his sense of time”锁定A选项。

article:
The following text is from Thomas Mann's 1924 novel The Magic Mountain, translated by John E. Woods in 1995.
The story of Hans Castorp that we intend to tell here—not for his sake (for the reader will come to know him as a perfectly ordinary, if engaging young man), but for the sake of the story itself, which seems to us to be very much worth telling (although in Hans Castorp's favor it should be noted that it is his story, and that not every story happens to everybody)—is a story that took place long ago, and is, so to speak, covered with the patina of history and must necessarily be told with verbs whose tense is that of the deepest past.
©1995 by Alfred A. Knopf, Inc.
stem: What does the text most strongly suggest about the story of Hans Castorp?

options.content: Though it is true that stories of even the most uninteresting people are themselves interesting because all people are unique, the reason this story is interesting is nonetheless difficult to understand because of the passage of time.
Even though it is a story of a person of no particular importance, its age and the manner in which it therefore must be told are both indicators that the story itself is important.
Like all stories about the lives of inconsequential people, this story must necessarily be related in a particular way if the reason the story is consequential is to be made evident to the audience.﻿
It is a remarkable story that happened to an unremarkable person, though one could plausibly argue that because the story is valuable, some of its value accrues to the person at its center.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

这是主旨理解题，核心任务是理解作者对Hans Castorp故事价值的态度，以及故事与人物之间的关系。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> The story of Hans Castorp that we intend to tell here—not for his sake (for the reader will come to know him as a perfectly ordinary, if engaging young man), but for the sake of the story itself, which seems to us to be very much worth telling (although in Hans Castorp's favor it should be noted that it is his story, and that not every story happens to everybody)—is a story that took place long ago, and is, so to speak, covered with the patina of history and must necessarily be told with verbs whose tense is that of the deepest past.

👉 这句话提出观点：故事的价值不在于主人公本身（普通人），而在于故事本身的价值；同时指出故事发生在很久以前，需要用过去时讲述。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                                         |
|:---------|:-------------------------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍Hans Castorp的故事，强调故事因其自身价值值得讲述，而非因主人公的非凡；指出故事年代久远，带有历史感。 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌【方向相反】
> Though it is true that stories of even the most uninteresting people are themselves interesting because all people are unique, the reason this story is interesting is nonetheless difficult to understand because of the passage of time.

错误原因：原文强调故事本身“very much worth telling”，而非“难以理解”；“passage of time”是说明故事发生久远并用过去时讲述，不是阻碍理解的原因。

**B 选项** ❌【过度推断】
> Even though it is a story of a person of no particular importance, its age and the manner in which it therefore must be told are both indicators that the story itself is important.

错误原因：原文提到故事“covered with the patina of history”及“must necessarily be told with verbs...past”，说明时间久远，但并未说故事的重要性源于“其年龄和讲述方式”，而是故事本身值得讲述。

**C 选项** ❌【无中生有】
> Like all stories about the lives of inconsequential people, this story must necessarily be related in a particular way if the reason the story is consequential is to be made evident to the audience.

错误原因：文中并无提及所有普通人故事都必须用特定方式讲述，也未说明讲述方式是为突出故事重要性，这属于无中生有。

**D 选项** ✅
> It is a remarkable story that happened to an unremarkable person, though one could plausibly argue that because the story is valuable, some of its value accrues to the person at its center.

正确原因：符合原文“not for his sake ... but for the sake of the story itself”，强调故事本身值得讲述，同时“although in Hans Castorp's favor it should be noted that it is his story”，暗示故事的价值也反映在主人公身上。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关注文中转折和强调结构，“not for his sake ... but for the sake of the story itself”是理解故事价值核心的关键；同时“although in Hans Castorp's favor”暗示故事价值也部分归功于主人公。通过这些信号词准确判断故事与人物关系，排除选项中的过度推断和无中生有。

article:
The following text is from William Shakespeare's play The Tempest, first performed in 1611. Miranda has lived on an island with her father, Prospero, since she was three years old. Prospero has stated that Miranda likely does not remember anything other than her life on the island.

MIRANDA: 'Tis far off,
And rather like a dream than an assurance
That my remembrance warrants. Had I not
Four or five women once that tended me?

PROSPERO: Thou hadst, and more, Miranda. But how is it
That this lives in thy mind? What seest thou else
In the dark backward and abysm of time?
If thou remember'st ought ere thou camest here,
How thou camest here thou mayst.
stem: In the text, which point does Prospero most directly make about Miranda and her memories?

options.content: Miranda's reminiscences about her early childhood have a melancholy quality that betrays her discontented view of her current circumstances.

Miranda's doubts about the accuracy of one recollection of a place other than the island are clouding her judgment and seem to be making her reluctant to explore her recollection of traveling to the island.
Miranda's ability to summon details of an experience she had before arriving on the island suggests that she may also be able to summon details of her arrival on the island.
Miranda's impression of a scene is vague because she is remembering a scenario she had daydreamed about as a child rather than a scenario that had occurred in reality.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

这是细节理解题，核心任务是准确把握Prospero对Miranda记忆的直接观点，理解对话中关于记忆内容和其可信度的表述。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
>'Tis far off,
>And rather like a dream than an assurance
>That my remembrance warrants. Had I not
>Four or five women once that tended me?

👉 Miranda表达自己对过去记忆的模糊和不确定，将记忆形容为“像梦一样”，并询问自己是否曾被多名女性照顾。

**第2句：**
>Thou hadst, and more, Miranda. But how is it
>That this lives in thy mind? What seest thou else
>In the dark backward and abysm of time?
>If thou remember'st ought ere thou camest here,
>How thou camest here thou mayst.

👉 Prospero肯定Miranda确实有这些记忆，进一步追问她是否还能忆起更多过去，特别是她来到岛上的过程。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容逻辑功能 |
|:---------|:-------------|
| 第一句   | Miranda陈述自己记忆模糊且不确定，并提及被多名女性照顾的细节（提出观点） |
| 第二句   | Prospero肯定记忆存在，追问是否还能忆起更多，并暗示能记得来岛过程（追问与推论） |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌【无中生有】
> Miranda's reminiscences about her early childhood have a melancholy quality that betrays her discontented view of her current circumstances.

文中Miranda并未表达任何“忧郁”或“不满”的情绪，只有对记忆的模糊描述，故此选项无事实依据。

**B 选项** ❌【过度推断】
> Miranda's doubts about the accuracy of one recollection of a place other than the island are clouding her judgment and seem to be making her reluctant to explore her recollection of traveling to the island.

文中Miranda确实说记忆“像梦”，但并未表明她“犹豫”或“拒绝”进一步探索自己的记忆，Prospero反而鼓励她回忆，选项推断过度。

**C 选项** ✅
> Miranda's ability to summon details of an experience she had before arriving on the island suggests that she may also be able to summon details of her arrival on the island.

Prospero说“如果你记得来这里以前的任何事，来这里的过程你也可以记得”，这正是选项内容的直接表述。

**D 选项** ❌【无中生有】
> Miranda's impression of a scene is vague because she is remembering a scenario she had daydreamed about as a child rather than a scenario that had occurred in reality.

文中Miranda将记忆比作“梦”，但没有暗示这是“白日梦”而非真实经历，选项内容无依据。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关注对话中关键因果词和表达，如Miranda说“像梦一样”，表示记忆模糊；Prospero用“如果...你也可以...”结构，直接指出记忆的可能性和范围，帮助锁定正确选项C，同时排除选项中无依据的情感色彩和过度推断。

article:
The following text is adapted from Countee Cullen's 1926 poem "Thoughts in a Zoo."

They in their cruel traps, and we in ours,
Survey each other’s rage, and pass the hours
Commiserating each the other's woe,
To mitigate his own pain's fiery glow.
Man could but little proffer in exchange
Save that his cages have a larger range.
That lion with his lordly, untamed heart
Has in some man his human counterpart,
Some lofty soul in dreams and visions wrapped,
But in the stifling flesh securely trapped.
stem: Based on the text, what challenge do humans sometimes experience?

options.content: They cannot effectively tame certain wild animals because of a lack of compassion.
They cannot focus on setting attainable goals because of a lack of motivation.
They quickly become frustrated when faced with difficult tasks because of a lack of self-control.
They have aspirations that cannot be fulfilled because of certain limitations.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

这是一道细节理解题，核心任务是根据诗歌内容准确把握人类所面临的挑战。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> They in their cruel traps, and we in ours,

👉 对比动物与人类都被困在各自的“笼子”中，提出主题。

**第2句：**
> Survey each other’s rage, and pass the hours

👉 描述彼此观察对方的愤怒，强调相似的情绪状态。

**第3句：**
> Commiserating each the other's woe,

👉 说明双方同情对方的痛苦，表现共情。

**第4句：**
> To mitigate his own pain's fiery glow.

👉 解释同情的目的，是为了减轻自身痛苦。

**第5句：**
> Man could but little proffer in exchange

👉 指出人类能提供的东西有限，转向人类的处境。

**第6句：**
> Save that his cages have a larger range.

👉 说明人类的“笼子”范围更大，暗示限制不同但同样存在。

**第7句：**
> That lion with his lordly, untamed heart

👉 描述狮子的野性本质，强调动物的自由精神。

**第8句：**
> Has in some man his human counterpart,

👉 说狮子的特质在人类中有相似者，建立类比。

**第9句：**
> Some lofty soul in dreams and visions wrapped,

👉 描绘人类有崇高的理想和梦想。

**第10句：**
> But in the stifling flesh securely trapped.

👉 说明这些理想被现实的肉体限制，表现出无奈和困境。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容及逻辑功能                         |
|:---------|:-------------------------------------|
| 1-2句    | 对比动物和人类都被困，观察彼此愤怒（提出主题） |
| 3-4句    | 双方同情彼此以缓解自身痛苦（解释原因）        |
| 5-6句    | 人类处境有限但范围更大（转折和补充说明）      |
| 7-8句    | 狮子的野性与人类相似（类比）               |
| 9-10句   | 人类有崇高梦想但受肉体限制（提出人类面临的挑战） |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌【无中生有】
> They cannot effectively tame certain wild animals because of a lack of compassion.

原文未提及人类因缺乏同情心而无法驯服动物，诗中重点在于“笼中困境”及精神限制，非驯服问题。

**B 选项** ❌【无中生有】
> They cannot focus on setting attainable goals because of a lack of motivation.

诗中没有提及缺乏动力或无法设定目标，反而强调人类有“lofty soul in dreams and visions”（崇高理想和梦想）。

**C 选项** ❌【无中生有】
> They quickly become frustrated when faced with difficult tasks because of a lack of self-control.

诗中没有提及自控力缺失或因困难任务而快速沮丧，焦点在于被“stifling flesh”限制。

**D 选项** ✅
> They have aspirations that cannot be fulfilled because of certain limitations.

第9、10句明确指出人类“lofty soul in dreams and visions wrapped, but in the stifling flesh securely trapped”，即有崇高理想却被肉体限制，完美对应选项含义。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关注诗中“traps/cages”（陷阱/笼子）和“stifling flesh securely trapped”（受限的肉体）等限制性的意象，结合“lofty soul in dreams and visions”（崇高理想）揭示人类面临的精神与现实的矛盾，从而锁定体现“梦想受限”的选项，排除无关或无根据的选项。

article: For centuries, the widespread acknowledgment of the involvement of the cerebellum—a dense brain structure in vertebrates—in coordinating motor control in humans has hindered recognition of other possible functions of the structure. Neuroscience research from the last two decades now suggests that the cerebellum regulates emotion and social behavior, and recent research by Ilaria Carta and colleagues has identified a pathway connecting the cerebellum to a center for motivation and reward processing known as the ventral tegmental area (VTA).
stem: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?

options.content: The recent verification of a pathway between the VTA and the cerebellum confirms the cerebellum’s long-suspected role in motor coordination.
Recent advances in the field of neuroscience have challenged widely accepted claims about the function of a pathway connecting the VTA and the cerebellum.
Technological limitations have historically hindered the study of the cerebellum, but the recent development of new technologies has led to greater insights into its functions.
The cerebellum has primarily been thought to regulate motor functioning, but in recent years neuroscience researchers have been uncovering additional functions.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

这是主旨大意题，核心任务是准确把握文章的中心思想，概括文章主要内容。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> For centuries, the widespread acknowledgment of the involvement of the cerebellum—a dense brain structure in vertebrates—in coordinating motor control in humans has hindered recognition of other possible functions of the structure.

👉 说明传统观点：小脑被广泛认为主要负责运动协调，因此阻碍了对其他功能的认识。

**第2句：**
> Neuroscience research from the last two decades now suggests that the cerebellum regulates emotion and social behavior, and recent research by Ilaria Carta and colleagues has identified a pathway connecting the cerebellum to a center for motivation and reward processing known as the ventral tegmental area (VTA).

👉 介绍近二十年神经科学研究的新发现：小脑可能调节情绪和社交行为；并指出最近发现了小脑与VTA之间的联系。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                                         |
|:---------|:-------------------------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 传统观点认为小脑主要协调运动，阻碍了对其其他功能的认识。      |
| 第二句   | 近20年研究发现小脑调节情绪和社交行为，且发现了小脑与VTA的联系。|

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> The recent verification of a pathway between the VTA and the cerebellum confirms the cerebellum’s long-suspected role in motor coordination.

错误原因：文中并未说VTA和小脑的连接验证了小脑运动协调的作用，反而指出小脑的其他功能；此选项与文意不符，属于【方向相反】。

**B 选项** ❌
> Recent advances in the field of neuroscience have challenged widely accepted claims about the function of a pathway connecting the VTA and the cerebellum.

错误原因：文章没有提到“广泛接受的关于VTA-小脑通路功能的说法”被挑战，且VTA-小脑通路是最近发现的，不是早已被广泛接受的；属于【无中生有】。

**C 选项** ❌
> Technological limitations have historically hindered the study of the cerebellum, but the recent development of new technologies has led to greater insights into its functions.

错误原因：文章没有提及技术限制或技术进步，只谈了传统观点和新研究发现；属于【无中生有】。

**D 选项** ✅
> The cerebellum has primarily been thought to regulate motor functioning, but in recent years neuroscience researchers have been uncovering additional functions.

正确原因：选项准确概括了文章第一句传统观点和第二句新研究发现的对比，符合全文主旨。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于识别文章的转折关系，文中“for centuries”表明传统认知，“now suggests”引出新的研究发现，这种先旧后新、由单一功能到多重功能的转变是文章主旨。选项中必须体现这一转折和扩展，排除与文意相悖或无中生有的选项。

article: The most recent iteration of the immersive theater experience Sleep No More, which premiered in New York City in 2011, transforms its performance space—a five-story warehouse—into a 1930s-era hotel. Audience members, who wander through the labyrinthine venue at their own pace and follow the actors as they play out simultaneous, interweaving narrative loops, confront the impossibility of experiencing the production in its entirety. The play’s refusal of narrative coherence thus hinges on the sense of spatial fragmentation that the venue’s immense and intricate layout generates.
stem: What does the text most strongly suggest about Sleep No More's use of its performance space?

options.content: The production's dependence on a particular performance environment would likely make it difficult to reproduce exactly in a different theatrical space.
Audience members who navigate the space according to a recommended itinerary will likely have a better grasp of the play's narrative than audience members who depart from that itinerary.
The choice of a New York City venue likely enabled the play's creators to experiment with the use of theatrical space in a way that venues from earlier productions could not.
Audience members likely find the experience of the play disappointing because they generally cannot make their way through the entire venue.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

本题为细节理解题，核心任务是理解文章对《Sleep No More》表演空间使用的描述，判断哪项选项最符合文中信息。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> The most recent iteration of the immersive theater experience *Sleep No More*, which premiered in New York City in 2011, transforms its performance space—a five-story warehouse—into a 1930s-era hotel.

👉 介绍《Sleep No More》的表演空间及其布置，说明演出将场地改造成特定年代的酒店，奠定空间环境背景。

**第2句：**
> Audience members, who wander through the labyrinthine venue at their own pace and follow the actors as they play out simultaneous, interweaving narrative loops, confront the impossibility of experiencing the production in its entirety.

👉 描述观众自由探索复杂空间，跟随演员演绎多线叙事，且无法完整体验全部内容，体现空间和叙事的复杂性。

**第3句：**
> The play’s refusal of narrative coherence thus hinges on the sense of spatial fragmentation that the venue’s immense and intricate layout generates.

👉 说明剧作拒绝连贯叙事的原因是空间的分裂感，强调空间布局对剧情体验的决定性影响。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                                         |
|:---------|:-------------------------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍剧场空间设定，将五层仓库改造成1930年代酒店。             |
| 第二句   | 观众自由探索复杂空间，叙事多线且无法完整体验全部内容。         |
| 第三句   | 叙事不连贯依赖于空间的碎片感，空间布局影响剧情体验。           |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅（正确）
> The production's dependence on a particular performance environment would likely make it difficult to reproduce exactly in a different theatrical space.

正确。文章多次强调空间布局对叙事体验的核心作用（“the venue’s immense and intricate layout generates”），说明演出依赖特定空间环境，换场地难以完全复制。

**B 选项** ❌（错误）
> Audience members who navigate the space according to a recommended itinerary will likely have a better grasp of the play's narrative than audience members who depart from that itinerary.

错误。文中指出观众“wander at their own pace”且叙事是“simultaneous, interweaving narrative loops”，没有提及推荐路线或强调按特定路线更易理解，属于【无中生有】。

**C 选项** ❌（错误）
> The choice of a New York City venue likely enabled the play's creators to experiment with the use of theatrical space in a way that venues from earlier productions could not.

错误。文章仅说明演出于纽约市首演，并无对比早期场地的讨论，也未提及纽约场地独特性，属于【过度推断】。

**D 选项** ❌（错误）
> Audience members likely find the experience of the play disappointing because they generally cannot make their way through the entire venue.

错误。文中提到“impossibility of experiencing the production in its entirety”是事实，但未表达观众“失望”，也未提及情感评价，属于【无中生有】。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关注文中描述“the venue’s immense and intricate layout generates spatial fragmentation”和“impossibility of experiencing the production in its entirety”，这是理解演出对特定空间依赖的关键信号词；排除选项时注意是否有文中未提及的推断（如推荐路线、观众情感、场地对比），避免【无中生有】和【过度推断】错误。

article: Having written the impassioned call to arms "Letter to the Spanish Americans" in 1791, Peruvian intellectual Juan Pablo Viscardo y Guzmán is often considered a forerunner for the independence movements in Latin America. But Viscardo’s role in history would have remained insignificant were it not for Venezuelan revolutionary Francisco de Miranda, who was handed the unpublished letter after Viscardo’s death. Miranda not only helped circulate the letter, but his edits and footnotes to the text position Miranda as a central figure in the text’s creation.
stem: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?

options.content: Miranda played a crucial role in influencing the content and distribution of "Letter to the Spanish Americans."
"Letter to the Spanish Americans" persuaded many people in Latin America to pursue national independence.
The majority of the most eloquently stated arguments in "Letter to the Spanish Americans" were written by Miranda.
The original authorship of "Letter to the Spanish Americans" is disputed by contemporary historians.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

主旨大意题，核心任务是准确把握文章的中心思想，选择最能概括全文主旨的选项。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Having written the impassioned call to arms "Letter to the Spanish Americans" in 1791, Peruvian intellectual Juan Pablo Viscardo y Guzmán is often considered a forerunner for the independence movements in Latin America.
👉 介绍Viscardo写作《致西班牙美洲人的信》及其作为独立运动先驱的身份。

**第2句：**
> But Viscardo’s role in history would have remained insignificant were it not for Venezuelan revolutionary Francisco de Miranda, who was handed the unpublished letter after Viscardo’s death.
👉 转折指出Viscardo历史地位依赖于Miranda的介入。

**第3句：**
> Miranda not only helped circulate the letter, but his edits and footnotes to the text position Miranda as a central figure in the text’s creation.
👉 说明Miranda不仅传播了信件，还通过修改和注释成为文本创作的核心人物。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                 |
|:---------|:------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍Viscardo及其写作《致西班牙美洲人的信》 |
| 第二句   | 转折，指出Viscardo的历史地位依赖Miranda     |
| 第三句   | Miranda传播信件并通过编辑成为核心人物       |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅
> Miranda played a crucial role in influencing the content and distribution of "Letter to the Spanish Americans."
符合全文主旨，文中明确指出Miranda“helped circulate the letter”且“his edits and footnotes position Miranda as a central figure”，强调了Miranda在内容和传播上的关键作用。

**B 选项** ❌ 【无中生有】
> "Letter to the Spanish Americans" persuaded many people in Latin America to pursue national independence.
文章并未提及信件对拉美独立运动的具体影响，只说Viscardo被认为是先驱，未论及信件的说服力。

**C 选项** ❌ 【过度推断】
> The majority of the most eloquently stated arguments in "Letter to the Spanish Americans" were written by Miranda.
文中说Miranda有编辑和注释，但没有说他写了大部分有力论点，属于过度推断。

**D 选项** ❌ 【无中生有】
> The original authorship of "Letter to the Spanish Americans" is disputed by contemporary historians.
文中未提及作者身份存在争议，故此选项无依据。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题重点关注文中因果转折词“But”引出的核心信息，文章强调Miranda对信件内容和传播的关键作用，排除其他选项因缺乏文中依据而错误。注意区分作者身份与文本影响的不同层面，避免无中生有或过度推断。

article: Algae living within the tissues of corals play a critical role in keeping corals, and the marine ecosystems they are part of, thriving. Some coral species appear brown in color when healthy due to the algae colonies living in their tissues. In the event of an environmental stressor, the algae can die or be expelled, causing the corals to appear white. To recover the algae, the bleached corals then begin to produce bright colors, which block intense sunlight, encouraging the light-sensitive algae to recolonize the corals.
stem: What does the text most strongly suggest about corals that produce bright colors?

options.content: These corals are likely more vulnerable to exposure from intense sunlight than white corals are.
These corals have likely been subjected to stressful environmental conditions.
These corals have likely recovered from an environmental event without the assistance of algae colonies.
These corals are more likely to survive without algae colonies than brown corals are.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

这是细节理解题，核心任务是根据文章内容准确理解“产生亮色的珊瑚”所暗示的情境。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Algae living within the tissues of corals play a critical role in keeping corals, and the marine ecosystems they are part of, thriving.

👉 说明藻类在珊瑚和海洋生态系统中的重要作用（提出观点）。

**第2句：**
> Some coral species appear brown in color when healthy due to the algae colonies living in their tissues.

👉 解释健康珊瑚呈棕色的原因（解释原因）。

**第3句：**
> In the event of an environmental stressor, the algae can die or be expelled, causing the corals to appear white.

👉 描述环境压力下藻类死亡或被排出的结果（因果推论）。

**第4句：**
> To recover the algae, the bleached corals then begin to produce bright colors, which block intense sunlight, encouraging the light-sensitive algae to recolonize the corals.

👉 说明产生亮色的珊瑚如何通过阻挡强光帮助藻类重新定殖（解释原因及过程）。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 藻类对珊瑚和生态系统的重要性 |
| 第二句 | 健康珊瑚棕色因藻类存在 |
| 第三句 | 环境压力导致藻类死亡，珊瑚变白 |
| 第四句 | 产生亮色珊瑚阻挡强光，促进藻类复苏 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> These corals are likely more vulnerable to exposure from intense sunlight than white corals are.

错误，文章说亮色珊瑚产生亮色是为了“block intense sunlight”，即阻挡强光，降低暴露，说明它们更能抵御强光。【方向相反】

**B 选项** ✅
> These corals have likely been subjected to stressful environmental conditions.

正确，文章明确提到“bleached corals then begin to produce bright colors”，说明产生亮色的珊瑚是经历了环境压力后开始恢复的阶段，符合题意。

**C 选项** ❌
> These corals have likely recovered from an environmental event without the assistance of algae colonies.

错误，文章强调亮色珊瑚产生亮色是为了“encouraging the light-sensitive algae to recolonize”，即帮助藻类重新定殖，说明恢复依赖藻类。【无中生有】

**D 选项** ❌
> These corals are more likely to survive without algae colonies than brown corals are.

错误，文章中没有任何信息表明亮色珊瑚比棕色珊瑚更能在没有藻类的情况下生存，且亮色珊瑚的目的是帮助藻类复苏，说明藻类仍然关键。【无中生有】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关注关键词“bleached corals then begin to produce bright colors”（产生亮色的珊瑚是漂白后的状态），结合因果词“then”，明确亮色是环境压力后的反应，从而锁定B选项；排除选项时注意文章对强光的描述和藻类作用，避免“方向相反”和“无中生有”的错误。

article: In superfluorescence, electrical charges known as dipoles emit light in synchronized bursts so intense that they are visible to the eye. Until recently, this phenomenon has only been observed at extremely cold temperatures because dipoles cannot synchronize at higher temperatures. But in a study, Melike Biliroglu and colleagues observed superfluorescence at room temperature in thin films made of perovskite and other similarly crystalline materials; the researchers propose that the formation of shock-absorbing quasiparticles called polarons in the material protects dipoles from thermal interference.
stem: Based on the text, how are polarons believed to be involved in the superfluorescence observed in Biliroglu and colleagues' study?

options.content: Polarons enable superfluorescent bursts to cross from one crystalline material to another.
Polarons allow for the dipoles to synchronize despite higher temperatures.
Polarons accelerate the dipoles' release of superfluorescent bursts.
Polarons decrease the intensity of the superfluorescent burst.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

这是细节理解题，核心任务是根据文中对“polarons”的描述，准确理解其在超辐射现象中的作用。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> In superfluorescence, electrical charges known as dipoles emit light in synchronized bursts so intense that they are visible to the eye.

👉 解释超辐射现象的定义和特征。

**第2句：**
> Until recently, this phenomenon has only been observed at extremely cold temperatures because dipoles cannot synchronize at higher temperatures.

👉 说明超辐射只能在极低温度下观察到的原因（高温下dipoles无法同步）。

**第3句：**
> But in a study, Melike Biliroglu and colleagues observed superfluorescence at room temperature in thin films made of perovskite and other similarly crystalline materials;

👉 转折，提出新发现：在室温下观察到超辐射。

**第4句：**
> the researchers propose that the formation of shock-absorbing quasiparticles called polarons in the material protects dipoles from thermal interference.

👉 解释原因：polarons保护dipoles不受热干扰，从而使同步成为可能。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                                     |
|:---------|:---------------------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 定义超辐射及其特征（dipoles同步发光，强度大）            |
| 第二句   | 说明超辐射只能在极低温度观察，因dipoles高温无法同步      |
| 第三句   | 转折，引入Biliroglu团队在室温下观察到超辐射的新发现       |
| 第四句   | 解释原因：polarons形成保护dipoles免受热干扰，实现同步     |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> Polarons enable superfluorescent bursts to cross from one crystalline material to another.

选项错误，文中未提及polarons使超辐射“跨越材料”，而是保护dipoles免受热干扰。【无中生有】

**B 选项** ✅
> Polarons allow for the dipoles to synchronize despite higher temperatures.

正确，文中明确说polarons保护dipoles免受热干扰，使其能在室温（高温）同步发光。

**C 选项** ❌
> Polarons accelerate the dipoles' release of superfluorescent bursts.

选项错误，文中未提及polarons加速释放光脉冲，只说保护dipoles免受热干扰。【无中生有】

**D 选项** ❌
> Polarons decrease the intensity of the superfluorescent burst.

选项错误，文中未提及polarons降低强度，反而暗示同步导致强烈发光。【方向相反】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关注关键词“polarons”和“protects dipoles from thermal interference”，结合转折词“But”引入的新发现，明确polarons的作用是“保护”而非“加速”或“减少”，锁定与“同步”相关的选项，排除无中生有和方向相反选项。

article: Disco remains one of the most ridiculed popular music genres of the late twentieth century. But as scholars have argued, the genre is far less superficial than many people believe. Take the case of disco icon Donna Summer: she may have been associated with popular songs about love and heartbreak (subjects hardly unique to disco, by the way), but like many Black women singers before her, much of her music also reflects concerns about community and identity. These concerns are present in many of the genre’s greatest songs, and they generally don’t require much digging to reveal.
stem: What does the text most strongly suggest about the disco genre?

options.content: It gave rise to a Black women's musical tradition that has endured even though the genre itself faded in the late twentieth century.
It has been unjustly ignored by most scholars despite the importance of the themes addressed by many of the genre's songs.
It has been unfairly dismissed for the inclusion of subject matter that is also found in other musical genres.
It evolved over time from a superficial genre focused on romance to a genre focused on more serious concerns.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

本题为细节理解题，核心任务是根据文章内容准确把握作者对disco音乐的评价，排除对原文信息的误读或过度推断。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Disco remains one of the most ridiculed popular music genres of the late twentieth century.
👉 提出观点：Disco被广泛嘲笑。

**第2句：**
> But as scholars have argued, the genre is far less superficial than many people believe.
👉 转折，反驳观点：学者认为disco并不像很多人想的那么肤浅。

**第3句：**
> Take the case of disco icon Donna Summer: she may have been associated with popular songs about love and heartbreak (subjects hardly unique to disco, by the way), but like many Black women singers before her, much of her music also reflects concerns about community and identity.
👉 举例说明：以Donna Summer为例，她的歌曲不仅谈论爱情（这并非disco独有主题），还关注社区和身份等更深层主题。

**第4句：**
> These concerns are present in many of the genre’s greatest songs, and they generally don’t require much digging to reveal.
👉 进一步论证：这些关于社区和身份的主题在disco很多经典歌曲中显而易见。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 介绍disco被嘲笑的现象 |
| 第二句 | 反驳disco肤浅的误解，强调学者观点 |
| 第三句 | 举Donna Summer例子说明disco歌曲的深层主题 |
| 第四句 | 说明这些主题普遍存在且易于发现 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> It gave rise to a Black women's musical tradition that has endured even though the genre itself faded in the late twentieth century.
错误原因：文章提到Donna Summer等黑人女性歌手的主题，但未说明disco“产生了一个持续的黑人女性音乐传统”，也未提及该传统是否延续。属于【过度推断】。

**B 选项** ❌
> It has been unjustly ignored by most scholars despite the importance of the themes addressed by many of the genre's songs.
错误原因：文章明确提到“学者们认为disco不肤浅”，说明学者并未忽视该流派。属于【方向相反】。

**C 选项** ✅
> It has been unfairly dismissed for the inclusion of subject matter that is also found in other musical genres.
正确原因：文章指出Donna Summer的爱情主题“hardly unique to disco”，暗示disco被否定部分原因是其主题在其他流派也存在，作者强调这是不公平的。

**D 选项** ❌
> It evolved over time from a superficial genre focused on romance to a genre focused on more serious concerns.
错误原因：文章反驳的是“肤浅”的看法，但并未提到disco经历了从肤浅到严肃的演变过程。属于【无中生有】。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关注转折词“But”引出的观点变化，注意作者强调的“不仅仅是爱情主题（其他流派也有）”，利用“hardly unique to disco”锁定选项C，排除B（学者未忽视）和D（无演变论述），避免A的过度推断。关键词帮助精准定位作者态度和文章主旨。

article:
The following text is adapted from María Cristina Mena's 1914 short story "The Vine-Leaf."

It is a saying in the capital of Mexico that Dr. Malsufrido carries more family secrets under his hat than any archbishop. The doctor's hat is, appropriately enough, uncommonly capacious, rising very high, and sinking so low that it seems to be supported by his ears and eyebrows, and it has a furry look, as if it had been brushed the wrong way, which is perhaps what happens to it if it is ever brushed at all. When the doctor takes it off, the family secrets do not fly out like a flock of parrots, but remain nicely bottled up beneath a dome of old and highly polished ivory.
stem: Based on the text, how do people in the capital of Mexico most likely regard Dr. Malsufrido?

options.content: Few feel concerned that he will divulge their confidences.
Many have come to tolerate him despite his disheveled appearance.
Most would be unimpressed by him were it not for his professional expertise.
Some dislike how freely he discusses his own family.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

这是主旨理解题，核心任务是根据文章细节推断人们对Dr. Malsufrido的态度。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> It is a saying in the capital of Mexico that Dr. Malsufrido carries more family secrets under his hat than any archbishop.

👉 介绍Dr. Malsufrido被认为掌握许多家族秘密，突出其保守秘密的特点。

**第2句：**
> The doctor's hat is, appropriately enough, uncommonly capacious, rising very high, and sinking so low that it seems to be supported by his ears and eyebrows, and it has a furry look, as if it had been brushed the wrong way, which is perhaps what happens to it if it is ever brushed at all.

👉 形象描写医生的帽子，暗示其外表不修边幅。

**第3句：**
> When the doctor takes it off, the family secrets do not fly out like a flock of parrots, but remain nicely bottled up beneath a dome of old and highly polished ivory.

👉 进一步强调医生不会泄露秘密，秘密被“牢牢封存”。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                             |
|:---------|:--------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍Dr. Malsufrido掌握众多家族秘密 |
| 第二句   | 描述医生帽子的外观，暗示不修边幅  |
| 第三句   | 强调医生不会泄露秘密，秘密被封存  |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅
> Few feel concerned that he will divulge their confidences.

文章多处强调Dr. Malsufrido“carries more family secrets”，且“secrets do not fly out”，表明他被认为不会泄露秘密，符合选项含义。

**B 选项** ❌ 【无中生有】
> Many have come to tolerate him despite his disheveled appearance.

文章确实描写了帽子“furry look”暗示不修边幅，但未提及“许多人容忍他”，属于无中生有。

**C 选项** ❌ 【过度推断】
> Most would be unimpressed by him were it not for his professional expertise.

文章未提及人们对他的印象是否因专业技能而改变，此推断无依据。

**D 选项** ❌ 【无中生有】
> Some dislike how freely he discusses his own family.

文章强调他保守秘密，且秘密“不飞出”，未提及他讨论自己家族，属于无中生有。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关注文中关于“秘密”的反复强调和比喻（“secrets do not fly out like parrots”），是判断人们对医生信任程度的关键，排除无直接证据支持的选项。描述外观的细节不能替代对人物态度的直接描写。

article: In a study of new technology adoption, Davit Marikyan et al. examined negative disconfirmation (which occurs when experiences fall short of one's expectations) to determine whether it could lead to positive outcomes for users. The team focused on established users of 'smart home' technology, which presents inherent utilization challenges but tends to attract users with high expectations, often leading to feelings of dissonance. The researchers found that many users employed cognitive mechanisms to mitigate those feelings, ultimately reversing their initial sense of disappointment.
stem: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?

options.content: Research suggests that users with high expectations for a new technology can feel content with that technology even after experiencing negative disconfirmation.
Research suggests that most users of smart home technology will not achieve a feeling of satisfaction given the utilization challenges of such technology.
Although most smart home technology is aimed at meeting or exceeding users’ high expectations, those expectations in general remain poorly understood.
Although negative disconfirmation has often been studied, little is known about the cognitive mechanisms shaping users’ reactions to it in the context of new technology adoption.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

主旨大意题，核心任务是准确把握文章的中心思想，选出最能概括全文内容的选项。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> In a study of new technology adoption, Davit Marikyan et al. examined negative disconfirmation (which occurs when experiences fall short of one's expectations) to determine whether it could lead to positive outcomes for users.

👉 提出研究主题和研究目的：关注“负向差异感知”是否可能带来积极结果。

**第2句：**
> The team focused on established users of 'smart home' technology, which presents inherent utilization challenges but tends to attract users with high expectations, often leading to feelings of dissonance.

👉 说明研究对象（智能家居技术用户）及其特点（高期望值和使用难度导致认知失调）。

**第3句：**
> The researchers found that many users employed cognitive mechanisms to mitigate those feelings, ultimately reversing their initial sense of disappointment.

👉 给出研究结论：用户通过认知调节机制减轻失望感，甚至将其转化为积极感受。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 介绍研究主题和目的，探讨负向差异感知是否能带来积极结果 |
| 第二句 | 说明研究对象（智能家居用户）及其期望与使用挑战 |
| 第三句 | 研究发现用户通过认知机制减轻负面感受，逆转失望情绪 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅
> Research suggests that users with high expectations for a new technology can feel content with that technology even after experiencing negative disconfirmation.

符合全文主旨，文中明确指出用户“高期望”且经历了“负向差异感知”（negative disconfirmation），但通过认知机制“逆转失望”，即“感到满足”，与原文完全对应。

**B 选项** ❌
> Research suggests that most users of smart home technology will not achieve a feeling of satisfaction given the utilization challenges of such technology.

与原文结论相反，原文强调用户通过认知机制“逆转失望”，最终产生积极感受，故该选项错误。【方向相反】

**C 选项** ❌
> Although most smart home technology is aimed at meeting or exceeding users’ high expectations, those expectations in general remain poorly understood.

文章没有提及对用户期望的理解问题，且重点不在“期望是否被理解”，而是负向差异感知的结果，属于【无中生有】。

**D 选项** ❌
> Although negative disconfirmation has often been studied, little is known about the cognitive mechanisms shaping users’ reactions to it in the context of new technology adoption.

文章描述了研究正是针对认知机制如何影响用户反应，说明已有相关了解，故该选项与文意不符，【方向相反】。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 抓住文章关键词“negative disconfirmation”、“high expectations”和“cognitive mechanisms reversing disappointment”，这些因果关系词汇和研究结论明确指向用户虽然经历负面体验，但认知调节使其感到满足，从而排除与结论相反或无关选项，锁定A。

article: In a paper about p-i-n planar perovskite solar cells (one of several perovskite cell architectures designed to collect and store solar power), Lyndsey McMillon-Brown et al. describe a method for fabricating the cell's electronic transport layer (ETL) using a spray coating. Conventional ETL fabrication is accomplished using a solution of nanoparticles. The process can result in a loss of up to 80% of the solution, increasing the cost of manufacturing at scale—an issue that may be obviated by spray coating fabrication, which the researchers describe as "highly reproducible, concise, and practical."
stem: What does the text most strongly suggest about conventional ETL fabrication?

options.content: It typically entails a greater loss of nanoparticle solution than do other established approaches for ETL fabrication.
It is less suitable for manufacturing large volumes of planar p-i-n perovskite solar cells than an alternative fabrication method may be.
It is somewhat imprecise and therefore limits the potential effectiveness of p-i-n planar perovskite solar cells at capturing and storing solar power.
It is more expensive when manufacturing at scale than are processes for fabricating ETLs used in other perovskite solar cell architectures.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

本题属于细节理解题，核心任务是根据文中信息判断传统ETL制备方法的缺点及其在大规模制造中的适用性。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> In a paper about p-i-n planar perovskite solar cells (one of several perovskite cell architectures designed to collect and store solar power), Lyndsey McMillon-Brown et al. describe a method for fabricating the cell's electronic transport layer (ETL) using a spray coating.
👉 引入背景及研究内容，介绍新的ETL制备方法（喷涂法）。

**第2句：**
> Conventional ETL fabrication is accomplished using a solution of nanoparticles.
👉 介绍传统ETL制备方法的基本工艺。

**第3句：**
> The process can result in a loss of up to 80% of the solution, increasing the cost of manufacturing at scale—an issue that may be obviated by spray coating fabrication, which the researchers describe as "highly reproducible, concise, and practical."
👉 说明传统方法存在高达80%的材料损失，导致规模化制造成本上升，同时暗示喷涂法可解决此问题。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 介绍研究背景和新的喷涂制备ETL方法 |
| 第二句 | 介绍传统ETL制备方法是用纳米颗粒溶液 |
| 第三句 | 传统方法材料损失严重，成本高，喷涂法能克服该问题 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> It typically entails a greater loss of nanoparticle solution than do other established approaches for ETL fabrication.
错误在于文章只说“传统方法损失高达80%”，但未比较其与其他已知方法的损失多少，缺乏比较依据。
【无中生有】

**B 选项** ✅
> It is less suitable for manufacturing large volumes of planar p-i-n perovskite solar cells than an alternative fabrication method may be.
正确，文章明确指出传统方法材料损失大，导致制造成本高，说明其不适合大规模制造，喷涂法则更实用。

**C 选项** ❌
> It is somewhat imprecise and therefore limits the potential effectiveness of p-i-n planar perovskite solar cells at capturing and storing solar power.
文中无任何关于传统方法“精准度”或“影响效率”的描述，错误解读。
【无中生有】

**D 选项** ❌
> It is more expensive when manufacturing at scale than are processes for fabricating ETLs used in other perovskite solar cell architectures.
文中只比较了传统方法和喷涂法，未涉及其他perovskite架构的ETL制备成本，无依据。
【无中生有】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 关注原文中表明传统方法“loss of up to 80%... increasing the cost of manufacturing at scale”以及“an issue that may be obviated by spray coating”，这明确指出传统方法不适合大规模制造，从而锁定B选项；同时排除其他选项时，注意是否有文中直接或间接对比或描述，避免无中生有或过度推断。

article: Paleontologist Lucas E. Fiorelli and colleagues have reported the discovery at a mine in Brazil of several egg clutches, partially preserved single eggs, and egg shells from the Late Cretaceous period. The researchers have concluded that the area was once a nesting and breeding site for titanosaurs, a group of sauropod dinosaurs. The finding is significant given the previous lack of known nesting sites in northern regions of South America, which led many paleontologists to assume that titanosaurs migrated south to lay eggs.
stem: What does the text most strongly suggest about the site discovered by the researchers?

options.content: It is the earliest known example of a titanosaur nesting and breeding site.
It was very difficult to excavate given that it was discovered in a mine.
It may have been occupied by other sauropods in addition to titanosaurs.
It is farther north than any other nesting site discovered in South America.
