While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
Species belonging to the Orchidaceae (orchid) family can be found in both tropical and temperate environments.
Orchidaceae species diversity has not been well studied in temperate forests, such as those in Oaxaca, Mexico.
Arelee Estefanía Muñoz-Hernández led a study to determine how many different Orchidaceae species are present in the forests of Oaxaca.
Muñoz-Hernández and her team collected orchids each month for a year at a site in Oaxaca.
Seventy-four Orchidaceae species were present at the site.
stem: The student wants to present the study and its findings. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.content: A study led by Arelee Estefanía Muñoz-Hernández identified a total of 74 Orchidaceae species in the temperate forests of Oaxaca, Mexico.
There are orchids in many environments, but there are 74 Orchidaceae species in Oaxaca, Mexico.
Oaxaca, Mexico, is home to temperate forests containing 74 Orchidaceae species.
Arelee Estefanía Muñoz-Hernández and her team wanted to know how many different Orchidaceae species are present in the forests of Oaxaca, Mexico, so they conducted a study to collect orchids.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

本题为信息整合与表达题，核心任务是根据学生笔记中提供的研究内容和结果，有效且准确地用一句话陈述研究及其发现。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Species belonging to the Orchidaceae (orchid) family can be found in both tropical and temperate environments.

👉 说明研究背景，指出兰科植物分布广泛。

**第2句：**
> Orchidaceae species diversity has not been well studied in temperate forests, such as those in Oaxaca, Mexico.

👉 指出研究空白，强调奥axaca等地温带森林中兰科多样性研究不足。

**第3句：**
> Arelee Estefanía Muñoz-Hernández led a study to determine how many different Orchidaceae species are present in the forests of Oaxaca.

👉 引出研究目的和研究者。

**第4句：**
> Muñoz-Hernández and her team collected orchids each month for a year at a site in Oaxaca.

👉 说明研究方法和时间。

**第5句：**
> Seventy-four Orchidaceae species were present at the site.

👉 给出研究结果。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                   |
|:---------|:-------------------------------------|
| 第1句    | 兰科植物分布于热带和温带环境          |
| 第2句    | 温带森林（如墨西哥奥axaca）兰科多样性研究不足 |
| 第3句    | Muñoz-Hernández领导研究确定奥axaca兰科物种数量 |
| 第4句    | 研究方法：一年每月采集兰花             |
| 第5句    | 研究结果：该地点存在74种兰科物种      |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅（正确）
> A study led by Arelee Estefanía Muñoz-Hernández identified a total of 74 Orchidaceae species in the temperate forests of Oaxaca, Mexico.

准确总结了研究领导者、地点、环境类型和研究结果，完全符合笔记信息，表达清晰完整。

**B 选项** ❌（错误）
> There are orchids in many environments, but there are 74 Orchidaceae species in Oaxaca, Mexico.

错误原因：该句缺少研究过程和研究者信息，且“but”转折词用法不恰当，语义逻辑弱化了研究发现的因果关系。【偷换概念】

**C 选项** ❌（错误）
> Oaxaca, Mexico, is home to temperate forests containing 74 Orchidaceae species.

错误原因：仅陈述地点和结果，缺少研究者及研究过程，信息不完整，且语气像是事实陈述，而非研究发现。【过度推断】

**D 选项** ❌（错误）
> Arelee Estefanía Muñoz-Hernández and her team wanted to know how many different Orchidaceae species are present in the forests of Oaxaca, Mexico, so they conducted a study to collect orchids.

错误原因：只描述了研究目的和方法，未包含研究结果，未完成“呈现研究及其发现”的任务。【信息不完整】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于抓住题干要求“呈现研究及其发现”，需包含研究者、研究地点、研究方法简述及结果。选项A通过关键词“led by”、“identified”、“74 Orchidaceae species”、“temperate forests of Oaxaca”完整体现了笔记中所有核心信息，且逻辑连贯。转折词“but”或省略结果信息的选项容易导致信息不全或逻辑弱化，需排除。

> Allan Houser was a Chiricahua Warm Springs Apache sculptor, illustrator, and painter.

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于锁定描述“独特风格”的信息，注意题干关键词“distinctive style”与原文中“abstract, modernist forms”对应，选项中需具体体现这种艺术手法，排除泛泛提及或无关影响的信息。理解核心词汇，避免被无关细节或模糊描述干扰，是解题关键。

article:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
In the midst of the US Civil War, Susie Taylor escaped slavery and fled to Union-army-occupied St. Simons Island off the Georgia coast.
She began working for an all-Black army regiment as a nurse and teacher.
In 1902, she published a book about the time she spent with the regiment.
Her book was the only Civil War memoir to be published by a Black woman.
It is still available to readers in print and online.
stem: The student wants to emphasize the uniqueness of Taylor’s accomplishment. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.content: Taylor fled to St. Simons Island, which was then occupied by the Union army, for whom she began working.
After escaping slavery, Taylor began working for an all-Black army regiment as a nurse and teacher.
The book Taylor wrote about the time she spent with the regiment is still available to readers in print and online.
Taylor was the only Black woman to publish a Civil War memoir.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

本题为主旨强调题，核心任务是选出最能突出泰勒成就独特性的选项。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> In the midst of the US Civil War, Susie Taylor escaped slavery and fled to Union-army-occupied St. Simons Island off the Georgia coast.
👉 介绍泰勒逃离奴隶制并抵达联邦军占领区的背景。

**第2句：**
> She began working for an all-Black army regiment as a nurse and teacher.
👉 说明她在军队中的身份和角色。

**第3句：**
> In 1902, she published a book about the time she spent with the regiment.
👉 介绍她出版了关于军队生活的书。

**第4句：**
> Her book was the only Civil War memoir to be published by a Black woman.
👉 强调她的书在身份和题材上的独特性。

**第5句：**
> It is still available to readers in print and online.
👉 说明这本书至今仍然可读，体现其持久影响。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                              |
|:---------|:---------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 描述泰勒逃奴及抵达联邦军占领区       |
| 第二句   | 讲述她在全黑人军团中的护士和教师身份  |
| 第三句   | 她于1902年出版了一本关于军团经历的书   |
| 第四句   | 她的书是唯一由黑人女性发表的内战回忆录 |
| 第五句   | 该书至今仍以纸质和电子形式存在        |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> Taylor fled to St. Simons Island, which was then occupied by the Union army, for whom she began working.
此选项只是描述泰勒逃亡和工作地点，未体现其成就的独特性，属于【以偏概全】。

**B 选项** ❌
> After escaping slavery, Taylor began working for an all-Black army regiment as a nurse and teacher.
描述了她的身份和工作，但未突出她成就的独特性，仍属于【以偏概全】。

**C 选项** ❌
> The book Taylor wrote about the time she spent with the regiment is still available to readers in print and online.
强调书籍的持续可读性，未突出她成就的“唯一性”，是【无中生有】的强调。

**D 选项** ✅
> Taylor was the only Black woman to publish a Civil War memoir.
直接引用“Her book was the only Civil War memoir to be published by a Black woman.”，最有效地强调了成就的独特性。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 题干要求强调“唯一性”，因此需锁定含有“only”“唯一”之类独特性词汇的句子或选项；选项D直接对应原文第四句的关键词，精准切题，排除其他只描述背景或持续性的选项。识别关键词“only”是解题关键。

While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
The melting rate of glaciers varies based on air temperature.
In the warm summer months, massive glaciers on the coast of Greenland melt into the surrounding water.
The melting glaciers contribute to rising sea levels each summer.
Huge icebergs also break off Greenland’s glaciers into the water and melt.
In 2017, geoscientist Twila Moon found that the iceberg melting rate depends not on air temperature but on water temperature.
Because water temperature is consistent, melting icebergs contribute to rising sea levels all year.
stem: The student wants to emphasize a similarity between glaciers and icebergs in Greenland. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.content: Because icebergs break off Greenland’s glaciers into the water, their melting rate depends on water temperature.
Greenland’s glaciers and icebergs both melt during the year, contributing to rising sea levels.
Geoscientist Twila Moon found that the melting rate of Greenland’s icebergs, unlike that of glaciers, does not depend on air temperature.
Glaciers on the coast of Greenland melt during the warm summer months into the surrounding water, the temperature of which remains consistent throughout the year.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

本题为信息整合题，核心任务是从笔记中提取相关信息，找出最有效强调格陵兰岛冰川与冰山相似性的选项。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> The melting rate of glaciers varies based on air temperature.
👉 说明冰川融化速率受空气温度影响（提出观点）。

**第2句：**
> In the warm summer months, massive glaciers on the coast of Greenland melt into the surrounding water.
👉 具体举例说明冰川夏季融化的情况（举例）。

**第3句：**
> The melting glaciers contribute to rising sea levels each summer.
👉 说明冰川融化对海平面上升的因果关系（因果推论）。

**第4句：**
> Huge icebergs also break off Greenland’s glaciers into the water and melt.
👉 说明冰山由冰川断裂而成并融化（补充说明）。

**第5句：**
> In 2017, geoscientist Twila Moon found that the iceberg melting rate depends not on air temperature but on water temperature.
👉 提出冰山融化速率与空气温度无关，而是与水温相关的观点（转折，提出对比）。

**第6句：**
> Because water temperature is consistent, melting icebergs contribute to rising sea levels all year.
👉 说明水温恒定导致冰山全年融化并促使海平面上升（因果推论，补充说明）。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                              |
|:---------|:---------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 冰川融化速率受空气温度影响        |
| 第二句   | 夏季冰川融化到周围水中            |
| 第三句   | 冰川融化每年夏季导致海平面上升    |
| 第四句   | 冰山由冰川断裂形成并融化          |
| 第五句   | 冰山融化速率与水温有关非空气温度  |
| 第六句   | 水温恒定导致冰山全年融化，海平面上升 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> Because icebergs break off Greenland’s glaciers into the water, their melting rate depends on water temperature.
错误原因：选项将“冰山融化速率依赖水温”与“冰山由冰川断裂”错误地因果关联，原文没有说明断裂导致水温依赖，且未强调冰川与冰山的相似性。【过度推断】

**B 选项** ✅
> Greenland’s glaciers and icebergs both melt during the year, contributing to rising sea levels.
正确原因：该选项准确强调冰川和冰山共同点——全年融化并导致海平面上升，吻合第3句和第6句信息，直接体现相似性。

**C 选项** ❌
> Geoscientist Twila Moon found that the melting rate of Greenland’s icebergs, unlike that of glaciers, does not depend on air temperature.
错误原因：该选项强调冰山和冰川的差异，未突出相似性，与题干要求相反。【方向相反】

**D 选项** ❌
> Glaciers on the coast of Greenland melt during the warm summer months into the surrounding water, the temperature of which remains consistent throughout the year.
错误原因：该选项仅描述冰川夏季融化和水温恒定，未涉及冰山，更未强调两者相似性。【信息不全】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关注“强调相似性”，需聚焦笔记中冰川与冰山“都融化并导致海平面上升”的共同点。选项中关键词“both melt during the year”和“contributing to rising sea levels”直接呼应第3句和第6句的因果关系，锁定正确答案B。排除选项时注意区分“相似性”和“差异性”的表述，避免选项C的方向相反陷阱。

---

article:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
Crown shyness is a phenomenon in which the tops (crowns) of neighboring trees grow close together but don't overlap.
To explain how this happens, Australian forester M.R. Jacobs proposes the mutual abrasion theory.
According to Jacobs's theory, when trees brush against one another, branches break off.
Malaysian scholar Francis S.P. Ng posits the mutual shade avoidance theory.
According to Ng's theory, when tree branches detect shade from nearby trees' branches, they stop growing.
stem: The student wants to compare the causes of crown shyness proposed in the two theories. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.content: Ng posits the mutual shade avoidance theory, whereas Jacobs proposes an alternative theory.
Both Jacobs and Ng have proposed theories to explain what causes crown shyness.
While Jacobs proposes that crown shyness is caused by neighboring tree branches brushing against one another, Ng posits that it occurs when branches detect shade from nearby trees' branches.

Jacobs's mutual abrasion theory proposes that when neighboring tree branches brush against one another, branches break off, resulting in a phenomenon in which the tops of trees grow close together but don't overlap.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

本题属于信息对比题，核心任务是比较两种理论对“crown shyness”形成原因的不同解释，选出最有效使用两者相关信息的选项。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Crown shyness is a phenomenon in which the tops (crowns) of neighboring trees grow close together but don't overlap.

👉 定义现象——说明“crown shyness”的含义。

**第2句：**
> To explain how this happens, Australian forester M.R. Jacobs proposes the mutual abrasion theory.

👉 引入Jacobs的理论，解释该现象。

**第3句：**
> According to Jacobs's theory, when trees brush against one another, branches break off.

👉 具体说明Jacobs理论的因果机制。

**第4句：**
> Malaysian scholar Francis S.P. Ng posits the mutual shade avoidance theory.

👉 引入Ng的理论，作为另一种解释。

**第5句：**
> According to Ng's theory, when tree branches detect shade from nearby trees' branches, they stop growing.

👉 具体说明Ng理论的因果机制。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                             |
|:---------|:--------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 定义crown shyness现象            |
| 第二句   | 引入Jacobs的mutual abrasion理论  |
| 第三句   | Jacobs理论的具体机制：树枝摩擦导致断裂 |
| 第四句   | 引入Ng的mutual shade avoidance理论 |
| 第五句   | Ng理论的具体机制：树枝感知遮荫停止生长 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> Ng posits the mutual shade avoidance theory, whereas Jacobs proposes an alternative theory.

错误原因：该选项只提到两者理论名称，未比较两种理论的具体“原因”，信息不充分，未完成题干要求的“比较因果原因”。【过度简化】

**B 选项** ❌
> Both Jacobs and Ng have proposed theories to explain what causes crown shyness.

错误原因：只是泛泛说明两人都提出了解释，没有具体比较两者对“形成原因”的不同解释，信息量不足。【过度简化】

**C 选项** ✅
> While Jacobs proposes that crown shyness is caused by neighboring tree branches brushing against one another, Ng posits that it occurs when branches detect shade from nearby trees' branches.

正确原因：准确比较了两种理论的核心因果机制，明确指出Jacobs强调“树枝摩擦导致断裂”，Ng强调“树枝感知遮荫停止生长”，符合题干要求且信息完整。

**D 选项** ❌
> Jacobs's mutual abrasion theory proposes that when neighboring tree branches brush against one another, branches break off, resulting in a phenomenon in which the tops of trees grow close together but don't overlap.

错误原因：只阐述了Jacobs的理论，没有涉及Ng的观点，未完成“比较两者原因”的任务。【信息缺失】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于识别题干要求“比较两种理论的原因”，需锁定文中两种理论对形成原因的描述（Jacobs强调“摩擦导致断裂”，Ng强调“感知遮荫停止生长”）。选项中只有C项完整且准确地对比了两者的因果机制，其他选项要么信息不足，要么只涉及一方。关键词“while”提示对比关系，帮助判断答案。

article:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
In 2018 researchers Adwait Deshpande, Shreejata Gupta, and Anindya Sinha were observing wild macaques in India's Bandipur National Park.
They saw macaques calling out to and gesturing at humans who were eating or carrying food.
They designed a study to find out if the macaques were intentionally communicating to try to persuade the humans to share their food.
In the study trials, macaques frequently called out to and gestured at humans holding food.
In the study trials, macaques called out to and gestured at empty-handed humans less frequently.
stem: The student wants to present the study's results. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.content: Macaques in the study called out to and gestured more frequently at humans holding food than at empty handed humans.
In 2018, researchers who had observed macaques in India's Bandipur National Park calling out to and gesturing at humans designed a study.
The researchers hoped to find out if the macaques were intentionally communicating to try to persuade humans to share their food.
The researchers studied how macaques behaved around both humans holding food and empty-handed humans.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

这是信息整合题，核心任务是从笔记中提取并准确整合研究结果的信息，明确呈现研究发现的对比和结论。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> In 2018 researchers Adwait Deshpande, Shreejata Gupta, and Anindya Sinha were observing wild macaques in India's Bandipur National Park.

👉 介绍研究背景和时间地点。

**第2句：**
> They saw macaques calling out to and gesturing at humans who were eating or carrying food.

👉 描述观察到的行为现象。

**第3句：**
> They designed a study to find out if the macaques were intentionally communicating to try to persuade the humans to share their food.

👉 说明研究目的。

**第4句：**
> In the study trials, macaques frequently called out to and gestured at humans holding food.

👉 研究结果，描述行为频率较高的情况。

**第5句：**
> In the study trials, macaques called out to and gestured at empty-handed humans less frequently.

👉 研究结果，描述行为频率较低的情况，形成对比。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                   |
|:---------|:-------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍研究时间、研究者和地点             |
| 第二句   | 观察到猴子对携带食物的人类的行为       |
| 第三句   | 研究目的：是否有意交流以获取食物       |
| 第四句   | 研究发现：对持有食物的人类行为频繁     |
| 第五句   | 研究发现：对空手人类行为较少           |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅
> Macaques in the study called out to and gestured more frequently at humans holding food than at empty handed humans.

选项准确总结了研究结果，直接反映了第4句和第5句的信息，体现了对比关系，符合题干“呈现研究结果”的要求。

**B 选项** ❌【无中生有】
> In 2018, researchers who had observed macaques in India's Bandipur National Park calling out to and gesturing at humans designed a study.

选项重点放在研究设计的背景和时间，未体现研究结果，且“calling out and gesturing”在此语境中指的是观察到的现象，不是研究设计的核心内容，偏离题干需求。

**C 选项** ❌【无中生有】
> The researchers hoped to find out if the macaques were intentionally communicating to try to persuade humans to share their food.

选项表达的是研究目的，而非研究结果，不符合题干“呈现研究结果”的要求。

**D 选项** ❌【以偏概全】
> The researchers studied how macaques behaved around both humans holding food and empty-handed humans.

选项只是笼统陈述研究内容，缺乏研究结果的具体信息，未能有效呈现研究发现。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于区分“研究目的”、“研究过程”和“研究结果”，题干要求呈现“研究结果”，需关注笔记中对行为频率的具体对比描述（“frequently…holding food” vs. “less frequently…empty-handed”），选择直接反映这一对比的选项，排除只讲背景或目的的选项。关键词“more frequently”和“less frequently”是锁定答案的核心信号。

article:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
Muckrakers were journalists who sought to expose corruption in US institutions during the Progressive Era (1897–1920).
Ida Tarbell was a muckraker who investigated the Standard Oil Company.
She interviewed Standard Oil Company executives, oil industry workers, and public officials.
She examined thousands of pages of the company’s internal communications, including letters and financial records.
Her book The History of the Standard Oil Company (1904) exposed the company's unfair business practices.
stem: The student wants to emphasize the thoroughness of Ida Tarbell’s investigation of the Standard Oil Company. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.content: Ida Tarbell not only interviewed Standard Oil executives, oil industry workers, and public officials but also examined thousands of pages of the company's internal communications.
As part of her investigation of the Standard Oil Company, muckraker Ida Tarbell conducted interviews.
Published in 1904, muckraker Ida Tarbell’s book The History of the Standard Oil Company exposed the company's unfair business practices.
Ida Tarbell, who investigated the Standard Oil Company, was a muckraker (a journalist who sought to expose corruption in US institutions during the Progressive Era, 1897–1920).

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

本题是细节归纳题，核心任务是从多个笔记中选出最能体现伊达·塔贝尔调查彻底性的选项。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Muckrakers were journalists who sought to expose corruption in US institutions during the Progressive Era (1897–1920).

👉 定义“muckrakers”，说明其背景和使命。

**第2句：**
> Ida Tarbell was a muckraker who investigated the Standard Oil Company.

👉 介绍伊达·塔贝尔身份及其调查对象。

**第3句：**
> She interviewed Standard Oil Company executives, oil industry workers, and public officials.

👉 具体说明她的调查方法之一：采访多方人员。

**第4句：**
> She examined thousands of pages of the company’s internal communications, including letters and financial records.

👉 进一步补充调查手段，强调查阅大量内部文件，体现调查深度。

**第5句：**
> Her book *The History of the Standard Oil Company* (1904) exposed the company's unfair business practices.

👉 说明调查结果及其影响。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 介绍muckrakers及其目标 |
| 第二句 | 介绍Ida Tarbell身份及调查对象 |
| 第三句 | 描述采访调查方法 |
| 第四句 | 描述查阅大量内部文件，突出调查深入 |
| 第五句 | 说明调查成果及影响 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅
> Ida Tarbell not only interviewed Standard Oil executives, oil industry workers, and public officials but also examined thousands of pages of the company's internal communications.

此选项准确结合了第3句和第4句内容，强调了多样的调查手段和调查的广度与深度，最有效地体现了调查的彻底性。

**B 选项** ❌ 【以偏概全】
> As part of her investigation of the Standard Oil Company, muckraker Ida Tarbell conducted interviews.

只提到采访，忽略了查阅大量内部文件这一重要信息，未能全面体现调查的彻底性。

**C 选项** ❌ 【无中生有】
> Published in 1904, muckraker Ida Tarbell’s book *The History of the Standard Oil Company* exposed the company's unfair business practices.

该选项强调的是调查结果而非调查过程的彻底性，偏离题目要求。

**D 选项** ❌ 【方向相反】
> Ida Tarbell, who investigated the Standard Oil Company, was a muckraker (a journalist who sought to expose corruption in US institutions during the Progressive Era, 1897–1920).

该选项主要介绍身份背景信息，没有突出调查的细致程度，与题目要求不符。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于锁定“调查的彻底性”，应关注描写调查细节和范围的句子（第3、4句），尤其是包含多种调查手段的信息。选项中包含多维度调查方法且内容全面的最符合题意，排除只强调一方面或偏离调查细节的选项。转折词“not only... but also...”是强调彻底性的强信号。

article:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
In 2013, archaeologists studied cat bone fragments they had found in the ruins of Quanhucun, a Chinese farming village.
The fragments were estimated to be 5,300 years old.
A chemical analysis of the fragments revealed that the cats had consumed large amounts of grain.
The grain consumption is evidence that the Quanhucun cats may have been domesticated.
stem: The student wants to present the Quanhucun study and its conclusions. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.content: As part of a 2013 study of cat domestication, a chemical analysis was conducted on cat bone fragments found in Quanhucun, China.
A 2013 analysis of cat bone fragments found in Quanhucun, China, suggests that cats there may have been domesticated 5,300 years ago.
In 2013, archaeologists studied what cats in Quanhucun, China, had eaten more than 5,000 years ago.
Cat bone fragments estimated to be 5,300 years old were found in Quanhucun, China, in 2013.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

本题为信息整合与表达题，核心任务是从学生笔记中筛选并有效整合关键信息，准确且简洁地呈现研究内容及结论。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> In 2013, archaeologists studied cat bone fragments they had found in the ruins of Quanhucun, a Chinese farming village.

👉 介绍研究背景和对象（时间、研究者、研究对象、地点）

**第2句：**
> The fragments were estimated to be 5,300 years old.

👉 提供研究对象的时间背景

**第3句：**
> A chemical analysis of the fragments revealed that the cats had consumed large amounts of grain.

👉 说明研究方法及关键发现

**第4句：**
> The grain consumption is evidence that the Quanhucun cats may have been domesticated.

👉 通过发现提出研究结论

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                     |
|:---------|:----------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍2013年考古学家对中国Quanhucun村猫骨碎片的研究 |
| 第二句   | 猫骨碎片的年代估计为5300年前                 |
| 第三句   | 化学分析显示猫吃了大量谷物                      |
| 第四句   | 猫食用谷物是猫可能被驯化的证据                   |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> As part of a 2013 study of cat domestication, a chemical analysis was conducted on cat bone fragments found in Quanhucun, China.

错误原因：选项暗示研究的主题是“猫的驯化”，而原文说明考古学家研究的是猫骨碎片，驯化是根据分析结果推测的结论，非研究出发点。【偷换概念】

**B 选项** ✅
> A 2013 analysis of cat bone fragments found in Quanhucun, China, suggests that cats there may have been domesticated 5,300 years ago.

正确原因：选项完整包含时间（2013年）、研究对象（猫骨碎片）、地点（Quanhucun）、年代（5300年前），并且准确表达了结论（猫可能被驯化），符合原文信息且结构清晰。

**C 选项** ❌
> In 2013, archaeologists studied what cats in Quanhucun, China, had eaten more than 5,000 years ago.

错误原因：该选项只提到“研究猫的食物”，未提及研究对象为骨碎片，也未表达研究结论，信息不完整。【以偏概全】

**D 选项** ❌
> Cat bone fragments estimated to be 5,300 years old were found in Quanhucun, China, in 2013.

错误原因：该选项只陈述了发现的事实，缺少研究行为和结论，未体现研究意义。【以偏概全】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于识别并整合笔记中“时间+地点+研究对象+研究方法+结论”五大要素，注意区分“研究过程”和“研究结论”，避免偷换概念或信息缺失，选项中关键短语如“suggests that cats may have been domesticated”直接对应结论，帮助锁定正确答案。

article:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
Cities tend to have a wide range of flowering vegetation in parks, yards, and gardens.
This vegetation provides a varied diet for honeybees, strengthening bees’ immune systems.
On average, 62.5 percent of bees in an urban area will survive a harsh winter.
Rural areas are often dominated by monoculture crops such as corn or wheat.
On average, only 40 percent of honeybees in a rural area will survive a harsh winter.
stem: The student wants to make and support a generalization about honeybees. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.content: Cities tend to have a wider range of flowering vegetation than do rural areas, which are often dominated by monoculture crops.
In urban areas, over 60 percent of honeybees, on average, will survive a harsh winter, whereas in rural areas, only 40 percent will.
The strength of honeybees’ immune systems depends on what the bees eat, and a varied diet is more available to bees in an urban area than to those in a rural area.
Honeybees are more likely to thrive in cities than in rural areas because the varied diet available in urban areas strengthens the bees’ immune systems.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

本题是归纳总结题，核心任务是根据笔记内容提炼一个总括性结论，并用相关信息支持该结论。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Cities tend to have a wide range of flowering vegetation in parks, yards, and gardens.

👉 说明城市中植物多样性较高，提出背景事实。

**第2句：**
> This vegetation provides a varied diet for honeybees, strengthening bees’ immune systems.

👉 解释城市植物多样性对蜜蜂免疫系统的积极影响，因果关系。

**第3句：**
> On average, 62.5 percent of bees in an urban area will survive a harsh winter.

👉 给出城市蜜蜂生存率数据，事实陈述。

**第4句：**
> Rural areas are often dominated by monoculture crops such as corn or wheat.

👉 描述农村地区植物单一的现象，背景事实。

**第5句：**
> On average, only 40 percent of honeybees in a rural area will survive a harsh winter.

👉 给出农村蜜蜂生存率数据，事实陈述。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                             |
|:---------|:--------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 说明城市植物多样性较高           |
| 第二句   | 解释多样化植物对蜜蜂免疫力的益处 |
| 第三句   | 城市蜜蜂冬季生存率数据           |
| 第四句   | 农村地区以单一作物为主           |
| 第五句   | 农村蜜蜂冬季生存率数据           |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> Cities tend to have a wider range of flowering vegetation than do rural areas, which are often dominated by monoculture crops.

错误原因：虽然正确反映了植物多样性差异，但只是陈述事实，没有形成关于蜜蜂生存的总体概括，缺乏“归纳总结”性质。【以偏概全】

**B 选项** ❌
> In urban areas, over 60 percent of honeybees, on average, will survive a harsh winter, whereas in rural areas, only 40 percent will.

错误原因：仅仅对比了生存率数据，没有解释原因，也未形成一般性结论，信息不够全面。【以偏概全】

**C 选项** ❌
> The strength of honeybees’ immune systems depends on what the bees eat, and a varied diet is more available to bees in an urban area than to those in a rural area.

错误原因：虽然指出了免疫力依赖饮食多样性，但未涉及生存率数据，缺少关于蜜蜂整体生存状况的概括。【以偏概全】

**D 选项** ✅
> Honeybees are more likely to thrive in cities than in rural areas because the varied diet available in urban areas strengthens the bees’ immune systems.

正确原因：准确总结了笔记中的因果关系和生存差异，结合了植物多样性、免疫力和生存率，形成了完整且有说服力的总括性结论。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于寻找整合因果关系（多样饮食→免疫力增强）和结果（城市蜜蜂生存率更高）的选项。题干要求“归纳总结”，故必须包含原因与结果，且体现“一般化”观点。选项中只有D选项完整体现了笔记的因果链条及结论，其他选项要么只陈述事实，要么缺少归纳，因而被排除。注意区分“事实陈述”和“因果总结”是答题关键。

article:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
John Carver was one of the 41 signatories of the Mayflower Compact.
The Mayflower Compact was a legal agreement among the pilgrims that immigrated to Plymouth Colony.
It was created in 1620 to establish a common government.
It states that the pilgrims who signed it wanted to “plant the first colony in the northern parts of Virginia” under King James.
Carver became the first governor of Plymouth Colony.
stem: The student wants to specify the reason the Mayflower Compact was created. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.content: Stating that its signatories wanted to “plant the first colony in the northern parts of Virginia,” the Mayflower Compact was a legal agreement among the pilgrims that immigrated to Plymouth Colony.
Created in 1620, the Mayflower Compact states that the pilgrims wanted to “plant the first colony in the northern parts of Virginia.”
The Mayflower Compact was created to establish a common government among the pilgrims that immigrated to Plymouth Colony.
The Mayflower Compact had 41 signatories, including John Carver, the first governor of Plymouth Colony.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

本题为细节归纳题，核心任务是从笔记中提取并准确表达“Mayflower Compact 被创建的原因”。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> John Carver was one of the 41 signatories of the Mayflower Compact.

👉 说明Carver是Mayflower Compact的签署者之一，提供背景信息。

**第2句：**
> The Mayflower Compact was a legal agreement among the pilgrims that immigrated to Plymouth Colony.

👉 说明Mayflower Compact的性质和签署者身份。

**第3句：**
> It was created in 1620 to establish a common government.

👉 直接说明创建Mayflower Compact的原因。

**第4句：**
> It states that the pilgrims who signed it wanted to “plant the first colony in the northern parts of Virginia” under King James.

👉 说明协议中签署者的愿望和目标。

**第5句：**
> Carver became the first governor of Plymouth Colony.

👉 介绍Carver后续身份，补充人物信息。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                             |
|:---------|:--------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍Carver是Mayflower Compact的签署者之一 |
| 第二句   | 说明Mayflower Compact是一个法律协议        |
| 第三句   | 说明Mayflower Compact创建的原因：建立共同政府 |
| 第四句   | 说明协议内容：签署者想建立殖民地           |
| 第五句   | 介绍Carver成为殖民地第一任州长            |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌【方向相反】
> Stating that its signatories wanted to “plant the first colony in the northern parts of Virginia,” the Mayflower Compact was a legal agreement among the pilgrims that immigrated to Plymouth Colony.

错误在于将“签署者想建立殖民地”作为创建协议的原因，而实际上创建的目的是“建立共同政府”（第3句明确指出），这里信息顺序颠倒，原因和内容混淆。

**B 选项** ❌【以偏概全】
> Created in 1620, the Mayflower Compact states that the pilgrims wanted to “plant the first colony in the northern parts of Virginia.”

该选项只提到协议的内容（“建立殖民地”），未提及创建的真正原因“建立共同政府”，信息不完整。

**C 选项** ✅
> The Mayflower Compact was created to establish a common government among the pilgrims that immigrated to Plymouth Colony.

准确提炼了第3句的核心信息，明确指出了“创建目的”，符合题意要求。

**D 选项** ❌【无中生有】
> The Mayflower Compact had 41 signatories, including John Carver, the first governor of Plymouth Colony.

该选项信息虽正确，但与题干“说明创建原因”无关，偏离题意。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 题干关键词“specify the reason the Mayflower Compact was created”直接指向文章中明确说明原因的句子（第3句，含因果关系词“to establish”），通过定位因果关系的表达锁定正确答案，排除仅描述内容或无关信息的选项。选项中若混淆内容与原因，或未涉及原因即为错误。

article:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
Jordan Bennett is a Mi’kmaq visual artist.
The Mi’kmaq are a First Nations people in North America.
Bennett’s paintings pay homage to traditional Mi’kmaq craftsmanship and have been displayed in over 75 exhibitions.
His 2017 exhibition Wije’wi was held at the Grenfell Art Gallery.
His 2018 exhibition Ketu’elmita’jik was held at the Art Gallery of Nova Scotia.
stem: The student wants to emphasize the order in which two of Jordan Bennett’s exhibitions were held. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.content: Jordan Bennett’s 2017 exhibition Wije’wi was followed a year later by his exhibition Ketu’elmita’jik.
Jordan Bennett’s paintings, some of which appeared in 2017 and 2018 exhibitions, pay homage to traditional Mi’kmaq craftsmanship.
Mi’kmaq visual artist Jordan Bennett has displayed his work in over 75 exhibitions, including Wije’wi and Ketu’elmita’jik.
Jordan Bennett’s 2018 exhibition Ketu’elmita’jik was held at the Art Gallery of Nova Scotia; another was held at the Grenfell Art Gallery.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

本题是信息排序题，核心任务是用恰当的语言准确表达两个展览举办的时间顺序。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Jordan Bennett is a Mi’kmaq visual artist.

👉 介绍主体人物和身份。

**第2句：**
> The Mi’kmaq are a First Nations people in North America.

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅

**B 选项** ❌【无中生有】

While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
Scientists have long sought to determine the origin of glass in Chile’s Atacama Desert.
A 2017 study concluded that ancient grass fires had melted the area’s sandy soil into glass.
In 2021, a different study revealed that the mineral signatures of glass samples were consistent with the mineral signatures of comet samples collected by NASA.
That study concluded that the glass had formed as a result of a cometary explosion close to the desert’s surface.
stem: The student wants to describe how scientific understanding about the glass’s origin has evolved. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.content: Scientists have long sought to determine the origin of the glass, with one study concluding that it formed when ancient grass fires melted the area’s sandy soil.
Studies in 2017 and 2021 offered different explanations for the origin of the glass.
Mineral signatures of glass samples are consistent with those of comet samples collected by NASA, according to new research.
A 2017 study concluded that ancient grass fires had caused the glass’s formation, but new research suggests that the glass formed as a result of a cometary explosion close to the desert’s surface.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

本题为信息整合与文章总结题，核心任务是用笔记中的信息准确且连贯地描述科学认识的发展变化过程。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Scientists have long sought to determine the origin of glass in Chile’s Atacama Desert.

👉 介绍背景和研究主题，指出科学家长期关注玻璃的起源。

**第2句：**
> A 2017 study concluded that ancient grass fires had melted the area’s sandy soil into glass.

👉 介绍2017年的研究结论，提出玻璃起源于古代草火融化沙土的观点。

**第3句：**
> In 2021, a different study revealed that the mineral signatures of glass samples were consistent with the mineral signatures of comet samples collected by NASA.

👉 介绍2021年另一项研究，指出玻璃的矿物特征与NASA采集的彗星样本一致。

**第4句：**
> That study concluded that the glass had formed as a result of a cometary explosion close to the desert’s surface.

👉 说明2021年研究的结论，认为玻璃由彗星爆炸形成。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容及逻辑功能 |
|:---------|:---------------|
| 第一句 | 介绍研究背景，提出科学家长期探索玻璃起源的问题 |
| 第二句 | 说明2017年研究结论，草火融化沙土形成玻璃 |
| 第三句 | 说明2021年研究发现玻璃矿物特征与彗星样本相符 |
| 第四句 | 说明2021年研究结论，玻璃由彗星爆炸形成 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> Scientists have long sought to determine the origin of the glass, with one study concluding that it formed when ancient grass fires melted the area’s sandy soil.

错误原因：只提到了2017年关于草火的观点，未体现科学认识的演变过程，缺少2021年新研究的对比信息。
错误类型：【以偏概全】

**B 选项** ❌
> Studies in 2017 and 2021 offered different explanations for the origin of the glass.

错误原因：表述过于笼统，没有具体说明两项研究的具体结论，信息不完整，缺乏细节支持。
错误类型：【过度推断】

**C 选项** ❌
> Mineral signatures of glass samples are consistent with those of comet samples collected by NASA, according to new research.

错误原因：仅陈述了2021年研究的部分内容，没有涉及2017年的旧观点，未体现科学认识的演变。
错误类型：【以偏概全】

**D 选项** ✅
> A 2017 study concluded that ancient grass fires had caused the glass’s formation, but new research suggests that the glass formed as a result of a cometary explosion close to the desert’s surface.

正确原因：完整且连贯地呈现了两项研究的结论及其时间顺序，体现了科学认识的变化过程，与原文内容完全对应。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于识别题干要求“描述科学认识的演变”，需同时包含旧观点和新观点及其关系。选项中时间顺序词（如“2017 study”、“new research”、“but”）是锁定正确答案的核心信号词；缺少某一研究或未体现对比关系的选项即为错误。通过对比两项研究的结论，明确认识的变化，是解题的关键。

stem: The student wants to introduce the scientist and her field of study to a new audience. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.content: Located in Brazil, the Amazon Reef is one of the largest known coral reefs in the world.
Marine biologist Camille Jazmin Gaynus studies coral reefs, vital underwater ecosystems that provide homes to 25% of all marine species.
Providing homes to 25% of all marine species, including up to 8,000 species of fish, coral reefs are vital underwater ecosystems and thus of great interest to marine biologists.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

本题为信息整合题，核心任务是从笔记中筛选并有效整合相关信息，准确介绍科学家及其研究领域。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Marine biologist Camille Jazmin Gaynus studies coral reefs.
👉 提出观点，介绍科学家及其研究领域。

**第2句：**
> Coral reefs are vital underwater ecosystems that provide habitats to 25% of all marine species.
👉 解释原因，说明珊瑚礁的重要性及生态功能。

**第3句：**
> Reefs can include up to 8,000 species of fish, such as toadfish, seahorses, and clown triggerfish.
👉 举例，具体说明珊瑚礁的物种多样性。

**第4句：**
> The Amazon Reef is a coral reef in Brazil.
👉 提出观点，介绍特定珊瑚礁实例。

**第5句：**
> It is one of the largest known reefs in the world.
👉 进一步说明，强调亚马逊珊瑚礁的规模。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                                         |
|:---------|:-------------------------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍科学家 Camille Jazmin Gaynus 及其研究珊瑚礁的领域。      |
| 第二句   | 说明珊瑚礁作为生态系统的重要性及其为25%海洋物种提供栖息地。  |
| 第三句   | 举例说明珊瑚礁包含多达8000种鱼类。                          |
| 第四句   | 引入亚马逊珊瑚礁作为具体实例。                               |
| 第五句   | 强调亚马逊珊瑚礁是世界上最大的珊瑚礁之一。                   |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> Located in Brazil, the Amazon Reef is one of the largest known coral reefs in the world.
错误原因：此选项只介绍了亚马逊珊瑚礁，未涉及科学家及其研究领域，偏离题干“介绍科学家及其研究领域”的核心要求。【无中生有】

**B 选项** ✅
> Marine biologist Camille Jazmin Gaynus studies coral reefs, vital underwater ecosystems that provide homes to 25% of all marine species.
正确原因：有效整合了科学家介绍和珊瑚礁的重要性，紧扣题干目标，信息相关且准确。

**C 选项** ❌
> Providing homes to 25% of all marine species, including up to 8,000 species of fish, coral reefs are vital underwater ecosystems and thus of great interest to marine biologists.
错误原因：虽然介绍了珊瑚礁及其吸引海洋生物学家的原因，但未直接介绍科学家 Camille Jazmin Gaynus，不符合题干要求。【以偏概全】

**D 选项** ❌
> As Camille Jazmin Gaynus knows well, coral reefs are vital underwater ecosystems, providing homes to thousands of species of fish.
错误原因：表达较为含糊，未明确介绍她的职业身份和研究领域，且“thousands of species of fish”不如笔记中“25% of all marine species”信息准确完整。【信息不全】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题核心在于抓住题干关键词“introduce the scientist and her field of study”，选项必须同时包含科学家身份和研究内容；利用笔记中第一句和第二句的关键信息（科学家职业 + 研究对象和生态重要性）来锁定正确答案B；排除选项主要看是否缺失科学家介绍或偏离主题。

**C 选项** ❌

> *The Ramayana* is an epic poem that features the character Kaikeyi.

错误原因：该选项只提及史诗和Kaikeyi角色，没有突出小说的叙述视角，不符合题干“强调小说视角”的要求。【无中生有】

**B 选项** ✅
> *Kaikeyi* is a retelling of *The Ramayana* from the character Kaikeyi's point of view.

正确原因：准确表述了小说《Kaikeyi》是从Kaikeyi视角重新叙述史诗，完全符合题干要求，且直接引用了笔记第4句信息。

**C 选项** ❌
> Vaishnavi Patel often portrays the character as heroic.

错误原因：该选项强调作者和角色形象，但没有明确小说叙述视角，且“often”描述的是形象而非视角。【方向相反】

**D 选项** ❌
> From the point of view of *The Ramayana*, the character Kaikeyi is often a villain.

错误原因：该选项错误地将视角归于史诗《罗摩衍那》，而非小说，且与题干强调“小说视角”不符。【偷换概念】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于锁定题干“强调小说视角”这一信息，笔记中“novel... from Kaikeyi's point of view”是唯一直接表述视角的句子，选项中必须体现这一点才能选对。排除无关史诗信息或只谈形象的选项，注意区分史诗与小说的不同视角表述。

---

article:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
In 2020, theater students at Radford and Virginia Tech chose an interactive, online format to present a play about woman suffrage activists.
Their "Women and the Vote" website featured an interactive digital drawing of a Victorian-style house.
Audiences were asked to focus on a room of their choice and select from that room an artifact related to the suffrage movement.
One click took them to video clips, songs, artwork, and texts associated with the artifact.
The play was popular with audiences because the format allowed them to control the experience.
stem: The student wants to explain an advantage of the "Women and the Vote" format. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.content: "Women and the Vote" featured a drawing of a Victorian-style house with several rooms, each containing suffrage artifacts.
To access video clips, songs, artwork, and texts, audiences had to first click on an artifact.
The "Women and the Vote" format appealed to audiences because it allowed them to control the experience.
Using an interactive format, theater students at Radford and Virginia Tech created "Women and the Vote," a play about woman suffrage activists.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

本题为细节理解题，核心任务是从笔记中找出最能说明“Women and the Vote”互动形式优势的信息。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> In 2020, theater students at Radford and Virginia Tech chose an interactive, online format to present a play about woman suffrage activists.

👉 介绍背景及采用的创新互动线上形式。

**第2句：**
> Their "Women and the Vote" website featured an interactive digital drawing of a Victorian-style house.

👉 说明互动形式的具体表现——网站和数字绘图。

**第3句：**
> Audiences were asked to focus on a room of their choice and select from that room an artifact related to the suffrage movement.

👉 解释用户如何参与互动，选择感兴趣的内容。

**第4句：**
> One click took them to video clips, songs, artwork, and texts associated with the artifact.

👉 描述互动的具体操作和内容展示方式。

**第5句：**
> The play was popular with audiences because the format allowed them to control the experience.

👉 说明互动形式的优势及其带来的受欢迎原因。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                             |
|:---------|:--------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍2020年学生选用互动线上形式演出女权题材剧 |
| 第二句   | 描述互动网站及数字绘图的场景设计           |
| 第三句   | 说明观众可以选择房间及相关历史物品参与互动   |
| 第四句   | 讲述点击物品后可获得多媒体资料             |
| 第五句   | 指出该格式受欢迎的原因是观众能掌控体验       |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> "Women and the Vote" featured a drawing of a Victorian-style house with several rooms, each containing suffrage artifacts.

错误原因：虽然描述了网站设计细节，但未说明这种设计的优势或好处。缺乏解释互动形式的“优势”这一题干核心要求。【以偏概全】

**B 选项** ❌
> To access video clips, songs, artwork, and texts, audiences had to first click on an artifact.

错误原因：只是描述了操作步骤，未涉及互动形式的优势或受欢迎原因，信息无助于回答题干。【以偏概全】

**C 选项** ✅
> The "Women and the Vote" format appealed to audiences because it allowed them to control the experience.

正确原因：直接引用了第五句“...because the format allowed them to control the experience”，明确指出了互动形式的优势和受欢迎的原因，切中题意。

**D 选项** ❌
> Using an interactive format, theater students at Radford and Virginia Tech created "Women and the Vote," a play about woman suffrage activists.

错误原因：只是背景介绍，没有说明互动形式的优势，未满足题干要求。【以偏概全】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关注“优势”的表达，关键在于捕捉因果关系词“because”和表原因的句子。第五句明确指出“...because the format allowed them to control the experience”，直接说明互动形式的优势，锁定正确选项C。其余选项均为描述细节或背景，未体现“优势”，因此被排除。注意区分细节描述与观点优势的区别。

article:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
Bharati Mukherjee was an Indian-born author of novels and short stories.
She published the novel The Holder of the World in 1993.
A central character in the novel is a woman living in twentieth-century United States.
Another central character is a woman living in seventeenth-century India.
stem: The student wants to introduce the novel The Holder of the World to an audience already familiar with Bharati Mukherjee. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.content: Bharati Mukherjee's settings include both twentieth-century United States and seventeenth-century India.
In addition to her novel The Holder of the World, which was published in 1993, Indian-born author Bharati Mukherjee wrote other novels and short stories.
Bharati Mukherjee's novel The Holder of the World centers around two women, one living in twentieth-century United States and the other in seventeenth-century India.
The Holder of the World was not the only novel written by Indian-born author Bharati Mukherjee.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

本题为信息整合题，核心任务是从学生笔记中筛选并整合最相关的信息，有效介绍小说《The Holder of the World》。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Bharati Mukherjee was an Indian-born author of novels and short stories.

👉 提供作者身份背景信息。

**第2句：**
> She published the novel *The Holder of the World* in 1993.

👉 说明小说的出版时间和作品名称。

**第3句：**
> A central character in the novel is a woman living in twentieth-century United States.

👉 描述小说中的一个主要人物和其背景。

**第4句：**
> Another central character is a woman living in seventeenth-century India.

👉 描述小说中另一主要人物及其背景。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                                         |
|:---------|:------------------------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 作者身份：印度出生的小说及短篇小说作家                      |
| 第二句   | 小说《The Holder of the World》出版于1993年                |
| 第三句   | 小说中一位主要人物是生活在20世纪美国的女性                 |
| 第四句   | 小说中另一主要人物是生活在17世纪印度的女性                 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> Bharati Mukherjee's settings include both twentieth-century United States and seventeenth-century India.

此选项只提到了小说的背景设定，没有明确指出是在《The Holder of the World》这部小说中，且未强调主要人物，信息不够具体完整。【过度推断】

**B 选项** ❌
> In addition to her novel *The Holder of the World*, which was published in 1993, Indian-born author Bharati Mukherjee wrote other novels and short stories.

此选项强调作者其他作品，但题目要求介绍《The Holder of the World》相关信息，重点偏离了题干要求。【方向相反】

**C 选项** ✅
> Bharati Mukherjee's novel *The Holder of the World* centers around two women, one living in twentieth-century United States and the other in seventeenth-century India.

此选项准确整合了小说名称、主要人物及其背景，信息完整且聚焦，直接对应笔记第2、3、4句内容，最有效地介绍了该小说。

**D 选项** ❌
> *The Holder of the World* was not the only novel written by Indian-born author Bharati Mukherjee.

此选项强调作者写过多部小说，但没有介绍该小说本身，未符合题目要求。【方向相反】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 题干要求“介绍小说《The Holder of the World》”，需聚焦该小说的关键信息。选项中出现的关键信号词有“centers around two women”“twentieth-century United States”“seventeenth-century India”，对应笔记中关于小说人物和背景的描述，锁定正确答案。选项若偏离小说内容或强调作者其他信息即可排除。

article:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
In 2019, Emily Shepard and colleagues in the UK and Germany studied the effect of wind on auks' success in landing at cliffside nesting sites.
They found as wind conditions intensified, the birds needed more attempts in order to make a successful landing.
When the wind was still, almost 100% of landing attempts were successful.
In a strong breeze, approximately 40% of attempts were successful.
In near-gale conditions, only around 20% of attempts were successful.
stem: The student wants to summarize the study. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.content: For a 2019 study, researchers from the UK and Germany collected data on auks' attempts to land at cliffside nesting sites in different wind conditions.
Emily Shepard and her colleagues wanted to know the extent to which wind affected auks' success in landing at cliffside nesting sites, so they conducted a study.
Knowing that auks often need multiple attempts to land at their cliffside nesting sites, Emily Shepard studied the birds' success rate, which was only around 20% in some conditions.
Emily Shepard's 2019 study of auks' success in landing at cliffside nesting sites showed that as wind conditions intensified, the birds' success rate decreased.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

本题是主旨总结题，核心任务是从学生笔记中提取关键信息，准确且简洁地总结研究内容，避免遗漏或歪曲事实。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> In 2019, Emily Shepard and colleagues in the UK and Germany studied the effect of wind on auks' success in landing at cliffside nesting sites.

👉 介绍研究背景和目的。

**第2句：**
> They found as wind conditions intensified, the birds needed more attempts in order to make a successful landing.

👉 说明研究发现的核心趋势——风力加大导致着陆难度增加。

**第3句：**
> When the wind was still, almost 100% of landing attempts were successful.

👉 举例说明无风时几乎100%成功率。

**第4句：**
> In a strong breeze, approximately 40% of attempts were successful.

👉 举例说明强风时成功率下降到40%。

**第5句：**
> In near-gale conditions, only around 20% of attempts were successful.

👉 举例说明近风暴状态下成功率进一步下降至20%。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                                     |
|:---------|:---------------------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍2019年英国和德国研究者研究风对海雀着陆成功率的影响     |
| 第二句   | 研究发现风力增强使鸟类需要更多尝试才能成功着陆             |
| 第三句   | 无风时着陆成功率接近100%                                  |
| 第四句   | 强风时成功率约为40%                                       |
| 第五句   | 近风暴时成功率约为20%                                     |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> For a 2019 study, researchers from the UK and Germany collected data on auks' attempts to land at cliffside nesting sites in different wind conditions.

错误原因：该选项仅描述了研究的背景和数据收集，没有总结研究结果，缺少风力对成功率影响的核心发现。【以偏概全】

**B 选项** ❌
> Emily Shepard and her colleagues wanted to know the extent to which wind affected auks' success in landing at cliffside nesting sites, so they conducted a study.

错误原因：该选项只描述了研究的动机和行动，没有提及研究结果，未完成总结任务。【以偏概全】

**C 选项** ❌
> Knowing that auks often need multiple attempts to land at their cliffside nesting sites, Emily Shepard studied the birds' success rate, which was only around 20% in some conditions.

错误原因：错误强调了“海雀通常需要多次尝试”这一未在笔记中出现的前提，且片面提及最低成功率20%，忽略了其他风速条件的成功率差异。【无中生有】【以偏概全】

**D 选项** ✅
> Emily Shepard's 2019 study of auks' success in landing at cliffside nesting sites showed that as wind conditions intensified, the birds' success rate decreased.

正确原因：准确总结了研究者、时间、研究对象以及核心发现——风力增强导致成功率下降，符合笔记所有关键信息，且表达简洁完整。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题核心在于关注题干“总结研究”的要求，重点提取研究背景和最重要的结论。注意选项中是否包含研究结果，且避免因补充笔记中未提及信息而误选。关键词如“showed that”、“as wind conditions intensified”和“success rate decreased”直接对应原文逻辑，能有效锁定正确答案D，同时排除缺失结果或添油加醋的错误选项。

article:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
The Heartbeat of Wounded Knee: Native America from 1890 to the Present is a history book by Ojibwe author David Treuer.
In a review, a critic for The Economist noted that “Treuer’s storytelling skills shine” and that the book is an “elegant handling of [a] complex narrative.”
A critic for O, The Oprah Magazine called it “a marvel of research and storytelling.”
A critic for the Missoulian dubbed it “a monumental achievement.”
stem: The student wants to emphasize a similarity in how critics responded to Treuer’s book. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.content: Treuer’s book, which was widely reviewed, focuses on Native American history from 1890 to the present.
Dubbed “a monumental achievement” by the Missoulian, Treuer’s book documents over a century of Native American history.

Critics praised Treuer’s book for its compelling narrative, with O, The Oprah Magazine calling it “a marvel of research and storytelling” and The Economist likewise writing that “Treuer’s storytelling skills shine” and that the book is an “elegant handling of [a] complex narrative.”
While the Missoulian focused on the book’s broader achievement, The Economist zeroed in on Treuer’s storytelling skills.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

这是一道细节归纳题，考查如何准确总结并强调不同评论者对同一书籍的共同评价。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> The Heartbeat of Wounded Knee: Native America from 1890 to the Present is a history book by Ojibwe author David Treuer.

👉 介绍书名、作者及主题，提供背景信息。

**第2句：**
> In a review, a critic for The Economist noted that “Treuer’s storytelling skills shine” and that the book is an “elegant handling of [a] complex narrative.”

👉 引用The Economist的评价，强调书的叙述技巧和复杂叙事的优雅处理。

**第3句：**
> A critic for O, The Oprah Magazine called it “a marvel of research and storytelling.”

👉 引用O, The Oprah Magazine的评价，称赞研究和叙事的精彩。

**第4句：**
> A critic for the Missoulian dubbed it “a monumental achievement.”

👉 引用Missoulian的评价，强调书籍的重大成就。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                                         |
|:---------|:-------------------------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍书名、作者及主题                                         |
| 第二句   | The Economist评价书的叙述技巧和复杂叙事的优雅处理           |
| 第三句   | O, The Oprah Magazine称赞研究和叙事                         |
| 第四句   | Missoulian称书为“重大成就”                                 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌【无中生有】
> Treuer’s book, which was widely reviewed, focuses on Native American history from 1890 to the present.

该选项强调书被广泛评论和历史主题，但没有体现“评论者对书的相似回应”，偏离题干“强调评论相似性”的核心任务。

**B 选项** ❌【无中生有】
> Dubbed “a monumental achievement” by the Missoulian, Treuer’s book documents over a century of Native American history.

该选项只引用了Missoulian的评价，且重点放在时间跨度和书的内容，没有体现多个评论者评价的相似性。

**C 选项** ✅
> Critics praised Treuer’s book for its compelling narrative, with O, The Oprah Magazine calling it “a marvel of research and storytelling” and The Economist likewise writing that “Treuer’s storytelling skills shine” and that the book is an “elegant handling of [a] complex narrative.”

该选项准确抓住了题干“强调评论者相似回应”的要求，引用了两条评论中都提到的“叙事/讲故事技巧”，体现评论者的共同点。

**D 选项** ❌【方向相反】
> While the Missoulian focused on the book’s broader achievement, The Economist zeroed in on Treuer’s storytelling skills.

该选项强调评论者评价的差异，而非相似之处，违背了题干“强调相似性”的目的。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于锁定题干中的“强调评论相似性”这一要求，关注各评论中共同出现的关键词“storytelling”、“narrative”等，排除只强调差异或书本内容的选项，优先选择整合多条评论相似评价的选项。转折词“while”在D选项中暗示对比，提示其不符合“强调相似性”的要求。

article:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
Some animals have evolved to physically resemble another animal, plant, or object.
This is known as mimicry.
Crab spiders mimic the appearance of flowers.
This helps crab spiders ambush their prey.
Katydids mimic the appearance of leaves.
This helps katydids hide from their predators.
stem: The student wants to emphasize a difference in how katydids and crab spiders use mimicry. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.content: Katydids mimic the appearance of flowers, and crab spiders mimic that of leaves.
Katydids and crab spiders are two examples of animals that use mimicry.
Unlike crab spiders, which use mimicry to ambush prey, katydids use mimicry to hide from predators.
Animals that use mimicry have evolved to resemble another animal, plant, or object.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

本题为细节对比题，核心任务是准确区分文中关于katydids和crab spiders模仿行为的不同用途，并用恰当信息表达这一差异。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Some animals have evolved to physically resemble another animal, plant, or object.

👉 提出主题：某些动物进化出模仿其他生物或物体的外貌。

**第2句：**
> This is known as mimicry.

👉 定义说明：介绍“mimicry”（拟态）的概念。

**第3句：**
> Crab spiders mimic the appearance of flowers.

👉 举例说明：螃蟹蜘蛛模仿花朵外观。

**第4句：**
> This helps crab spiders ambush their prey.

👉 解释原因：拟态帮助螃蟹蜘蛛伏击猎物。

**第5句：**
> Katydids mimic the appearance of leaves.

👉 举例说明：蝈蝈模仿树叶外观。

**第6句：**
> This helps katydids hide from their predators.

👉 解释原因：拟态帮助蝈蝈躲避天敌。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                         |
|:---------|:-----------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍动物进化模仿其他生物或物体外貌 |
| 第二句   | 说明这种现象称为mimicry    |
| 第三句   | 举例：螃蟹蜘蛛模仿花朵       |
| 第四句   | 螃蟹蜘蛛用拟态伏击猎物       |
| 第五句   | 举例：蝈蝈模仿树叶           |
| 第六句   | 蝈蝈用拟态躲避捕食者         |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> Katydids mimic the appearance of flowers, and crab spiders mimic that of leaves.

错误原因：选项颠倒了两种动物的拟态对象，文中明确“crab spiders mimic flowers”，“katydids mimic leaves”。
错误类型：【方向相反】

**B 选项** ❌
> Katydids and crab spiders are two examples of animals that use mimicry.

错误原因：虽然陈述正确，但未强调两者拟态用途的差异，不符合“强调区别”的题意。
错误类型：【以偏概全】

**C 选项** ✅
> Unlike crab spiders, which use mimicry to ambush prey, katydids use mimicry to hide from predators.

正确原因：准确反映了文中两种动物拟态的不同功能，且用了“Unlike”强调对比，符合题目要求。

**D 选项** ❌
> Animals that use mimicry have evolved to resemble another animal, plant, or object.

错误原因：此句为定义性陈述，没有涉及两者拟态用途的区别，不符合题意。
错误类型：【无中生有】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于识别题干“强调差异”的要求，注意选项中是否体现了两者拟态用途的不同（伏击猎物 vs 躲避捕食者）；关键词“Unlike”锁定对比关系，排除无差异描述或错误信息的选项。通过对照文中第4句和第6句信息，准确判断答案。

Thailand’s annual Songkran Water Festival is held each April.

stem: The student wants to emphasize a similarity in how people in Bangkok and Chiang Mai celebrate Songkran. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.content: The largest water fight in Bangkok takes place along a city street, whereas the largest water fight in Chiang Mai takes place at a historical monument.
In both Bangkok and Chiang Mai, thousands gather to celebrate Songkran with water fights.
People in both Bangkok and Chiang Mai celebrate Songkran, but they don’t do so in exactly the same way.
Each April, people in Thailand celebrate Songkran, the traditional Thai New Year.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

这是细节对比题，核心任务是找出能够强调曼谷和清迈庆祝宋干节相似性的选项。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Thailand’s annual Songkran Water Festival is held each April.
👉 介绍节日的时间和名称（背景信息）。

**第2句：**
> It marks Songkran, the traditional Thai New Year.
👉 解释节日的意义。

**第3句：**
> People splash and spray each other for fun at the festival’s community-wide water fights.
👉 描述节日的主要活动。

**第4句：**
> In Bangkok, thousands gather along Silom Road for the city’s largest water fight.
👉 描述曼谷庆祝活动的具体地点和规模。

**第5句：**
> In Chiang Mai, thousands gather at a historical monument called the Tha Phae Gate for the city’s largest water fight.
👉 描述清迈庆祝活动的具体地点和规模。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                              |
|:---------|:---------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍宋干节时间和名称              |
| 第二句   | 解释宋干节是泰国传统新年          |
| 第三句   | 描述节日活动：泼水嬉戏            |
| 第四句   | 曼谷在Silom路举行最大规模水战      |
| 第五句   | 清迈在Tha Phae Gate举行最大规模水战 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> The largest water fight in Bangkok takes place along a city street, whereas the largest water fight in Chiang Mai takes place at a historical monument.
该选项强调的是两地地点的不同，突出差异而非相似性，违背题干强调“相似”的要求。
错误类型：【方向相反】

**B 选项** ✅
> In both Bangkok and Chiang Mai, thousands gather to celebrate Songkran with water fights.
该选项准确使用了“thousands gather”和“water fights”两点共同信息，强调两地庆祝活动的相似性，符合题干要求。

**C 选项** ❌
> People in both Bangkok and Chiang Mai celebrate Songkran, but they don’t do so in exactly the same way.
该选项强调差异，明确指出“不完全一样”，与题干要求强调相似性相悖。
错误类型：【方向相反】

**D 选项** ❌
> Each April, people in Thailand celebrate Songkran, the traditional Thai New Year.
该选项陈述的是宋干节的时间和意义，但没有涉及曼谷和清迈的相似庆祝方式，信息不相关。
错误类型：【无中生有】

---

## 核心解题技巧

**第1句：**
> Soo Sunny Park is a Korean American artist who uses light as her primary medium of expression.

👉 介绍艺术家身份及其创作媒介。

| 第二句   | 说明作品名称和创作时间 |

**B 选项** ❌
> Korean American light artist Soo Sunny Park created *Unwoven Light* in 2013.

---

**C 选项** ❌
> The chain-link fence in Soo Sunny Park’s *Unwoven Light* was fitted with tiles made from iridescent plexiglass.

**D 选项** ✅

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于识别题干“向陌生听众介绍作品”的需求，要求信息完整且准确。注意原文中艺术家身份（Korean American artist Soo Sunny Park）、作品名称和时间（*Unwoven Light*, 2013）、作品构成（chain-link fence + iridescent plexiglass tiles）以及作品效果（light形成彩色棱镜）均需体现。选项中若表达不准确（偷换概念）或信息不全（以偏概全），均可排除。选项D准确整合所有关键信息，故为正确答案。

While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
In astronomy, the mass of stars can be described in units called solar masses.
One solar mass is roughly equal to the mass of the Sun.
The mass of the star Proxima Centauri is 0.122 solar masses.
The mass of the star Sirius A is 2.063 solar masses.
stem: The student wants to emphasize the mass of Sirius A. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.content: The mass of stars, like Proxima Centauri, can be described in units called solar masses.
In astronomy, the mass of stars can be described in units called solar masses, and one solar mass is roughly equal to the mass of the Sun.
The Sun is more massive than Proxima Centauri, which has a mass of 0.122 solar masses.
With a mass of 2.063 solar masses, Sirius A is more massive than the Sun.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

本题为信息整合与表达效果题，核心任务是选择最有效利用给定笔记信息强调“Sirius A”的质量的表达。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> In astronomy, the mass of stars can be described in units called solar masses.

👉 介绍专业术语“solar masses”，为后文描述星体质量提供单位基础。

**第2句：**
> One solar mass is roughly equal to the mass of the Sun.

👉 解释“solar mass”的定义，帮助理解质量单位与太阳质量的对应关系。

**第3句：**
> The mass of the star Proxima Centauri is 0.122 solar masses.

👉 举例说明某星体的质量大小，体现单位的具体应用。

**第4句：**
> The mass of the star Sirius A is 2.063 solar masses.

👉 直接给出Sirius A的质量数据，是本题强调的重点信息。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                   |
|:---------|:--------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍“solar masses”作为星体质量单位    |
| 第二句   | 定义1个solar mass约等于太阳的质量      |
| 第三句   | 举例Proxima Centauri的质量为0.122太阳质量 |
| 第四句   | 给出Sirius A的质量为2.063太阳质量       |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> The mass of stars, like Proxima Centauri, can be described in units called solar masses.

错误原因：只提及了Proxima Centauri和单位定义，未涉及Sirius A，未达到强调Sirius A质量的目的。【方向相反】

**B 选项** ❌
> In astronomy, the mass of stars can be described in units called solar masses, and one solar mass is roughly equal to the mass of the Sun.

错误原因：只是说明单位定义，没有涉及任何具体星体质量，更无强调Sirius A的信息。【无中生有】

**C 选项** ❌
> The Sun is more massive than Proxima Centauri, which has a mass of 0.122 solar masses.

错误原因：比较的是太阳和Proxima Centauri，与强调Sirius A无关，且没有突出Sirius A质量。【方向相反】

**D 选项** ✅
> With a mass of 2.063 solar masses, Sirius A is more massive than the Sun.

正确原因：直接引用了Sirius A的质量数据，且明确强调其比太阳更重，最有效利用了笔记信息，完成题目目标。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于定位题干“强调Sirius A的质量”，需找含有Sirius A质量数据的选项。注意选项中是否直接提及“Sirius A”和其质量数值，及是否与太阳质量比较突出其重要性。排除未提及Sirius A或侧重点错误的选项，锁定D选项。

article:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
The Million Song Dataset (MSD) includes main audio features and descriptive tags for popular songs.
Audio features include acoustic traits such as loudness and pitch intervals.
Many algorithms use these audio features to predict a new song’s popularity.
These algorithms may fail to accurately identify main audio features of a song with varying acoustic traits.
Algorithms based on descriptive tags that describe fixed traits such as genre are more reliable predictors of song popularity.
stem: The student wants to explain a disadvantage of relying on audio features to predict a song's popularity. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.content: Algorithms based on audio features may misidentify the main features of a song with varying acoustic traits, making such algorithms less reliable predictors of popularity than those based on fixed traits.
The MSD’s descriptive tags are reliable predictors of a song's popularity, as the traits they describe are fixed.

Audio features describe acoustic traits such as pitch intervals, which may vary within a song, whereas descriptive tags describe fixed traits such as genre, which are reliable predictors of popularity.
Many popularity-predicting algorithms are based on a song's audio features, such as loudness and pitch intervals.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

这是细节理解题，核心任务是从学生笔记中找出关于“依赖音频特征预测歌曲流行度的缺点”的相关信息，并用其准确解释该缺点。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> The Million Song Dataset (MSD) includes main audio features and descriptive tags for popular songs.
👉 介绍MSD数据集包含两类信息：音频特征和描述性标签。

**第2句：**
> Audio features include acoustic traits such as loudness and pitch intervals.
👉 说明音频特征的内容，具体指声学特征。

**第3句：**
> Many algorithms use these audio features to predict a new song’s popularity.
👉 说明已有许多算法用音频特征来预测歌曲流行度。

**第4句：**
> These algorithms may fail to accurately identify main audio features of a song with varying acoustic traits.
👉 指出基于音频特征的算法缺点：对变化的声学特征识别不准确。

**第5句：**
> Algorithms based on descriptive tags that describe fixed traits such as genre are more reliable predictors of song popularity.
👉 对比说明基于描述性标签（固定特征）的算法更可靠。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                             |
|:---------|:------------------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 介绍MSD数据集包含音频特征和描述性标签             |
| 第二句   | 说明音频特征具体指声学特征（响度、音高间隔等）     |
| 第三句   | 许多算法用音频特征预测歌曲流行度                   |
| 第四句   | 基于音频特征的算法可能无法准确识别变化的声学特征   |
| 第五句   | 基于描述性标签（固定特征）的算法更可靠             |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅（正确）
> Algorithms based on audio features may misidentify the main features of a song with varying acoustic traits, making such algorithms less reliable predictors of popularity than those based on fixed traits.
该选项准确反映第4句和第5句信息，指出音频特征算法在变化声学特征面前表现欠佳，且可靠性不及基于固定特征的算法，完美解释了缺点。

**B 选项** ❌（错误）【无中生有】
> The MSD’s descriptive tags are reliable predictors of a song's popularity, as the traits they describe are fixed.
该选项虽然正确描述了描述性标签的优点，但题干要求解释音频特征预测的缺点，选项并未涉及音频特征的缺陷，偏离题意。

**C 选项** ❌（错误）【以偏概全】
> Audio features describe acoustic traits such as pitch intervals, which may vary within a song, whereas descriptive tags describe fixed traits such as genre, which are reliable predictors of popularity.
该选项陈述了音频特征和描述性标签的区别，但未明确指出基于音频特征预测流行度的缺点，只是对比性质，缺乏对“缺点”的直接说明。

**D 选项** ❌（错误）【无中生有】
> Many popularity-predicting algorithms are based on a song's audio features, such as loudness and pitch intervals.
该选项仅陈述音频特征被广泛使用，未提及其缺点，不能解释题干要求的“缺点”，信息不相关。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题核心在于锁定题干关键词“disadvantage”（缺点），快速定位第4句（音频特征算法可能失败）和第5句（描述标签算法更可靠）相关内容，排除只讲优点或事实陈述的选项，选择既说明缺点又对比优势的答案。转折词“may fail”与比较结构“more reliable”是关键线索，帮助准确选出A选项。

article:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
Some powerful works of literature have so influenced readers that new legislation has been passed as a result.
The Interesting Narrative of the Life of Olaudah Equiano (1789) is the autobiography of a man who endured slavery on both sides of the Atlantic.
Equiano's book contributed to the passage of the Slave Trade Act of 1807.
The Jungle (1906) is a fictional work by Upton Sinclair that describes unsanitary conditions in US meatpacking plants.
Sinclair’s book contributed to the passage of the Pure Food and Drug Act in 1906.
stem: The student wants to emphasize a difference between the two books. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.content: They may have written about different topics, but Equiano and Sinclair both influenced readers.
The 1807 Slave Trade Act resulted in part from a book by Equiano, while the 1906 Pure Food and Drug Act resulted in part from a book by Sinclair.
The Interesting Narrative of the Life of Olaudah Equiano and The Jungle are two works of literature that contributed to new legislation (concerning the slave trade and food safety, respectively).
Although both are powerful works of literature that contributed to new legislation, Equiano's book is an autobiography, while Sinclair's is fictional.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

本题为细节对比题，核心任务是利用笔记中提供的信息，准确找出两本书之间的区别并进行强调。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> Some powerful works of literature have so influenced readers that new legislation has been passed as a result.

👉 介绍主题，提出观点：文学作品能影响读者并促成立法。

**第2句：**
> *The Interesting Narrative of the Life of Olaudah Equiano* (1789) is the autobiography of a man who endured slavery on both sides of the Atlantic.

👉 介绍第一本书的基本信息，说明其为自传。

**第3句：**
> Equiano's book contributed to the passage of the Slave Trade Act of 1807.

👉 说明第一本书对具体立法的影响。

**第4句：**
> *The Jungle* (1906) is a fictional work by Upton Sinclair that describes unsanitary conditions in US meatpacking plants.

👉 介绍第二本书的基本信息，说明其为虚构作品。

**第5句：**
> Sinclair’s book contributed to the passage of the Pure Food and Drug Act in 1906.

👉 说明第二本书对具体立法的影响。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 总述文学作品影响立法的主题 |
| 第二句 | 介绍Equiano的自传背景 |
| 第三句 | 说明Equiano书籍促成奴隶贸易法案 |
| 第四句 | 介绍Sinclair的虚构作品背景 |
| 第五句 | 说明Sinclair书籍促成食品安全法案 |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> They may have written about different topics, but Equiano and Sinclair both influenced readers.

错误原因：该选项强调的是两书的相似点——都影响了读者，而非题干要求的“强调两书的不同点”。【方向相反】

**B 选项** ❌
> The 1807 Slave Trade Act resulted in part from a book by Equiano, while the 1906 Pure Food and Drug Act resulted in part from a book by Sinclair.

错误原因：此选项只是陈述两本书都影响了立法，未强调两书之间的区别，未完成“强调差异”的任务。【方向相反】

**C 选项** ❌
> *The Interesting Narrative of the Life of Olaudah Equiano* and *The Jungle* are two works of literature that contributed to new legislation (concerning the slave trade and food safety, respectively).

错误原因：该选项同样强调的是两书的相似功能（促成立法），并未突出它们的不同之处。【方向相反】

**D 选项** ✅
> Although both are powerful works of literature that contributed to new legislation, Equiano's book is an autobiography, while Sinclair's is fictional.

正确原因：准确利用笔记信息，突出两书的不同点——一本是自传，一本是虚构作品，符合题干“强调不同”的要求。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 题干要求强调两书的不同，解题时需关注转折词“difference”、“although”等，锁定对比句型。选项中若只强调相似点则可排除；只有D选项明确指出“自传”与“虚构”的区别，符合题干意图。注意利用文章中明确的类别信息（autobiography vs. fictional）来做出准确判断。

---

In 2012, Video Game High School premiered on RocketJump; it would later be nominated for an award.

## 题目类型说明

叙述开头选择题，核心任务是选出最有效利用笔记内容、恰当开篇介绍Wong获奖提名的网络剧的句子。

> Freddie Wong (born 1985) is a director and special effects artist from the United States.

> *VGHS* premiered in 2012 on RocketJump, a YouTube channel that Wong cocreated.

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                   |

| 第一句   | 介绍Freddie Wong身份                   |
| 第二句   | 指出他最著名的作品是*Video Game High School* |

| 第四句   | 评价该剧的创新世界观和特效质量           |

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> *Video Game High School* was celebrated for its inventive video game–centric world and high-quality special effects, and it was nominated for a Producer's Guild Award for Outstanding Digital Series.

错误原因：此选项遗漏了Wong作为创作者的信息，且“Producer's Guild Award”写法错误（原文为Producers Guild Award），信息不完整。

**B 选项** ❌

错误类型：【表达不清】

**C 选项** ✅
> In 2012, director and visual effects artist Freddie Wong launched a new action-comedy web series: *Video Game High School*.

**D 选项** ❌

错误原因：此句未提及Wong身份，且“would later be nominated”语气不够直接，且“an award”泛指，缺乏具体性。
错误类型：【信息不全】【语气不明确】

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于选出既明确介绍Wong身份，又清晰交代作品名称和时间的句子。注意时间状语“In 2012”定位叙述起点，避免使用未来时态或模糊表述。正确答案C条理清晰，信息全面，符合叙述开头的要求；而其他选项或信息缺失，或语气不合，或表达模糊，均可排除。

While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
As engineered structures, many bird nests are uniquely flexible yet cohesive.
A research team led by Yashraj Bhosale wanted to better understand the mechanics behind these structural properties.
Bhosale’s team used laboratory models that simulated the arrangement of flexible sticks into nest-like structures.
The researchers analyzed the points where sticks touched one another.
When pressure was applied to the model nests, the number of contact points between the sticks increased, making the structures stiffer.
stem: The student wants to present the primary aim of the research study. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.content: The researchers used laboratory models that simulated the arrangement of flexible sticks and analyzed the points where sticks touched one another.
As analyzed by Bhosale's team, bird nests are uniquely flexible yet cohesive engineered structures.
Bhosale’s team wanted to better understand the mechanics behind bird nests' uniquely flexible yet cohesive structural properties.
After analyzing the points where sticks touched, the researchers found that the structures became stiffer when pressure was applied.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

本题为主旨概括题，核心任务是准确提炼研究的主要目的，要求根据笔记内容选择最能表达研究核心目标的选项。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> As engineered structures, many bird nests are uniquely flexible yet cohesive.

👉 描述鸟巢的结构特性，提出研究对象的特点。

**第2句：**
> A research team led by Yashraj Bhosale wanted to better understand the mechanics behind these structural properties.

👉 明确研究团队的研究目的，即理解鸟巢结构特性的机制。

**第3句：**
> Bhosale’s team used laboratory models that simulated the arrangement of flexible sticks into nest-like structures.

👉 介绍研究方法，模拟鸟巢结构。

**第4句：**
> The researchers analyzed the points where sticks touched one another.

👉 进一步说明具体的研究细节，分析接触点。

**第5句：**
> When pressure was applied to the model nests, the number of contact points between the sticks increased, making the structures stiffer.

👉 说明研究发现，因果关系：压力增加导致接触点增加，结构变硬。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容                                 |
|:---------|:------------------------------------|
| 第一句   | 描述鸟巢结构的灵活且有凝聚力的特性     |
| 第二句   | 说明研究团队的目的：理解这种结构特性的机制 |
| 第三句   | 介绍实验方法：使用模拟模型              |
| 第四句   | 说明研究细节：分析接触点                |
| 第五句   | 研究结果：压力增加导致结构变硬           |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> The researchers used laboratory models that simulated the arrangement of flexible sticks and analyzed the points where sticks touched one another.

该选项只描述了研究方法和细节，没有体现研究的主要目的。
错误类型：【以偏概全】

**B 选项** ❌
> As analyzed by Bhosale's team, bird nests are uniquely flexible yet cohesive engineered structures.

该选项描述的是鸟巢的特性，而非研究的主要目的或研究内容。
错误类型：【无中生有】

**C 选项** ✅
> Bhosale’s team wanted to better understand the mechanics behind bird nests' uniquely flexible yet cohesive structural properties.

该选项准确表达了研究的核心目的，与第二句内容完全对应，是研究的主旨。

**D 选项** ❌
> After analyzing the points where sticks touched, the researchers found that the structures became stiffer when pressure was applied.

该选项描述的是研究的发现，而非研究的主要目标。
错误类型：【以偏概全】

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题关键在于区分“研究目的”与“研究方法”或“研究结果”，题干要求呈现研究的“primary aim”，即第二句中明确的“wanted to better understand…”，注意选项中是否直接体现“目的”词汇，排除仅描述方法（A）、发现（D）或对象特性（B）的选项。使用关键词“wanted to better understand”锁定答案C。

## 题目类型说明

本题为信息整合题，核心任务是从笔记中提取并整合解释与举例信息，形成对Oliveros《Sonic Meditations》的有效说明。

**第1句：**

👉 明确界定作品性质，区分作品与传统音乐的不同。

**第3句：**
> Each meditation consists of instructions for participants to make, imagine, listen to, or remember sounds.

👉 解释作品的构成形式——一系列包含指令的练习。

**第4句：**
> The instructions for Meditation V state, "walk so silently that the bottoms of your feet become ears."

👉 举例说明其中一则具体的练习指令。

| 第3句    | 说明练习由指令构成，涉及声音的制作、想象、聆听等 |

| 第5句    | 例示Meditation XVIII的具体指令                   |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ✅（正确）
> *Sonic Meditations* is not music but rather a series of sound-based meditations that consist of instructions; Meditation XVIII, for instance, instructs participants to “listen to a sound until you no longer recognize it.”

正确。选项准确说明了作品的性质（非音乐而是指令练习），且用Meditation XVIII的具体指令作为例证，完全符合题目要求的“解释和举例”。
原文依据：第2句（性质）、第3句（由指令构成）、第5句（Meditation XVIII例子）。

**B 选项** ❌（错误）

**C 选项** ❌（错误）
> In 1971, Oliveros created *Sonic Meditations*, a series of meditations that consist of instructions for participants to make, imagine, listen to, or remember sounds.

错误。该选项只给出了背景和组成说明，缺少具体例子，未能满足“解释和举例”两方面的要求。
错误类型：【信息不全】

**D 选项** ❌（错误）
> “Walk so silently that the bottoms of your feet become ears” is one example of the instructions found in Oliveros’s *Sonic Meditations*.

错误。该选项仅给出举例，缺少对作品性质或整体说明，未体现解释功能。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题要求“解释+举例”，应重点关注含有作品性质说明的句子（第2句、第3句）和具体指令的例子（第4、5句）。选项中既需体现作品的定义（如“非音乐而是指令练习”），又需包含具体例子才能符合题意。排除只给背景、只举例或仅对比的选项，锁定同时满足解释与举例的选项A。

While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
British musicians John Lennon and Paul McCartney shared writing credit for numerous Beatles songs.
Many Lennon-McCartney songs were actually written by either Lennon or McCartney, not by both.
The exact authorship of specific parts of many Beatles songs, such as the verse for "In My Life," is disputed.
Mark Glickman, Jason Brown, and Ryan Song used statistical methods to analyze the musical content of Beatles songs.
They concluded that there is 18.9% probability that McCartney wrote the verse for "In My Life," stating that the verse is "consistent with Lennon's songwriting style."
stem: The student wants to make a generalization about the kind of study conducted by Glickman, Brown, and Song. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.content: Based on statistical analysis, Glickman, Brown, and Song claim that John Lennon wrote the verse of "In My Life."
There is only an 18.9% probability that Paul McCartney wrote the verse for "In My Life"; John Lennon is the more likely author.
It is likely that John Lennon, not Paul McCartney, wrote the verse for "In My Life."
Researchers have used statistical methods to address questions of authorship within the field of music.

text_analysis:
---

## 题目类型说明

本题是归纳概括题，核心任务是根据给出的笔记信息，选出最能概括Glickman、Brown和Song所进行研究性质的选项。

---

## 文章逻辑拆解

**第1句：**
> British musicians John Lennon and Paul McCartney shared writing credit for numerous Beatles songs.

👉 介绍背景信息，指出Lennon和McCartney共同署名创作许多歌曲。

**第2句：**
> Many Lennon-McCartney songs were actually written by either Lennon or McCartney, not by both.

👉 说明事实，强调很多歌曲实际上由其中一人单独创作。

**第3句：**
> The exact authorship of specific parts of many Beatles songs, such as the verse for "In My Life," is disputed.

👉 提出问题，说明具体部分的作者身份存在争议。

**第4句：**
> Mark Glickman, Jason Brown, and Ryan Song used statistical methods to analyze the musical content of Beatles songs.

👉 介绍研究方法，指出三位研究者使用统计方法分析歌曲内容。

**第5句：**
> They concluded that there is 18.9% probability that McCartney wrote the verse for "In My Life," stating that the verse is "consistent with Lennon's songwriting style."

👉 给出研究结论，说明McCartney写该段的概率较低，且该段更符合Lennon的风格。

---

## 结构总结

| 段落位置 | 内容 |
|:---------|:-----|
| 第一句 | 介绍Lennon和McCartney共同署名创作歌曲的事实 |
| 第二句 | 说明很多歌曲由单独一人创作 |
| 第三句 | 指出具体歌曲部分作者身份存在争议 |
| 第四句 | 介绍三位研究者采用统计方法分析歌曲 |
| 第五句 | 给出研究结论，低概率为McCartney写作，风格更像Lennon |

---

## 逐项分析选项

**A 选项** ❌
> Based on statistical analysis, Glickman, Brown, and Song claim that John Lennon wrote the verse of "In My Life."

错误原因：原文只是给出McCartney写作的概率是18.9%，并未明确断言Lennon写了该段，只说风格“consistent with Lennon’s songwriting style”，没有claim Lennon写作。【过度推断】

**B 选项** ❌
> There is only an 18.9% probability that Paul McCartney wrote the verse for "In My Life"; John Lennon is the more likely author.

错误原因：同样，原文仅说明McCartney概率低，但并未直接声明Lennon是更可能的作者，只说风格相符，不能确定作者身份。【过度推断】

**C 选项** ❌
> It is likely that John Lennon, not Paul McCartney, wrote the verse for "In My Life."

错误原因：与B选项错误类型相同，原文没有明确表明Lennon写作的可能性，只是说McCartney概率低，风格与Lennon相符，不能断定“likely”。【过度推断】

**D 选项** ✅
> Researchers have used statistical methods to address questions of authorship within the field of music.

正确原因：准确总结了第四句和第五句内容，强调“使用统计方法研究音乐作品作者身份的问题”，符合题干要求的“对研究性质的概括”。

---

## 核心解题技巧

> 💡 本题的关键在于识别笔记中关于研究方法和结论的表述，特别是“statistical methods”（统计方法）和“authorship questions”（作者身份问题）是锁定答案D的核心信息。其他选项均对结论做出过度推断，而题干要求的是对研究性质的“泛化描述”，所以要避免选项中出现明确断定作者身份的表述。
